action: Refer to additional message(s) for details.

cause: Attempt to reopen disk failed.
action: Ensure that the disk is functioning properly.

cause: Specified ASM file does not exist.
action: Correct the ASM file number or name specified for extract.

description: Disk N%04u is in currently mounted diskgroup %s.
cause: Specified ASM file does not exist.
action: Ensure that the ASM file number or name is specified correctly.

description: Disk N%04u open failed during deep discovery.
cause: Attempt to open disk failed during discovery.
action: Ensure that the disk is functioning properly.

description: Shallow discovery failed for %s with asmlib %s.
cause: Attempt to discover ASMLIB disks failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Shallow discovery failed for %s.
cause: Attempt to discover disks failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: File directory block not found. Cannot extract file %s.
cause: File directory block for specified file is out of bounds.
action: Correct the ASM file number or name specified for extract.

description: Corrupt block found: Disk N%04u AU [%u] block [%u] type [%u]
cause: Block validation failed for reported block
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: No disks found in diskgroup %s
cause: No disks were discovered for the specified disk group.
action: Ensure that the disk group name is entered correctly and that the member disks are discoverable.

description: Inconsistent disks in diskgroup %s.
cause: Disk discovery discovered disks with identical names in multiple disk groups.
action: Specify the disk discovery string so as to avoid doscovery of disks with nonunique names.

description: Scan of diskgroup %s does not appear in report.
cause: AMDU cannot locate information about the specified disk group in the report file.
action: Ensure that the -directory option points to a directory with a report file and dump for the specified disk group.

description: Disk N%04u not found for group %s
cause: AMDU encountered a map file entry for a disk that does not exist in the the report file. The mapfile may have been corrupted.
action: Re-create the original dump. If the operation still fails, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Image files were not created for diskgroup %s.
cause: The original AMDU dump request specified -noimage.
action: Re-create the AMDU dump including image files.

description: Mirror miscompares on %u blocks of file %s
cause: Comparison of mirrored blocks revealed mismatches.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: 0xbadfda7a written to %u blocks of file %s
cause: AMDU was unable to read a number of blocks from the disk. It has written "0xbadfda7a" in place of these blocks.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Invalid block num1 = [%s], num2 = [%s], error = [%s]
cause: Block validation failed with reported block
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Voting file not found. Cannot extract file %s.
cause: Voting file is not present in specified disk group.
action: Ensure that the disk group name is specified correctly.

description: Inconsistent block found: Disk N%04u AU [%u] block [%u] type [%u].
cause: Block validation failed when the disk group was mounted.
action: Dismount the disk group and try the operation again.

description: request to extract file %s rejected
cause: An attempt was made to extract a file type that could not be extracted.
action: Ensure that the file number specified is for a file type that is permitted for extraction.

description: Request %s rejected on client cluster for security reasons.
cause: An attempt to dump, print, or extract disk group data on a client cluster failed.
action: Contact the ASM server administrator to dump the disk group data from server side.

description: diskgroup '%s' does not exist or is not mounted
cause: An operation failed because the diskgroup specified did not exist or was not mounted by the current Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance.
action: Verify that the diskgroup name specified is valid, that the diskgroup exists, and that the diskgroup is mounted by the current Oracle ASM instance.

description: entry '%s' does not exist in directory '%s'
cause: The specified path contained elements that did not exist.
action: Specify an existing Oracle ASM file path.

description: command disallowed by current instance type
cause: ASMCMD was connected to an instance with an instance type other than Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM).
action: Ensure you are connecting to an instance whose INSTANCE_TYPE parameter is Oracle ASM.

description: Oracle ASM file path '%s' contains an invalid alias name
cause: The path specified contained an invalid alias name.
action: Specify a valid path.

description: directory '%s' is ambiguous
cause: The directory on which the command was executed translated to multiple matches.
action: Specify a unique directory string.

description: entry '%s' does not refer to an existing directory
cause: The 'cd' command failed as the specified path did not exist.
action: Specify an existing Oracle ASM file path.

description: unclosed single quotation mark
cause: The input did not contain a closing single quotation mark.
action: Close the single quotation mark properly.

description: both source '%s' and target '%s' cannot be from remote instances
cause: The 'copy' command specified both source and target files that were on remote instances.
action: Either the source file or the target file can be on the remote instance, but not both.

description: more than one source file specified, one of which is remote
cause: The 'copy' command specified multiple source files, at least one of which was remote.
action: When there are multiple source files, all of them must be on the local node only.

description: user name is not specified in remote instance connect string '%s'
cause: The user name was not specified in the remote instance connect string.
action: Specify the user name in the remote instance connect string.

description: instance identifier is not specified in the remote instance connect string '%s'
cause: An instance identifier was not specified in the remote instance connect string.
action: Specify an instance identifier in the remote instance connect string.

description: cannot determine file type for file
cause: The file type was incompatible with the copy operation.
action: Specify file types which are supported by Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) such as CONTROLFILE, DATAFILE, etc.

description: cannot determine logical block size for file '%s'
cause: During the copy operation, the logical block size of the indicated file could not be determined. The file is corrupted or it is an internal error.
action: Ensure that the source and destination files are valid and retry. If the source and destination files are valid, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: file '%s' does not exist
cause: The file specified did not exist or is a directory.
action: Specify a file that exists and make sure it is not a directory.

description: child '%s' cannot be on remote instance
cause: The 'setsparseparent' command specified a child file that was on a remote instance.
action: The child file cannot be on a remote instance.

description: copy source '%s' and target '%s' failed
cause: The 'copy' command was not successful.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: setting parent of child '%s' to new parent '%s' failed
cause: The 'setsparseparent' command was not successful.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: more than one child file specified, one of which is remote
cause: The 'setsparseparent' command specified multiple child files, at least one of which was remote.
action: When there are multiple child files, all of them must be on the local node only.

description: parent '%s' cannot be on remote instance
cause: The 'setsparseparent' command specified a parent file that was on a remote instance.
action: The parent file cannot be on a remote instance.

description: could not write into trace file
cause: Writing to the trace file failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: password cannot contain the following characters $%%^&*()<>'" or tab
cause: Invalid characters were found in the specified password.
action: Supply a password which does not contain $%%^&*()<>'\" or tab.

description: unknown command '%s' specified
cause: An unknown command was specified.
action: Enter a valid command; 'asmcmd help' will list valid commands.

description: copying password file using Oracle ASM requires software version '%s' or later on host '%s'
cause: A request to copy a password file was issued to an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance whose version did not support that operation.
action: Upgrade Oracle ASM to version 12.1 or later.

description: file number could not be determined for alias name '%s'
cause: The attempt to determine the file number for the specified alias was unsuccessful.
action: Ensure that the discovery string corresponds to disks for the specified disk group. The specified alias name may not be valid; ensure that it exists. If an ASM system file name was passed, then use the --sys_filename option.

description: Invalid file name specified. Absolute path name is required when there is no connection to Oracle ASM instance.
cause: The specified file name did not begin with '+'. It is therefore treated as a relative path name which requires a connection to Oracle Automatic Storage Management.
action: Specify an absolute path name for the file you wish to extract. Absolute path names begin with '+<diskgroup>'.

description: Password file '%s' is in use. Use the force option.
cause: A password file was specified, but it is used by other resources.
action: Use the force option to share the given password file with other resources.

description: Password file '%s' already exists. Use the force option to overwrite.
cause: An attempt to create a password file failed because it already existed.
action: Use the force option to overwrite an existing password file.

description: Password file '%s' is associated with '%s' already. Use the force option.
cause: A password file was specified for a CRS resource, which already has a password file associated with it.
action: Use the force option to associate new password file.

description: Cannot change diskgroup redundancy from '%(1)s' to '%(2)s'
cause: The disk group redundancy must be either NORMAL or HIGH to perform this operation.
action: Try again with a NORMAL or HIGH redundancy disk group.

description: file '%s' specified with 'sparse_merge_end' cannot be on remote instance
cause: The 'copy' command with the 'sparse_merge_end' option specified a file that was on a remote instance.
action: The file cannot be on a remote instance.

description: more than one file specified with 'sparse_merge_begin' option
cause: The 'copy' command specified multiple files with the 'sparse_merge_begin' option.
action: Multiple files cannot be specified with the 'sparse_merge_begin' option.

description: target '%s' cannot be on remote instance
cause: The 'copy' command with the 'sparse_merge_begin' and 'sparse_merge_end' options specified a target file that was on a remote instance.
action: The target file cannot be on a remote instance.

description: failure merging sparse files '%(1)s' through '%(2)s' to target '%(3)s'
cause: The 'copy' command with the 'sparse_merge_begin' and 'sparse_merge_end' options was not successful.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: sparse merge copy operation failure due to incorrect command syntax
cause: The 'copy' command with the 'sparse_merge_begin' and 'sparse_merge_end' options was not successful due to incorrect command syntax.
action: Check command line help for the correct syntax.

description: file specified with sparse_merge_begin and sparse_merge_end are the same - '%s'
cause: The 'copy' command specified same files for both the 'sparse_merge_begin' and 'sparse_merge_end' options.
action: Make sure files specified with the 'sparse_merge_begin' and 'sparse_merge_end' options are different.

description: file '%s' specified with 'sparse_merge_begin' cannot be on remote instance
cause: The 'copy' command with the 'sparse_merge_begin' option specified a file that was on a remote instance.
action: The file cannot be on a remote instance.

description: invalid system alias root path name '%s'
cause: An invalid system alias root path name was specified.
action: Ensure that the 'dest_dbname' option is a non-null, begins with an alphabetic character, and follows up with alphanumeric characters, underscore (_), number sign (#), or dollar sign ($), if dest_dbname is longer than one character.

description: invalid path to ASM system file name '%s'
cause: An invalid file path to an ASM system file name was specified.
action: Ensure that the provided ASM file name is not an alias, and that it points to an existing file. An ASM system file name follows the format <name>.<file_number>.<incarnation>.

description: disk group '%(1)s' does not match with the disk group in the file path '%(2)s'
cause: The specified disk group and the disk group in the file path were different.
action: Ensure that the provided disk group is the same as the disk group in the file path. If you use a relative path, then ensure that you are inside the desired disk group.

description: no disks found from disk group '%(1)s' in the discovery string '%(2)s'
cause: No disks from the given disk group were found in the specified discovery string.
action: Ensure that the provided discovery string exists and that it contains disks from the specified disk group.

description: The 'credverify' command cannot be executed; Oracle ASM is not running on the cluster.
cause: The specified command does not allow client access mode. Oracle ASM was not running on the local cluster.
action: Ensure that Oracle ASM is running on the local cluster by issuing the command 'srvctl status asm'.

description: no credentials in OCR
cause: There were no credentials in the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR).
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to create a working credential.

description: more than one credential in OCR
cause: There was more than one credential in the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) when there should have only been one.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command. This keeps the newest working credential and deletes the older ones.

description: more than one credential in the password file
cause: The password file had more than one credential when there should have only been one.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command. This keeps the newest working credential and deletes the older ones.

description: no credentials in the password file
cause: The password file had no credentials when there should be one.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to create a working credential.

description: credentials in the password file and Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) do not match
cause: The OCR and password file had mismatching credentials.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to make the credentials match.

description: Cannot connect to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) with Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) credentials
cause: Either the credentials in the OCR cannot be used to connect to Oracle ASM or the disk group is not mounted.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to create a working credential. If that does not work, check if the disk group is mounted.

description: no credentials in OLR on node %(1)s
cause: There were no credentials in the Oracle Local Registry (OLR)."
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to import credentials to OLR.

description: more than one credential in OLR on node %(1)s
cause: There was more than one credential in the Oracle Local Registry (OLR).
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to delete extra credentials.

description: credentials inconsistent on OCR and OLR on node %(1)s
cause: The credentials in the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) and Oracle Local Registry (OLR) did not match.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to create matching credentials.

description: failed to execute internal operation, see accompanying error messages or alert log.
cause: There was a failure executing an internal operation.
action: Try running the 'credverify' or 'credfix' command again, and examine the alert log for more information. Contact Oracle Support Services if not resolved.

description: failed to create new credentials
cause: The call to ASMCMD 'addcrscreds' command failed.
action: Rerun the command with '-v info' specified, and examine the ASMCMD trace files. Contact Oracle Support Services if not resolved.

description: could not import credentials to node %(1)s
cause: The call to ASMCMD 'credimport' command failed.
action: Rerun the command with '-v info' specified, and examine the ASMCMD trace files. Contact Oracle Support Services if not resolved.

description: could not delete Cluster Ready Services (CRS) credentials for user %(1)s
cause: The call to ASMCMD 'delcrscreds' command failed.
action: Rerun the command with '-v info' specified, and examine the ASMCMD trace files. Contact Oracle Support Services if not resolved.

description: failed to perform remote operation, see accompanying error messages
cause: There was a failure executing an operation using SSH or 'cluutil'.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Platform %(1)s is not supported for 'credverify' or 'credfix' commands. The supported platforms are %(2)s.
cause: Commands 'credverify' or 'credfix' could not be executed. The 'credverify' and 'credfix' commands require SSH capability. This is only supported for certain platforms.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot connect to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) with Oracle Local Registry (OLR) credentials on node %(1)s
cause: Either the credentials in OLR cannot be used to connect to Oracle ASM or the disk group is not mounted.
action: Execute the 'credfix' command to import working credentials to the OLR. If that does not work, check if the disk group is mounted.

description: The 'credfix' command must be run on a node with a local Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance.
cause: There is an error executing the 'credfix' command. These commands are being run on a node without a local Oracle ASM instance.
action: Run the 'credfix' command on a node with a local Oracle ASM instance.

description: The ORACLE_SID parameter is not set.
cause: The ORACLE_SID parameter was not set.
action: Set the ORACLE_SID parameter.

description: SSH equivalency is not set up between all nodes in the cluster.
cause: SSH equivalency was not set up between the nodes in the cluster.
action: Set up SSH equivalency for the 'credverify' or 'credfix' commands to work.

description: The ORACLE_HOME parameter is not set.
cause: The ORACLE_HOME parameter was not set.
action: Set the ORACLE_HOME parameter.

description: ASM root credential domain does not exist in node %(1)s.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) root credential domain did not exist on the specified node.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root' as a root user.

description: Oracle High Availability Services is not running on nodes %(1)s.
cause: Oracle High Availability Services was not running on the listed nodes.
action: Execute 'crsctl start has' on all of the listed nodes in order for the 'credverify' and 'credfix' commands to work.

description: ASM root credential domain does not exist on Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR).
cause: The root credential domain did not exist on the OCR.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root' as a root user.

description: The command 'credfix --root' must be run as a root user.
cause: The command 'credfix --root' was not run as root.
action: Execute the command 'credfix -root' as a root user.

description: The command 'credfix' needs the --root flag to fix existing issues.
cause: The command 'credfix' ran without the '--root' flag.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root --giuser <giuser>' as a root user to fix existing issues.

description: Oracle Flex ASM is not enabled.
cause: Oracle Flex ASM was not enabled.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root' to enable Oracle Flex ASM.

description: The command 'credfix --root' must be run with option '--giuser <giuser>' specified.
cause: The command 'credfix --root' was run without the option '--giuser <giuser>' specified.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root --giuser <giuser>'.

description: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain has incorrect permissions.
cause: The Oracle ASM credential domain did not have the correct permissions for a Grid user.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root --giuser <giuser>' as a root user.

description: Invalid file name specified '%(1)s'. Absolute path name is required for operating system files.
cause: The specified file was not an absolute operating system path. Operating system paths must be absolute path names.
action: Specify an absolute path name for the operating system file.

description: invalid '--local' option for source path and destination path
cause: An attempt was made to use the '--local' option when either copying a file from one ASM disk group to another or from one operating system file path to another.
action: Remove the '--local' option or specify a different source or destination file.

description: encountered operating system error %(1)s when opening file %(2)s
cause: The operating system file could not be opened because of an internal operating system error.
action: Check the root cause of the operating system error and try the process again.

description: encountered operating system error %(1)s when closing file %(2)s
cause: The operating system file could not be closed because of an internal operating system error.
action: Check the root cause of the operating system error and try the process again.

description: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain did not exist on the node.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) did not exist on the specified node.
action: Process the command 'credfix' to fix the credentials.

description: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain did not exist on the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR).
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain did not exist on the OCR.
action: Process the command 'credfix' to fix the credentials.

description: 'credverify' or 'credfix' cannot proceed due to incorrect Oracle ASM listener setup
cause: A connection to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) failed as a result of an incorrect Oracle ASM listener setup. The credentials may not be incorrect.
action: Ensure that the Oracle ASM listener is running, and then try processing 'credverify' or 'credfix' again.

description: The '%s' command is only supported on Oracle Exadata.
cause: The command was rejected because it is only supported on Oracle Exadata.
action: Ensure that the command is being run on Oracle Exadata.

description: The PDB GUID '%(1)s' does not exist in target ASM disk group.
cause: The PDB GUID that was provided as a command option could not be found in the target ASM disk group.
action: Ensure that the PDB GUID option is a valid system alias directory in the target ASM disk group.

description: 'credverify' or 'credfix' cannot proceed because service +ASM is not registered with the listener on the host
cause: A connection to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) failed as a result of an incorrect Oracle ASM listener setup. The credentials may not be incorrect.
action: Ensure that the +ASM service is registered with the listener on the host, and then try processing 'credverify' or 'credfix' again.

description: The '%s' command is not supported under Windows
cause: This command is no longer supported under Windows.
action: Enter a valid command; 'asmcmd help' will list valid commands.

description: no connection to Oracle ASM; command requires Oracle ASM to run
cause: A command that requires Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) processing was issued but there was no connection to an Oracle ASM instance.
action: Start the Oracle ASM instance and retry the command.

description: failed to connect to ASM; ASMCMD running in non-connected mode, ORACLE_SID='%(1)s'
cause: An attempt to connect to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) was made using ORACLE_SID='%(1)s' but the connection failed.
action: Check the accompanying error messages in case the operation fails. If Oracle ASM is required, then start the ASM instance and retry the command.

description: Oracle ASM not available %s
cause: During a copy operation, connection to the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance on the remote node failed.
action: Check ASMCMD alert log for more information.

description: internal error: %s
cause: There was an internal error.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: The executable '%(1)s' failed its execution.
cause: An issue occurred when executing the binary, which could be a signal, a coredump, or an error return code from the binary.
action: Check accompanying error messages in the alert log.

description: invalid SPFILE '%s'
cause: The specified server parameter file did not have a valid file type, a valid file size, or a valid block size.
action: Specify a valid server parameter file.

description: invalid ORACLE ASM SPFILE '%s'
cause: The specified ORACLE ASM SPFILE did not have a valid file type.
action: Specify a valid ORACLE ASM SPFILE.

description: GPNPTOOL executable not found at '%s'
cause: The GPNPTOOL executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: could not edit the GPnP profile
cause: A 'gpnptool edit' command failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: could not sign the GPnP profile
cause: A 'gpnptool sign' command failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: -f option cannot be used when Oracle Clusterware stack is up
cause: The force option was supplied when the Oracle Clusterware stack was up.
action: Remove the force option and retry.

description: could not check the status of cluster
cause: The command 'crsctl check css' failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: could not get the GPnP profile sequence number
cause: An error occurred while retrieving the sequence number of the GPnP profile.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: CRSCTL executable not found at '%s'
cause: The CRSCTL executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: could not set the disk string
cause: The command 'srvctl modify asm -d <diskstring>' failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: could not determine the mode in which Oracle Clusterware is running
cause: The command 'crsctl status resource ora.crsd -init -g' failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: SRVCTL executable not found at '%s'
cause: The SRVCTL executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: could not get the Oracle ASM disk string
cause: The command 'srvctl config asm' to get the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk string failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: environment variable '%s' not set
cause: The environment variable HOSTNAME was not set before running this command.
action: Set the variable HOSTNAME and retry.

description: could not locate the GPnP profile
cause: The Grid Plug and Play (GPnP) profile did not exist.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: destination cannot be an alias directory when the source is a fully qualified ASM file name
cause: The destination for the copy was an ASM alias directory and the provided SPFILE source path was a fully qualified ASM file name.
action: When providing a fully qualified ASM file name as the SPFILE source, provide either the disk group name only or an ASM alias name as the destination path.

description: destination must be an alias name when the source is a fully qualified ASM file name
cause: The destination for the copy or move was not an ASM alias name and the provided SPFILE source path was a fully qualified ASM file name.
action: When providing a fully qualified ASM file name as the SPFILE source, provide an ASM alias name as the destination path.

description: operation was not performed on the file %s
cause: Altering the diskgroup to change the owner, group, or permissions failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: cannot accept null password
cause: A null password was passed.
action: A non-null password must be entered.

description: 'chmod' operation not allowed for %s
cause: A 'chmod' command specified the write-only permission.
action: Specify a permission other than write-only and retry the command.

description: invalid KEYSTORE FILE '%s'
cause: The specified keystore file did not have a valid file type, a valid file size, or a valid block size.
action: Specify a valid keystore file.

description: operations on a KEYSTORE file require the SYSASM privilege
cause: An attempt to copy a keystore file was made without the SYSASM privilege.
action: Retry the operation as a SYSASM user.

description: invalid diskgroup name '%s'
cause: An invalid diskgroup name was specified.
action: Ensure that the command's -G option has a non-null value passed and has only alphanumeric characters.

description: invalid volume name '%s'
cause: An invalid volume name was specified.
action: Ensure that the volume name is a non-null value and has only alphanumeric characters.

description: diskgroup '%s' volume '%s' not found
cause: The specified diskgroup or volume was not found.
action: Specify a valid diskgroup and volume.

description: invalid size multiplier specified
cause: An invalid size multiplier was specified.
action: Specify a numeric volume size terminating in 'K', 'k', 'M', 'm', 'G', 'g', T',or 't'.

description: invalid size specified
cause: The size specified contained a valid size multiplier but contained other non-numeric characters.
action: Specify a numeric volume size terminating in 'K', 'k', 'M', 'm', 'G', 'g', T',or 't'.

description: could not create the analyze directory
cause: An internally issued 'mkdir' command failed to create the analyze directory.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: time stamp format is not recognized
cause: The format for time stamp was invalid.
action: Specify a time stamp in the following format: Mon Sep 19 19:56:15 2011.

description: invalid value specified for 'tracedirectory'
cause: The specified trace directory did not exist.
action: Supply a valid trace directory which contains the set of logs and trace files that need to be analyzed.

description: Start time is later than end time. Please specify end time later than start time.
cause: Inconsistent values for --startime and --endtime options.
action: Please specify the value of --endtime option later than the value of --starttime option

description: cannot read the event list file.
cause: The event list file did not exist or could not be read
action: Check if the file asmevents.xml exists under $ORACLE_HOME/lib and you have read permissions.

description: invalid disk group name '%(1)s'.
cause: The disk group name specified contained special characters.
action: Ensure that the disk group name specified only contains alphanumeric characters and underscores.

description: invalid value for '%s' option: %s
cause: The provided value was not valid for the specified option.
action: Correct the value and retry the command.

description: file group '%s' does not exist
cause: The specified file group name did not exist.
action: Specify the name of an existing file group.

description: cannot access '%s', no such XML file
cause: The specified file did not exist.
action: Specify the name of an existing file.

description: cannot read '%s', permission denied
cause: The permission to read the specified file or directory was not granted.
action: Grant read permission for the file or directory and retry the command.

description: failed to create member cluster '%s' because plugging in the GIMR PDB from a directory requires configuring the GIMR component
cause: An attempt to configure the indicated member cluster failed because the Grid Infrastructure Management Repository (GIMR) component was not specified.
action: Retry the command specifying the '--gimr' option.

description: None of the nodes in the current client cluster %(1)s have a valid credential.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) cannot be connected on all the nodes in the client cluster.
action: Process the command 'credfix --clustername <clustername> --wrap <wrap_file.xml>' on the server cluster. Then process the command 'credfix --crsusr <crs_user> --wrap <wrap_file>' here to fix the credentials on nodes of the client cluster.

description: Some of the nodes in the current client cluster have invalid credentials. The nodes are %(1)s.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) cannot be connected on some of the nodes.
action: Process the command 'credfix' to fix the credentials.

description: ASM root credential domain does not exist on Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) on a server cluster.
cause: The root credential domain does not exist on the OCR.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root --giuser <giuser>' as a root user to fix the root domain. Then, execute 'credfix --clustername <clustername> --wrap <wrap_file.xml> --root --giuser <giuser>' as a root user if fixing a credential of a client cluster in the server cluster is needed.

description: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain does not exist on the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) on a server cluster.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain does not exist on the OCR on a server cluster.
action: Process the command 'credfix --clustername <clientcluster_name> --wrap <wrap_file.xml>' to fix the credentials.

description: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) credential domain has incorrect permissions on a server cluster for the client cluster %(1)s.
cause: The Oracle ASM credential domain does not have the correct permissions for an Oracle Grid Infrastructure user.
action: Execute the command 'credfix --root --giuser <giuser> --clustername <clientcluster_name> --wrap <wrap_file.xml>' as a root user.

description: There are no credentials in OCR on the server cluster of the client cluster %(1)s.
cause: There are no credentials in the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) on the server cluster of the specified client cluster.
action: Process the command 'credfix --clustername <clientcluster_name> --wrap <wrap_file.xml>' to fix the credentials.

description: Cannot connect to Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) with credentials of the client cluster %(1)s in the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) of the server cluster.
cause: The credentials of the specified client cluster in the OCR of the server cluster cannot be used to connect to Oracle ASM.
action: Process the command 'credfix --clustername <clientcluster_name> --wrap <wrap_file.xml>' to fix the credentials.

description: None of the nodes specified for the client cluster %(1)s have valid credentials.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) cannot connect to the specified nodes in the client cluster.
action: Process the command 'credverify' to check credentials on the entire client cluster, without the nodes argument, in case any other node contains valid credentials.

description: hello, here is your argument: '%s'
cause: Internal error.
action: Nothing.

description: could not open intermediate file '%s'
cause: During Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata backup operation, an attempt to open the intermediate file failed.
action: Supply an existing file that can be read and written to by the current user.

description: invalid intermediate file '%s'
cause: The intermediate file did not begin with string '@diskgroup_set' or there was an error while evaluating the file contents.
action: Ensure that the intermediate file begins with '@diskgroup_set' or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: diskgroup '%s' not discovered by Oracle ASM instance; skipping...
cause: A non-existent diskgroup was specified during execution of the 'md_backup' command.
action: Specify a valid diskgroup and retry the command.

description: diskgroup '%s' not mounted by Oracle ASM instance; skipping...
cause: The diskgroup specified was not mounted in an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance.
action: Mount the diskgroup in the Oracle ASM instance and retry the command.

description: Oracle ASM instance has no diskgroup mounted
cause: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance had no diskgroups mounted.
action: Mount the diskgroups to be backed up and retry the command.

description: CREATE DISKGROUP failed %s
cause: SQL command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the SQL command and retry the command.

description: ADD or ALTER TEMPLATE failed %s
cause: SQL command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the SQL command and retry the command.

description: ADD ALIAS failed %s
cause: SQL command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the SQL command and retry the command.

description: could not find information for diskgroup '%s' in backup file
cause: Information about the diskgroup specified was not present in the backup file.
action: Check that the correct diskgroup name and the backup file are specified and retry the command.

description: backup file '%s' is either empty or cannot be interpreted
cause: Incorrect backup file was specified.
action: Specify a non-empty backup file.

description: file with name '%s' already exists
cause: The specified file already exists.
action: Change the file name and retry the command.

description: source and target files are the same - '%s'
cause: The source and target file were the same.
action: Make sure the source and target files are different.

description: invalid diskgroup name '%s' specified in override options
cause: The old diskgroup name specified in the override options was not found in the backup file.
action: Correct the diskgroup name and retry the command.

description: ADD or ALTER ATTRIBUTE failed %s
cause: SQL command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the SQL command and retry the command.

description: backup version not supported %s
cause: The COMPATIBLE.ASM value of the diskgroup in the backup file was greater than the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance version executing the command.
action: Upgrade the Oracle ASM instance and retry the command.

description: ADD or ALTER VOLUME failed %s
cause: SQL command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the SQL command and retry the command.

description: disk group containing auxiliary volume not found
cause: Disk recovery log did not exist.
action: Use the --silent option to create volume with no recovery log disk group. Use the --full or -G option and restore disk recovery log.

description: volume device for VOLUME: '%s' in DG: '%s' does not exist
cause: Volume was not restored or was not listed for restore.
action: Create volume with the given volume name in the given disk group.

description: failed to make file system %s
cause: The command execution failed.
action: Fix the error in the mkfs command.

description: invalid user name '%s' specified for %s
cause: The specified user name did not exist on the host.
action: Create a local system user with the specified user.

description: invalid group name '%s' specified for %s
cause: The specified group name did not exist on the host.
action: Create a local system group with the specified group.

description: Oracle ACFS is not loaded
cause: Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) was not loaded.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Could not open file '%s'
cause: During Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata scan operation, an attempt to open the output file failed.
action: Supply a non existing file that can be written to by the current user.

description: cannot read the Oracle ACFS list file
cause: The Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) list file did not exist or could not be read.
action: Check if the file asmcmdambracfs.xml exists under $ORACLE_HOME/lib and that you have read permissions.

description: disk '%s' does not exist in diskgroup '%s'
cause: The disk specified was not part of the diskgroup.
action: Correct the disk name and retry the command. The disk name must match the NAME column in the V$ASM_DISK view.

description: physical blocks %s-%s do not map to a valid Oracle ASM file
cause: The physical blocks specified were not part of any Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file.
action: Correct the range of the physical block numbers and retry the command.

description: not all physical blocks submitted for remapping
cause: An attempt to submit all of the physical blocks for remapping failed.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages for details.

description: KFED executable not found at '%s'
cause: The KFED executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Run these commmands if using Oracle 10.2 or later: cd $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/lib make -f ins_rdbms.mk ikfed Run these commmands if using Oracle 10.1: cd $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/lib mv ssskfeded.o sskfeded.o make -f ins_rdbms.mk $ORACLE_HOME/rdbms/lib/kfed mv kfed ../../bin/ Verify that $ORACLE_HOME/bin/kfed exists and has the execute permission bit set.

description: error occurred when executing %s %s
cause: The 'lsdsk' command was not successful.
action: Fix the error indicated in the accompanying messages and retry the command.

description: scanning of disk headers is supported on UNIX platforms only
cause: The 'lsdsk' command failed because scanning of disk headers is supported on UNIX platforms only.
action: Start the Oracle Automatic Storage Management instance and retry the command without the -I option.

description: 'remap' command requires Oracle ASM software version %s or later.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance did not support the 'remap' command.
action: Upgrade the Oracle ASM instance and retry the command.

description: physical blocks %s-%s map to an unmirrored file
cause: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) couldnot remap an unmirrored file.
action: Specify physical blocks which map to a mirrored file.

description: 'mapextent' command requires Oracle ASM software version %s or later
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance did not support the 'mapextent' command.
action: Upgrade the Oracle ASM instance and retry the command.

description: 'mapau' command requires Oracle ASM software version %s or later
cause: The current Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) version did not support this command.
action: Upgrade to 11g Release 2 or a later version.

description: 'lsblk' command requires Oracle ASM software version %s or later
cause: The current version of Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance did not support this command.
action: Upgrade Oracle ASM to 12.2 or a later version and retry the command.

description: 'chblk' command requires Oracle ASM software version %s or later
cause: The current version of Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance did not support this command.
action: Upgrade Oracle ASM to 12.2 or a later version and retry the command.

description: invalid XML tag '%s'
cause: An invalid XML tag was specified.
action: Check the value of the tag to ensure it is valid and retry.

description: invalid XML file
cause: Certain parameters were not defined or had invalid values in the file.
action: Check whether the required parameters are defined in the file and retry.

description: provided XML file cannot be read
cause: The provided XML file could not be read.
action: Check reading permissions on the XML file and retry.

description: error parsing XML file: %s
cause: An error occurred while parsing the XML file.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: element %s is empty
cause: No disks were found in the element.
action: Add disks to this element and retry.

description: argument '%s' is not a valid number
cause: A numeric value was expected in the argument.
action: Change the argument to a numeric value.

description: command syntax error
cause: Incorrect command syntax was specified.
action: Refer to the command line help or to the documentation to determine the correct syntax and options.

description: Invalid option: %s
cause: An invalid option was specified.
action: Refer to the command line help or to the documentation to determine the correct syntax and options.

description: missing '--dbuniquename' or '--asm' option for password file located on a diskgroup
cause: When trying to update the CRSD resource for a password file located on a diskgroup, the '--dbuniquename' parameter or the '--asm' option was not specified.
action: Execute the command again with the '--dbuniquename' parameter if the password file is a database password file. If the password file is an ASM password file, then execute the command with '--asm' option.

description: 'orapwd' executable was not found at '%s'
cause: 'orapwd' executable was not found at the location.
action: Ensure that the executable is present at the location and executable permissions are set.

description: The password file was not found at '%s' or the path specified does not exist.
cause: The password file could not be located at the specified path or the path to the password file did not exist.
action: Ensure that the path specified is valid and that the password file is present at that location.

description: failed to register password file as a CRS resource
cause: An internally issued 'srvctl' command to register the password file as a CRS resource failed.
action: Ensure that the user has enough privileges to run srvctl commands and respond based on the accompanying error messages.

description: could not create new password file
cause: An internally issued 'orapwd' command to create the password file failed.
action: Respond based on the accompanying error messages.

description: location for the new password file was not valid
cause: An invalid path was specified to create the password file. ASMCMD can be used to create password files only on disk groups.
action: Specify a location on a disk group for the password file and make sure the disk group is mounted.

description: password file should be located on an ASM disk group
cause: An invalid path for the password file was specified. The password file should be located on an ASM disk group.
action: Specify a valid location on a disk group for the password file and make sure the disk group is mounted.

description: an internally issued srvctl command failed with errors
cause: An internally issued 'srvctl' command failed. The location of the password file could not be retrieved from the Cluster Ready Services (CRS) resource.
action: Respond based on the accompanying error messages.

description: user tried to move a password file within Operating System file system
cause: ASMCMD 'pwmove' or 'pwcopy' was used to move a password file to a different location on an Operating System file system. This action is not supported by the command.
action: Ensure that ASMCMD pwmove and pwcopy commands are not used to move password files within OS filesystems.

description: user tried to move or copy a password file to the same location in the disk group
cause: ASMCMD 'pwmove' or 'pwcopy' command was used to move or copy a password file to the same location in the disk group. This action is not supported by the command.
action: Ensure that ASMCMD pwmove and pwcopy commands are not used to move or copy password files to the same location within the disk group.

description: ASMCMD '%s' command was used on a file which is not a password file
cause: This particular ASMCMD command was used on a file which is not a password file. This command supports only operations on password files.
action: Ensure that the file specified is a password file.

description: invalid password file '%s'
cause: The specified password file did not have a valid file type, a valid file size, or a valid block size.
action: Specify a valid password file.

description: could not delete password file
cause: An internally issued 'orapwd' command to delete the password file failed.
action: Respond based on the accompanying error messages.

description: operation failed due to lack of write permissions
cause: An ASMCMD command failed because the user lacks write permissions necessary for the operation. Either the target directory or file does not have write permissions or the target already exists and cannot be overwritten.
action: Specify a different target or modify the permissions for the target.

description: invalid format for password file
cause: The specified format for the password file was not valid.
action: Specify a valid format for the password file, for example, 12 or 12.2.

description: ASM proxy instance unavailable
cause: An ASM proxy instance was detected but was not ONLINE.
action: Start the 'ora.proxy_asm' resource.

description: cannot enable or disable volumes
cause: Could not communicate with the ASM proxy.
action: Start the 'ora.proxy_asm' resource.

description: failed to connect to the ASM proxy
cause: An ONLINE ASM proxy was detected but the connection failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: volume STATE will show as REMOTE
cause: An ASM proxy instance was detected but was not ONLINE. An Oracle Flex ASM instance cannot display the volume state.
action: This error is informational only.

description: volume statistics cannot be queried
cause: An ASM proxy instance was detected but was not ONLINE. An Oracle Flex ASM instance cannot display the volume statistics.
action: Start the 'ora.proxy_asm' resource.

description: ASM proxy SID not found
cause: An ONLINE ASM proxy was found but the SID could not be determined.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: failed to create the Cluster Manifest File for member cluster '%s'
cause: Creation of the Cluster Manifest File for the member cluster failed.
action: Enable Oracle Flex ASM. Refer to Oracle Automatic Storage Management Administrator's Guide for configuring Oracle Flex ASM. Ensure that the user has write access permission on the Cluster Manifest File. Retry the command.

description: delete member cluster '%s' failed
cause: Deletion of the member cluster failed.
action: Deinstall the member cluster using the procedure documented in the Oracle Clusterware documentation and retry the command.

description: Create or delete member cluster '%(1)s' failed because the Domain Services Cluster is in '%(2)s' state.
cause: An attempt to configure or deconfigure the indicated member cluster was rejected because the Domain Services Cluster was in the middle of upgrading or patching.
action: Retry the command when the Domain Services Cluster is in 'Normal' state.

description: invalid GUID '%s' specified
cause: The operation was rejected because the supplied Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) was syntactically invalid.
action: Retry the command specifying the Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) as a text string of 32 hexadecimal digits (0-f) without a hyphen (-) character or the hexadecimal literal prefix (0x). Refer to the command inline help or product documentation for more information.

description: There are too many connection strings for Oracle Flex ASM.
cause: While fetching connection strings for Oracle Flex ASM, there were too many connection strings.
action: Run the 'lsnrctl' command to see all are valid ASM end points, or try again later.

description: There are no connection strings available for Oracle Flex ASM.
cause: While fetching connection strings for Oracle Flex ASM, there were no connection strings available.
action: Make sure ASM is running and is registered.

description: Unknown error happened while fetching connection strings for FlexASM
cause: While fetching connection string for FlexASM, unknown error reported.
action: Check ASM is running and is registered and retry.

description: Operations on the ASM SPFILE require the SYSASM privilege.
cause: An attempt to modify the ASM SPFILE was made without the SYSASM privilege.
action: Retry the operation as a SYSASM user.

description: '%s' cannot be run with '%s' privilege
cause: Command was executed with lower privilege
action: Retry with appropriate privilege.

description: operations on member cluster require SYSASM privilege
cause: An attempt was made to create or delete a member cluster without the SYSASM privilege.
action: Retry the operation as a SYSASM user.

description: no member clusters configured
cause: NA
action: NA

description: member cluster '%s' is not configured
cause: The specified member cluster was not configured.
action: Execute the 'asmcmd lscc' command to list all of the configured member clusters. Reexecute the command with a member cluster name that is configured.

description: failed to list the configured member clusters
cause: A failure occurred while attempting to display the member cluster configuration. The accompanying error message provides the details.
action: Examine the accompanying error message, address the reported issue and retry the operation.

description: The configuration for member cluster '%s' is inconsistent between components '%s' and '%s'.
cause: There were multiple member clusters identified by the indicated name with mismatched versions or GUIDs.
action: Deinstall one of the member clusters, and deconfigure using a component-specific method. Create the member cluster with a different name using the 'asmcmd mkcc' command with the required components. Install and configure the new member cluster.

description: The '%s' feature is not supported on this operating system.
cause: The command was rejected because the indicated feature is not supported on this operating system.
action: Refer to the command inline help or product documentation for more information.

description: failed to create component '%s' credentials for member cluster '%s'
cause: A failure occurred while attempting to create credentials for the member cluster.
action: Examine the accompanying error message, address the reported issue, and retry the operation. If there are no accompanying error messages, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Directory '%s' does not exist.
cause: An attempt was made to access a nonexistent directory."
action: Retry the operation with a directory that exists.

description: The Cluster Manifest File '%s' does not contain any components.
cause: A Cluster Manifest File that does not contain any components was provided.
action: Provide a valid Cluster Manifest File and retry the operation.

description: File '%s' is not a Cluster Manifest File.
cause: The file provided was not a Cluster Manifest File.
action: Provide a valid Cluster Manifest File and retry the operation.

description: The command is only supported on the Domain Services Cluster.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that is only supported on the Domain Services Cluster.
action: Rerun the command on the Domain Services Cluster.

description: invalid member cluster version '%s'
cause: An attempt to create a configuration for a member cluster failed because an invalid cluster version was provided for the cluster.
action: Retry the operation, providing a valid member cluster version in the required format (%u.%u.%u.%u.%u).

description: member cluster version '%(1)s' is incompatible with Domain Services Cluster version '%(2)s'
cause: The specified member cluster version was not supported by the Domain Services Cluster.
action: Upgrade or downgrade the Domain Services Cluster to a version that is compatible with the member cluster version and retry the operation. Install a member cluster using a supported version. Refer to product documentation for a complete list of supported releases.

description: Clear timestamp for OS trail type requires RAC instance number
cause: There was no RAC instance number specified to clear timestamp for OS trailtype
action: Specify the RAC Instance number for OS trail type.

description: Set timestamp for OS trail type requires RAC instance number
cause: RAC instance number was not specified while OS trail type was specified.
action: Provide a RAC instance number for OS trail type for set timestamp operation.

description: failed to obtain required AFD disk string from Oracle Local Repository
cause: The AFD disk string required for this operation could not be retrieved from the Oracle Local Repository (OLR).
action: Check that Oracle Clusterware is properly configured using 'ocrcheck -local'. Ensure that ASMCMD afd_dsset command is used to set AFD disk string before retrieving the value.

description: failed to update AFD disk string in Oracle Local Repository.
cause: An error occurred while setting AFD disk string.
action: Check that Oracle Clusterware is properly configured using 'ocrcheck -local'.

description: ASM disk label set operation failed.
cause: An error occurred while setting the ASM label.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages and correct the problem indicated, then retry the afd_label operation.

description: ASM disk label clear operation failed.
cause: An error occurred while clearing the ASM label.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages and correct the problem indicated, then retry the afd_unlabel operation.

description: KFOD executable not found at '%s'
cause: The KFOD executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: AFDTOOL executable not found at '%s'
cause: The AFDTOOL executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: AFDROOT executable not found at '%s'
cause: The AFDROOT executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: AFDDRIVERSTATE executable not found at '%s'
cause: The AFDDRIVERSTATE executable was not found at the indicated location.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: ASMLib elements are present or ASM disk string '%s' still includes references to ASMLib disk path names.
cause: An attempt was made to configure Oracle ASM Filter Driver (AFD) when ASMLib was present. ASMLib must be completely removed from the system before AFD can be configured. Otherwise, when the Oracle Clusterware stack is restarted, the AFD devices may not be discovered.
action: Remove all traces of ASMLib from the system, including the libasm.so object in /opt/oracle. Set ASM disk string to default empty string. Refer to the product documentation and follow the procedure to configure AFD.

description: AFD is not '%s'
cause: The Oracle ASM Filter Driver (AFD) was either not supported, not installed, or not loaded.
action: If attempting to pre-label the devices, then use the --init option. Otherwise, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: AFD is already configured
cause: AFD was already configured and loaded on the node.
action: Run the command when AFD is not configured. Refer to the product documentation and follow the procedure to configure AFD.

description: Insufficient permission to execute the command. Require privileged user
cause: A non-privileged user attempted to execute a command requiring privileges.
action: Issue the command again as a privileged user.

description: command cannot be used when Oracle Clusterware stack is up
cause: The command was executed when the Oracle Clusterware stack was up.
action: Stop Oracle Clusterware using 'crsctl stop crs' command and retry.

description: AFD configuration failed '%s'
cause: The afd_configure command was not successful.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages, correct the problem indicated and then retry the command. Check ASMCMD alert log for more information.

description: AFD deconfiguration failed '%s'
cause: The afd_deconfigure command was not successful.
action: Examine the accompanying error messages, correct the problem indicated and then retry the command. Check ASMCMD alert log for more information.

description: The AFD state is '%s' and filtering is '%s' on host '%s'
cause: User requested to retrieve the status of AFD on the node.
action: Note the status of AFD and its filtering mode.

description: AFD is loaded, but resource ora.driver.afd does not exist
cause: The command was executed with AFD loaded on the node but its OHASD resource ora.driver.afd did not exist.
action: Forcibly configure AFD using the 'ASMCMD afd_configure -f' command.

description: disk '%s' does not exist
cause: The disk specified did not exist.
action: Specify a disk that exists.

description: The executable '%s' is either not found or non-executable in the location(s) %s
cause: The executable file is either not found or non executable in the specified location(s). It must be available in any one of the specified location(s).
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: The AFD state is '%s'
cause: User requested to retrieve the status of AFD.
action: Note the status of AFD. AFD is functional if the state is LOADED.

description: External redundancy disk groups cannot contain sites.
cause: The tag <site> was not compatible with the external redundancy disk groups.
action: Do not use <site> tags when the command is applied to an external disk group.

description: command cannot be used when Oracle Clusterware stack is down
cause: The command was executed when the Oracle Clusterware stack was down.
action: Start Oracle Clusterware using 'crsctl start crs' command and retry.

description: resource ora.driver.afd does not exist
cause: The command was executed when OHASD resource ora.driver.afd did not exist.
action: Verify the status of AFD using the 'ASMCMD afd_state' command.

description: Discovery string is not provided.
cause: The discovery string was not provided and the stamp operation was not permitted.
action: Provide a discovery string adding the option '--dscstr' to the command 'asmcmd stamp'.

description: Failure group label is not provided.
cause: An attempt was made to stamp a site label without providing a failure group label.
action: Provide a failure group label adding the option '--failgroup' to the command 'asmcmd stamp'.

description: The site label '%s' is invalid.
cause: An invalid site label was supplied.
action: Specify a site name which is at least one character but no more than 15 characters in length. A site name consists of alphanumeric characters plus the hyphen character (a..z, A..Z, 0..9, -). It cannot begin with a numeric character. It cannot begin or end with the hyphen (-) character.

description: The failure group label '%s' is invalid.
cause: An invalid failure group label was supplied.
action: Specify a failure group label that is a valid SQL identifier. It must be at least one character in length but no more than 30 characters in length. It must begin with a letter and is composed of letters, digits, and the underscore (_) character.

description: The disk label '%s' is invalid.
cause: An invalid disk label was supplied.
action: Specify a disk label that is a valid SQL identifier. It must be at least one character in length but no more than 23 characters in length. It must begin with a letter and is composed of letters, digits, and the underscore (_) character.

description: No disks were discovered using the string '%s'.
cause: The supplied discovery string did not match any disk.
action: Provide a valid discovery string.

description: Disks are managed by AFD or ASMLIB.
cause: An attempt was made to stamp the disk label on disks that are managed by Oracle ASM Filter Driver (AFD) or ASMLIB."
action: Provide a discovery string for disks that are not managed by AFD or ASMLIB, or do not provide the disk label, and retry the command.

description: Disk %s belongs to mounted disk group %s.
cause: An attempt was made to stamp a disk that belongs to a mounted disk group.
action: Dismount the disk group and retry the command.

description: Disk %s is member of disk group %s and ASMCMD is not connected to an instance.
cause: An attempt was made to stamp a disk that is a member of an ASM disk group, and ASMCMD was not connected to an ASM instance to verify if that disk group was mounted.
action: Connect ASMCMD to an ASM instance and retry the command.

description: cannot rename the site and the failgroup for a disk
cause: An attempt was made to rename the site and the failgroup for a disk. The operation was not permitted because these options are mutually exclusive, since the failgroup can be renamed only if the disk group redundancy is external and the site cannot be renamed if the disk group redundancy is external.
action: Provide only one of the two options: 'site' or 'failgroup'.

description: The command is not supported on a member cluster.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that was not supported on a member cluster.
action: Rerun the command on the storage server.

description: The installed AFD drivers are not correct for this operating system.
cause: A request to retrieve the status of Oracle ASM Filter Driver (AFD) was made. The installed AFD drivers and the current running operating system were not compatible.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Insufficient permission to execute the command. The command requires an Oracle Grid Infrastructure user.
cause: An attempt was made to execute a command by a user who was not an Oracle Grid Infrastructure user.
action: Rerun the command as an Oracle Grid Infrastructure user.

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk unmanage operation failed.
cause: An error occurred while attempting to remove a disk from Oracle ASM Filter Driver (Oracle ASMFD).
action: Examine the accompanying error messages and correct the problem.

description: error occurred when executing %s %s %s
cause: The 'afd_scan' command is not successful.
action: Fix the error indicated in the accompanying messages and retry the command.

description: ASM Client Cluster creation failed because the access mode specified is invalid.
cause: An invalid access mode was supplied in an attempt to create an ASM Client Cluster.
action: Rerun the command by specifying the correct access mode.

description: The command is not supported on a Domain Services Cluster.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that was not supported on a Domain Services Cluster.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: The command is not supported on a Standalone Cluster.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that was not supported on a Standalone Cluster.
action: Refer to the command line help or to the documentation or Contact Oracle Support Services

description: The command is only supported on a Cluster that has ASM configured locally.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that is only supported on the Cluster that has ASM configured locally.
action: Rerun the command on the Cluster that has ASM configured locally.

You must create one. 3) You are connected to a standby database in the broker configuration that has either been disabled or deleted. While the standby is in this state, the details of the broker configuration are not available on the standby database. Connect to the primary database and reissue the command. 4) You are connected to a database in the broker configuration that must be reinstated or reinstantiated. While in this state, details of the broker configuration are not available. Either reinstate or reinstantiate the database and reissue the command, or connect to the primary database and reissue the command.

cause: Parameters or their values were specified incorrectly in the configuration file.
action: Check and correct the configuration parameters or their values.

description: bad value for mode
cause: An undefined mode value was specified.
action: Check that the correct mode is selected and that an allowed value for that mode is specified.

description: null host specified in thread-safe logon
cause: A host data area (HDA) was not specified in the logon call while running in a thread-safe environment.
action: Ensure that HDA is not NULL when calling the logon routine.

description: host connection in use by another thread
cause: An attempt was made to use the host connection while it was in use by another thread.
action: Wait for another thread to finish before using this connection.

description: call not supported in non-deferred linkage
cause: One of the calls that is supported in deferred mode linkage exclusively was invoked when the client was linked non-deferred.
action: Use this call in deferred mode of linkage.

description: datatype not allowed for this call
cause: Data of this datatype cannot be sent or fetched in pieces.
action: Use other bind or define calls for this datatype.

description: bad bind or define context
cause: The call was executed on a cursor for which this is invalid.
action: Verify that this call is valid for this cursor. For example, Get piece information and set piece information are valid on a cursor if appropriate binds and defines have been done on this cursor.

description: bad buffer for piece
cause: A zero length buffer or a null buffer pointer was provided.
action: Verify that the buffer pointing to this piece or its length is non-zero. The buffer pointer for the next piece or its length can be zero if it is the last piece to be inserted and there are no more data for the column.

description: Length provided in piecewise bind operation exceeded the maximum size.
cause: The length of the piece exceeded the maximum size provided in an Oracle Call Interface (OCI) bind by position or bind by name call.
action: Verify that the length of this piece plus the cumulative length of all the previous pieces is not more than the maximum size allowed by the application.

description: illegal define position
cause: Call to modify attributes was done for a non-existent position
action: Verify that a define has been done for this position

description: already connected to a server
cause: This server handle is already attached to a server.
action: Disconnect from the server and then retry the call to establish a connection.

description: length specified for null connect string
cause: The connect string is null, but a length was specified for it.
action: Set length to zero if connect string is null.

description: memory initialization failed
cause: Cannot initialize user memory.
action: Contact customer support.

description: illegal parameters specified for allocating user memory
cause: An illegal size or null pointer was specified for user memory.
action: Specify a legal size and a valid pointer for user memory.

description: user already authenticated
cause: A user has already been authenticated on this service handle.
action: Terminate the service context before using it for another user.

description: service handle not initialized
cause: The server context did not exist.
action: Establish the server context in the service context.

description: illegal attribute type
cause: An illegal attribute type was specified for the handle.
action: Consult user manual to specify an attribute valid for this handle.

description: illegal handle type
cause: An illegal handle type was specified.
action: Consult user manual to specify a valid handle type.

description: define handle used in a different position
cause: A define was done with an existing handle on a different position.
action: Specify the same position as before on a re-define.

description: call not allowed for scalar data types
cause: This call is valid only for object types.
action: Verify that the data-type for this variable is an object type

description: unable to allocate memory
cause: Process was unable to allocate memory to store diagnostics.
action: Cancel other processes in order to reclaim the needed memory.

description: unable to initialize a mutex
cause: An attempt to initialize a mutex failed.
action: Contact customer support.

description: inconsistent parameters passed
cause: One of the three memory function pointers is null or non-null.
action: Verify that either all the memory functions are null or non-null.

description: unable to delete an initialized mutex
cause: An attempt to delete an initialized mutex failed.
action: Contact customer support.

description: value not allowed
cause: A null or invalid value was passed in for a mandatory parameter.
action: Verify that all mandatory parameters are properly initialized.

description: service handle not initialized
cause: An attempt was made to use an improper service context handle.
action: Verify that the service context handle has all the parameters initialized prior to this call.

description: this OCI operation is not currently allowed
cause: An attempt was made to use a context handle outside its scope.
action: Verify that the context handle is set to a service context handle that has been converted to a logon data area for other OCI calls. The logon data area must be converted back to a service context before it can be used.

description: handle passed in is already initialized
cause: An attempt was made to pass an initialized handle.
action: Verify that the parameter passed in to retrieve a handle does not already point to a handle.

description: explicitly attach before authenticating a user
cause: The server context was not initialized before user authentication was attempted.
action: Create and initialize a server handle. A server context must be initialized before attempting to authenticate a user.

description: illegal attribute value
cause: The attribute value passed in is illegal.
action: Consult the users manual and specify a legal attribute value for the handle.

description: invalid character set identifier
cause: The character set identifier specified was invalid.
action: Specify a valid character set identifier in the OCI call.

description: internal Oracle Call Interface error
cause: An internal Oracle Call Interface (OCI) error has occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: user buffer too small
cause: The user buffer to contain the output data is too small.
action: Specify a bigger buffer.

description: invalid object type
cause: An invalid object type is requested for the describe call.
action: Specify a valid object type to the describe call.

description: zero iteration count
cause: An iteration count of zero was specified for the statement
action: Specify the number of times this statement must be executed

description: no descriptor for this position
cause: The application is trying to get a descriptor from a handle for an illegal position.
action: Check the position number.

description: cannot support more than 1000 columns
cause: The number of columns exceeds the maximum number supported.
action: Specify a number of columns less than 1000.

description: invalid result set descriptor
cause: The result set descriptor should have valid data fetched into it before it can be converted to a statement handle
action: Fetch valid data into the descriptor before attempting to convert it into a statement handle

description: statement handle not prepared
cause: A statement cannot be executed before making preparing a request.
action: Prepare a statement before attempting to execute it.

description: statement handle not executed
cause: A fetch or describe was attempted before executing a statement handle.
action: Execute a statement and then fetch or describe the data.

description: cannot set server group name after connecting to server
cause: An attempt was made to set the server group in a server handle after connecting to the server. However, once the connection is established to a server, the server group name cannot be set anymore.
action: Attach to the server after setting the server group name in the server handle.

description: cannot support more than 255 columns
cause: The number of columns exceeds maximum supported by the server.
action: Limit your operation to 255 columns.

description: bad mode specified
cause: OCI_ENV_NO_MUTEX mode was specified for a non-threaded client.
action: OCI_ENV_NO_MUTEX may be specified when OCI_THREADED had been specified at process initialization.

description: unable to destroy a mutex
cause: An attempt to destroy a mutex failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: user defined callback error
cause: The only valid return value for a user defined callback function is OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_ROWCBK_DONE. Any other value will cause this error.
action: Ensure that OCI_CONTINUE or OCI_ROWCBK_DONE is returned from the user-defined callback function.

description: A compilation error occurred while creating an object.
cause: A SQL or PL/SQL compilation error occurred while creating an object.
action: Return OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO with the error code.

description: A Truncation or null fetch error occurred
cause: A truncation or a null fetch error"
action: Please ensure that the buffer size is long enough to store the returned data.

description: cannot run without binding variables
cause: The SQL statement contained bind variable placeholders but no values were bound.
action: Ensure that you bind all the variables before running the SQL statement.

description: Warning of a NULL column in an aggregate function
cause: A null column was processed by an aggregate function
action: An OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO is returned.

description: Update or Delete without Where
cause: An update or delete was executed without where clause
action: An OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO is returned.

description: Array DML row counts not available
cause: One of the following occurred: -The attribute in OCIAttrGet was used incorrectly. -The version of the database used does not support this feature -There was an error in the array DML for all of the iterations.
action: Ensure that the statement is an array DML and also ensure that the database version is Oracle 12 or higher and the correct mode is used.

description: OCI call not allowed
cause: OCI used is not permitted from external procedures.
action: Refer to user manual for usage restrictions.

description: invalid date passed into OCI call
cause: A bad date was passed into one of the OCI calls.
action: Check your date bind values and correct them.

description: conversion of data from COBOL display data type to Oracle number type failed
cause: An invalid COBOL display type was used in an Oracle Call Interface (OCI) bind or define call.
action: Use the proper COBOL display type when binding or defining number data.

description: user buffer too small to accommodate COBOL display type
cause: User supplied buffer for a COBOL display type was too small to accommodate fetched number.
