description: Parameter %s value change failed.
cause: The parameter could not be changed during Oracle Active Data Guard (Oracle ADG) recovery.
action: Stop the Oracle ADG recovery and then change the parameter value.

description: Simulate error during get object locks
cause: NA
action: NA

description: The value change failed for parameter %s.
cause: An attempt was made to enable the parameter on a non-Engineered system or it was not on a Platform as a Service.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot start Oracle ADG recovery on a non-Oracle Cloud database on a server that is not a primary server.
cause: An attempt was made to start Oracle Active Data Guard (Oracle ADG) recovery on a non-Oracle Cloud database that was not on the primary server.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Preplugin recovery cannot start from a backup belonging to a prior PDB incarnation.
cause: An attempt was made to start preplugin recovery from a backup prior to the current pluggable database (PDB) incarnation.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Statement failure due to standby query SCN lag while reading undo segment %s information.
cause: A new undo segment is being added or an existing undo segment is being dropped on the primary database. A query can occasionally halt when issued around the time an undo segment is added, or dropped and used immediately on the primary.
action: Retry the query. Review the reasons for the lagging query SCN on the standby database. Avoid frequent drop or creation of the new undo segments when using standby database.

description: the segment type specification is invalid
cause: segment type is not TABLE, INDEX, or CLUSTER
action: use a correct segment type

description: the group number specification is invalid
cause: the freelist group number was either negative or larger than the the number of freelist groups in the segment
action: use a correct group number

description: the scan limit specification is invalid
cause: the scan limit did not have a positive integer value the number of freelist groups in the segment
action: use a correct scan limit

description: concurrent update activity makes space analysis impossible
cause: high volume of user updates interfere with the space analysis
action: retry the command or lock the underlying objects

description: the segment type specification should indicate partitioning
cause: partition name is specified for the space analysis, but the object type does not indicate partitioning
action: specify PARTITION in the segment type, if the object is partitioned, otherwise, omit the partition name

description: partition name is required when partitioned type is specified
cause: partition name is not specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates partitioning
action: specify partition name, if the object is partitioned, otherwise, specify a non-partitioned type

description: maximum file size of (%s) blocks in AUTOEXTEND clause is out of range
cause: The maximum file size for an autoextendable file has exceeded the maximum number of blocks allowed.
action: Reduce the size and retry.

description: subpartitioned type must be specified for composite object
cause: partition type is specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates composite partitioning
action: specify subpartition name and subpartition type

description: partitioned type must be specified for a non-composite object
cause: subpartition type is specified for the space analysis, but the object type indicates non-composite partitioning
action: specify partition name and partition type

description: DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN package invalid file or block specification
cause: The value of the file number or block number was outside of the limits or was inconsistent.
action: Fix the file number or block number value.

description: DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN package invalid option specification
cause: The value of one of the option parameters was incorrect.
action: Fix the option value.

description: The segment does not exist or is not in a valid state
cause: The segment specified in the DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN or DBMS_SPACE operation does not exist or is not in a state appropriate for this operation
action: Fix the segment specification, or put the segment in the appropriate state.

description: Temporary Segment cannot be created in locally-managed tablespace
cause: Attempt to create a temporary segment for sort/hash/lobs in in permanent tablespace of kind locally-managed
action: Alter temporary tablespace of user to a temporary tablespace or a dictionary-managed permanent tablespace

description: invalid large object (LOB) segment name in DBMS_SPACE package
cause: The large object (LOB) segment specified in the DBMS_SPACE procedure does not exist.
action: Provide a valid LOB segment name.

description: The specified file size is smaller than the minimum blocks %s.
cause: The file size specified in ADD or RESIZE command for a data file or temp file is too small to create an allocation unit.
action: Increase the file size. Retry.
params: 1) min_size: The minimum number of blocks required.

description: File Size specified for resize is too small
cause: File Size specified for resize datafile/tempfile causes bitmap control structures to overlap
action: Increase the specification for file size

description: Tablespace/Segment Verification cannot proceed
cause: Corruptions detected during verification which cannot be dealt with
action: Do manual verification

description: invalid option for alter of TEMPORARY TABLESPACE
cause: invalid option for alter of temporary tablespace was specified
action: Specify one of the valid options: ADD TEMPFILE, TEMPFILE ONLINE, TEMPFILE OFFLINE

description: invalid option for CREATE/ALTER TABLESPACE
cause: invalid option for create/alter tablespace of type locally-managed
action: Specify one of the valid options.

description: Tablespace '%s' is dictionary-managed, offline or temporary
cause: Operation which is only applicable to permanent, online, locally-managed tablespaces is specified for a tablespace which is either dictionary-managed, offline or temporary
action: Reissue operation for a different tablespace, mount the tablespace or do not issue it at all, since it does not apply for the given tablespace

description: DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN required parameter is NULL or missing
cause: Some of the procedures was called with missing or NULL parameters
action: Specify the missing parameter

description: Temporary tablespaces and temporary segments must have standard block size
cause: An attempt was made to do one of the following : (1) create a temporary tablespace with a non-standard block size or, (2) alter an existing permanent tablespace of non-standard block size to a temporary tablespace or, (3) issue a DDL statement that would result in the creation of a temporary segment in a tablespace of non-standard block size.
action: (1) If creating a temporary tablespace, do not specify a block size different from the standard block size. (2) If altering an existing permanent tablespace to a temporary tablespace, ensure that it is of standard block size. (3) Ensure that the user's temporary tablespace is a tablespace having the standard block size.

description: average row size and row count must be greater than zero
cause: Either a bad value passed to dbms_space.create_table_cost() or explain plan did not pass through size information.
action: Check the row size parameter in dbms_space.create_table_cost(). For explain plan, make sure statistics have been computed for all source tables in the CREATE TABLE AS SELECT statement.

description: Bitmap index block addressable limitation reached
cause: The limitation of addressability of BMIB (Bitmap Index Block) was reached for the current blocksize.
action: If the segment size has grown greater than addressability of BMIB (Bitmap Index Block), do the following: (1) Partition the table. (2) Move the segment to a tablespace having bigger blocksize.

description: DBMS_SPACE_ADMIN requires a 12c bigfile tablespace
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation which was supported only for bigfile tablespaces created in 12c or later.
action: Use the appropriate bigfile tablespace.

description: segment only contains %s blocks of unused space above high water mark
cause: Attempt to preserve too many blocks.
action: reduce the KEEP amount.

description: the INITIAL extent may not be deallocated
cause: Attempt to deallocate space from the segment which was truncated prior to the 7.3 release.
action: increase the KEEP amount, or truncate the segment, and reissue the command.

description: unable to extend table %s.%s subpartition %s by %s in tablespace %s
cause: Failed to allocate an extent for table subpartition segment in tablespace.
action: Use ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

description: unable to extend index %s.%s subpartition %s by %s in tablespace %s
cause: Failed to allocate an extent for index subpartition segment in tablespace.
action: Use ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

description: max # extents (%s) reached in table %s.%s subpartition %s
cause: A table subpartition tried to extend past maxextents
action: If maxextents is less than the system maximum, raise it. Otherwise, you must recreate with larger initial, next or pctincrease params

description: max # extents (%s) reached in index %s.%s subpartition %s
cause: An index subpartition tried to extend past maxextents
action: If maxextents is less than the system max, raise it. Otherwise, you must recreate with larger initial, next or pctincrease params.

description: Initial Extent of specified size cannot be allocated in tablespace (%s)
cause: Too large a size for an initial extent due to freelist group specification
action: Reduce number of freelist groups specified for segment

description: unable to extend LOB segment %s.%s subpartition %s by %s in tablespace %s
cause: An attempt was made to allocate an extent for LOB subpartition segment in tablespace, but the extent could not be allocated because there is not enough space in the tablespace indicated.
action: Use the ALTER TABLESPACE ADD DATAFILE statement to add one or more files to the tablespace indicated.

description: maxextents (%s) reached in LOB segment %s.%s subpartition %s
cause: A LOB subpartition segment tried to extend past maxextents.
action: If maxextents is less than the system maximum, raise it. Otherwise, recreate the subpartition with larger INITIAL, NEXT, or PCTINCREASE parameters.

description: User's temporary tablespace same as tablespace being migrated
cause: Users default temporary tablespace must be different from the tablespace being migrated.
action: alter users default temporary tablespace to be different.

description: Invalid unit size
cause: User specified an invalid unit size for the tablespace
action: Specify the correct unit size. To estimate unit size please refer to Oracle Server Administrator's Guide.

description: Tablespace migration retried 500 times
cause: For migration to complete, temporary segments should not be present in the tablespace at the time of migration.
action: Avoid migrating the tablespace when there is heavy temporary segment creation going on as with object drops.

description: destination dba overlaps with existing control information
cause: Cannot overlap control information during relocation
action: Please chose another destination address

description: No free space found to place the control information
cause: During migration of tablespace found no place to put the control information. If during bitmaps relocation, found no space at the specified destination.
action: If during migration, add more space to the tablespace and retry migration. If during bitmaps relocation, specify a destination address where there is enough free space.

description: Tablespace has to be dictionary managed, online and permanent to be able to migrate
cause: Tablespace was not dictionary managed or online or permanent.
action: Make sure the tablespace is online, permanent and dictionary managed

description: Invalid block number specified
cause: Control information cannot be placed at the specified dba either because the block number specified is beyond the file end or the file is not large enough to accomodate the control information at that location
action: specify a correct block number

description: Invalid block number specified
cause: Relocation of bitmaps to the said destination will make the tablespace self descriptive
action: Choose another destination dba.

description: Too much of segment creation activity during migration
cause: Temporary segments were attempted to be created during migration
action: The error is signalled after retrying migration for 500 times. Run migration when there is less of segment creation activity is going on.

description: Uniform size for automatic segment space management tablespace should have at least %s blocks
cause: For the given blocksize, uniform size specified is insufficient
action: Specify larger extent size and retry

description: Cannot mark this segment corrupt
cause: This segment cannot be marked corrupt because it contains data dictionary objects
action: Check the segment information and reissue the command.

description: Cannot issue this command on SYSTEM tablespace
cause: It is not permitted to migrate SYSTEM tablespace from locally managed format to dictionary managed format or relocate bitmaps.
action: Check the tablespace name and procedure name

description: initial extent size not enough for LOB segment
cause: Fatblock size of LOB segment is too big to fit into the initial extent.
action: Specify a smaller fatblock size or create the LOB segment in other tablespaces with bigger initial extent size.

description: unable to execute the sql in read only database
cause: Unable to create a consistent snapshot of the object in a read only database. Transaction recovery must be performed before opening the database read only.
action: Open the database read write, allow dead transaction recovery to complete and then open the database read only.

description: the tablespace %s has only one file
cause: Dropping file from ts which has a single file extent.
action: Cannot make a tablespace fileless

description: The data file is not empty.
cause: An attempt was made to drop a non empty data file. A non empty data file cannot be dropped.
action: Cannot drop a non empty data file.

description: cannot drop the first file of tablespace %s
cause: Trying to drop the first datafile with which ts is created
action: Cannot drop the first datafile with which ts is created

description: cannot drop offline datafile of locally managed tablespace
cause: Trying to drop offline datafile in lmts
action: Try to drop file after making it online

description: both ALLOCATE EXTENT and DEALLOCATE UNUSED options are specified
cause: The DEALLOCATE option and the ALLOCATE option are specified in the same command.
action: Choose one of the options or issue two separate commands.

description: duplicate DEALLOCATE option specification
cause: The DEALLOCATE UNUSED option to ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX is specified more than once.
action: Specify the option at most once.

description: duplicate ALLOCATE EXTENT option specification
cause: The ALLOCATE EXTENT option to ALTER TABLE or ALTER INDEX is specified more than once.
action: Specify the option at most once.

description: invalid SIZE specified
cause: The specified value must be an integer.
action: Choose an appropriate integer value.

description: duplicate ALLOCATE EXTENT option specification
cause: An option (DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE) was specified more than once.
action: Specify each option at most once.

description: invalid INSTANCE specified
cause: The specified value is not recognized as a valid instance name.
action: Use a valid name.

description: invalid DATAFILE file name specified
cause: A character string literal is expected, but not found.
action: Specify file names using character string literals.

description: invalid ALLOCATE EXTENT option
cause: An option other than DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE was specified.
action: Remove invalid option and retry the command.

description: missing ALLOCATE EXTENT option
cause: No ALLOCATE EXTENT options were specified.
action: Specified one or more of the following options: DATAFILE, SIZE or INSTANCE.

description: specified datafile %s does not exist
cause: The datafile does not exist
action: Retry the option with the correct datafile

description: datafile or tempfile %s is not a member of tablespace %s
cause: The specified datafile or tempfile did not belong to the tablespace that the object resides in.
action: Retry the option with the correct datafile or tempfile.

description: ALLOCATE EXTENT not valid for HASH CLUSTERS
cause: The cluster is a hash cluster, and can not use the allcoate extent option.
action: NA

description: invalid FREELIST GROUP specified
cause: The specified FREELIST GROUP number is invalid
action: Choose a number between 1 and # freelist groups for this object

description: both FREELIST GROUP and INSTANCE parameters may not be specified
cause: Both FREELIST GROUP and INSTANCE were specified in clause
action: Remove one of the two parameters

description: partition name and segment type do not match
cause: Partition name and segment type specified for space analysis do not match
action: Specify type PARTITION if the object is partitioned, specify SUBPARTITION if the object is composite

description: Invalid truncate command - missing CLUSTER or TABLE keyword
cause: Invalid object specification given.
action: Either specify TRUNCATE CLUSTER or TRUNCATE TABLE

description: Invalid truncate option - missing STORAGE keyword
cause: Expected STORAGE keyword
action: Either specify DROP STORAGE or REUSE STORAGE

description: Table to be truncated is part of a cluster
cause: The table being truncated is a member of a cluster.
action: Either use TRUNCATE CLUSTER or DROP TABLE

description: Cluster to be truncated is a HASH CLUSTER
cause: Only INDEX CLUSTERS can be truncated.
action: Drop and recreate the HASH CLUSTER instead of using truncate.

description: cannot resize datafile - file %s not found
cause: The specified datafile is not available for resizing.
action: Ensure that the datafile name is valid, and if so, ensure the file is accessible.

description: File contains used data beyond requested RESIZE value.
cause: Some portion of the file in the region to be trimmed was currently in use by one or more database objects.
action: Drop or move segments containing extents in this region prior to resizing the file, or choose a RESIZE value limited to free space in the tail of the file being trimmed.
remediation: 1) The resize floor is the highest allocated block in the file, not the amount of data: `SELECT file_id, MAX(block_id + blocks - 1) hwm_blocks FROM dba_extents WHERE file_id = <n> GROUP BY file_id;` 2) Convert to a size: multiply hwm_blocks by the block size, then resize to slightly above that. 3) To shrink further, move the segments sitting above the high water mark: `SELECT owner, segment_name, segment_type FROM dba_extents WHERE file_id = <n> AND block_id > <hwm> GROUP BY owner, segment_name, segment_type;` then `ALTER TABLE <o>.<t> MOVE;` or `ALTER INDEX <o>.<i> REBUILD;` and retry the resize. 4) Remember that MOVE invalidates indexes on the table: `ALTER TABLE <o>.<t> MOVE ONLINE;` maintains them, otherwise rebuild afterwards.

description: cannot shrink datafile - file %s is under hot backup
cause: Attempt to shrink a datafile while it is under hot backup. This is not allowed.
action: Retry shrinking the file after the hot backup completes.

description: cannot create dictionary table %s
cause: A dictionary table is created upon the first execution of the command 'alter database datafile autoextend on' for a database. This operation did not succeed. The most probable cause for this is insufficient space in the system tablespace.
action: See action for next error message in error stack.

description: invalid setting '%s' specified in command ALTER SESSION SET "ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS": %s
cause: The setting for ALTER SESSION "ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS" is invalid. ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS can be set using ALTER SYSTEM to 'ON' or 'OFF' or 'DISALLOWED'. ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS can be set using ALTER SESSION to 'ON' or 'OFF'. The setting 'DISALLOWED' is invalid when using ALTER SESSION. When ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS is set to 'DISALLOWED' using ALTER SYSTEM, individual sessions cannot use ALTER SESSION to change their session value of ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS.
action: Use a valid setting for ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS.
params: 1) setting: Invalid setting. 2) explanation: Explanation of why this parameter is invalid.

description: (ORA-00001 details) row with column values (%s) already exists
cause: The preceding ORA-00001 error on the stack is enhanced to provide additional details when requested. Additional error details are configured using system parameter "ERROR_MESSAGE_DETAILS".
action: Use these details to understand the preceding ORA-00001 error and take the appropriate action as described in the ORA-00001 Action text.
params: 1) column_values: Column values which violated the unique constraint.

description: (ORA-01722 details) invalid string value: %s
cause: The error supplements the preceding ORA-01722 error by providing the character string whose conversion to number failed.
action: Use the character string to understand the preceding ORA-01722 error and take the action described in the ORA-01722 action text.
params: 1) string_value: The character string that cannot be converted to a number.

description: Conversion failed from column type %s to define type %s for column name %s at define position or name %s
cause: Attempted conversion from column type to define type failed on server side.
action: Use the column name and type to identify the problematic conversion value to the defined type.
params: 1) column_type: Type of the column being used for conversion 2) define_type: The type definition on client side 3) column_name: Name of the column used for conversion 4) define_position: Define position in statement

description: For TIME_BUCKET function, the specified datetime and the origin should be DATETIME or Epoch Time.
cause: The specified datetime or the origin is neither a DATETIME nor an Epoch Time.
action: Check the specified datetime (the first argument) and the origin (the third argument), and ensure they are either DATETIME or Epoch Time.

description: For TIME_BUCKET function, the stride should be an INTERVAL or ISO 8601 time interval string.
cause: The stride is neither an INTERVAL nor ISO 8601 time interval string.
action: Check the stride (the second argument), and ensure it is either an INTERVAL or ISO 8601 time interval string.

description: For TIME_BUCKET function, the origin should have the same data type as specified datetime.
cause: The origin has a different data type than the specified datetime.
action: Check the origin (the third argument) and the specified datetime (the first argument), and ensure that they are of the same data type.

description: For TIME_BUCKET function, fractional second is supported only if the specified datetime and the origin are Epoch Time, BINARY_FLOAT or BINARY_DOUBLE.
cause: Fractional second is used when the specified datetime and the origin are not Epoch Time, BINARY_FLOAT or BINARY_DOUBLE.
action: Check the datetime (the first argument) and the origin (the third argument), and ensure that they are Epoch Time, BINARY_FLOAT or BINARY_DOUBLE.

description: End of query reached; no additional text should follow.
cause: An unexpected text is being encountered in the SQL statement after the end of a complete query. One of the following probably occurred: 1. Additional text is added after the end of the query, denoted by a semicolon. 2. A semicolon is mistakenly included in the middle of the SQL statement.
action: Check the syntax of your SQL statment. Include only one SQL statement at a time.

description: Unknown level identifier %s
cause: The specified level identifier is invalid.
action: Ensure that the level is valid and try again. Valid levels are as follows: 1. BASIC 2. TYPICAL (default) 3. ALL

description: Unknown object type %s
cause: The specified type is invalid.
action: Ensure that the type is valid and try again.

description: Object not found : %s.%s
cause: The specified object does not exist, or a synonym pointed to an object that does not exist. To find existing user tables, views and indexes, query the ALL_OBJECTS data dictionary views. Certain privileges may be required to access the object. If an application returned this message, then the object that the application tried to access does not exist in the database, or the application does not have access to it.
action: Check each of the following: - The spelling of the object is correct. - The referenced object does exist. - The synonym points to an existing object. If the object does exist, ensure that the correct access privileges are granted to the database user requiring access to the table. Otherwise, create the table. Also, if you are attempting to access an object in another schema, ensure that the correct schema is referenced and that access to the object is granted.

description: Invalid value specified for %s parameter (%s). Must be an integer literal between 1 and 100.
cause: The value specified should be a positive integer. For RESCORE FACTOR parameter, it should be at most 100.
action: Modify the parameter value and retry the operation.
params: 1) param_name: The name of the parameter. 2) param_value: The value specified for the parameter.

description: The time unit for DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF is invalid.
cause: The first argument is either missing, incorrect, or not a valid time unit.
action: Ensure that the first argument of DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF is one of these keywords: YEAR, MONTH, DAY, WEEK, QUARTER, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND, MILLISECOND, MICROSECOND, or NANOSECOND. Or, ensure that the first argument is a runtime CHAR value that correctly evaluates to one of these keywords.

description: The start datetime or end datetime for DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF is invalid.
cause: The second or third argument for DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF is invalid or of an unsupported type.
action: Ensure that the second and third arguments for DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF are of the appropriate data types. Both arguments should be either DATE, TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMP WITH TIMEZONE, or TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIMEZONE, or expressions evaluating to these types.

description: The start of period value for DATEDIFF or TIMESTAMPDIFF is invalid.
cause: The fourth argument is either incorrectly specified or is using an unsupported time unit.
action: Use the fourth argument only when the time unit is YEAR, QUARTER, or WEEK and ensure that it falls within the valid range of 1-12 for YEAR or QUARTER or falls within the valid range of 0-7 for WEEK.

description: Parameter must be set when logged in as SYSDBA.
cause: An attempt was made to set a parameter as a user other than SYSDBA.
action: Log in as SYSDBA to set this parameter.

description: More than one shardspace not allowed with system-managed sharding.
cause: An attempt to add a shardspace to the catalog was attempted when a shardspace already existed.
action: Only one shardspace is allowed per system-managed catalog. Use the existing shardspace or re-create the catalog with a different sharding type.

description: invalid parameter combination: %s and %s
cause: Mutually exclusive parameters were specified in a command.
action: Verify the parameters and retry command.

description: reserved word used as object name: %s
cause: A reserved word was used as the name of an object.
action: Verify the parameters and retry command.

description: no sharded database pools exist
cause: A command was issued which required a sharded database pool, but none existed.
action: Add a sharded database pool and retry the command.

description: too many sharded database pools exist
cause: A command was issued which required a sharded database pool, but more than one existed.
action: Remove a sharded database pool and retry the command.

description: must explicitly specify shardgroup name because there could be multiple candidates
cause: A command was issued without specifying a shardgroup and a default shardgroup could not be determined.
action: Do not omit '-shardgroup' when multiple shardgroups exist.

description: must explicitly specify shardspace name because there could be multiple candidates
cause: A command was issued without specifying a shardspace and a default shardspace could not be determined.
action: Do not omit '-shardspace' when multiple shardspaces exist.

description: mandatory environment variable not set at destination: %s
cause: An environment variable required for the operation was not set at the specified destination.
action: Provide a value for the variable and retry operation.

description: shard '%s' does not exist
cause: The requested shard did not exist.
action: Check the name and try again.

description: invalid format for input parameter file
cause: The input file contained a parameter that was too long or the input file was not in the correct format.
action: Consult the documentation and confirm that the file contents and parameters being used are valid and retry the operation.

description: directory does not exist or is not writeable at destination: %s
cause: A directory required for successful operation did not exist or was not writeable at the destination.
action: Confirm that the directory exists and that permissions allow for the creation of files.

description: A shard with the same database identifier is a member of a different shardgroup.
cause: A shard with the same database identifier was a member of a shardgroup in another shardspace.
action: All shards with the same database identifier must be members of the same shardgroup. Specify a different shardroup and retry the operation.

description: A shard with the same database identifier is already in the shardgroup.
cause: A shard with the same database identifier was a member of the specified shardgroup.
action: All shards in a shardgroup must have unique database identifiers. Specify a different shardroup and retry the operation.

description: Shard '%s' contained %s chunks and %s replication units.
cause: A shard that contained chunks or replication units was removed from the catalog. Those chunks or replication units are no longer available.
action: This is an informational message only.

description: errors found during chunk recovery
cause: The chunk recovery procedure was not able to automatically recover corrupted chunks.
action: Examine the trace files and manually fix the problems by altering shard tablespaces.

description: invalid user %s
cause: The specified user did not exist on this shard.
action: Ensure that the shard DDL is up to date and re-try.

description: statement too long
cause: The statement was too long.
action: Reduce the size of the statement to 3800 bytes or less.

description: Shard %s does not exist in the shard pool.
cause: A nonexistent shard was provided for execution.
action: Ensure that the shard exists and try again.

description: Service management is not available at this time because broker configuration %s does not have a registered primary database.
cause: The primary database was not registered. Service management requires registration of all primary databases.
action: Wait for new primary database to be registered and try again.

description: Shard character set does not match catalog character set.
cause: The specified shard character set did not match the catalog character set.
action: Ensure that the character sets match and try again.

description: Shard national character set does not match catalog national character set.
cause: The specified shard national character set did not match the catalog national character set.
action: Ensure that the national character sets match and try again.

description: Shard metadata replication.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Target database metadata retrieval and availability check.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Backup 0 creation.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Backup 0 replication and restoration.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Transition to read-only mode.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Backup 1 creation, replication and restoration.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: User metadata export.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk import.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk migration is successful. Performing data transition and cleanup.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk migration is not successful. Performing recovery of data on source database and cleanup of target database.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk migration is scheduled.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk migration cleanup failed on source.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Actual chunk migration failed.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Chunk migration failed on target.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Database "%s" status shows previous move errors. Chunk migration is scheduled.
cause: Chunk migration information message
action: NA

description: Database %s is not a part of the sharded schema.
cause: The specified database was not in the sharded schema.
action: Ensure that the name is correct and try again.

description: cannot suspend move for chunk number %s
cause: The specified chunk move could not be suspended.
action: Either the move has already started or is no longer in the the queue. Check the status and try again.

description: cannot remove chunk number %s from the move queue
cause: The specified chunk could not be removed from the queue.
action: Either the move has already started or is no longer in the queue. Check the status and try again.

description: The specified database is not configured to be a catalog.
cause: The specified database was not configured to be a catalog.
action: Specify a valid catalog database and retry the operation.

description: Deployment failed with error: %s
cause: Unable to successfully complete shard deployment.
action: Check error returned and retry the operation.

description: Could not retrieve default template from shard.
cause: Unable to retrieve default Oracle Database Configuration Assistant (DBCA) template from shard.
action: Verify that General_Purpose.dbc exists on shard and retry the operation. Alternately, explicity provide a template using 'create shard' command options.

description: Move chunk conditions are not met.
cause: Chunk migration pre-check failed because one of the transporting tablespaces was either read-only or in hot backup mode.
action: Alter the tablespace to fulfill chunk migration requirements.

description: cannot create service, sharded services must use preferred_all option
cause: An attempt was made to create a service in a sharded pool that specified preferred and available databases.
action: Use only preferred_all option for sharded services.

description: Shard DDL state is not up-to-date.
cause: The requested operation required one or more involved shards to be up-to-date with the DDL state of the sharded system.
action: Recover shards, which are in DDL Error state, wait for DDL execution to finish on every shard, then retry executing the operation.

description: global service manager not running
cause: The master global service manager was no longer connected to the catalog.
action: Restart the global service manager and retry operation.

description: The GSMUSER account does not have SYSDG and SYSBACKUP privileges.
cause: The GSMUSER account was not granted SYSDG and SYSBACKUP privileges.
action: Grant the necessary privileges and retry the operation.

description: root table already exists
cause: New shardspaces could not be added because a root table already existed in the sharded database.
action: Drop the root table and retry operation.

description: A deploy operation is already in progress.
cause: A previous request for deploy operation was still in progress.
action: Wait for the previous deploy operation to complete and check if another deploy operation is required before resubmitting the request.

description: Cross shard chunk operation cannot be performed at this time. Details : %s
cause: A database condition that prevents chunk move was detected.
action: Refer to the following error message for additional information. Correct the error, if possible, and try the move again.

description: flashback database not enabled
cause: The flashback database was not enabled on the database being configured.
action: Enable flashback database and retry the operation.

description: user-defined sharding not supported
cause: User-defined sharding was not supported on the database being configured.
action: Use either system-managed or composite sharding.

description: specified VNCR in use
cause: The specified valid node check for registration (VNCR) was in use by at least one database or shard.
action: Remove any databases or shards that use the VNCR and retry the operation.

description: The procedure cannot be propagated.
cause: SYS.EXEC_SHARD_PLSQL can only execute a limited set of PL/SQL procedures.
action: Execute a procedure manually on each shard.

description: shardgroups not allowed with user-defined sharding or federated database
cause: An attempt was made to create a shardgroup with user-defined sharding or a federated database.
action: Use either system-managed or composite sharding in the non-federated database.

description: current database role is incorrect: %s
cause: An attempt was made to create a primary shard from a standby database or a standby shard from a primary database.
action: Validate the current database role and confirm that it matches the role of the specified shardgroup (for system-managed or composite sharding) or that it matches the -deploy_as parameter specified in the 'add shard' command (for user-defined sharding).

description: The chunk %s is already being split.
cause: There was an incomplete split operation on the same chunk ID.
action: Wait until the split finishes and try again.

description: cannot skip or ignore shard DDL
cause: An attempt was made to skip a system DDL request such as SPLITCHUNK.
action: Fix the error at the shard, which cause the DDL to fail, and then recover.

description: cannot schedule split during an ongoing move
cause: There was an incomplete move operation.
action: Wait until the move finishes and try again.

description: This procedure cannot be used to set database parameter %s.
cause: An attempt was made to set a database parameter that cannot be set using this procedure.
action: Do not set this parameter using this procedure.

description: Oracle RAC affinity is supported only on a non-sharded Oracle RAC database.
cause: An attempt to enable affinity was made on an Oracle database that was either non-RAC, or shard, or shard catalog.
action: Enable affinity on the Oracle RAC non-sharded database.

description: Table is not found.
cause: The table specification was not correct.
action: Specify a valid table name in the ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE AFFINITY statement.

description: Partitioned table with this name does not exist.
cause: The specified table was not partitioned.
action: Enable affinity for a partitioned table.

description: Partitioned type '%s' is not supported.
cause: The specified table was not partitioned by either RANGE, LIST or HASH.
action: Enable affinity for a partitioned table.

description: Affinity is already enabled for a different table or service.
cause: A table affinity was already specified. Multiple table affinities are currently not supported.
action: Disable affinity for existing table.

description: Service %s has already been deleted by another session.
cause: An attempt was made to delete a service that was already deleted.
action: None. The previous delete request completes and the service is removed.

description: Cannot modify service %s because it is being deleted.
cause: An attempt was made to modify a service that was already deleted.
action: None. The previous delete request completes and the service is removed.

description: The database to be replaced is not deployed: %s
cause: An attempt was made to replace a database that was not deployed.
action: Verify that the database to be replaced is in a deployed state.

description: The database to be replaced is still up: %s
cause: An attempt was made to replace a database that was still running.
action: Verify that the database is down and try again.

description: job_queue_processes setting must be greater than one
cause: The job_queue_processes initialization parameter was set to zero or one.
action: Set job_queue_processes to a larger value and retry the operation.

description: incorrect shard is given for replace: %s
cause: An attempt was made to replace a shard with another shard that did not have the same data as the original shard.
action: Copy the data correctly before attempting to replace. The RMAN utility can be used for this purpose.

description: parameter parsing failed with error: %s
cause: The parameter values passed to SET DATAGUARD_PROPERTY were invalid.
action: Verify the parameter values and retry the operation.

description: attempt to set Oracle Data Guard property failed with error: %s
cause: The values passed to SET DATAGUARD_PROPERTY were invalid.
action: Verify the input values and retry the operation.

description: SPLIT CHUNK is not supported on a user-defined sharding environment.
cause: A SPLIT CHUNK command was attempted on a user-defined sharding environment.
action: This operation is not supported.

description: Cannot replace shard with OGG replication setup: %s
cause: An attempt was made to replace a shard with Oracle GoldenGate (OGG) as replication setup.
action: None. The operation is not supported.

description: The new DBID of the standby database does not match the old DBID.
cause: An attempt was made to replace a standby database shard having a different database identifier (DBID) than the original shard. All members of the Oracle Data Guard configuration must have same DBID.
action: Ensure that the correct shard is specified and that it has the same DBID.

description: maximum number of shards exceeded
cause: A maximum of three primary shards are supported on this platform.
action: Do not attempt to use more than three primary shards.

description: A move operation is already in progress.
cause: A move was already in progress. Multiple concurrent user-requested move operations are not permitted.
action: Wait until the current move operation completes before starting another.

description: Chunk %s was already being moved to or from another location.
cause: The chunk was already being moved. The current move request cannot be superceded.
action: Wait until the existing move completes, or cancel it, before trying to move the chunk again.

description: failed to update broker configuration with error: %s
cause: A request to update the broker configuration failed.
action: Check the broker logs for details.

description: failed to stop fast-start failover observers with error: %s
cause: A request to stop observers failed during an attempt to modify the Oracle Data Guard broker configuration.
action: Ensure that the primary database shard can connect to the observer. Check the broker logs for details.

description: error, 'error while executing some of the DDL statements'
cause: There was an error while executing some of the DDL statements.
action: Check the status of the DDL execution on shards and fix the problem.

description: error, 'time out while waiting for the DDL statement execution'
cause: The specified timeout was reached while waiting for the completion of the DDL statement execution.
action: Check the status of the DDL execution on shards and try again.

description: no new shard to deploy
cause: No qualifying shards were available to be deployed.
action: If undeployed shards exist, ensure that all primary shards have a corresponding standby shard in every standby shardgroup and retry the deployment. If no undeployed shards exist, add shards to the configuration and retry the deployment.

description: failed to disable fast-start failover with error: %s
cause: A request to disable fast-start failover failed.
action: Check the broker logs for details.

description: database not open
cause: An operation was attempted that requires the database to be open.
action: Open the database and retry the operation.

description: failed to replace primary database shard: %s
cause: An attempt was made to replace a primary database shard when standby databases are alive. This is not allowed.
action: Do not replace a primary when standbys are alive. Replacing a primary database is only allowed when all the standby databases are down. If this database was the primary before failure, one of the standbys need to transition to a primary role by a failover. This database can then be replaced as a standby database.

description: failed to remove standby shard %s from the broker configuration with error: %s
cause: A request to remove the shard from the broker configuration failed.
action: Check the broker logs for details.

description: Shardspace '%s' does not contain a primary or readwrite shardgroup.
cause: An attempt is being made to add a standby or readonly shard group or to modify an existing shard group, resulting in the absence of any primary or readwrite shard groups.
action: Add a primary or readwrite shardgroup to the shardspace before adding a standby or readonly shardgroup.

description: cannot move chunk when sharded tables are in inconsistent state
cause: An attempt was made to move chunk when one or more of the sharded tables are in inconsistent state.
action: Alter the tables that are inconsistent to make them consistent with the root table and then try to move chunk.

description: multitenant container database (CDB) already exists: %s
cause: The specified multitenant container database (CDB) was already in existence.
action: Verify the multitenant container database (CDB) name and retry the operation.

description: CDB for this PDB is not found
cause: An attempt was made to add a pluggable database (PDB) shard, but its container database (CDB) was not part of the sharding configuration or did not match the database identifier (DBID).
action: Add the CDB using ADD CBD command before adding the PDB. Ensure that the PDB and the CDB have the same DBID.

description: CDB already has one of the PDBs as a shard
cause: One of the pluggable databases (PDB) in a container database (CDB) was already added as a shard.
action: Do not add multiple PDBs of the same CDB as shards.

description: CDB name is invalid: %s
cause: An invalid multitenant container database (CDB) name was specified.
action: Verify the multitenant container database (CDB) name and retry the operation.

description: CDB does not exist: %s
cause: The specified multitenant container database (CDB) did not exist.
action: Verify the multitenant container database (CDB) name and retry the operation.

description: The tablespace set %s is read-only or offline.
cause: Chunk operation was requested while the tablespace set was not online.
action: Ensure that all tablespace sets are online and repeat the operation.

description: database already contains sharding metadata
cause: The specified database already contained sharding metadata and could not be added as a new shard.
action: Create a new database and retry the operation.

description: cannot deploy this shard for user-defined sharding because database version is not compatible
cause: The database version was older than version 18.0 and did not support user-defined sharding.
action: Upgrade the database version to deploy the shard in user-defined sharding.

description: Source database version is higher than target database version.
cause: Target database was a lower version than the source database.
action: Upgrade the target database so that both databases have the same version.

description: invalid table family name specified: %s
cause: The table family name specified for the service was invalid.
action: Verify that the table family name is in the format of <schema_name>.<root_table_name> and retry the operation.

description: cannot drop values from partitions and subpartitions of a user-defined sharded table
cause: An attempt was made to modify a partition or a subpartition of a user-defined sharded table to drop one or more values.
action: Perform a split partition followed by a drop partition to remove the value from the partition.

description: incomplete PARTITION or SUBPARTITION maintenance command
cause: The ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT or MERGE PARTITION or SUBPARTITION command did not contain an UPDATE INDEXES clause for a user-defined sharded table.
action: Specify the UPDATE INDEXES clause and try again.

description: cannot add partitionset to table that is not root sharded table.
cause: ADD PARTITIONSET was a valid command only for a root sharded table.
action: Use the MOVE PARTITIONSET command to move the table to a different tablespace set in the shardspace.

description: Only REFRESH COMPLETE ON DEMAND USING TRUSTED CONSTRAINTS option is supported for materialized views on sharded tables created on the catalog.
cause: An attempt was made to create a materialized view on a sharded table on the shard catalog using the unsupported REFRESH options.
action: Specify the supported option to create such materialized views.

description: cannot alter the root table when there are child tables in inconsistent state
cause: An attempt was made to alter a root table when one or more of its child tables were in inconsistent state.
action: Alter the child tables that are in the inconsistent state to make them consistent with the root table and then alter the root table.

description: missing tablespace clause for LOB column or columns in one or more partitions
cause: An attempt was made to split a table partition with LOB columns without specifying tablespaces for all LOB columns in each resulting partition after the split.
action: Use LOB(<column names>) STORE AS clause in each partition to specify tablespaces for all the LOB columns in the table.

description: partition set %s does not exist
cause: An invalid partition set name was specified in the ALTER TABLE DDL.
action: Specify a valid partition set name.

description: An all shard GRANT command cannot contain any local objects.
cause: A GRANT command that contained local objects was issued with shard DDL enabled.
action: Remove the local objects from the command, or issue it with shard DDL disabled.

description: shard key or partition set key columns cannot be columns that accept NULL values
cause: An attempt was made to create a sharded table with shard key or partition set key columns that accept NULL values.
action: Create the sharded table with shard key or partition set key columns having a NOT NULL constraint.

description: invalid database context for CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function
cause: An attempt was made to call either the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function in a non-sharded environment.
action: Use the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function only on shard databases.

description: invalid column position for CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function
cause: An attempt was made to call either the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function with an invalid column position.
action: Use a valid column position with either the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function.

description: Filtering shard query results based on the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function is not supported with full outer joins.
cause: An attempt was made to call either the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY or CURRENT_PSET_KEY function to filter results of a sharded query with full outer joins.
action: Disable filtering shard query results for queries with full outer joins.

description: cannot specify NULL as partition bound or partitionset bound in sharding
cause: An attempt was made to create a sharded table partition or partitionset with NULL value bound.
action: Create the sharded table partition or partitionset with bound values that is not NULL.

description: list partition method expects a single partitioning column in user-defined sharding
cause: An attempt was made to create a sharded table with multiple columns as partitioning key.
action: Create the sharded table with a single column as the partitioning key.

description: cannot set a column of object data type as UNUSED in sharded tables
cause: An attempt was made to alter a sharded table and set a column of object data type as UNUSED.
action: Do not alter the sharded table to set a column of object data type as UNUSED.

description: cannot drop the parent of a sharded child table
cause: An attempt was made to drop the parent of a sharded child table.
action: Drop all sharded child tables before dropping the parent table.

description: cannot merge partitions that belong to different shardspaces
cause: An attempt was made to merge partitions that are created in different shardspaces.
action: Do not merge partitions that are created in different shardspaces.

description: DML operations are not supported on the catalog for federated database tables.
cause: An attempt was made to perform a data manipulation language (DML) operation on a federated database table in the catalog.
action: Do not perform any DML operations on tables in a federated database in the catalog.

description: DDL operations are not allowed under enabled shard DDL in a federated database setup.
cause: An attempt was made to perform a DDL (data definition language) operation on a federated database catalog while shard DDL was enabled.
action: Do not perform any DDL operations other than ALTER TABLE EXTERNALLY on federated database tables in the catalog while shard DDL is enabled.

description: ALTER TABLE EXTERNALLY cannot be performed on non-federated database tables.
cause: An attempt was made to alter a non-federated database table to externally sharded or duplicated.
action: Do not perform ALTER TABLE EXTERNALLY on non-federated database tables. This operation only applies to tables in a federated database in the catalog.

description: Barrier DDL statements cannot be executed across a Sharding Replication Unit in the current execution context.
cause: A data definition language (DDL) statement was issued across a Sharding Replication Unit, but the execution context does not support this DDL statement. This error occurs when the Oracle Database system's synchronous DDL feature is enabled, but the session is not connected using a dedicated server connection. All subsequent attempts at barrier DDL will also be rejected.
action: Either connect using a dedicated server connection, or, as SYSDBA, disable synchronous DDL and retry the DDL statement.

description: WARNING: DDL failed on %s shards( offline: %s, skipped: %s, errors: %s)
cause: DDL was not propagated to offline shards and skipped shards with past DDL errors. DLL errors show the number of shards with errors.
action: Use the GDSCTL 'config shard' and 'recover shard' to identify and fix DDL-related issues.

description: Asynchronous propagation of DDL is timed out.
cause: DDL statement propagation was not finished within one hour.
action: Check GDSCTL and shard database server logs to identify the cause of the delay.

description: Error on %s shard(s): %s
cause: DDL statement propagation errored out on one or more shards.
action: Use the GDSCTL 'config shard' command for details on the error and then use the 'recover shard' command.

description: DDL statement cannot be executed due to shard unavailability.
cause: DDL statement could not be executed synchronously because some shards were offline. The DDL STRICT execution mode requires all primary shards to be online.
action: Start the shards and reexecute the statement.

description: Barrier DDL statement cannot be executed in a shard with both read/write (RU %s) and read-only (RU %s) replication units.
cause: A Barrier DDL statement can only be executed in a shard that is either exclusively read/write or read-only. The shard is found to contain both read/write and read-only replication units. This can also occur if replication units are currently being moved between read/write and read-only shards or regions.
action: Either disable Barrier DDL and resubmit the DDL statement again, or wait for the replication unit to stabilize after being moved.
params: 1) read_write_replication_unit: The number of the read/write replication unit. 2) read_only_replication_unit: The number of the read-only replication unit.

description: deadlock detected between Barrier DDL statement on table %s.%s and a concurrently running DML statement on the same table (root cause is %s, %s)
cause: While a sharding replication unit Barrier DDL statement was in progress there was a concurrently running DML statement referencing the same table as that referenced in the Barrier DDL statement. Both the DDL and the DML deadlocked while trying to access the same resources and same locks.
action: To avoid resource contention try to run one statement followed by the other statement.

description: cannot operate on externally sharded objects in the catalog
cause: An attempt was made to create or modify an externally sharded object in the federated database catalog.
action: Do not operate on externally sharded objects in the federated database catalog. Perform the operation on all shards and run the 'gdsctl sync schema' command to update the catalog.

description: sharding key or super sharding key error
cause: The sharding key or super sharding key provided did not match the key column definitions for the table family.
action: Double check the sharding key and super sharding key columns for this table family.

description: sharding and supersharding columns must form a subset key of key columns of a foreign key
cause: An attempt is being made to create a foreign key constraint in a sharded table whose sharding or supersharding key columns do not form a subset of the foreign key columns.
action: Include all sharding and supersharding key columns in the list of foreign key columns. This is required because foreign key constraint cannot be enforced across shards.

description: Creating network senders (error code %s) failed.
cause: Failure while creating the network sender servers.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Logical change record (LCR) producer process for replication unit %s is unable to communicate with network sender %s during initialization.
cause: Network sender could not be started properly.
action: Fix any errors during network sender creation and restart the logical change record (LCR) producer process.

description: Network sender, logical change record (LCR) persister, or user %s is unable to communicate with logical change record (LCR) producer process for replication unit %s.
cause: The logical change record (LCR) producer process was not started properly or was aborted.
action: Fix any errors during the logical change record (LCR) producer process creation and restart the logical change record (LCR) producer process.

description: %s background process for replication unit %s might not be started successfully
cause: An error occurred during creation of a background process for the given replication unit.
action: Check the trace file for more information.

description: Logical change record (LCR) producer process for replication unit %s received an error from network sender or acknowledgment receiver.
cause: The network sender or the acknowledgment receiver received an error.
action: Check the log for error details.

description: Network sender for replication unit %s for shard %s is active and needs to join logical change record (LCR) producer process.
cause: The network sender was waiting for the remote follower to catch up.
action: Logical change record (LCR) producer process needs a restart (done automatically).

description: Leader cannot enqueue logical change records (LCRs) for replication unit %s.
cause: The queue was not initialized or memory was full.
action: Retry the user DML operations.

description: cannot perform DML operations (%s on %s.%s) in a follower shard for replication unit %s, chunk ID %s
cause: This shard was a follower of the replication unit.
action: Retry the user DML operations in the leader shard for this replication unit.

description: foreign key constraint must be on a table in the same table family
cause: A foreign key constraint was specified with the referenced table belonging to a different table family.
action: Specify foreign key reference on a table in the same table family.

description: invalid %s received for replication unit %s
cause: An invalid value was received in network receiver for the specified replication unit.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: unknown replication unit: %s
cause: The replication unit was not known to the follower database.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Raft log record for replication unit %1!s and log index %2!s does not exist. Last persisted log index %3!s.
cause: The specified raft log record does not exist.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: chunk relocation error
cause: Chunk relocation between replication units failed.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Raft log record for replication unit %s and log index %s has no more data.
cause: The specified raft log record had no more data to be read.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: cannot create substitutable columns of object data type on sharded or duplicated tables
cause: An attempt was made to create a substitutable column of object data type on a sharded or duplicated table.
action: For sharded table, create this column with the NOT SUBSTITUTABLE option. For duplicated table, do not use non-final object data type.

description: Schema on the shard is inconsisent with the schema on the catalog of a federated database.
cause: Schema was modified on a shard of a federated database and the SYNC SCHEMA operation has not been performed.
action: Perform SYNC SCHEMA operation to update the catalog database about changes on the shard.

description: The following ALTER TYPE statement is not supported for all shard object types: %s.
cause: An attempt was made to alter an all shard object type with invalid options.
action: Do not specify this option in an ALTER TYPE statement.

description: cannot drop an all shard object type with FORCE option
cause: An attempt was made to drop an all shard object type with the FORCE option.
action: Drop all types and tables depending on the type and then retry the operation without the FORCE option.

description: A column cannot be both sharding and partitionset key.
cause: An attempt was made to create a sharded table with a column defined as both sharding and partitionset key.
action: Do not create a sharded table with the same column defined as sharding as well as partitionset key.

description: The tablespace set %s is already associated with a table family.
cause: The specified tablespace set could not be used for this command because it was already associated with another table family.
action: Specify a different tablespace set for the command.

description: operation not supported in federated database
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation that was not supported with federated database.
action: Do not attempt to run this operation.

description: user already exists on the catalog: %s
cause: A schema name was specified for creation that already exists on the catalog.
action: Specify schema names that do not exist in the catalog.

description: no schema provided
cause: No schemas were specified for this command.
action: If specific schemas need to be synchronized, specify a comma-separated list of schemas with the '-schema' parameter of the GDSCTL command. Specify 'all' to synchronize all non-Oracle schemas common to all shards and that do not exist in the catalog.

description: A CDB must be specified when adding a PDB shard.
cause: An attempt was made to add a pluggable database (PDB) shard to the configuration without specifying its multitenant container database (CDB).
action: Use the -cdb parameter in the 'add shard' command to specify a CDB.

description: root container (CDB$ROOT) cannot be used as a shard
cause: An attempt was made to add the root container (CDB$ROOT) to the configuration.
action: Validate the connect string provided and specify a pluggable database (PDB) instead.

description: root container (CDB$ROOT) must be specified when adding a CDB
cause: An attempt was made to add a pluggable database (PDB) as a multitenant container database (CDB).
action: Validate the connect string provided and specify the root container (CDB$ROOT) instead.

description: A listener.ora file already exists in the shard host Oracle home.
cause: An attempt was made to create a new TNS listener on the shard host, but a listener.ora file already existed in the $ORACLE_HOME/network/admin directory.
action: Stop any listeners running from the target Oracle home, delete the listener.ora file and retry the operation.

description: The specified CDB already contains a PDB shard from the current sharded database.
cause: An attempt was made to add a pluggable database (PDB) shard to a multitenant container database (CDB) that already contained a PDB shard from the same sharded database.
action: Use the -cdb parameter in the 'add shard' command to specify a different CDB.

description: Moving all chunks is not allowed in user-defined sharding.
cause: An attempt was made to move all chunks from a source database. This operation is not allowed for user defined sharding.
action: Move only numbered chunks from the source database. Do not use the -all flag.

description: Creating a shard catalog is not allowed in the root of a multitenant container database (CDB).
cause: An attempt was made to create a shard catalog in the root of a CDB.
action: Connect to a pluggable database (PDB) to create the shard catalog.

description: Pluggable database (PDB) name cannot be modified for a service.
cause: An attempt was made to modify the pluggable database (PDB) name for a service.
action: Do not modify the pluggable database (PDB) name for a service. If necessary, remove the service and re-create it in another pluggable database (PDB).

description: A common user cannot run sharded DDL statements.
cause: An attempt was made to run sharded DDL statements as a common user.
action: Common users cannot run sharded DDL stetements. Connect as a Pluggable Database user and try again.

description: There is no deployed database named %s.
cause: The named database either did not exist or was not deployed.
action: Check the database name and deploy the database before attempting to sync it.

description: cannot move chunk when there are no partition sets
cause: Move chunk operation was attempted in a shardspace that did not have any partition set for sharded tables.
action: Add partition set to sharded tables before running the move chunk operation.

description: The GSMROOTUSER account does not have SYSDG and SYSBACKUP privileges.
cause: The GSMROOTUSER account was not granted SYSDG and SYSBACKUP privileges.
action: Grant the necessary privileges and retry the operation.

description: maximum number of table families reached
cause: An attempt was made to create a new table family when the maximum supported number of table families was reached.
action: Do not create more table families than the maximum allowed. /

description: shardspace does not contain a primary shard
cause: The specified shardspace did not contain a primary shard.
action: Add a primary shard to the shardspace prior to adding any standby shards.

description: The specified shard is already configured as a catalog.
cause: An attempt was made to add a shard that was already configured as a catalog.
action: Verify the connect string specified and retry the operation.

description: Parameter %s passed to function %s has invalid value %s.
cause: A sharding function was called with an invalid value.
action: This is an internal error, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Some DDL statements are not applied to the catalog.
cause: The GDSCTL command 'sync schema' was executed before all of the existing DDL statements were applied.
action: Execute the GDSCTL command 'sync schema' with the '-apply' parameter before attempting to synchronize with shards and ensure that all of the statements are executed by running 'sync schema -show'.

description: unable to create shard wallet at %(1)s with error %(2)s
cause: Oracle was unable to create the shard wallet at the specified location.
action: Verify that the specified location exists and can be written to or try again using a different wallet location.

description: unable to encrypt DDL statement with error %s
cause: The system was unable to encrypt the DDL statement.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: unable to encrypt GSMUSER password with error %s
cause: Oracle was unable encrypt the Global Service Manager GSMUSER password.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: The database parameter WALLET_ROOT is already set.
cause: A new WALLET_ROOT value was used to create the catalog, but the database parameter WALLET_ROOT was already set.
action: Do not pass a WALLET_ROOT value. The catalog uses the existing location stipulated in the WALLET_ROOT parameter.

description: error %s when attempting to generate a temporary key to add new shards
cause: The system was unable to generate a new key to add shards.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Chunk is put online on migration destination shard
cause: Chunk migration information message.
action: NA

description: The specified VNCR or VNCR group does not exist.
cause: The specified valid node check for registration (VNCR) or VNCR group did not exist in the catalog.
action: Verify that the specified VNCR or VNCR group exists and retry the operation.

description: schemas do not exist on all shards: %s
cause: The GDSCTL command 'sync schema' was executed with schema names that did not exist on all shards.
action: Specify schemas that exist on all shards.

description: no new DDL (Data Definition Language) statement to apply
cause: No new DDL statements were found to apply on the catalog.
action: NA

description: Parallel execution of data import failed.
cause: A chunk migration error occurred during the parallel execution of the chunk import phase.
action: Examine the worker process trace files to identify the cause.

description: unsupported catalog database character set for federated database
cause: The database character set of the catalog was not AL32UTF8 which is needed to deploy a federated database.
action: Change the database character set of catalog to AL32UTF8 and retry the operation.

description: Execute synchronize schema operation after reconfiguration of shards completes.
cause: An operation was executed resulting in reconfiguration of shards, which should be followed by the 'synchronize schema' operation in a federated database in order to see the schema changes in the catalog.
action: Perform 'synchronize schema' using GDSCTL after the current operation succeeds, and all primary shards are deployed and available.

description: some primary shards are undeployed or unavailable
cause: Some of the primary shards were not deployed or not available when performing this operation.
action: This operation requires that all of the primary shards are deployed and available. Ensure that they are up and retry the operation. Check the output of 'config shard' command for the status of shards.

description: chunk '%s' in shardspace '%s' too small to split
cause: A chunk split was requested for a chunk that only had a range of 1.
action: Do not split a chunk that only has a range of 1.

description: operation not supported in non-federated database
cause: An operation was attempted which is only supported in a federated database.
action: Do not execute the operation in a non-federated database.

description: alias '%s' not allowed here
cause: Referencing alias in the GROUP BY clause, HAVING clause, or grouping()/grouping_id() function is not supported when MODEL clause is present.
action: Replace alias reference with the expression that is aliased.

description: Shard DDL cannot be executed as SYS because the following databases are either not available or do not support encryption: %s.
cause: An attempt was made to execute shard DDL as user SYS. This is insecure unless it can be encrypted.
action: Either execute the DDL as another user, or update the listed shards or catalog so that they can support encryption. Shards and the catalog must be secure to make this check.

description: invalid duplicated table: %s
cause: The table name specified was not a duplicated table.
action: Specify a valid duplicated table name.

description: The specified tag is too long or contains invalid characters.
cause: The specified length of the tag exceeded 30 characters or contained characters other than letters, numbers, and underscore.
action: Specify a tag having at most 30 characters; ensure that it contains only letters, numbers, and underscore.

description: common users are not allowed: %s
cause: A common user was specified with the SYNC SCHEMA command. This is not supported because only pluggable database (PDB) local users can be created on the shard catalog.
action: Only specify PDB local users with the SYNC SCHEMA command.

description: Shard DDL cannot be executed as SYS because the following shards need to be upgraded to at least Oracle Database 21c: %s.
cause: An attempt was made to execute shard DDL as user SYS. This is insecure unless it can be encrypted.
action: Either execute the DDL as another user, or upgrade the listed shards to at least Oracle Database 21c and update them to support encryption.

description: Failed to send keys to shard %s with error %s.
cause: Cannot send a shard key to the shard.
action: Check that the database is up and that the GSMUSER password has been correctly set on the catalog.

description: Cannot add shards at versions lower than Oracle Database 21c because there is encrypted DDL in the catalog.
cause: Some catalog DDL was encrypted, but shards at lower than Oracle Database 21c cannot decrypt DDL.
action: Upgrade the shard to at least Oracle Database 21c before adding it.

description: Unable to load the sharding wallet successfully.
cause: The sharding wallet was unable to be opened or the required wallet data was not found.
action: Validate that the sharding wallet is present in WALLET_ROOT. If running a standby database, verify that the wallet has been correctly updated from the corresponding primary database.

description: operation is not allowed on a shard with candidate replication unit role
cause: The role of the replication unit was incompatible with the attempted operation.
action: Execute the operation on the shard with the required replication unit role.

description: replication unit is not empty
cause: An attempt was made to delete a replication unit that contained chunks.
action: Relocate the chunks prior to removing the replication unit.

description: current user not set correctly
cause: The variable "curuser" was not set before running internal sharding code.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: shard internal database link cannot be altered or dropped
cause: An attempt was made to directly alter or drop an internal database link for sharding, which is not allowed.
action: Do not alter or drop shard internal database links.

description: shard key or partition set key column cannot be renamed
cause: An attempt was made to rename a shard key column or a partition set key column of a sharded table, which is not allowed.
action: Do not rename shard key or partition set key column of a sharded table.

description: cannot shrink a system-managed or composite sharded table with primary key or any sharded table with functional index
cause: An attempt was made to shrink a system-managed or composite sharded table with primary key or a sharded table with functional index, which is not allowed.
action: Do not perform shrink such tables.

description: The Flashback Table operation is not supported on sharded or duplicated tables.
cause: An attempt was made to perform the Flashback Table operation on a sharded or duplicated table, which is not allowed.
action: Do not perform a Flashback Table operation on sharded or duplicated tables.

description: The sharding virtual column cannot be modified.
cause: An attempt was made to modify the sharding virtual column, SYS_HASHVAL, which is not allowed.
action: Do not modify the sharding virtual column.

description: cannot use the same tablespace for multiple partitions of a user-defined sharded table
cause: An attempt was made to use a tablespace for multiple partitions of a user-defined sharded table.
action: Use different tablespaces for different partitions in a user-defined sharded table.

description: invalid tablespace name %s specified for the partition %s
cause: An attempt was made to specify a tablespace name for a partition, subpartition, or LOBs that did not belong to the shardspace.
action: Specify a tablespace name that belongs to the same shardspace.

description: REF data type is not supported for duplicated tables.
cause: An invalid option was specified while creating duplicated tables.
action: Verify the specified option.

description: cannot drop duplicated table materialized views on shards
cause: An attempt was made to manually drop materialized views of a duplicated table on shard databases.
action: Drop the duplicated table on the catalog database, if required.

description: cannot set parameter SHRD_DUPL_TABLE_REFRESH_RATE in SPFILE
cause: An attempt was made to set parameter SHRD_DUPL_TABLE_REFRESH_RATE in SPFILE.
action: Set the parameter with SCOPE = MEMORY.

description: cannot drop duplicated table materialized view log
cause: An attempt was made to drop materialized view logs created on duplicated tables.
action: Drop the duplicated table, if required.

description: column %s is not supported for duplicated tables
cause: An invalid option was specified while creating duplicated tables.
action: Verify the specified option.

description: option %s is not supported for duplicated tables
cause: An invalid option was specified while creating duplicated tables.
action: Verify the specified option.

description: A tablespace cannot be referenced at the table level.
cause: An attempt was made to reference a tablespace at the table level.
