cause: Names of the partitionsets resulting from splitting the existing partitionset were not distinct.
action: Rename the resulting partitionsets to ensure that their names are distinct and different from those of any other existing partitionset.

description: tablespaces can be specified for only one of the resulting partitionsets
cause: Tablespaces for all resulting partitionsets were either specified or not specified at all.
action: Specify the tablespace for only one resulting partitionset.

description: partitionset already exists in target shardspace for the same FAMILY_ID.
cause: The partitionset already existed in the target shardspace of the SPLIT PARTITIONSET operation.
action: The target shardspace needs to be empty for the SPLIT PARTITIONSET operation.

description: row count mismatch between source and target during the SPLIT PARTITIONSET operation
cause: The expected rows count on the target side did not match the source row count during the SPLIT PARTITIONSET operation.
action: Clean up the target shardspace before retrying the SPLIT PARTITIONSET operation.

description: sharding key update failed
cause: One of the steps involved in the sharding key update failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: sharding key update failed; transaction automatically rolled back
cause: One of the steps involved in the sharding key update failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: sharding key update failed; roll back transaction manually to return to consistent state
cause: One of the steps involved in the sharding key update failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: Sharding key update is not supported for this table.
cause: One of the settings for this table was not correct for the sharding key update to be supported.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: Updating more than one sharding column at a time is not supported.
cause: Updating more than one sharding column at a time was not supported.
action: Update one sharding column at a time.

description: cannot enable foreign key constraint
cause: An attempt was made to enable a foreign key constraint that existed between a sharded table and a duplicated table. Such constraints can only exist in a disabled state because they cannot be enforced on the shard or the catalog.
action: This operation is not allowed.

description: cannot operate on multiple constraints for duplicated table
cause: An attempt was made to operate on multiple constraints at the same time for a duplicated table.
action: Operate on only one constraint at a time.

description: cannot create unique index on primary key columns of a duplicated table
cause: An attempt was made to create a unique index on the same columns of a disabled primary key constraint for a duplicated table.
action: Enable the primary key constraint to create this index automatically.

description: invalid specification of a clause in CREATE TABLESPACE statement in sharding environment
cause: An unsupported clause was specified in the CREATE TABLESPACE statement in a sharding environment.
action: Drop the unsupported clause and reissue the CREATE TABLESPACE statement.

description: cannot set or alter the default tablespace of a sharded table
cause: An attempt was made to set or alter the default tablespace of a sharded table.
action: None. A default tablespace cannot be set for sharded tables.

description: The sharding key is not found or does not belong to the shard
cause: A request was made to either the shard catalog with a sharding key that did not belong to any shard, or to a shard with a sharding key that did not belong to this shard.
action: Check the sharding key value in the request.

description: root table required for routing not found
cause: The shard routing information was not yet available, possibly due to the shard table family being dropped, or delay in loading the new table family information.
action: Check the presence of sharded table definitions.

description: cannot find a matching sharded table family
cause: There was no matching table family for the request, either because the service was not associated with any table family or no sharded table family existed.
action: Check the table family associated with the service and the presence of sharded table definitions.

description: the super sharding key does not belong to this shard
cause: An attempt was made to connect to a shard using a super sharding key value that did not belong to the shard.
action: Check the super sharding key value and the partition set mapping to the shards.

description: inconsistent shard routing metadata with request
cause: The shard routing lookup for the request found inconsistent metadata on the server.
action: Check the request sharding key and and super sharding key specification and sharding configurations.

description: PARTITIONED AS TABLE clause contradicts LOCAL clause
cause: CREATE INDEX statement contained a PARTITIONED AS TABLE clause together with a LOCAL clause.
action: Specify either the PARTITIONED AS TABLE clause or the LOCAL clause, but not both.

description: Locking rows for sharding key update failed.
cause: One of steps involved in locking rows for the sharding key update failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: chunk id %s is in the middle of chunk move operation. Retry after chunk move is done.
cause: chunk id was in the middle of a chunk move operation.
action: Retry after the chunk move is done.

description: cannot update the sharding key when row movement is not enabled.
cause: cannot update the sharding key when row movement is not enabled.
action: Enable row movement for all tables in this table's table family.

description: cannot update the sharding key when SNR is enabled
cause: An attempt was made to update the sharding key when sharding Raft replication was enabled.
action: Do not try to update the sharding key when SNR is enabled.

description: cannot delete or update parent key referenced by sharded table
cause: An attempt was made to delete or update a row from a duplicated table when a foreign key constraint existed in a sharded table referencing this duplicated table and the constraint was ENABLED.
action: DISABLE NOVALIDATE the constraint before attempting to delete or update rows from the duplicated table. When a sharded table references a duplicated table, deleting a parent row is only allowed when the constraint is in DISABLE state. This means rows from the child sharded table are not looked up for violation. The constraint state can later be changed to ENABLE VALIDATE if there are no rows in sharded table violating the constraint and after duplicated table is refreshed on all shards.

description: cannot use ON DELETE clause for this constraint
cause: A foregin key constraint was being created or altered in a sharded table referencing a duplicated table with ON DELETE clause.
action: Remove the ON DELETE clause.

description: cannot create a sharded index on this table
cause: Creating sharded indexes is restricted to sharded tables in certain sharding methods.
action: Do not specify SHARDED keyword in the create index statement.

description: cannot allocate %s bytes of memory for Sharding Replication Unit %s
cause: This is an Oracle internal error code.
action: None. This is an Oracle internal error code.

description: timed out on SNR raft log ru_id %s on-disk logidx %s endidx %s
cause: This is an Oracle internal error code.
action: None. This is an Oracle internal error code.

description: PDB SGA usage has exceeded the limit.
cause: The pluggable database (PDB) was using more system global area (SGA) than the limit set by the SGA_TARGET parameter.
action: Increase the SGA_TARGET (limit) of the PDB.

description: operation only allowed with directory-based sharding
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation that is only supported with directory-based sharding.
action: Check the definition of the sharded root table, if any. Create or re-create the table with the PARTITION BY DIRECTORY clause to enable directory-based sharding.

description: error with SHA-256 calculation on the sharding key
cause: An error was encountered while calculating the SHA-256 encryption value of a sharding key.
action: Check the sharding key value, ensure that all key columns match the corresponding sharding key column definition and are in the correct order.

description: no matching directory-based sharded root table found for %s.%s
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation on the directory for a sharded table that did not exist.
action: Check the schema and root table name provided for the operation and ensure that the table has been created for directory-based sharding.

description: no matching partition found for %s for directory insert
cause: An attempt was made to insert data into the shard directory with a partition name that did not exist.
action: Check the partition name specified for the insert statement against the partitions defined for the root table.

description: no matching record found for specified key in the directory
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation with a sharding key that did not have a matching entry in the directory.
action: Check the sharding key value and ensure that it has a corresponding entry in the shard directory.

description: only the schema owner is allowed to modify the directory
cause: An attempt was made to modify the directory of a sharded table that belonged to a different schema, which is prohibitted.
action: Connect as the schema owner of the sharded root table to modify the shard directory.

description: shard directory can only be modified on the shard catalog
cause: An attempt was made to execute a PL/SQL procedure that modifies the shard directory from a shard database.
action: Connect to the shard catalog database to modify the shard directory.

description: value list is not allowed in ADD PARTITION in directory-based sharding
cause: Either a VALUES LESS THAN clause or a VALUES (<values_list>) clause was specified when adding a partition to a directory partitioned table, which is not allowed.
action: Remove the VALUES LESS THAN clause or VALUES (<values_list>) clause from the partition being added.

description: DEFAULT partition is not allowed in a directory partitioned table
cause: The DEFAULT clause was specified for a partition in a directory partitioned table, which is not allowed.
action: Remove the DEFAULT clause.

description: maximum of two destination partitions is allowed
cause: More than two destination partitions were specified in split partition command for directory partitioned table.
action: Specify two destination partitions only.

description: Adding a chunk ID to the value list of an existing partition failed.
cause: Adding a chunk ID to the value list of an existing partition failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: Error occurred during phase = %s of Raft log files for RU %s [%s] [%s] [%s]
cause: Sharding Raft log appears to be corrupted or inaccessible.
action: Reinstantiate the replication unit by copying from another follower or the leader of the replication unit.

description: Error occurred during phase = %s of Raft control file record of RU %s
cause: Sharding Raft control file records appears to be corrupted or inaccessible.
action: Reinstantiate the replication unit by copying from another follower or the leader of the replication unit.

description: invalid DIRECTORY clause specified for a non-directory-based sharded root table creation
cause: DIRECTORY can only be specified for the creation of a directory-based sharded root table and must be followed by TABLESPACE.
action: Remove the DIRECTORY clause if the statement is not for the creation of a directory-based sharded root table, otherwise, specify the tablespace with DIRECTORY TABLESPACE clause.

description: cannot allocate %s bytes of memory for Sharding Replication Unit %s
cause: User session cannot allocate memory from Oracle Streams pool to stage logical change records (LCR).
action: Increase the initialization parameter STREAMS_POOL_SIZE.

description: An internal error occurred while encrypting a password in a DDL statement.
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot commit transaction in a follower shard for replication unit %s, transaction ID %s
cause: A sharding replication unit leadership change occurred while a transaction was being committed. This shard is no longer a leader and the commit request is rejected.
action: Retry the transaction from the leader shard for this replication unit.

description: maximum number of replication units (%s) reached on shard %s
cause: The specified shard already contained the maximum number of replication units allowed.
action: Decrease the number of replication units on the shard and retry the operation.

description: Standby catalog does not support DDL operations.
cause: Standby catalogs were read only and DDL ALTER queries did not apply.
action: Perform non-DDL or non-ALTER operations.

description: no sharded table found in the setup
cause: A sharded table was not created in the sharding setup.
action: Do not query the CURRENT_SHARD_KEY on the shard since there is no sharded table created."

description: In a Sharding Replication system, Barrier DDL on sharded table %s.%s is not allowed directly on a shard from a session that has enabled shard DDL.
cause: In a Sharding Replication system, Barrier DDL directly issued on a shard from a session that has enabled shard DDL can lead to data or schema inconsistency and is not allowed.
action: When running Sharding Replication, issue Barrier DDL on a sharded table from the catalog connection if you want to change the table schema or truncate the table.
params: 1) schema_name: The sharded table's schema name. 2) table_name: The sharded table's name.

description: target shard name missing
cause: Target name was not specified as an argument for move chunk command.
action: Specify the name of the target shard.

description: A move chunk operation is not allowed in a shardgroup containing one shard.
cause: User attempted a move chunk operation in a sharding setup containing a single shard in a shardgroup.
action: Do not perform the attempted operation in a shardgroup containing a single shard.

description: cannot use predicate with specified pseudocolumn along with sharding key column predicates
cause: Using predicates with pseudocolumns like ORA_SHARD_ID and ORA_SHARDSPACE_NAME are not allowed to be used along with predicates with sharding key columns
action: Remove predicates with either the pseudocolumn or sharding key columns.

description: cannot make direct updates on shard directory.
cause: A DML was issued on the shard directory table directly, which was not allowed.
action: Use the PL/SQL procedures defined in the dbms_sharding_directory on the catalog to make changes to the directory table.

description: shard directory table or view can not be modified.
cause: An attempt was made to modify the shard directory table or view, which was not allowed. They are managed by Oracle only.
action: Do not perform such operations.

description: shard %s is at different version than catalog
cause: A shard database was found to be at different version than the catalog database. Sharding requires catalog and all shard databases to be at the same version when running a sharding DDL statement.
action: Make sure that versions of all shards and catalog match before executing a sharding DDL statement.

description: GSM %s is at a different version than the catalog.
cause: A global service manager (GSM) was at a different version than the catalog database. The catalog and GSMs were required to be at the same version.
action: Ensure all GSM and catalog versions are the same before executing a sharding DDL statement.

description: partitionset method of the table is not LIST
cause: ALTER TABLE ADD|DROP VALUE could only be performed when the partitionset type is list.
action: Do not attempt to add or drop value from a partitionset when the partitionset method is not list.

description: cannot add values to or drop values from a partition of a directory-sharded table.
cause: An attempt was made to directly add values to or drop values from a partition of a directory-based sharded table, which was not allowed.
action: Use the PL/SQL procedures defined in the dbms_sharding_directory on the catalog to make changes to the list of keys in a partition.

description: a directory-sharded table can only be created with user-defined sharding
cause: An attempt was made to create a directory-sharded table with system or composite sharding, which was not allowed.
action: Set up user-defined sharding to create sharded tables by directory.

description: operation %s not supported for directory-based sharding
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation that was not yet supported for directory-based sharding
action: Do not perform the operation.

description: Cannot change password of sharded user %s when shard DDL is disabled.
cause: An attempt was made to change the password of a sharded user on the catalog when shard DDL was disabled.
action: Enable shard DDL to perform this operation.
params: 1) shard_user_name: The name of the shard user whose password change is being attempted.

description: INSTEAD OF triggers are not supported in sharding.
cause: An attempt was made to create an all-shard INSTEAD OF trigger in a sharded database.
action: Create a local INSTEAD OF trigger on the shard.

description: cannot perform DML from shards on duplicated tables having %s type columns
cause: An attempt is being made to perform a DML operation from the shard on a duplicated table containing user-defined type columns.
action: Perform DML on duplicated table from the catalog.

description: Missing post commit logical change record (LCR) for transaction %2!s, leader DBID %3!s with commit log index %4!s for replication unit %1!s.
cause: This is an internal error.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: maximum number of committed transactions exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the allowed number of committed transactions.
action: Clear the current list of committed transactions.

description: invalid replication unit ID
cause: There is an invalid replication unit ID.
action: Enter a valid replication unit ID available in this pluggable database.

description: invalid Raft replication file number
cause: There is an invalid raft log file number.
action: Check V$SHARD_LCR_LOGS to determine the number of log files and enter a valid value for the raft file number.

description: invalid indexes for raft log or file blocks
cause: There are invalid indexes for the raft log or file blocks.
action: Enter valid log indexes or block indexes.

description: Assignment rule id is not valid
cause: For directory based sharding, user needs to specify a valid assignment rule id before using automatic partition assignment feature during insertion.
action: Specify a valid assignment rule id using PL/SQL setAssignmentRule API.

description: The sharding key is already in partition %s
cause: An attempt is being made to move data into a target partition that is the same as the current partition where the key is located.
action: Ensure that the partition name specified for the move key statement is different from the partition where the key is located.

description: Move key between partitions on the same shard is not supported
cause: An attempt is being made to move data into a target partition that is on the same shard as the source partition. This is not supported.
action: Ensure that the partition name specified for the move key statement is on a different shard from the source partition.

description: Cannot commit the transaction due to one or more shards being unavailable.
cause: An attempt was made to commit a transaction involving synchronous duplicated tables when one or more shards were unavailable.
action: Retry the transaction when all the shards are available.

description: %s clause is not supported with Synchronous Duplicated Table
cause: The specified clause is not currently supported with Synchronous Duplicated Table.
action: Do not specify the unsupported clause with Synchronous Duplicated Table.

description: Cannot perform DML operations for replication unit %s while minority of followers are connected to the leader.
cause: This shard is still a replication unit leader however DMLs cannot be executed without consensus.
action: Retry the user DML operations in the leader shard for this replication after follower databases are up.

description: maximum number of columns in a sharded table in a system or composite sharding environment is %s
cause: An attempt was made to create a sharded table with too many columns, or to add more columns to a sharded table which pushes it over the maximum allowable limit. Note that unused columns in the table are counted toward the total column limit.
action: If the error is a result of a CREATE command, then reduce the number of columns in the command and resubmit. If the error is a result of an ALTER TABLE command, then there are two options: 1) If the table contained unused columns, remove them by executing ALTER TABLE DROP UNUSED COLUMNS before adding new columns; 2) Reduce the number of columns in the command and resubmit.

description: The shard is not registered with at least one GSM.
cause: The operation requires that the shard is registered with at least one Global Service Manager (GSM). The shard may not register with a GSM if: a GSM is not up, the shard is not on the valid node checking for registration (VNCR) list, or the shard cannot reach the GSM listener port.
action: Check if a shard is registered with a GSM using the command 'gdsctl validate'. If the shard is not registered, do the following: - Check that at least one GSM is up. - Use the command 'gdsctl config vncr' to check that the shard's hostname or IP address is added to the VNCR list. - Ensure that the shard can reach the GSM listener port. Use the command 'gdsctl validate -validate_network' to check network connectivity.

description: Cannot perform DML operations on synchronous duplicated tables on the shards.
cause: An attempt was made to perform a DML operation on a synchronous duplicated table on a shard.
action: All DML operations on a synchronous duplicated table must be performed on the catalog.

description: validation of raft file no %s failed in block %s logindex %s
cause: Sharding Raft log appears to be corrupted.
action: Check trace files for further information on corrupt blocks

description: validate of raft file %s could not be completed, please try again
cause: Raft file was overwritten before validation could complete.
action: Rerun validation again for the same file.

description: Cannot build chunk topology due to missing in-memory object for replication unit %s.
cause: An attempt is being made to perform a DML operation while there is a replication unit that is in the middle of recovery or move.
action: Repeat DML operation later.

description: Cannot commit transaction for replication unit %s while majority of followers have not acknowledged the transaction prepare message (timeout = %s seconds, transaction ID = %s).
cause: This shard is a replication unit leader and requires a majority consensus from all follower shards in order to commit the identified transaction. The transaction's prepare-to-commit message was not acknowledged by a majority of followers during the allotted time.
action: Retry the transaction when the follower shards have stabilized.

description: Raft replication does not support LOB fragment operations, 'set options', or 'get options'.
cause: LOB operations on Raft replication include one of the following a. LOB fragment operation b. Set Options c. Get Options
action: Do not include the above Lob operations.

description: Switchover operation could not be completed due to leader recovery errors
cause: An attempt is being made to perform replication unit switchover, but recovery procedure of the new leader was not successful.
action: Check the database alert log to find out the exact error message, take the appropriate action.

description: unable to find logindex %s while moving RU %s during move/copy RU
cause: Raft logs were overwritten before move could be completed.
action: Rerun move/copy again for the same RU

description: Leader of RU %s does not contain logindex %s to send to follower
cause: Leader RAFT logs were overwritten before follower could catch up
action: Identify the disabled follower using gdsctl RU command and reinstaniate it.

description: cannot modify an Oracle maintained user to an all-shard user
cause: An attempt is being made to modify an Oracle maintained user to an all-shard user.
action: Only non Oracle maintained users can be modified to all-shard users.

description: cannot modify user on shard database
cause: An attempt is being made to modify a user on a shard database.
action: Connect to the catalog and modify the user.

description: user is already %s user
cause: An attempt is being made to convert an existing user to the same type of user.
action: Only local user can be converted to all-shard users, and only all-shard users can be converted to local users.

description: move key failed; transaction automatically rolled back
cause: One of the steps involved in move key failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: Move key for table family defined by parent clause is not supported
cause: An attempt is being made to move key for table family defined by parent clause. This is not supported.
action: No action required.

description: Unable to overwrite raft log for replication unit %1!s
cause: For the given replication unit, the raft log file cannot be overwritten since logical change records (LCRs) in the file are still required by this shard or some followers.
action: Check if apply on the shards requiring these LCRs is progressing. If apply is stuck, check the alert log for errors. Fix the errors and restart the replication unit.

description: Logical change record (LCR) persister not detected for replication unit %s
cause: Alive check for LCR persister failed for the replication unit.
action: No action is normally needed. The LCR persister should restart automatically. If it does not, the replication unit may need to be restarted using gdsctl.

description: Network receiver not detected for replication unit %s
cause: Alive check for network receiver failed for the replication unit.
action: No action is normally needed. The network receiver should restart automatically. If it does not, the replication unit may need to be restarted using gdsctl.

description: all-shard user does not exist: %s
cause: Username specified was not an all-shard user.
action: Correct the username and retry the operation.

description: Replication unit creation failed. Code %s. Error: %s
cause: Replication unit creation failed and was succesfully rollbacked.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: task cannot be altered: %s
cause: The task cannot be altered because of an invalid input or a status that conflicted with a specified parameter.
action: Read the additional information provided and take appropriate action.

description: invalid 'compatible' setting for Raft replication: %s
cause: The 'compatible' parameter setting was not supported with Raft replication configurations.
action: Set the 'compatible' parameter to a version equal to or later than '23.0'.

description: unable to decrypt password for %s shards: %s
cause: The system is unable to decrypt the password or password is not available.
action: To re-create database links to failed shards, run GDSCTL command 'modify shard' for each failed shard, providing password for each shard.

description: invalid status for replication unit %s on shard %s: %s
cause: Validation for the attempted operation failed because the replication unit status is invalid.
action: Verify the replication unit status and retry operation.

description: no leader exists for replication unit %s in shardgroup %s
cause: A leader shard does not currently exist for the specified replication unit and shardgroup.
action: Initiate a leadership election with 'switchover ru' and retry the operation.

description: no shards are available for replication unit %s
cause: An attempt is being made to move a replication unit but there are no available deployed shards that do not already contain the replication unit.
action: Ensure that there is an available deployed shard that does not already contain the replication unit and retry the operation.

description: Attempt to set replication unit parameter failed with error: %s
cause: The values passed to SET RU PARAMETER are invalid.
action: Verify the input values and retry the operation.

description: Transaction is too large for sharding native replication. Maximum allowed size is %s
cause: The number of logical change records (LCRs) is larger than the maximum allowed for the size of this transaction.
action: Reduce the size of the transaction and try again.

description: Cannot perform DML operations for replication unit %s in read-only shard group.
cause: This shard is still a replication unit leader however DMLs cannot be executed in read-only shard group.
action: Retry the user DML operations in the leader shard of read-write shard groups.

description: Internal error after leadership loss in remote shard group
cause: This is an Oracle internal error code.
action: None.

description: Raft replication is not supported with Oracle Real Application Cluster (Oracle RAC) databases.
cause: An attempt is being made to add an Oracle RAC database to a Raft replication configuration.
action: Retry the operation with single instance databases.

description: Cannot generate shard key for autonomous with error %s
cause: There is an error generating the autonomous key for sharding.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Failed to validate host with error %s
cause: The added shard host cannot be validated as an autonomous host.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Attempting to perform move or copy replication unit across different shardgroups.
cause: An attempt is being made to move or copy a replication unit across two different shardgroups, which is not allowed.
action: Verify the input source, target and replace shard names, and ensure that they are in the same shardgroup.

description: Remote shard group has incorrect Read Write status
cause: Switchover is happening while shard group is offline.
action: None. Automatic recovery is initiated.

description: This operation is not supported if a vector index on a sharded table exists.
cause: An attempt is made to perform an operation that is not supported if a vector index on a sharded table exists.
action: Either do not attempt to run this operation or drop all vector indexes on sharded tables and run the operation.

description: Invalid attempt to call %s on a non-primary shard
cause: Shard database is not a primary.
action: Call the indicated PL/SQL procedure on a primary shard database.

description: Invalid attempt to call %s on non-catalog shard
cause: The Shard database is not a catalog.
action: Call the indicated PL/SQL procedure on catalog shard.

description: An attempt is being made to upgrade sharding for the specified configuration.
cause: Sharding Native Replication is already in place.
action: Check the metadata or internal parameters. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Upgrade to Sharding Native Replication is not supported for the specified configuration: %s.
cause: Upgrade to Sharding Native Replication is not supported for the specified configuration.
action: Check the current configuration or contact Oracle Support.

description: Data Guard setup with specified configuration is not supported.
cause: The specified number of standby shards is not supported for each primary shard.
action: Ensure that all primary shards have an equal number of standby shards and the number of replicas should be 3 or 5 including the primary.

description: Specified low value for input parameter replication units for sharding upgrade to Sharding Native Replication.
cause: The number of replication units to create should be at least the number of primary shards.
action: Change the input value for replication units or use the default value.

description: Data Guard setup with specified configuration is not supported.
cause: Multiple shard groups have primary shard databases.
action: Move all primary shards to one shard group and mark it as primary.

description: A failure is occurring while mapping a chunk to a replication unit on a catalog shard.
cause: There is inconsistent sharding metadata.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Source and destination shards are on different COMPATIBLE settings.
cause: An attempt is made to perform an operation that require the same COMPATIBLE setting.
action: Shutdown and startup with the same compatibility setting for both shards.

description: One or more GSMs are running
cause: An attempt is being made to update the metadata of sharding when there are one or more GSMs running.
action: Stop all the GSMs and retry.

description: An attempt is being made to call %s on a non-root container database.
cause: An attempt is being made to call the specified PL/SQL procedure on a non-root container database.
action: Call the specified PL/SQL procedure on a root container database.

description: Replication unit is empty.
cause: An attempt is being made to synchronize a replication unit that does not contain data/chunks.
action: Retry the operation with a replication unit that contains data.

description: Region name must be set for CSQ region affinity.
cause: Cross-shard query (CSQ) is running with region affinity enabled, but the region name parameter is not set. When region affinity is enabled for CSQs with the parameter MULTISHARD_QUERY_DATA_CONSISTENCY, the region name parameter must be set on the query coordinator.
action: Set the region name for the query coordinator using the GDSCTL command 'modify catalog'.

description: Rack value configuration is incorrect
cause: Rack value must be set for all multitenant container databases (CDBs) in the shardgroup or Rack value must be NULL for all CDBs in the shardgroup. There also needs to be at least `repfactor` distinct Rack values set. The Rack value of a CDB containing a given replication unit (RU) cannot be the same as any other Rack value for CDBs that also contain that RU.
action: Run the `gdsctl config cdb` command to see all Rack values for the specified CDB. Update the Rack values for CDBs to adhere to these rules using `gdsctl modify cdb` command.

description: Cannot sync shardgroup with readwrite leader for specifed replication unit.
cause: An attempt is being made to sync a shardgroup where the replication unit specified has readwrite status without the -syncAll flag specifed. To sync a shardgroup with a readwrite leader for that replication unit, -syncAll flag must be specifed, which will sync all shardgroups in the shardspace for the specfied replication unit or units.
action: Retry GDSCTL 'sync ru' with -syncAll parameter to sync all shardgroups.

description: All replication units in the shardgroup must have the same readwrite or readonly mode.
cause: The shardgroup contains replication units with a mix of readwrite and readonly modes.
action: Use the GDSCTL 'switchmode' command to change individual replication unit modes until they are the same for all replication units in the shardgroup.

description: Unable to attach to IO buffers for replication unit %s for writer %s
cause: Another process is attached to the IO buffers for the replication unit.
action: Use the GDSCTL 'stop ru' and 'start ru' commands to restart the replication unit.

description: Unable to detach from IO buffers for replication unit %s for writer %s
cause: The process is unable to detach from the IO buffers for the replication unit.
action: Use the GDSCTL 'stop ru' and 'start ru' commands to restart the replication unit.

description: This operation is not supported if a hybrid vector index is created on a sharded table.
cause: An attempt is made to perform an operation that is not supported if a hybrid vector index on a sharded table exists.
action: Either do not attempt to run this operation or drop all hybrid vector indexes on sharded tables and run the operation.

description: Database instance is not a shard.
cause: An attempt is made to perform an operation that is not supported if a shard is not part of sharding deployment.
action: Check given shard is part of sharding.

description: No readwrite leader found for the replication unit.
cause: A 'switchmode' command is issued when there is no readwrite leader present in the shardspace.
action: Ensure that a readwrite leader exists for the replication unit or use the -force flag on the 'switchmode' command.

description: MOVE CHUNK is not allowed while local HNSW indexes are loading in-memory.
cause: A MOVE CHUNK command is being executed while local HNSW indexes are loading in-memory.
action: Wait and retry the operation or drop the local HNSW indexes and retry the operation.

description: Column hash %s not found.
cause: Column name compression is enabled but the column with the specific hash value is not found.
action: Verify the table columns and retry the operation.

description: Invalid value %s bytes specified for SHARD_APPLY_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE
cause: An invalid value is specified for the SHARD_APPLY_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE parameter.
action: Specify the value in Bytes,KB,MB or GB within the range of 0 to 90% of STREAMS_POOL_SIZE.

description: Failed to create raft log files in DB_CREATE_FILE_DEST
cause: File creation failed due to either insufficient operating system permission or no disk space.
action: Check for additional error messages. Increase disk space and check permissions.

description: Cannot insert into the duplicated table with read-only partition from the shard
cause: Insertion into the duplicated table with read-only partitions is not allowed from the shard.
action: Connect to the catalog and insert data into the duplicated table.

description: Failed to switch replication unit %s to read-only mode
cause: Switch of the replication unit to read-only mode is failing due to unavailability of all distributed system that should guarantee consistent role transition.
action: Check for additional error messages in trace file of Replication Unit process group.

description: Cannot insert into the duplicated table with identity columns generated by default from the shard
cause: Insertion into the duplicated table with identity columns generated by default is not allowed from the shard.
action: Connect to the catalog and insert data into the duplicated table.

description: Cannot rename Sharding Native Replication log file
cause: An attempt is being made to rename a Sharding Native Replication log file.
action: None. Sharding Native Replication log files cannot be renamed.

description: Chunk move failure: exascale data file snapshot creation error. Destination: "%s"
cause: An error happened during exascale data file snapshot creation process.
action: Check the alert log for details.

description: Sharding column cannot be a user-defined data type.
cause: A user-defined data type is created as an object and used as the sharding column for creating the table.
action: Ensure that no sharding column is a user-defined data type.

description: Source shardspace ID and Target shardspace ID must be different.
cause: An attempt is being made to split a partitionset with the same shardspace ID for source and target.
action: Ensure that the target and source shardspace ID are different.

description: COMPATIBLE needs to be %s or higher for %s. The current COMPATIBLE setting is %s.
cause: Some shards associated with the replication unit are on a lower compatibility setting.
action: Shutdown and startup with the specified compatibility setting for all shards associated with the replication unit.

description: Cannot perform DML operations on the duplicated table with HNSW index.
cause: DML operations on the duplicated table with HNSW index is not allowed.
action: Drop the HNSW index and perform DML operations on the duplicated table.

description: Cannot create a vector index on a vector column with flexible dimensions or format if the base table is sharded.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a vector index on a vector column with flexible dimensions or format.
action: Create the vector index on a vector column that has specific dimensions and format.

description: Remote network receiver for replication unit %s restarts to receive logical change recrod (LCR) from log index %s to %s from remote network sender
cause: This is an Oracle internal error code.
action: None. This is an internal error code.

description: Local hybrid vector indexes are not supported in sharding.
cause: Creating local hybrid vector indexes in sharding is not allowed.
action: Create global hybrid vector indexes on the catalog instead.

description: Cannot switch leadership to a witness replica
cause: An attempt is being made to switch leadership to a witness replica.
action: Ensure that switchover target is a full replica.

description: Hybrid vector indexes cannot be created on a duplicated table.
cause: Creating hybrid vector indexes on duplicated tables is not allowed.
action: Create hybrid vector indexes on sharded tables instead.

description: Key column "%s" in shard %s (shard group = %s) does not match any key column in the logical change record (LCR) for table "%s"."%s"
cause: The key column for this table in this shard does not match those in the LCR.
action: Make sure that the key columns for this table are consistent in all replicas.

description: consensus log creation failed
cause: Creation of the consensus log failed on one or multiple peers.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: consensus log %s not found
cause: The specified consensus log did not exist in the database.
action: Use the correct consensus log and retry the operation.

description: internal error for consensus service
cause: This is an Oracle internal error code.
action: None. This is an Oracle internal error code.

description: append to consensus log failed
cause: The append entry operation on the consensus log failed.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: peer is not the leader of consensus log
cause: The consensus service operation failed because the current peer was not the leader.
action: Retry the operation on the leader peer.

description: peer %s is not enabled
cause: The consensus service operation failed because the specified peer was not enabled.
action: Enable the peer and retry the operation.

description: drop of consensus log failed
cause: The drop operation on the consensus log failed on one or multiple peers.
action: Check the error stack and other messages in the trace files for detailed error information.

description: This is a control event for the consensus service diagnostic tracing.
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is used to control consensus service diagnostic tracing.
action: None. This is an Oracle internal event code.

description: current peer is not included
cause: The consensus service operation failed because the current peer was not included.
action: Include the current peer and retry the operation.

description: schema %s does not exist at current peer
cause: The consensus service operation failed because the specified schema did not exist at the peer database.
action: Ensure that the specified user schema exists at the peer.

description: entry at index #%s does not exist in the log
cause: The consensus service operation failed because the entry at the specified index did not exist in the consensus log.
action: Wait and retry the operation.

description: consensus service is not running
cause: The operation failed because the consensus service was not running.
action: Start the consensus service and retry the operation.

description: Consensus service failed to start because database is not open in read/write mode.
cause: The consensus service failed to start because the database was not open in read/write mode.
action: Open the database in read/write mode and retry the operation.

description: consensus log %s is not enabled
cause: The operation failed because the specified consensus log was not enabled.
action: Enable the log and retry the operation.

description: checksum error in consensus entry header
cause: The consensus entry header contained checksum that did not match the recomputed value at the receiving peer.
action: Analyze the consensus log and fix any discrepancies.

description: previous configuration change is not yet committed
cause: The operation failed because previous configuration change was not yet committed.
action: Wait and retry the operation.

description: failed to execute consensus log pre-append entry callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log pre-append entry callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: failed to execute consensus log post-append entry callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log post-append entry callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: failed to execute consensus log new entry callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log new entry callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: failed to execute consensus log cache load callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log cache load callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: failed to execute consensus log varray column read callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log varray column read callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: failed to execute consensus log varray column write callback
cause: An error was encountered while executing consensus log varray column write callback.
action: Examine and fix the problem described in the additional errors on on the error stack.

description: Accommodating consensus log entry in specified buffer failed.
cause: Buffer size was not large enough to hold consensus log entry.
action: Pass in a bigger buffer and retry the command.

description: Computing the signature for consensus log entry failed.
cause: An error was encountered while computing the signature for entry in the consensus log.
action: Analyze the consensus log and fix the discrepancies.

description: Signature verification failed for consensus log entry.
cause: The originator signature for consensus log entry cannot be verified.
action: Analyze the consensus log and fix the discrepancies.

description: missing or invalid input value
cause: A valid input value was not specified.
action: Reissue the statement specifying a valid input value.

description: blockchain user %s did not exist
cause: The operation failed because the specified user does not exist.
action: Create the user and retry the operation.

description: unable to retrieve the database global name
cause: The database initialization parameter GLOBAL_NAMES was not set to be TRUE in a blockchain peer database.
action: Change GLOBAL_NAMES to TRUE, then retry this operation.

description: the referenced database link %s did not exist

description: NETASY: initialisation failure
cause: Async driver unable to complete initialisation
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: connect failed
cause: Async driver unable to establish connection with partner
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: channel open failure
cause: no free channel [should never happen]
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETASY: port open failure
cause: Async driver unable to open port
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: VTM error
cause: Virtual Terminal Manager unable to read/write to port
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: Configuration error
cause: Async driver genned for server-only, but client service requested
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETASY: port close failure
cause: Async driver unable to close port
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: channel close failure
cause: Async driver unable to close channel
action: Check log file for OS-specific error code

description: NETASY: unable to intialise for logging
cause: Async driver unable to initialise for logging I/O
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETASY: port assignment failure
cause: Async driver unable to assign port to channel [should never happen]
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, unrecognized node name
cause: Node name specified in host string is unknown (probably misspelled)
action: Retry with correct node name

description: NETDNT: connect failed, unrecognized object name
cause: Host string contains reference to object (which doesn't exist): @d:<node>-<obj> => object is ORDN<obj>; when <node> is VMS, the object is ORDN<obj>.COM when <node> is UNIX, the object is ORDN<obj> @d:<node>::"task=<obj>" => object is <obj>; when <node> is VMS, the object is <obj>.COM when <node> is UNIX, the object is <obj>
action: Retry with correct object name or create the required object on host node

description: NETDNT: connect failed, access control data rejected
cause: Host string contains invalid username/password
action: Retry with correct username/password

description: NETDNT: connect failed, partner rejected connection
cause: Connection with partner was made but was rejected.
action: Contact your network administrator.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, partner exited unexpectedly
cause: Connection with host node was made but partner aborted
action: Make sure object (see 06031, above) is working (for VMS run the command file and make sure that the ORACLE server process starts up); sometimes happens when the network/node is under stress - in this case a retry often works.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, insufficient resources
cause: Insufficient system resources are available to complete the connection; for example, all DECnet channels are in use.
action: Contact your network administrator.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, no response from object
cause: NA
action: NA

description: NETDNT: connect failed, node unreachable
cause: Host node is down.
action: Contact your network administrator.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, network driver not loaded
cause: NA
action: NA

description: NETDNT: connect failed
cause: Connect failed for unexpected reason (see OSD error).
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETDNT: invalid login (connect) string
cause: Syntax error in login string.
action: Resubmit with correct string.

description: NETDNT: disconnect failed
cause: Driver gets error while doing network close operation
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETDNT: message receive failure
cause: Driver gets I/O error while doing network read operation
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETDNT: message send failure
cause: Driver gets I/O error while doing network write operation
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETDNT: connect failed, byte count quota exceeded
cause: Connect failed because of insufficient byte count quota.
action: Increase byte count quota.

description: NETTCP: cannot allocate context area
cause: Insufficient dynamic memory available for connection context area.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: remote host is unknown
cause: Host name specified in the login (connect) string is unknown.
action: Check spelling; make sure name is in the TCP/IP HOST file.

description: NETTCP: socket creation failure
cause: Process open file quota probably exceeded.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: ORACLE network server not found
cause: No entry in SERVICES file for ORACLE server.
action: Add ("orasrv") entry to the TCP/IP SERVICES file.

description: NETTCP: connect to host failed
cause: Connection attempt to remote host has failed. Probably means that the SQL*Net TCP/IP server on the remote host is not up, or the host itself is not up (check the latter by targeting it with Telnet).
action: Start the SQL*Net TCP/IP server process on the remote host.

description: NETTCP: message receive failure
cause: I/O error occurred while attempting network read operation.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: message send failure
cause: I/O error occurred while attempting network write operation.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: disconnect failure
cause: Error occurred while closing a socket.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: invalid buffer size
cause: The buffer size specified in the login string exceeds the allowed maximum (of 4096).
action: Re-submit with valid buffer size.

description: NETTCP: Too many connections
cause: The maximum no. of concurrently open connections has been reached.
action: Exit an application with an open connection which is no longer required.

description: NETTCP: SID lookup failure
cause: From the remote host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server: the database SID, specified in the login (connect) string, was not recognized.
action: Add the appropriate SID entry to the CONFIG.ORA file on the remote host (and restart the SQL*Net TCP/IP server).

description: NETTCP: unable to create ORACLE logicals
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to create the necessary logicals required by the ORACLE server process. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your system administrator.

description: NETTCP: unable to create ORASRV process
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to create the ORACLE server process. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your system administrator.

description: NETTCP: unable to create ORASRV: quota exceeded
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to create the ORACLE server process because of quota depletion.
action: Increase quota allocations to the SQL*Net TCP/IP server process.

description: NETTCP: unable to complete handshake with ORASRV
cause: The ORACLE server process was started but failed to complete its initialization.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: spurious client request
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to recognize this connection request. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: network driver not loaded
cause: The TCP/IP network driver is not loaded.
action: Check that the TCP/IP driver is loaded correctly.

description: NETTCP: access failure
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to test the accessibility of the SID mapping file (specified in CONFIG.ORA) associated with this connection request. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: setup failure
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to set up the appropriate environment to service this connection request. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: cannot set KEEPALIVE
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to set the socket KEEPLIVE option. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: timeout waiting for ORASRV
cause: The ORACLE server process was started but failed to respond after N secs.
action: For heavily loaded systems this is not an uncommon occurrence. Increase the value of N (the default is 30) by placing the following entry in the CONFIG.ORA file: SQLNET ORASRV_WAIT = <no. of secs> which will come into effect the next time the SQL*Net TCP/IP server is started.

description: NETTCP: ORASRV exited unexpectedly
cause: The ORACLE server process was started but exited unexpectedly. Possible causes: 1. Insufficient quotas to run ORASRV 2. ORACLE is not installed See the ORASRV output file for more details; the file will be in the ORA_SQLNET directory and will have a name of the form: ORA_SRVTnn_<SID>.OUT
action: If appropriate action is not obvious from the ORASRV output file then contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: ORASRV unable to open network connection
cause: The ORACLE server process was started but was unable to open the socket passed to it by TCPSRV.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: unable to change username
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server could not establish a PROXY LOGIN connection because the client username is unknown (to the host OS).
action: Create new user account on host.

description: NETTCP: unable to create mailbox
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to create a mailbox (needed for IPC communication with the ORACLE server process). See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: unable to transfer socket ownership to ORASRV
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to transfer the network communication handle to the ORACLE server process. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: host access denied
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server rejected this connection request because the client node does not have access privilege - as determined by the contents of the Valid Node Table (VNT), a component of the host's CONFIG.ORA.
action: To grant access, add appropriate entry to the host's VNT.

description: NETTCP: user access denied
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server rejected this connection request because the client user(name) does not have access privilege - as determined by the contents of the Username Mapping Table (UMT), a component of the host's CONFIG.ORA.
action: To grant access, add appropriate entry to the host's UMT.

description: NETTCP: access denied, wrong password
cause: The host SQL*Net TCP/IP server rejected this connection request because the client password did not match the host password.
action: To grant access, get passwords in sync.

description: NETTCP: file not found
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server could not find the SID mapping file (specified in CONFIG.ORA) associated with this connection request.
action: Check CONFIG.ORA for spelling; make correct entry.

description: NETTCP: file access privilege violation
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server did not have READ/ EXECUTE permission for the SID mapping file (specified in CONFIG.ORA) associated with this connection request.
action: Change protection on SID mapping file.

description: NETTCP: connection rejected; server is stopping
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server rejected this connection request because it is in the process of stopping.
action: Re-start SQL*Net TCP/IP server.

description: NETTCP: error during connection handshake
cause: Network I/O failure occurred while communicating with the host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: error during connection handshake
cause: Network I/O failure occurred while communicating with the host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: error during connection handshake
cause: Network I/O failure occurred while communicating with the host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: no such user
cause: A proxy login connect attempt failed because the client username has no counterpart on the host.
action: Try again with a user that has a counterpart on the host.

description: NETTCP: no privilege for user
cause: A proxy login connect attempt failed because the SQL*Net TCP/IP server had insufficient privileges to access the proxy account.
action: Change account protection; change server privilges.

description: NETTCP: error getting user information
cause: A proxy login connect attempt failed because the SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to access the proxy account. See the SQL*Net TCP/IP server log file for more details.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETTCP: maximum connections exceeded
cause: The connect failed because the maximum conncurrent connections supported by the host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server has already been reached.
action: Wait for a short period and re-try.

description: NETTCP: SID (database) is unavailable
cause: The database administrator on the host has varied the SID offline.
action: Wait for it to be varied back on-line.

description: NETTCP: unable to start ORASRV: images not installed
cause: The host's SQL*Net TCP/IP server was unable to start the ORACLE server process because the ORACLE protected images were not installed.
action: Install the images.

description: NETNTT: cannot allocate send and receive buffers
cause: Two-task driver could not allocate data buffers.
action: There is insufficient memory to run your program. Kill off other processes to free up memory.

description: NETNTT: cannot translate address file name
cause: ORACLE_HOME environment variable not set.
action: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported.

description: NETNTT: cannot open address file
cause: The NTT two-task driver could not open a file containing address information.
action: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported. Make sure the instance you are attempting to connect to is actually up and running.

description: NETNTT: cannot read arguments from address file
cause: The NTT two-task driver could not read addressing information from its addressing file.
action: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported. Make sure the instance you are attempting to connect to is actually up and running.

description: NETNTT: cannot share connection to cube
cause: The NTT two-task driver could not share a connection to the cube.
action: Make sure that the ORACLE_HOME environment variable has been properly set and exported. Make sure the instance you are attempting to connect to is actually up and running.

description: NETNTT: cannot read pid of remote process
cause: An error occurred while reading the NTT communications link.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: remote fork failed
cause: The Oracle listener process on the cube could not fork off a shadow process.
action: The instance you are trying to connect to probably doesn't have enough memory to run another shadow process. Ask someone else to log off, or connect to a different instance.

description: NETNTT: cannot send command line to shadow process
cause: An error occurred while writing the NTT communications link.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: cannot allocate context area
cause: Two-task driver could not allocate data buffers.
action: There is insufficient memory to run your program. Kill off other processes to free up memory.

description: NETNTT: cannot read from remote process
cause: An error occurred while reading the NTT communications link.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: cannot write to remote process
cause: An error occurred while writing the NTT communications linke.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: nrange() failed
cause: The call to 'nrange()' failed while attempting to establish a connection.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: nfconn() failed
cause: The call to 'nfconn()' failed while attempting to establish a connection.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: out of memory in pi_connect
cause: Two-task driver could not allocate data buffers.
action: There is insufficient memory to run your program. Kill off other processes to free up memory.

description: NETNTT: data protocol error
cause: The NTT two-task driver received an unexpected message type."
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: break protocol error
cause: The NTT two-task driver received an unexpected message type."
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: bad write length
cause: The NTT two-task driver failed on an internal consistency check.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: bad state
cause: The NTT two-task driver failed on an internal consistency check.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETNTT: cannot read /etc/oratab
cause: The NTT two-task driver could not read configuration information from /etc/oratab.
action: Make sure /etc/oratab exists and is readable. This error may occur if the file is incorrectly formatted. It also may occur if the driver has run out of memory.

description: IPA: Disconnect failure
cause: A fatal error occurred during the disconnect from the server. This was probably caused by inaccessible message queues.
action: If there is no message queue, restart the SQL*Net IPA servers using ipactl. Otherwise contact your customer support representative.

description: IPA: Cannot allocate driver context
cause: The memory pool is exhausted.
action: Check the circumstances and try to allocate less memory in your program or adjust the init parameters in your INIT.ORA file and retry.

description: IPA: Cannot connect to remote host
cause: The cause may be one of the following: - there is no ADI server defined to reflect a connection to the specified host. - the remote host is not known by the local system. - the ORACLE kernel on the remote host is not generated with the IPA driver
action: Check sequentially for the above causes and eliminate the actual cause found.

description: IPA: Message send error
cause: The SQL*Net IPA driver could not write the message into the message queue.
action: Make sure that the message queue exists and is accessible. If necessary rerun ipactl.

description: IPA: Message receive error
cause: The SQL*Net IPA driver could not read a message from the message queue.
action: Make sure that the message queue exists and is accessible. If necessary rerun ipactl.

description: IPA: Illegal message type
cause: The communication between user and ORACLE is out of synchronization. This message should not normally be issued.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: IPA: Message write length error
cause: The IPA driver tried to write a message in the queue that was too big for the queue.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: IPA: Cannot reset connection
cause: A fatal error occurred during the resetting of the connection.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: IPA: No more connections available
cause: You have exhausted all your connections.
action: Try again when some of the current users have logged off.

description: IPA: No message queue available
cause: The SQL*Net IPA servers have not been started.
action: Run ipactl.

description: IPA: Environment variable(s) not set
cause: Environment variable(s) not set correctly.
action: Check and correct.

description: IPA: Maximum number of servers reached
cause: Maximum number of servers reached.
action: Shutdown and restart with an increased maximum number of servers. Note that database links consume one server per link. Be sure to start up enough servers to support database links.

description: IPA: Incorrect outgoing service name supplied
cause: Incorrect outgoing service name supplied.
action: Check and correct the service name.

description: IPA: Shared memory failed to initialise
cause: The shared memory has not been set up correctly.
action: Contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Event set up failure
cause: Fatal interprocess communication error.
action: Contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Invalid connect string
cause: The connect string is malformed.
action: Check and correct.

description: IPA: Invalid database SID
cause: The SID is unknown at the remote side.
action: Either the database does not exist, is not running, or there are no reserved servers for that SID.

description: IPA: Local maximum number of users exceeded
cause: The maximum number of simultaneous users of SQL*Net IPA has been exceeded on the local side.
action: Wait for free connections to become available. If the problem persists, contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Local maximum number of connections exceeded
cause: The maximum number of simultaneous connections that SQL*Net IPA can handle to different hosts has been exceeded on the local side.
action: Wait for free connections to become available. If the problem persists, contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Remote maximum number of users exceeded
cause: The maximum number of simultaneous users of SQL*Net IPA has been exceeded on the remote side.
action: Wait for free connections to become available. If the problem persists, contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Remote maximum number of connections exceeded
cause: The maximum number of simultaneous connections that SQL*Net IPA can handle from different hosts has been exceeded on the remote side.
action: Wait for free connections to become available. If the problem persists, contact your system manager.

description: IPA: Cannot reach the remote side
cause: There has been a timeout on an attempt to connect to a remote server the reason for which is most likely to be the remote SQL*Net IPA software is not running. An alternative reason could be that the remote initiator service name is incorrect.
action: Check and start the remote SQL*Net software. Check that it is started with the correct service names supplied.

description: IPA: Fatal shared memory error
cause: An internal error has occurred in the shared memory handling.
action: Contact customer support.

description: IPA: Cause event error
cause: Fatal interprocess communication error.
action: Contact your system manager.

description: NETCMN: No default host string specified
cause: There was no default host string specified in the configuration and the user didn't specify any explicit connect string.
action: Either reconfigure the system specifying a default connect string or use an explicit connect string.

description: NETCMN: invalid driver designator
cause: The login (connect) string contains an invalid driver designator.
action: Correct the string and re-submit.

description: NETCMN: error receiving break message
cause: Error occurred while attempting to read a break message.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: unable to allocate memory
cause: The system was unable to allocate needed virtual memory.
action: Contact your database administrator for assistance with this error.

description: NETCMN: invalid login (connect) string
cause: Syntax error in login string.
action: Correct string and re-submit.

description: NETCMN: reset protocol error
cause: Unable to reset out of break state.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETCMN: error sending break message
cause: Error occurred while attempting to send a break message.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETCMN: unable to set up break handling environment
cause: Error occurred while attempting to set up asynchronous handlers for in-coming, out-of-band break messages.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETCMN: incorrect message format
cause: Message from partner contains bad header.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: Connection not open.
cause: Unable to establish connection.
action: Use diagnostic procedures to ascertain exact problem.

description: NETCMN: error on test
cause: Error occurred while testing I/O status of the network connection.
action: Contact your customer support representative.

description: NETCMN: server can not start oracle
cause: The remote server was unable to start an ORACLE process on behalf of the client.
action: Make sure permissions on the remote ORACLE program are correctly set. Contact your system administrator.

description: NETCMN: SID lookup failure
cause: From the remote host's server: the database SID, specified in the login (connect) string, was not recognized.
action: Add the appropriate SID entry to the CONFIG.ORA or oratab file on the remote host (restarting the remote server may be needed).

description: NETCMN: Error detected in the read-in data
cause: Error found during recomputation of checksum or CRC.
action: Possible hardware failures of communication nodes. Contact system administrator immediately.

description: NETCMN: Error in sending data
cause: Unable to transmit data to remote host.
action: Try reconnect to remote host, and contact your system administrator.

description: NETCMN: Error in receiving data
cause: Unable to receive data from remote host.
action: Try reconnect to remote host, and contact your system administrator.

description: ssaio: Seals do not match
cause: A function was called with an invalid argument.
action: Contact your Oracle Customer Support Representative.

description: ssaio: Invalid Block number
cause: The file block number is out of range of the file. The additional information returns the block number.
action: Verify that the block number is correct. Run dbfsize and check if the block number is in that range. Contact your Oracle Customer Support Representative.

description: ssaio: Buffer Not Aligned
cause: The I/O buffer was not aligned on a 2K boundary.
action: Contact your Oracle Customer Support Representative.

description: ssaio: LSEEK error, unable to seek to requested block.
cause: The additional information returns the block number
action: Look up the additional information returned in your operating system reference manual. Verify that the block number is correct.

description: ssaio: read error, unable to read requested block from database file.
cause: The read system call returned an error.
action: The additional information indicates the block number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssaio: write error, unable to write requested block to database file.
cause: The write system call returned an error.
action: The additional information indicates the block number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssaio: asynchronous I/O failed due to incorrect parameters.
cause: The Asynchronous I/O system call returned an error.
action: The additional information indicates the block number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssaio: the asynchronous write was unable to write to the database file.
cause: The Asynchronous I/O system call returned an error.
action: The additional information indicates the block number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssaio: the asynchronous read was unable to read from the database file.
cause: The Asynchronous I/O system call returned an error.
action: The additional information indicates the block number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssaio: the asynchronous write returned incorrect number of bytes
cause: This write call may have been truncated. The additional information returns the block number and number of bytes.
action: Verify that the block number and the number of bytes written are correct.

description: ssaio: the asynchronous read returned incorrect number of bytes
cause: This read call may have been truncated. The additional information returns the block number and number of bytes.
action: Verify that the block number and the number of bytes read are correct.

description: ssvwatev: Incorrect parameter passed to function call
cause: Either the ORACLE process id, or wait time or event ID is invalid.
action: The additional information indicates the process id, time and event id.

description: ssvwatev: Failed with unexpected error number.
cause: Some system problems may exists on your system, please check error logs.
action: The additional information indicates the error number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssvpstev: Incorrect parameter passed to function call
cause: An invalid event ID is passed in to this routine.
action: The additional information indicates the event id.

description: ssvpstev: Failed with unexpected error number.
cause: Some system problems may exist on your system, please check error logs.
action: The additional information indicates the error number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssvpstevrg: Incorrect parameters passed to function call
cause: An invalid event id, or the low and high event ID do not exist.
action: The additional information indicates the error number. It also contains the event id, low boundary and high boundary.

description: ssvpstevrg: Failed with unexpected error number.
cause: Some system problems may exist on your system, please check error logs.
action: The additional information indicates the error number. Look up the additional information returned in your operating system manual.

description: ssvpstp: Incorrect parameter passed to function call
cause: Invalid oracle process ID is passed in to this routine.
action: The additional information indicates the process id.

description: ssvpstp: Failed with unexpected error number.
