description: missing or invalid user name
cause: The command did not specify a valid user name.
action: Specify a valid user name.

description: missing or invalid user group name
cause: The command did not specify a valid user group name.
action: Specify a valid user group name.

description: missing or invalid timeout value after DROP AFTER
cause: The command did not specify a valid timeout value after the DROP AFTER clause.
action: Specify a valid timeout value after the DROP AFTER clause.

description: timeout value exceeded range
cause: The OFFLINE timeout value exceeded the range of 0-136 years, inclusive. 136 years are 49674 days, 1192176 hours, and 71530560 minutes.
action: Specify a timeout value within the range of 0-136 years, inclusive.

description: conflicting or duplicate disk region options
cause: The command contained one or more of the following: - both the HOT and the COLD keywords - both the MIRRORHOT and the MIRRORCOLD keywords - the HOT keyword more than once - the COLD keyword more than once - the MIRRORHOT keyword more than once - the MIRRORCOLD keyword more than once
action: Specify either the HOT or the COLD keyword and either the MIRRORHOT or the MIRRORCOLD keyword, at most, once.

description: invalid file attribute specification
cause: The keyword UNPROTECTED, MIRROR, HIGH, FINE, or COARSE was specified in a MODIFY FILE clause. These file attributes are immutable once a file is created.
action: Specify a disk region keyword; for example, HOT, COLD, MIRRORHOT, or MIRRORCOLD.

description: ASM operation requires compatible.asm of %s or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.asm.
action: Set the disk group attribute compatible.asm to or above the requested version.

description: ASM disk "%s" is offline and cannot be renamed.
cause: An attempt was made to rename a disk that is offline.
action: Check the ASM disk name as specified in the command.

description: conflicting disk operations for %s
cause: An attempt was made to ADD and DROP the specified ASM disk in the same statement.
action: Revise the statement to specify distinct ASM disks in the ADD disk and DROP disk clauses.

description: Disk "%s" is already provisioned for Oracle ASM.
cause: An attempt was made to label a disk that was already provisioned for Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM).
action: Check the Oracle ASM disk name as specified in the command.
params: 1) disk_name: The path name of disk to be labeled.

description: The label name '%s' is already in use.
cause: A LABEL SET command specified a label name that was already used by another Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk.
action: Select a different name for the label.
params: 1) label_name: The name of the label specified for the labeling disk.

description: label name '%s' is not used by Oracle ASM
cause: A LABEL CLEAR command specified a label name that was not used by Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM).
action: Select a different name for the label, and retry the operation.
params: 1) label name: The label name to be cleared from the disk.

description: could not perform label set or clear operation
cause: An error occurred while setting or clearing the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) label.
action: Examine the underlying error(s) on the error stack. Check other messages in the trace files for more information.

description: Internal ASM testing event number 15228
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level controls error simulation.

description: Internal Oracle ASM testing event number 15229
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level controls error simulation.

description: diskgroup '%s' does not require the FORCE option
cause: An attempt was made to MOUNT or DROP a disk group with the FORCE option.
action: MOUNT and DROP diskgroup with the FORCE option are only permitted if the diskgroup cannot be mounted normally.

description: Advancing disk group compatibility would exclude connected clients.
cause: Disk group compatibility could not be advanced because connected clients were at a lower compatibility than the target value.
action: Ensure that all connected clients are at the target compatibility level or higher.

description: Command requires all disks in disk group %s to be online.
cause: Disk group compatibility could not be advanced because some disks are offline.
action: Retry the command after all offline disks are either set to online or dropped from the disk group.

description: Cannot advance disk group compatibility due to [%s].
cause: Disk group compatibility could not be advanced because of errors.
action: Check the alert log for more information on the reason for the error.

description: Diskgroup COMPATIBLE.RDBMS parameter value (%s) exceeds COMPATIBLE.ASM parameter value (%s).
cause: Attempted to advance the COMPATIBLE.RDBMS parameter value for the diskgroup beyond the COMPATIBLE.ASM parameter.
action: Make sure the COMPATIBLE.ASM parameter setting is at the same or higher compared to the COMPATIBLE.RDBMS parameter for the diskgroup.

description: diskgroup %s mount mode conflicts with existing mount
cause: The mode specified in the diskgroup mount command conflicted with the mode in which it was mounted on some other instance.
action: Specify a compatible mode in the diskgroup mount command.

description: diskgroup %s mounted in restricted mode
cause: The specified diskgroup was mounted in restricted mode prohibiting client access.
action: Dismount the diskgroup and remount it in appropriate mode.

description: invalid attribute %s to CREATE DISKGROUP command
cause: An invalid attribute was specified with the CREATE DISKGROUP command.
action: Check the valid attributes for CREATE DISKGROUP command and specify a valid one.

description: %s is not a valid value for attribute %s
cause: The specified value was not valid for the attribute.
action: Check the attribute name and value.

description: allocation unit size higher than %s requires RDBMS compatibility %s
cause: The allocation unit size requested exceeded the limit imposed by the RDBMS compatibility setting.
action: Use a smaller allocation unit size or specify a higher RDBMS compatibility setting.

description: Attribute name %s is invalid.
cause: The attribute name was not valid or was not recognized.
action: Check the attribute name and retry the operation.

description: attribute %s is read-only
cause: The attribute value was read-only and could not be changed.
action: None. The attribute value cannot be changed.

description: Could not set attribute %s.
cause: Attempts to set the specified attribute failed with an error.
action: Examine the underlying error(s) on the error stack. If necessary, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: %s is not a valid version number
cause: The given version number was invalid, or not valid in this context.
action: Verify that the version number is valid and is appropriate for this command. Check for additional errors reported.

description: new compatibility setting less than current [%s]
cause: The compatibility setting was invalid. The compatibility setting can only be advanced.
action: Check the version number.

description: ASM disk %s is already online or being brought online.
cause: An attempt was made to bring a disk online that was either already online or was being brought online.
action: Change the ONLINE statement to exclude the disk.

description: cannot bring ASM disk %s both online and then offline in the same statement
cause: An attempt was made to bring the specified disk both online and offline in the same statement.
action: Revise the statement to either bring the disk online or take the disk offline.

description: cannot specify both WAIT and NOWAIT options in the same statement
cause: An attempt was made to specify both WAIT and NOWAIT options in the same statement.
action: Revise the statement and include at most one option.

description: ASM attributes feature not enabled
cause: The ASM attributes feature was not enabled.
action: Advance disk group ASM compatibility to version 11.1.0 or newer.

description: could not locate ASM attribute %s
cause: The specified attribute could not be accessed.
action: Check the attribute name and examine underlying error(s) on the error stack.

description: insufficient diskgroup space for rebalance completion
cause: The command attempted to reduce the available diskgroup space below the current space used.
action: Consult V$ASM_DISK to determine the space requirements for the diskgroup contents, and repeat the command after making the required storage available.

description: only restricted mount is allowed in the ASM instance
cause: The ASM instance was started in restricted mode, and an attempt was made to mount a diskgroup in non-restricted mode.
action: Start the ASM instance in non-restricted mode and mount the diskgroup again, or mount the diskgroup in restricted mode.

description: user name '%s' does not exist in OS user dictionary
cause: The specified user name was not a valid operating system user.
action: Specify a valid operating system user.

description: user group name '%s' exceeds limit of %s characters
cause: The length of the specified user group name exceeded the maximum limit.
action: Reduce the length of the user group name to a value within the limit.

description: user group '%s' already exists in disk group
cause: The specified user group name was already defined in the disk group.
action: Specify a different user group name.

description: user group '%s' does not exist in disk group '%s'
cause: The specified user group name did not exist in the disk group.
action: Specify a valid user group name.

description: user '%s' is already a member of user group '%s'
cause: The user that was provided was already a member of the specified user group.
action: Specify either an alternate user or an alternate user group.

description: exceeded %s number of members per user group
cause: The maximum number of members per user group was exceeded.
action: Delete existing members of the user group to create space.

description: user group entry number must be between %s and %s, inclusive
cause: The specified user group entry number was beyond the acceptable range.
action: Specify a valid value for the user group entry number.

description: user '%s' is not a member of user group '%s'
cause: The specified user was not a member of the specified user group.
action: Specify either an alternate user or an alternate user group.

description: permission denied on ASM disk group
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation on an ASM disk group without the appropriate privileges.
action: Ask the ASM administrator to perform the operation or grant the required privileges.

description: user '%s' already exists in disk group '%s'
cause: The specified UID already existed in the disk group.
action: Specify a different UID.

description: user '%s' does not exist in disk group '%s'
cause: The specified UID did not exist in the disk group.
action: Specify a user with a valid UID.

description: The length of the user name '%s' exceeds the limit of %s characters.
cause: The length of the specified user name exceeded the maximum limit.
action: Reduce the length of the user name to a value within the limit.

description: operating system function returned error %s
cause: An operating system error occurred.
action: Correct the operating system error and retry the operation.

description: user identification number not in range of [%s,%s]
cause: The operating system user identification number exceeded the maximum value.
action: Change the user identification number to a value within the accepted range.

description: user identification number '%s' already in use
cause: This user identification number was already in use internally by Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM).
action: Choose a different user identification number and retry the operation.

description: Internal ASM event number 15267.
cause: Do not set this event. It is used internally by Oracle.
action: None.

description: Internal Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM) file %s already exists.
cause: The specified Oracle ASM internal file already existed and was not automatically overwritten.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: group identification number not in range of [%s,%s]
cause: The operating system group identification number exceeded the maximum value.
action: Change the group identification number to a value within the accepted range.

description: disk %s is not a quorum disk
cause: The specified disk was not a quorum disk.
action: Retry the operation without the quorum attribute for the disk.

description: failgroup %s is a quorum failgroup
cause: The specified failgroup was a quorum failgroup.
action: Retry the operation with the quorum attribute for the failgroup.

description: failgroup %s is not a quorum failgroup
cause: The specified failgroup was not a quorum failgroup.
action: Retry the operation without the quorum attribute for the failgroup.

description: Could not create the required number of voting files.
cause: The required number of voting files could not be created. See accompanying messages for possible causes.
action: See accompanying messages for possible actions.

description: Not enough failgroups (%s) to create voting files
cause: The number of failgroups required for this redundancy were not present in the diskgroup to create voting files.
action: Retry the operation after creating new failgroup(s).

description: not enough space (%s allocation units) in disk %s to allocate voting file
cause: The specified disk did not have enough (contiguous) space to allocate a voting file on it.
action: Ensure that there is at least 1 disk with the required space in the minimum required number of failure groups for the disk group and retry the operation.

description: ASM diskgroup %s has cluster voting files
cause: An attempt was made to drop a diskgroup that contained cluster voting files.
action: Move the cluster voting files out of the diskgroup and retry the operation.

description: disk %s is a quorum disk
cause: The specified disk was a quorum disk.
action: Retry the operation with the quorum attribute for the disk.

description: External redundancy disk group requires at least one regular disk.
cause: Attempted to create an external redundancy disk group with only quorum disks.
action: Specify at least one regular disk to create an external redundancy disk group.

description: user '%s' is currently being deleted
cause: The specified user was in the process of being deleted and could not be used.
action: Either abandon this operation or specify a different user.

description: user '%s' owns existing files
cause: An attempt was made to drop a user that still owns existing files.
action: Specify the CASCADE option to drop the user and all of the owned files.

description: not all specified disks were brought ONLINE
cause: Some of the disks specified either experienced I/O errors while being brought ONLINE, or were simultaneously brought OFFLINE or dropped in another session, or were full.
action: Query V$ASM_DISK or use ASMCMD LSDSK to determine which disks were not brought ONLINE. Inspect any additional error messages and the alert log to determine the exact cause. If some of the disks failed, either fix the cause of the failures or drop the disks. If some of the disks are full, either free space in the disk group or add new disks to the diskgroup.

description: Cluster Synchronization Services operation '%s' failed with error '%s'.
cause: This is an internal error.
action: Check the accompanying error messages. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: ASM operation requires compatible.rdbms of %s or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.rdbms.
action: Set the disk group attribute compatible.rdbms to or above the requested version.

description: ASM terminated ALTER DISKGROUP ONLINE
cause: None of the disks specified by ALTER DISKGROUP ONLINE could be brought ONLINE.
action: Inspect additional error messages and the alert log to determine why the specified disks cannot be brought ONLINE.

description: disk '%s' violates disk group attribute %s
cause: Including the specified disk would violate a restriction imposed by the specified disk group attribute.
action: Retry the operation while omitting the offending disk or change the attribute.

description: failed to set attribute %s for the Oracle ASM disk group due to offline disks
cause: The specified attribute could not be set for the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group because some disks in the disk group were offline.
action: Drop the offline disks and wait for the rebalance operations to complete, or online the offline disks and wait for the online to complete. Then retry the operation.

description: could not set disk group attribute %s due to incompatible disks
cause: The specified disk group attribute could not be set because the disk group includes disks that conflict with the new value.
action: Retry the operation after dropping the conflicting disks in this disk group.

description: disk(s) require disk group attribute %s clause
cause: Some of the disks specified by the command also require the specified disk group attribute to be stated.
action: Retry the command including an ATTRIBUTE clause for the required disk group attribute. Alternatively, omit the disks that require setting the disk group attribue. See the alert log for additional information on the disks that require setting the disk group attribute.

description: disk %s is limited to %s MB on instance %s
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ADD DISK or RESIZE DISK command specified a disk with a size greater than the specified instance could use.
action: Check the storage subsystem configuration on the specified node.

description: operation not permitted on offline disk %s
cause: An attempt was made to specify an operation that is only permitted on disks that are online. The specified disk was not online.
action: Online the disk or wait for online to complete before retrying the operation.

description: ASM could not add disk "%s" to disk group "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk to a disk group while the distribution of disks in failure groups was too uneven.
action: Add or drop disks to or from failure groups to balance their distribution in all failure groups and retry the operation.

description: Disk name %s is being used by another disk
cause: The specified disk name could not be reused because an 11.1.0.6.0 or earlier database instance had it cached in memory.
action: Do one of the following - Specify a different name for the disk. - Wait for the rebalance to complete successfully. - Identify the database instance with the problem and shut it down before retrying the command.

description: operation disallowed by ASM_POWER_LIMIT
cause: This operation required data movement in order to complete successfully. However, ASM_POWER_LIMIT was set to zero, thereby preventing this operation.
action: Repeat the operation after setting ASM_POWER_LIMIT to a non-zero value.

description: cannot grant or revoke SYSASM privilege on database instances
cause: The SYSASM privilege could not be granted or revoked on database instances. This privilege can only be used to authenticate on Oracle Automatic Storage Management instances.
action: Ensure that there is a connection to an Oracle Automatic Storage Management instance, and grant or revoke the SYSASM privilege.

description: Oracle ASM instance software version %s less than client version %s
cause: The Oracle ASM instance software version was less than the client version.
action: Upgrade the Oracle ASM instance software or use a client version that matches the Oracle ASM version. Check the alert log for more information regarding the failure.

description: POWER disallowed by diskgroup compatibility
cause: The rebalance power was not allowed due to the diskgroup compatiblity.
action: None.

description: extent pointer %s for file %s block %s%s does not exist
cause: This is an internal error in ASM. End users will never see this error. It is raised when kfcInitPba attempts to extract the extent pointers from a locator block and finds they are KFXP_NODISK or KFXP_NOEXT. An external error is used because sometimes this error needs to be caught and ignored.
action: None. End users will not see this error.

description: possible lost disk write detected during crash recovery
cause: ASM crash recovery read a block who's version was older than expected.
action: None. End users will not see this error. ASM automatically traps this error and attempts a fallback recovery.

description: FINE striping not allowed for the Staleness Registry
cause: An SQL command attempted to set the striping attribute of the ASM_STALE template to FINE striping.
action: Do not modify the striping attribute of the ASM_STALE template.

description: File %s is incompatible with this operation
cause: The file type was incompatible with the operation.
action: Use another file of the correct type.

description: cannot change %0!s of the open file '%1!s'
cause: A SET OWNERSHIP or SET PERMISSION command was attempted on an open file. These commands require the file to be closed.
action: Close the file and then retry the operation.

description: active use of files owned by user '%s' precludes its drop
cause: A DROP USER command specified a user owning files that were in use.
action: Close all files owned by this user.

description: Voting files could not be created in diskgroup %s due to small Allocation Unit size
cause: An attempt was made to create voting files in a diskgroup with a small Allocation Unit size.
action: Create voting files in a different diskgroup whose Allocation Unit size is at least 1 mega byte.

description: operation requires ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to be TRUE
cause: An attempt was made to run an operation that required the ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to be set to TRUE, but its existing state was FALSE.
action: Set the ACCESS_CONTROL.ENABLED attribute to TRUE and retry the operation.

description: cannot update Oracle ASM internal files
cause: An attempt was made to change Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata used to manage the disk group. This was not allowed.
action: Check the specified Oracle ASM file name to ensure a file name with a file number greater than or equal to 256 is selected.

description: ASM password file update failed on node %s
cause: A CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, GRANT, or REVOKE command failed on the specified node of the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) cluster.
action: Check the ASM alert logs for more information.

description: disk %s not discoverable by CSS; diskgroup %s has CSS voting files
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk which cannot be discovered by Cluster Synchronization Services (CSS). CSS has voting files in the disk group and will not be able to use the new disk if CSS cannot discover the disks.
action: Update the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) disk string in the Grid Plug and Play (GPnP) profile to include the specified disk and retry the operation. Alternatively, migrate the CSS voting files out of the diskgroup and retry the operation

description: cannot access Oracle ASM SPFILE in RDBMS instance
cause: An attempt to open an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) server parameter file (SPFILE) from a relational database management system (RDBMS) instance was disallowed.
action: Connect to an Oracle ASM instance and reissue the command. Alternatively, specify an RDBMS SPFILE.

description: could not access database SPFILE in ASM instance
cause: An Automatic Storage Management (ASM) instance attempted to access a relational database management system (RDBMS) SPFILE.
action: Connect to an RDBMS instance and reissue the command. Alternatively, specify an ASM SPFILE.

description: process terminated due to signal
cause: A process was terminated as a result of a signal in the I/O path.
action: Reconnect to the database or the ASM instance. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

description: process terminated due to fenced I/O
cause: A process was terminated because it was fenced from doing any more I/Os.
action: Reconnect to the database or the ASM instance. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

description: invalid file type
cause: Automatic Storage Management (ASM) could not determine the type of file.
action: The file specified is not supported with Automatic Storage Management (ASM). Specify a supported file type for the operation.

description: Oracle ASM disk %s cannot be resized under %s M
cause: An Oracle ASM disk resize command specified a size that was less than the size required to support the voting file present on the disk.
action: Increase the size specified for the disk.

description: Internal ASM event number 15314
cause: Do not set this event. Used internally by Oracle.
action: None.

description: Write errors in disk group %s could lead to inconsistent Oracle ASM metadata.
cause: One or more failures occurred while writing Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata to the disk.
action: Repair the hardware problem and remount the disk group. Check the accompanying errors and alert log for the disks which reported the error.

description: Previous client instance %s has not fully exited.
cause: A process from a prior instantiation of this client was not fenced.
action: Ensure that all processes belonging to the client instance have exited. Check the client alert log and the trace file of the process that terminated the instance.

description: user identification number '%s' does not exist in operating system user dictionary
cause: The specified user identification number did not belong to a valid operating system user.
action: Specify a valid operating system user.

description: disks in disk group %s cannot be resized
cause: Execution of ASM Storage Reclamation Utility script was incomplete on the specified disk group.
action: Execute ASM Storage Reclamation utility on the disk group to complete the operation.

description: ownership assignment of files to user '%s' precludes its drop
cause: A DROP USER command specified a user currently being assigned as the owner of one or more files with a SET OWNERSHIP command.
action: Wait for the SET OWNERSHIP command to complete and then retry the DROP USER command

description: cannot drop user '%s' that has been assigned as the owner of one or more open files
cause: A SET OWNERSHIP command assigned this user as the owner of one or more files which were open at the time of assignment, and hence this user cannot be dropped due to possible inconsistencies in file ownerships.
action: Restart all ASM client instances of the cluster in a rolling manner.

description: failed to set attribute %s for the Oracle ASM disk group due to connected clients
cause: The specified attribute could not be set for the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group because it was being used by one or more databases.
action: Query the V$ASM_CLIENT view in an Oracle ASM instance or use the ASMCMD LSOF command to identify databases using the Oracle ASM disk group. Shut down connected clients and then retry the operation.
params: 1) attribute_name: The name of the Oracle ASM disk group attribute.

description: cannot drop the owner '%s' of user group '%s' in disk group '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to drop the owner of a user group from the group's member list.
action: Specify a user group member who is not the owner of the user group.

description: ASM password update has failed on local node
cause: A CREATE USER, ALTER USER, DROP USER, GRANT, or REVOKE command failed on the local node of the Automatic Storage Management (ASM) cluster.
action: Check the ASM alert logs for more information.

description: Requested operation is not allowed on password file %s.
cause: Attempted to run an unsupported operation on password files.
action: Specify a new file name or a file with the correct file type, and retry the operation.

description: File %s is not a valid password file.
cause: An attempt was made to open a file that had a type different from the password file.
action: Specify a valid password file name and retry the operation.

description: specified input %s is not an ASM file
cause: The attributes could not be obtained because the specified input was either a disk group or a directory.
action: Specify a valid Automatic Storage Management (ASM) file name.

description: remote ASM is not enabled
cause: An operation was requested that requires remote ASM to be enabled.
action: Enable remote ASM.

description: user identification string '%s' exceeds limit of %s characters
cause: The user identification string provided for this operation exceeded the maximum number of characters allowed.
action: Provide a user identification string of shorter length.

description: cluster identification string '%s' exceeds limit of %s characters
cause: The cluster identification string provided for this operation exceeded the maximum number of characters allowed.
action: Provide a cluster identification string of shorter length.

description: ASM user name format requires COMPATIBLE.ASM of %s or higher
cause: The ASM user name format specified requires a higher disk group attribute value for COMPATIBLE.ASM.
action: Set the disk group attribute COMPATIBLE.ASM to or above the requested version.

description: Oracle ASM proxy instance ORACLE_SID %s does not start with %s.
cause: The Oracle ASM proxy instance was started with an invalid ORACLE_SID prefix.
action: Start the Oracle ASM proxy instance with an ORACLE_SID that begins with the correct prefix.

description: ASM proxy instance cannot connect to an ASM server
cause: The ASM proxy instance could not find an ASM server to connect to during startup.
action: Verify that an ASM server instance is running and accessible in the cluster and restart the proxy instance.

description: disk is not available on all client instances
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ADD DISK statement specified a disk that could not be discovered by all client instances.
action: Check the Oracle ASM and client alert logs for more information. Check operating system permissions for the device and the storage subsystem configuration on all instances.

description: volume background process terminated with error
cause: A volume background process terminated with an error.
action: Restart the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance where the issue occurred. If the issue persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: ASM metadata corruption detected in disk group '%s'
cause: A corruption was detected reading a block. It may be recoverable.
action: The corruption could be the result of a storage problem, a configuration issue, or a software bug. Check the alert log for the result of the recovery attempt. If unsuccessful, contact Oracle Support Services with the incident information.

description: STRIPE_WIDTH cannot be set when STRIPE_COLUMNS equals 1
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a value of 1 in STRIPE_COLUMNS and specified the STRIPE_WIDTH argument.
action: If striping is required, then set STRIPE_COLUMNS to a value greater than 1. If striping is not required, then do not set STRIPE_WIDTH.

description: invalid or missing database name
cause: You did not specify a valid database name for this command.
action: Specify a valid database name.

description: Oracle ASM client instance %s reconnection refused
cause: The client was not an orphaned client and is not a legitimate candidate to reconnect to Oracle ASM.
action: Shut down and restart the remote client so that it is considered a new client in the cluster.

description: client instance %s has been fenced by Oracle ASM
cause: Oracle ASM had already fenced this client.
action: Shutdown and restart the remote client instance to be registered as a new client in the cluster.

description: unable to create member cluster '%s'
cause: Creation of the member cluster failed.
action: Check the alert logs and trace files of the Oracle ASM instance for more information on the reason for the failure, as well as checking the accompanying error messages.

description: unable to delete member cluster '%s'
cause: Deletion of the member cluster failed.
action: Check the alert logs and trace files of the Oracle ASM instance for more information on the reason for the failure, as well as checking the accompanying error messages.

description: Internal ASM testing event number 15342
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: This event sets the total number of processes allowed to trace a disk failure.

description: Feature %s ASM is not enabled
cause: An operation was requested that requires Oracle Flex ASM to be enabled.
action: Enable Oracle Flex ASM.

description: client %s not found
cause: The specified Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) client was not registered with this instance.
action: Check the Oracle ASM instance alert log, the client alert log and trace files, and any accompanying error messages for more information on the reason for the failure.

description: disconnected client instance(s) detected
cause: One or more ASM client instances were not connected to an ASM instance.
action: Check that all of the ASM client instances are connected to an ASM instance and retry the operation.

description: Process attempting to identify or create the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file %s was aborted.
cause: The client process attempting to create or open the Oracle ASM file was terminated or interrupted.
action: Use the alert log to identify any issues encountered. Correct the cause of the issue and retry. If the issue persists, contact Oracle Support.

description: The logical block size %0!s of the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file '%1!s' is too small for disk group sector size %2!s.
cause: You attempted to create a file on Oracle ASM whose logical block size was less than the sector size of the disk group.
action: Check if the system configuration has changed. Correct the error and retry.

description: ASMLIB misconfiguration error [%s]
cause: ASMLIB was found in more than one location.
action: Check the configuration of ASMLIB and ensure that only one library is configured.

description: failed to set or get AFD_DISKSTRING parameter
cause: The operation failed because either Oracle Local Repository (OLR) was not available or AFD disk string attribute did not exist.
action: Check that Oracle Clusterware is properly configured using 'ocrcheck -local' command.

description: invalid SYS_ASMFD_PROPERTIES parameter
cause: The parameter passed in for SYS_ASMFD_PROPERTIES was invalid.
action: Pass in the correct parameter. Refer to the product documentation for a list of allowed parameter values.

description: I/O request issued to a sparse grid disk failed because the disk was out of space.
cause: The sparse grid disk was out of space.
action: Add more space to the disk group by adding more disks or add more space to existing disks by resizing them.

description: invalid client name %s specified
cause: The client name specified in the command was invalid.
action: Specify a valid client name. A valid client name must have one of the following formats: <instance name>:<database unique name>:<cluster name> or <instance name>:<database unique name>

description: disk '%s' cannot be added to disk group '%s'
cause: The disk type did not match the disk group sparse type.
action: Ensure that the disk type matches the disk group sparse type.

description: failed to format grid disk "%s"
cause: The grid disk format command failed.
action: Check the grid disk logs and take corrective actions.

description: Internal Oracle ASM testing event number 15355
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: This event sets the configuration for read cancel.

description: Internal ASM testing event number 15356
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: This event sets the configuration for write cancel.

description: File "%s" can not be created on a sparse disk group.
cause: An attempt was made to create a fine-grained striping file on a sparse disk group. Fine-grained striping files cannot be created on sparse disk groups.
action: Create the file on a regular disk group, or create a coarse- grained striping file on a sparse disk group.

description: query for materialized space to sparse grid disk "%s" of disk group "%s" has failed
cause: The query for materialized space to the cell server has failed.
action: Check the ASM and cell alert logs and take corrective actions.

description: could not perform label scan operation
cause: An error occurred while scanning for ASM label.
action: Look at the underlying errors on the error stack. Check other messages in the trace files for more information.

description: could not perform label filter operation
cause: An error occurred while setting AFD filter status.
action: Look at the underlying errors on the error stack. Check other messages in the trace files for more information.

description: unable to find member cluster '%s'
cause: Looking up of the member cluster failed.
action: Execute the 'asmcmd lscc' command to list all of the configured member clusters. If the member cluster listed in the message is not present, it might have been forcibly deleted. Refer to the product documentation for more information. If the member cluster listed in the message was present, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: invalid cluster name '%s' specified
cause: An invalid cluster name was supplied.
action: Specify a cluster name which is at least one character but no more than 15 characters in length. The cluster name must be alphanumeric, it cannot begin with a numeric character, and it may contain hyphen (-) characters. However, it cannot end with a hyphen (-) character.

description: invalid version number '%s' specified
cause: The command did not specify a valid version number.
action: Correct the version number in the command. It should be of the form #.#.#.#.# or other forms with fewer numbers delimited by a period.

description: member cluster version %s is incompatible with storage server version %s
cause: The specified member cluster version was not supported by the Storage Server.
action: Upgrade or downgrade the storage server to a version that is compatible with member cluster and retry the operation. Install a member cluster using a supported version. Refer to product documentation for a complete list of supported releases.

description: member cluster '%s' already configured
cause: The specified member cluster was already configured.
action: Execute the 'asmcmd lscc' command to list all of the configured member clusters. Reexecute the command with a member cluster name that has not already been configured.

description: unable to delete configuration for member cluster '%s' because the directory '%s' was not empty
cause: Deleting the member cluster configuration failed because some files were present.
action: Deinstall the member cluster and rerun the command. If the command fails again, execute the 'asmcmd rmcc <member_cluster_name> -f' command to force deletion of the configuration for the member cluster.

description: member cluster '%s' not configured
cause: The specified member cluster was not configured.
action: Execute the 'asmcmd lscc' command to list all of the configured member clusters. Reexecute the command with a member cluster name that is configured.

description: Oracle Cluster Registry operation failed with error %s. %s
cause: This is an internal error.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Oracle Call Interface (OCI) call returned invalid handle %s.
cause: An Oracle Call Interface (OCI) call returned the OCI_INVALID_HANDLE return code and did not store the error on the stack.
action: Check the alert log and trace file for more information on this failure. Solve any issues and retry the operation. If the issue persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: database version needs to be 12.1 or higher to access a disk group number higher than 63
cause: An attempt was made to access a disk group number greater than 63 with a database version lower than 12.1.
action: Upgrade the database to version 12.1 or higher and retry the operation.

description: The command is not supported on a member cluster.
cause: An attempt was made to run a command that is not supported on a member cluster.
action: Rerun the command on the storage server.

description: Client version %s not supported by the Oracle ASM instance.
cause: The software version of the client instance was not supported by the release of the Oracle ASM instance.
action: Upgrade the client instance to a later release that is compatible with the Oracle ASM instance and retry the operation. Refer to product documentation for a complete list of supported releases.

description: SYSDG, SYSKM, SYSRAC, and SYSBACKUP administrative privileges cannot be granted on an ASM instance.
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke SYSDG, SYSKM, SYSRAC, or SYSBACKUP administrative privileges to a user on an ASM instance.
action: Do not attempt to grant SYSDG, SYSKM, SYSRAC, or SYSBACKUP administrative privileges on an ASM instance.

description: invalid cluster configuration
cause: The client instance detected an invalid configuration.
action: Install and configure Oracle Grid Infrastructure and retry the operation. Refer to product documentation for more information.

description: Physical sector size (%s) cannot be smaller than the logical sector size (%s).
cause: An attempt was made to create or modify a disk group with a physical sector size value smaller than its logical sector size value.
action: Review the SQL statement and fix any discrepancies.

description: The existence of native disk '%s' does not allow disk group %s from changing sector sizes. Sector size of native disk is %s.
cause: An attemp was made to change the physical or logical sector size value. Changing the sector size value is not allowed when there are native disks (physical sector equal to logical sector size) in the disk group, because this could cause invalid I/O operations.
action: Drop the native disks or replace them for disks that support sector size emulation.

description: Block size (%s) for file '%s' is incompatible with the selected sector size (%s).
cause: The operation could not be completed because the sector size was incompatible for the specified file.
action: Re-create or migrate the file to a block size that is compatible with the desired sector size, and redo the operation.

description: Grid Naming Service operation failed with error %s. %s
cause: This is an internal error.
action: Check the accompanying error messages. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cluster Credentials operation failed with error %s. %s
cause: This is an internal error.
action: Check the accompanying error messages. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: invalid file group name specifier
cause: The file group name specified was invalid.
action: Specify a valid file group name.

description: missing or invalid file group client specifier
cause: The command did not specify a valid file group client string.
action: Specify a valid file group client string with alphanumeric characters.

description: invalid file group client name specifier
cause: The file group name specified was invalid.
action: Specify a valid file group name.

description: invalid file group property '%s'
cause: An invalid property was specified for the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file group.
action: Check the Oracle documentation for valid Oracle ASM file group properties. The correct format of a valid Oracle ASM file group property is either file 'type.property_name' or 'property_name'.

description: invalid file type '%s'
cause: An invalid file type was specified for the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file group property.
action: Check the documentation for valid Oracle ASM file types.

description: file group '%s' does not exist
cause: The specified file group did not exist within the disk group.
action: Specify a file group that exists within the disk group.

description: file group '%s' already exists in disk group '%s'
cause: A file group with the same name was already defined.
action: Select another file group name or drop the existing file group. While creating non multitenant container database (CDB) or pluggable database (PDB), manually create a file group for the non-CDB or PDB.

description: existing files are associated with file group '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to drop a file group that contained existing files.
action: Specify the CASCADE option to drop the file group and all of the associated files.

description: A file type cannot be specified for file group property '%s'.
cause: The specified file group property affects the file group itself or all files in the file group. It is not specific to a type of file.
action: Remove the file type from the property name.

description: missing or invalid file group property specification
cause: The command did not specify a valid file group property name or a valid file group property value.
action: Specify a valid file group property name and value pair.

description: invalid value for file group property '%s'
cause: An invalid value was specified for the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file group property.
action: Check the documentation for acceptable values for this Oracle ASM file group property.

description: cannot drop the default file group
cause: The specified file group was created by the system and must always exist for proper operation.
action: Specify another file group name.

description: cannot alter the default file group
cause: The specified file group was created by the system and must remain set to the default values for proper operation.
action: Specify another file group name.

description: File number '%d' does not exist in file group '%s'.
cause: The specified file did not exist within the file group.
action: Check the file number and the file group number.

description: duplicate file group property '%s' specified
cause: A command specified the same file group property more than once for the same file type.
action: Specify only one file group property for each file type.

description: file group redundancy incompatible with file type
cause: An attempt was made to move a file to a file group with an incompatible redundancy specification, or to change the redundancy specification of a file group in a way that was incompatible with existing files in that file group.
action: Specify a valid redundancy property for the file group. Only write-once files, such as the offline archive log and backup set, support parity protection. Other types of files must be configured with as unprotected, mirror or high redundancy. The file group redundancy can be changed from a parity protection scheme to unprotected, mirror, or high, and conversely, as long as the file group does not contain any files.

description: command operates on only one file group property
cause: More than one file group property was specified in the ADD FILEGROUP or MODIFY FILEGROUP statement.
action: Specify only one file group property per statement.

description: command requires all disks in disk group %s to be online
cause: The file group redundancy could not be changed to UNPROTECTED because some disks were offline.
action: Retry the command after the offline disks are dropped.

description: file group property '%s' is read-only
cause: The specified file group property could not be changed.
action: Retry the command providing a nonread-only file group property.

description: New RDBMS compatibility '%0!s' exceeds client COMPATIBLE setting '%1!s'.
cause: The specified value for the COMPATIBLE.RDBMS attribute exceeded the database COMPATIBLE setting for one or more clients.
action: Verify the COMPATIBLE setting for each client of this disk group.

description: not running on supported Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) appliance
cause: An attempt was made to initialize the server code as an appliance when it was not running a supported appliance configuration.
action: Check the appliance configuration and retry the operation.

description: command not supported on ASM appliance '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to run an operation that is not supported by the specified appliance.
action: Check the documentation to see which operations are allowed or disallowed for the specified appliance.

description: insufficient number of disks to support ASM appliance '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to do an operation that resulted in insufficient number of disks required for the specified appliance.
action: Check the appliance configuration and retry the operation after inserting disks in the appropriate slots.

description: unable to read an ASM appliance configuration file
cause: Oracle ASM was unable to read an appliance configuration file.
action: Check the operating system error messages to determine the identity of the configuration file. Then, fix the configuration file.

description: Oracle ASM could not add disk "%s" to disk group "%s" on appliance %s
cause: There were too many dropping or offline disks in the specified disk group.
action: Wait for the drop and rebalance operations to complete, or online the offline disks and wait for the online to complete. Then, retry the operation.

description: Slot %s partition %s in Oracle ASM appliance '%s' contains more than one disk.
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk to a slot and a partition number in the Oracle ASM appliance that already had a disk (possibly OFFLINE) associated with it.
action: Use FORCE to drop the disk that exists in the specified slot and the partition number. Then, retry the operation.

description: ASM disk %s is being replaced.
cause: An attempt was made to either online or replace a disk that was already being replaced, probably by another instance.
action: Change the ONLINE statement to exclude the disk.

description: Disk specification '%s' matches multiple disks.
cause: More than one disk is discovered matching the specified disk string.
action: Change the disk string to specify one and only one disk.

description: Replacement disk '%s' for '%s' must be at least %s MB.
cause: The replacement disk must be at least of the same size of the old disk.
action: Use a larger physical disk to replace.

description: All disks in disk group %s are not of the same type.
cause: An attempt was made to add disks of a different type to the disk group under appliance mode.
action: Check if all the disks in the disk group are of the same type. Do not add flash and hard disks to the same disk group.

description: Disks in disk group %s do not have equal size.
cause: The disks in the disk group were not of equal size.
action: Ensure that all disks in the disk group are of equal size. If adding new disks to the disk group, their size must be equal to the size of the existing disks in the disk group. If resizing, all disks in the disk group must be resized to the same size.

description: Failure groups in disk group %s have different number of disks.
cause: An attempt was made to enable appliance mode with a different number of disks in each failure group.
action: Check if all failure groups have an equal number of disks and try again.

description: Operation on disk group %s is incompatible under appliance mode.
cause: An attempt was made to do an operation that resulted in dropping all disks in a failure group or creating a new failure group.
action: Disable appliance mode, perform the operation and reenable appliance mode. WARNING: To reenable appliance mode, ensure the following constraints are met: * There are a sufficient number of disks in each failure group. * All failure groups have an equal number of disks. * There are no offline disks in the disk group. * Every disk in the disk group is of the same type (flash or hard disk). * All disks in the disk group have an equal size.

description: Appliance mode is disabled.
cause: Appliance mode cannot be set because it was explicitly disabled.
action: Enable appliance mode and appliance partnering parameters.

description: Appliance mode requires either %s or %s disks in all failure groups.
cause: Appliance mode cannot be enabled because it does not meet the minimum requirements.
action: Check if there are sufficient number of disks in each failure group.

description: could not retrieve appliance properties for disk group %s
cause: Some of the appliance properties were invalid. This could be due to a cell software downgrade after setting the 'appliance.mode' attribute.
action: Check the cell software on all of the cells or disable appliance mode.

description: ASM disk %s in disk group %s is offline.
cause: An offline disk prevented the current ADD or DROP operation.
action: Drop the offline disk or online the offline disk or disable appliance mode.

description: Relocation failed due to a transient condition and will be retried or restarted automatically.
cause: A relocation has to be retried due to a transient condition.
action: Internal event.

description: Appliance mode is not supported for compatible.asm %s.
cause: Appliance mode could not be enabled for the current value of the compatible.asm attribute.
action: Disable appliance mode if it is enabled or advance compatible.asm to a version that supports appliance mode.

description: disk group %s is not mounted in restricted mode
cause: The specified disk group was not mounted in restricted mode which prohibited the requested operation.
action: Dismount the disk group, mount it in restricted mode, and then retry the operation.

description: Operation on disk group %s is disabled.
cause: The current operation could not be completed because the disk group is in the middle of an appliance migration.
action: Wait for the migration to complete and then retry the command.

description: %s is not supported when the disk group is mounted for recovery.
cause: The disk group was mounted for recovery preventing the requested operation.
action: Dismount the disk group, remount it in normal mode and retry the operation.

description: Disks '%s' and '%s', in failure group '%s' of disk group '%s', do not belong to the same cell
cause: It was detected that disks from different cells belong to the same failure group.
action: Make the necessary disk swaps so only disks from the same cell belong to the same failure group.

description: Disk '%s' in failure group '%s' and disk '%s' in failure group '%s' of disk group '%s' belong to the same cell
cause: It was detected that disks from the same cell belong to different failure groups.
action: Make the necessary disk swaps so disks from the same cell are not shared between different failure groups.

description: relocation must be restarted
cause: A relocation has to be restarted due to a transient condition.
action: Internal event.

description: DB_UNIQUE_NAME conflict across clusters
cause: The DB_UNIQUE_NAME parameter was specified with duplicate, conflicting or invalid attributes.
action: Specify a different DB_UNIQUE_NAME.

description: Slot %s partition %s in Oracle ASM appliance '%s' contains more than one disk.
cause: An attempt was made to add a disk to a slot and a partition number in the Oracle ASM appliance that already had a disk (possibly OFFLINE) associated with it.
action: Check the appliance configuration and retry the operation after inserting disks in the appropriate slots. If the disk that exists in the specified slot and the partition is dropping, then wait for the rebalance operation to finish before retrying the operation, or use FORCE to drop the existing disk and then retry the operation. Note that with FORCE drop, the redundancy of the diskgroup may be compromised until the rebalance operation completes. If the disk that exists in the specified slot and the partition is OFFLINE, then use REPLACE disk to replace the disk.

description: Appliance mode requires at least %s failure groups.
cause: Appliance mode cannot be enabled because it does not meet the minimum requirements.
action: Check if there are sufficient failure groups in the disk group.

description: Invalid disk slots to enable appliance mode.
cause: Appliance mode requires that the set of disk slots in every regular (non-quorum) failure group is the same and also, the disk slots are consecutive.
action: Use cellcli and check the celldisk attribute 'virtualslot' for every disk that belongs to the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group. Ensure the slot requirements are met before enabling appliance mode for the disk group. If this is CREATE DISKGROUP operation, ensure that the correct set of disks are used. Otherwise, use the ALTER DISKGROUP SQL to ADD the correct disks to the disk group or DROP the incorrect disks from the disk group.

description: Appliance mode requires at least %s disks in each failure group.
cause: Appliance mode cannot be enabled because it does not meet the minimum requirements.
action: Check if there are sufficient disks in each regular (non-quorum) failure group in the disk group.

description: missing or invalid quota group name
cause: The command did not specify a valid quota group name.
action: Specify a valid quota group name.

description: missing or invalid quota group property
cause: The command did not specify a valid quota group property.
action: Specify a valid quota group property.

description: missing or invalid quota
cause: The command did not specify a valid quota limit for the quota group.
action: Specify a valid quota limit.

description: missing or invalid file group name
cause: The command did not specify a valid file group name.
action: Specify a valid file group name.

description: quota group %s already exists in disk group %s
cause: The specified quota group already existed in the disk group.
action: Specify a different quota group name.

description: quota group %s does not exist in disk group %s
cause: The specified quota group did not exist in the disk group.
action: Specify a valid quota group name.

description: invalid operation on quota group %s
cause: The specified operation was not permitted on the quota group.
action: Check the quota group specified in the command.

description: insufficient quota available in quota group %s
cause: The specified quota group did not have sufficient quota available to permit the operation.
action: Specify a quota group with enough available quota or increase the quota limit of the specified quota group.

description: Quota group %s has one or more file groups associated.
cause: One or more file groups were associated with the specified quota group and, therefore, the operation was not permitted.
action: Drop the file groups or move the file groups to a different quota group.

description: VIO0 process terminated with an error
cause: A volume I/O background (VIO0) process terminated with an error.
action: No action is required since the process will restart automatically. If the issue persists, check the log files for the cause. If you need additional assistance, contact Oracle Support.

description: Internal Oracle ASM testing event number 15441
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level controls which ASM rebalance phase must be skipped.

description: The ASM rebalance phase %s does not exist.
cause: The specified ASM rebalance phase did not exist.
action: Specify a valid rebalance phase.

description: The ASM rebalance phase %s cannot be skipped.
cause: The specified ASM rebalance phase cannot be skipped.
action: Specify a valid rebalance phase to skip.

description: Volume %s must be online and mounted to complete the operation.
cause: The operation could not be completed with the volume offline or dismounted.
action: Ensure that the volume is online or mounted, and retry the operation.

description: Volume %s does not allow sector size migration.
cause: Sector size migration was not allowed because either of the following existed in the disk group: * Oracle ACFS accelerator volumes, or * Volumes associated with an Oracle ACFS accelerator, or * Non-Oracle ACFS volumes
action: Move the volume to a different disk group, and retry the operation.

description: Internal ASM testing event number 15446
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level is used as a count for maximum hardcheck errors before aborting the rebalance.

description: Internal Oracle ASM testing event number 15447
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level is used as the maximum error count for ORA-59331 before aborting the rebalance. ORA-59331 is hit when resource fetching time is too long for extent relocation. 15448 available

description: volume creation on a sparse disk group is not supported
cause: Volume creation failed because a sparse disk group is specified.
action: Specify a different disk group that is not sparse.

description: invalid volume name specifier
cause: The volume name specified was invalid
action: Specify a valid volume name.

description: missing or invalid volume size specifier
cause: The volume size specified was invalid.
action: Specify a valid volume size.

description: missing or invalid stripe width specifier
cause: The volume stripe width specified was invalid.
action: Specify a valid volume stripe width.

description: invalid STRIPE_COLUMNS specifier
cause: An ADD VOLUME command did not specify a valid number of stripe columns.
action: Specify a valid number of stripe columns.

description: ALTER DISKGROUP ALL cannot use single volume names
cause: An ALTER DISKGROUP ALL command specified a single volume or a list of volumes
action: Use the ALL keyword when specifying volumes on multiple diskgroups.

description: FORCE option cannot be used when specifying ALL volumes
cause: The FORCE option was used to disable ALL volumes.
action: Use FORCE option to disable one volume at a time.

description: missing or invalid volume usage specifier
cause: The command did not specify a valid volume usage string.
action: Specify a valid volume usage string with alphanumeric characters.

description: first letter of the volume name is not an alphabet
cause: The first letter of the volume name was not an alphabetic character.
action: Specify an alphabetic character as the first letter of the volume name.

description: invalid character '%s' in volume name
cause: A volume name was specified with an invalid character.
action: Use a volume name with alphanumeric characters only.
params: 1) character: The invalid character in the volume name.

description: STRIPE_WIDTH of %s is not a power of two.
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was not a power of two.
action: Select a STRIPE_WIDTH that is a power of two; for example, 4K and 8K.

description: volume name '%s' is already in use
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume name that was already used by another volume.
action: Select a different name for the volume.

description: STRIPE_WIDTH of %s bytes is less than the minimum of %s bytes.
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was too small.
action: Select a larger STRIPE_WIDTH value and retry the operation.

description: STRIPE_WIDTH of %s bytes is greater than the maximum of %s bytes
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_WIDTH that was too large.
action: Specify a smaller STRIPE_WIDTH.

description: volume size of %sK is less than the minimum of %sM
cause: The volume size specified was too small.
action: Specify a larger volume size.

description: STRIPE_COLUMNS of %s is greater than the maximum of %s
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_COLUMNS that was too large.
action: Specify a smaller STRIPE_COLUMNS value.

description: STRIPE_COLUMNS of %s is less than the minimum of %s
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a STRIPE_COLUMNS value that was too small.
action: Specify a larger value for STRIPE_COLUMNS.

description: volume '%s' in disk group '%s' does not exist
cause: The command specified a volume name that did not exist.
action: Ensure that a valid volume name is used.

description: volume operation is already in progress
cause: Another command was currently operating on a volume.
action: Retry the command after a short time.

description: Volume %s in disk group %s is currently being accessed.
cause: An attempt was made to change a volume that was being accessed by another application and therefore could not be changed.
action: Shut down all applications that might be accessing this volume and then retry the command.

description: VBG process terminated with error.
cause: A volume background (VBG) process terminated with an error.
action: VBG process %s terminated. The process will try to automatically restart.

description: VDBG process terminated with error
cause: The volume driver background (VDBG) process terminated with an error.
action: Warm start the instance.

description: volume redundancy incompatible with disk group redundancy
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume redundancy that was incompatible with the redundancy of the disk group.
action: Specify a valid volume redundancy. The following restrictions apply: - An unprotected redundancy volume cannot be added to a normal or high redundancy disk group. - A mirror or high redundancy volume cannot be added to an external redundancy disk group. - A mirror volume cannot be added to a high redundancy disk group.

description: Volume library cannot be loaded. Platform may not support volume creation.
cause: The volume library could not be loaded. The possible causes are: - The platform does not support volume operations. - There is a problem with the library.
action: Ensure that the platform supports volumes. If the platform does support volumes, then check the alert log for library loading failure information.

description: failure to access a volume's storage using an unsupported command
cause: An attempt was made to access or modify a volume's storage through an unsupported SQL or ASMCMD command.
action: Use supported commands to access volume devices.

description: The volume name is greater than %s characters.
cause: An ADD VOLUME command specified a volume name that was too long.
action: Enter a smaller volume name.

description: USAGESTRING is greater than %s characters
cause: The optional attribute --USAGESTRING specified while updating Oracle ADVM attributes was too long.
action: Select a smaller value for the --USAGESTRING attribute and retry the operation.

description: Oracle ACFS volumes must be resized with the 'acfsutil size' operating system command.
cause: An attempt was made to resize an Oracle ASM Dynamic Volume Manager (Oracle ADVM) volume that contained an Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) file system using SQL statements.
action: Use the 'acfsutil size' operating system command to resize the volume.

description: cannot communicate with the volume driver
cause: An attempt was made to communicate with the volume driver.
action: Verify if the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM) volume driver is loaded. If the Oracle ASM volume driver is loaded, then check the alert log to identify the reason for failure and perform the necessary action to prevent such failures in the future.

description: The Oracle ACFS background process terminated with an error.
cause: The Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) background process terminated with an error.
action: Wait for process restart. If the error persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group does not support volumes.
cause: Volumes were not supported. A typical example was having disks, such as Network File System (NFS) in the disk group that was not supported by volumes.
action: Remove unsupported disks in the disk group.

description: Error reported by the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM) volume driver.
cause: An error was reported by the Oracle ASM volume driver.
action: Check the operating system log files to identify the reason for the error. Perform the action or actions to prevent future errors.

description: missing or invalid volume mountpath specifier
cause: A invalid volume mountpath string was specified.
action: Specify a valid volume mountpath string with alphanumeric characters.

description: failed to create or remove device file for volume %s on diskgroup %s
cause: The driver was improperly installed.
action: Check the alert log for information on the failure of device file creation. Reload the driver using the supported installation method.

description: volume driver version is not compatible with the Oracle ASM instance
cause: The version of the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) volume driver was not supported by Oracle ASM.
action: Ensure that the volume driver version is compatible with the Oracle ASM instance. In case of a downgrade, make sure Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) is properly downgraded (see note 1634684.1).

description: volume '%s' contains %s error(s)
cause: Errors were returned by the ALTER DISKGROUP CHECK VOLUME command.
action: See the alert log for details of the errors.

description: Number of volumes in the disk group exceeds the maximum of %s.
cause: A volume was added on a disk group that already contained the maximum number allowed.
action: Remove one or more volumes from the disk group.
params: 1) number_of_volumes: The maximum number of volumes allowed per disk group.

description: internal error while altering volume
cause: An internal Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) error occurred while altering a volume.
action: See the alert log for details of the error.

description: cannot shutdown the ASM instance with an open ASM volume
cause: One or more ASM volumes were found to be open during shutdown.
action: Close the ASM volume and retry the shutdown.

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (ASM) volume %s is open on node %s.
cause: The ASM volume was not closed prior to instance termination on the specified node.
action: Close the ASM volume either via unmount or node restart and retry.

description: conflicting volume already open on this node
cause: An Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) volume was not closed prior to an instance shutdown on the specified node. There was a conflict with the volume that was to be enabled.
action: Close the Oracle ASM volume either using UNMOUNT or node restart and retry the operation.

description: not all instances could add or drop the volume
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) volume could not be added or dropped on all instances.
action: See the alert log for the reason the volume could not be added or dropped.

description: volume redundancy conflicts with disk region options
cause: Non-mirrored volumes erroneously contained the MIRRORHOT or MIRRORCOLD keyword.
action: Remove the MIRRORHOT or MIRRORCOLD keywords from non-mirrored volumes.

description: command or option incompatible with ASM volumes
cause: An attempt was made to use a feature which is not compatible with existing ASM volumes. A common example is adding a disk to the diskgroup that is unsupported by ASM volumes.
action: Omit the option from the command.

description: target ADVM compatibility (%s) exceeds ASM compatibility (%s)
cause: An attempt was made to advance the Advanced Dynamic Volume Manager (ADVM) compatibility beyond the disk group's Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) compatibility.
action: Make sure the requested Advanced Dynamic Volume Manager (ADVM) value for compatibility is never higher than the Oracle ASM compatibility setting.

description: compatible.advm must be %s or higher
cause: An attempt was made to set the Oracle ASM Dynamic Volume Manager (Oracle ADVM) compatibility to a version that was lower than the minimum supported version.
action: Set Oracle ADVM compatibility to at least the minimum supported version.

description: ASM operation requires compatible.advm of %s or higher
cause: The ASM operation specified required a higher disk group attribute value for compatible.advm.
action: Set the disk group attribute compatible.advm to or above the requested version.

description: volume size is greater than the maximum of %sT
cause: The volume size specified was too large.
action: Specify a smaller volume size and retry the operation.

description: Volume %s uses a metadata block size (%s) smaller than the specified sector size (%s).
cause: The Oracle Advanced Cluster File System (Oracle ACFS) volume had a metadata block size that was incompatible with the specified sector size.
action: Migrate Oracle ACFS to a larger metadata block size before changing the sector size.

description: Volume name %s collides with existing volume(s) %s %s.
cause: The operation attempted to create a block device and a raw device with the volume name <vol_name>-<dg_num>, which conflicted with an existing volume name.
action: Choose another name for the volume (no leading 'r' is recommended).

description: VMB process terminated with error
cause: The volume membership (VMB) process terminated with an error.
action: Warm start the instance.

description: Reserved for Workload Capture and Replay tracing
cause: NA
action: NA

description: cannot start workload capture on instance %s
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to start the workload capture.
action: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

description: cannot stop workload capture on instance %s
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to stop the workload capture.
action: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

description: cannot startup instance when procedures in "DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE" or "DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY" are in the middle of their execution
cause: The new instance could not be started because the database was executing a procedure in either the DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE or DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY package.
action: Start the new instance after such procedures in the given packages have finished execution.

description: cannot start workload capture because instance %s not present in RESTRICTED SESSION mode
cause: The NO_RESTART_MODE option in DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE.START_CAPTURE was FALSE, therefore all the active instances were expected to be in the RESTRICTED SESSION mode.
action: Start all instances using STARTUP RESTRICT or execute ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RESTRICTED SESSION on all active instances before issuing DBMS_WORKLOAD_CAPTURE.START_CAPTURE.

description: cannot start workload capture because instance %s encountered errors while accessing directory "%s"
cause: Given instance could not access the specified CAPTURE directory or the specified CAPTURE directory already had a workload capture in it.
action: Provide a directory object that is valid, empty and accessible from all the instances in the database cluster.

description: cannot prepare instance %s for replay
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to prepare for a workload replay.
action: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

description: cannot start workload replay on instance %s
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to start a workload replay.
action: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

description: cannot cancel workload replay on instance %s
cause: Given instance encountered unexpected errors while trying to cancel a workload replay.
action: Check the alert log and other diagnostics in the given instance to diagnose the problem.

description: workload replay has been cancelled
cause: Workload replay was cancelled.
action: Restart the workload replay.

description: cannot perform operation when "STATISTICS_LEVEL" is "BASIC"
cause: The STATISTICS_LEVEL initialization parameter was set to BASIC.
action: Change the STATISTICS_LEVEL initialization parameter setting to either TYPICAL or ALL.

description: cannot process workload capture because no user sessions were recorded
cause: No user sessions were recorded in the given workload capture. Processing this capture failed because no user workload was captured.
action: Capture a workload in which at least one user session connects and performs some operations.

description: directory "%s" does not contain a valid processed workload capture
cause: One or more files created by DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE were missing.
action: Process the workload capture using DBMS_WORKLOAD_REPLAY.PROCESS_CAPTURE and then retry the command.

description: cannot access the input directory
cause: Given input directory is either invalid or inaccessible.
action: Verify that the input directory is valid and accessible and then retry the command.

description: cannot find a match for the remote procedure call during replay
cause: The corresponding PL/SQL program was either dropped or modified.
action: Verify that the corresponding PL/SQL program is defined the same way during replay as it was defined during workload capture.

description: error while replaying remote procedure call: "%s.%s.%s"
cause: Error encountered during the replay of a remote procedure call.
action: Correct the cause of the preceding error and restart workload replay.

description: Parallel preprocessing worker encountered ORA-%s error.
cause: One of the parallel preprocessing workers ended unexpectedly while processing the workload.
action: Find the root cause or preprocess the workload using a single process.

description: Cannot start parallel preprocessing worker.
cause: One of the parallel preprocessing workers could not be started.
action: Find the root cause or preprocess the workload using only a single process.

description: Parallel preprocessing encountered an error.
cause: An error occurred during parallel preprocessing.
action: Find the root cause or preprocess the workload using a single process.

description: cannot access database link "%s" because it is disabled
cause: For security considerations, access to external databases via database links were disabled during workload replay.
action: Use advanced parameter for Database Replay to enable database links during workload replay.

description: Directory is corrupted. Two WMD files are found at "%s" and "%s"
cause: Two WMD files were found in the directory.
action: Check that the WMD files in capture directory were not modified, moved, duplicated or deleted.

description: file creation failed for "%s" during workload processing
cause: Attempted to create a file during workload processing. The directory does not have the proper permissions.
action: Correct the file permissions and retry.

description: failed to generate a workload capture subset: "%s"
