cause: A FACT ROWS clause was specified for an analytic view with at least one dense dimension.
action: Remove the FACT ROWS clause or change the dimension to be sparse.

description: data manipulation operation not allowed on a hierarchy or analytic view
cause: An attempt is being made to use an UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE or MERGE statement on a hierarchy or analytic view.
action: UPDATE, INSERT, DELETE or MERGE are not allowed on a hierarchy or analytic view.

description: Failed analytic view group by transform
cause: An analytic view group by transform has failed and flag to show error during transform process is set to TRUE.
action: Check the analytic view logs for the reason of the failure and correct, or set the flag to show errors during transform process to FALSE.

description: Snowflake table key (%s) with value (%s) cannot be found in joining table using join path ("%s").
cause: There was a row in a snow flake table with a key column value that was not in the corresponding joining table key column.
action: Ensure that each snow flake key column value has a corresponding row in the table key column that you are trying to join.

description: Many-to-many join caused by key (%s) with value (%s) using join path ("%s").
cause: There was a key value in the snow flake table that was causing a many-to-many relation between two tables.
action: Ensure that for a given one-to-many relation the values of the keys are unique.

description: Analytic view key (%0!s) with value (%1!s) for measure %2!s contains numeric data which cannot be used with COUNT DISTINCT operator.
cause: There was non-integer numeric data or numeric data that is out of a valid range for a measure with the COUNT DISTINCT aggregation method
action: Either correct the data in the fact table column so that all rows are integers and are in a valid range, or change the COUNT DISTINCT aggregation method.

description: Leaf level key attributes (%0!s) with values (%1!s) are not unique in the star table for dimension %2!s.
cause: There was a non unique key column value in the dimension star table for the MANY TO MANY join relationship.
action: Ensure that each dimension star table key column value is unique for MANY TO MANY join relationships.

description: operation not supported in the middle of a transaction
cause: The call was made in the middle of a transaction.
action: Commit or rollback the transaction.

description: operation not supported when flashback enabled
cause: The call was made while flashback was enabled.
action: Disable flashback.

description: extra row for keys (%s) with values (%s) in aggregation table (%s)
cause: An aggregation table key value did not match the source data.
action: Ensure that the aggregation table rows match the source data.

description: missing row for keys (%s) with values (%s) in aggregation table (%s)
cause: An aggregation table key value did not match the source data.
action: Ensure that the aggregation table rows match the source data.

description: invalid action column value for keys (%s) with values (%s) in change tracking table (%s)
cause: A change tracking table key value did not have a valid value for the action column.
action: Ensure that all action column values in the change tracking table are either I or D.

description: invalid row for keys (%s) with values (%s) in change tracking table (%s)
cause: A change tracking table key value row was invalid because it had an I action row that did not match a row in the fact table or a D action row in the change tracking table.
action: Ensure that all I action change tracking table rows have a corresponding row in the fact table or a corresponding D action change tracking row.

description: unable to create object %s of type %s
cause: An object cannot be created.
action: Verify the specified arguments and retry the operation.

description: unable to query max depth of value hierarchy
cause: A query to get max depth of value hierarchy has failed.
action: Verify the specified arguments and retry the operation.

description: the data in %s does not represent a value hierarchy
cause: The computed max depth is insufficient for creating a value hierarchy.
action: Modify the table used for hierarchy creation and retry the operation.

description: table has missing or invalid column "%s"
cause: The table had a missing or invalid column.
action: Ensure that the table has the correct columns.

description: The query transform cannot be enabled because there is more than one source for the analytic view dimension "%s".
cause: An attempt was made to enable query transform on a snowflake schema.
action: Limit the number of sources to one for analytic view dimensions when enabling an analytic view for query transform.

description: cannot enable query transform because fact source is joined to distinct members of analytic view dimension "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to enable query transform with a REFERENCES DISTINCT clause in which the fact and dimension tables did not match.
action: Match the source of the dimension to the source of the fact when enabling an analytic view for query transform.

description: Cannot enable query transform because NORELY was specified and a remote source was detected on "%s" in the analytic view.
cause: An attempt was made to enable query transform NORELY with a remote source.
action: Specify RELY or do not use remote sources when enabling an analytic view for query transform.

description: invalid measure in filter fact clause
cause: A base measure that was built over an expression that was not a single column was used in the filter fact clause of the derived analytic view.
action: Ensure that the base measures used in the derived analytic view filter fact clause have a single column expression.

description: invalid analytic view dimension "%s"
cause: The specified analytic view dimension did not exist in the base analytic view.
action: Ensure that the specified analytic view dimension exists in the base analytic view.

description: invalid numeric value (%s) in the calculated measure expression
cause: The specified numeric value in the calculated measure expression was invalid.
action: Ensure that the numeric value in the calculated measure expression is valid.

description: invalid use of bind variable "%s" in the analytic view query
cause: A bind variable with the same name but different value was used in a clause of the query-scoped analytic view.
action: Rename the bind variable so that all of the names are unique.

description: The query transform cannot be enabled because there is a duplicate join path for the analytic view dimension "%s" to columns (%s) in source %s.
cause: Two analytic view dimensions cannot have the same join path if query transform is enabled.
action: Ensure all analytic view dimension join paths are unique when query transform is enabled.

description: The join attributes (%s) in the REFERENCES clause and the leaf level of every hierarchy are not determined by a non-null level of the analytic view dimension "%s"
cause: There must be a non-null level that determines all the attributes in the join condition and the lowest level of each hierarchy.
action: Ensure that there is a non-null level that determines all the attributes in the join condition and the lowest level of each hierarchy or change the join relatinship to MANY TO ONE.

description: There are no columns in the FILTER FACT condition for the specified hierarchy "%s".
cause: There are no columns in the FILTER FACT condition for the specified hierarchy.
action: Remove the redundant hierarchy from the FILTER FACT clause.

description: Cannot use enforced constraints on cache when dependent objects have a VPD or redaction policy enabled
cause: An attempt is being made to use enforced constraints on cache when dependent objects of the cache have an Oracle Virtual Private Database (VPD) or redaction policy enabled.
action: Either change the cache to use trusted constraints, or remove the aggregation table, or remove or disable the VPD or redaction policy.

description: The attribute value (%s) for added dimension row "%s" cannot be implicitly converted to data type "%s" for attribute "%s".
cause: The attribute values for a dimension row do not have a data type that can be implicitly converted to the data type of the corresponding attribute.
action: Ensure that each attribute value in each added row has a data type that can be implicitly converted to the data type of the corresponding attribute.

description: The query transform cannot be enabled because there are added rows for the analytic view dimension "%s".
cause: An attempt is being made to enable query transform with an analytic view dimension with added rows.
action: Ensure that there are no added rows on any analytic view dimensions when enabling for query transform.

description: Materialized cache is not allowed on an attribute dimension with added rows.
cause: An attempt is being made to create an object that has both materialized cache type without an aggregation table and added rows.
action: Either change the cache type from materialized or add an aggregation table or remove the added rows from the attribute dimension.

description: AGGREGATE INTO cannot be specified on the analytic view fact-based dimension "%s".
cause: An analytic view dimension cannot be a fact-based dimension and have an AGGREGATE INTO clause.
action: Remove the AGGREGATE INTO clause from the fact-based dimension.

description: The attribute %s referenced in the base measure "%s" must be determined by the JOIN level "%s".
cause: The specified attribute is not determined by the analytic view (AV) JOIN level. Therefore, there is no value to use for the aggregation.
action: Remove the invalid attribute reference or modify the DDL so that the attribute is determined by the JOIN level.

description: analytic view auto caching is not enabled.
cause: Analytic View (AV) autonomous caching initialization parameter was not set.
action: Enable AV autonomous caching using the appropriate initialization parameter.

description: One or more editioned attribute dimension, hierarchy, or analytic view objects exist that cannot be downgraded.
cause: There were editioned attribute dimension, hierarchy, or analytic view objects that are not supported in the selected release for downgrade.
action: Prior to downgrade, drop the editioned attribute dimension, hierarchy, or analytic view objects that cannot be downgraded to the selected release.

description: An analytic view dimension may not be specified as dense when the cache clause has been included.
cause: A dimension has been specified as dense and the cache clause has been included.
action: Mark all dimensions as sparse or remove the cache clause.

description: Either all or none of the analytic view caches are required to have a change tracking table.
cause: Either all or none of the analytic view caches were required to have a change tracking table.
action: Ensure that either all or none of the analytic view caches have a change tracking table.

description: analytic view which uses a change tracking table cannot have a cube source column named "ACTION$"
cause: An analytic view with a change tracking table could not have a cube source column named action$.
action: Rename the cube source column name or remove the change tracking table.

description: analytic view which uses a change tracking table has a measure "%s" based on an expression that is not a single column
cause: An analytic view with a change tracking table could not have a non column expression measure.
action: Either remove the non column measure from the cache or remove the change tracking table.

description: Analytic view with a change tracking table has a measure "%s" with an invalid aggregation operator "%s".
cause: An analytic view with a change tracking table used an invalid aggregation operator.
action: Either change the aggregation operator or remove the change tracking table.

description: DISTINCT cannot be specified on analytic view dimension "%s" with a MANY TO MANY join relationship
cause: An analytic view dimension cannot be both DISTINCT and MANY TO MANY join relationship.
action: Either remove the DISTINCT reference or change to not be a MANY TO MANY join relationship.

description: illegal reference of a query name in analytic view USING clause
cause: The derived anaytic view specified in the USING clause is not valid.
action: Change the USING clause with a valid analytic view query.

description: Invalid expression (%s) specified as an attribute value on attribute dimension row "%s"
cause: An invalid attribute dimension row attribute expression is detected.
action: Ensure that the attribute dimension row attribute expression is a constant expression.

description: no foreign key constraints
cause: Foreign key constraints are not specified.
action: Specify foreign key constraints.

description: date format missing one or more required elements
cause: The specified date format is missing one or more required elements.
action: Modify the date format to include all required elements.

description: date format includes one or more prohibited elements
cause: The specified date format includes one or more prohibited elements.
action: Modify the date format to remove all prohibited elements.

description: fiscal year start day is greater than 28
cause: The specified fiscal start day is greater than 28.
action: Modify the fiscal year start to a day less than or equal to 28.

description: invalid value '%s' for is_restated parameter
cause: The specified is_restated parameter value is invalid.
action: Modify the is_restated value to be 'RESTATED' or 'NOT RESTATED'.
params: 1) is_restated: The is_restated value passed to the function

description: day is not in the restated retail calendar
cause: The day falls within the week not represented in the restated retail calendar.
action: Use the retail_day_exists function to filter out the row or use a NOT RESTATED retail calendar.

description: invalid value '%s' for index_by parameter
cause: The specified index_by parameter value is invalid.
action: Modify the index_by value to be 'POSITION' or 'DATE'.
params: 1) index_by: The index_by value passed to the function

description: invalid value '%s' for format parameter
cause: The specified format parameter value is invalid.
action: Modify the format value to be 'LONG' or 'SHORT'.
params: 1) format: The format value passed to the function

description: calendar '%s' not supported by this function
cause: The specified calendar is not supported by the function.
action: Change the NLS_CALENDAR parameter to a supported calendar.
params: 1) calendar: The NLS_CALENDAR either from user environment or passed to the function

description: 'YYYY' format may not be used with negative year
cause: The YYYY format is specified and the input year is negative.
action: Restrict input to positive years or use SYYYY format.

description: FILTER clause on aggregate function must use NULL ON NULL clause
cause: The specified aggregate function must have the NULL ON NULL clause in order to support the FILTER clause.
action: Specify the NULL ON NULL clause for this aggregate function, or remove the FILTER clause and write an equivalent query using WHERE.

description: aggregation FILTER clause not allowed here
cause: The aggregation FILTER clause is not allowed at this point in the statement.
action: Remove or relocate the aggregation FILTER clause and try again.

description: missing RELATIONAL keyword
cause: The keyword RELATIONAL in the work OBJECT RELATIONAL is missing in the XMLTYPE storage clause specification.
action: Supply the RELATIONAL keyword in the storage clause

description: invalid storage option %s specified
cause: An invalid storage option was specified for the OPAQUE type.
action: Provide a valid storage option in the storage clause such as CLOB, BINARY XML, or TRANSPORTABLE BINARY XML in case of XMLType.
params: 1) storage_option_name: The invalid storage option provided in the DDL.

description: XML Schema URL is missing in the storage option.
cause: An XML Schema URL was not specified in the storage option.
action: Specify an XML Schema URL for the storage option.

description: XML schema is missing XML root element name.
cause: An XML schema was encountered that does not have a root element.
action: Specify a root element in the XML schema.

description: Duplicate XMLType OBJECT RELATIONAL storage option
cause: A duplicate storage option for the XMLType column was specified
action: Specify a single storage option for an XMLType column

description: duplicate XMLType storage option specified
cause: A duplicate storage option for the XMLType column was specified.
action: Specify a single storage option for an XMLType column.

description: TYPE option is not appropriate for the storage option of XMLTYPE column.
cause: Attempted to use the TYPE option outside the OBJECT RELATIONAL XML storage option.
action: Remove the TYPE option or specify an OBJECT RELATIONAL storage for the XMLTYPE column.

description: Schema %s does not match expected schema %s.
cause: The specified XML document did not conform to the specified XML schema.
action: INSERT/UPDATE XML documents which conform to the XML schema.

description: invalid version of XMLTYPE instance
cause: An invalid version of XMLTYPE instance was found.
action: This is possibly due to data corruption, an internal error, or running an older client against a newer version of the database. Ensure that the version of the client can understand the XMLTYPE instance in the database. Contact Oracle Support Services if the error persists.

description: Missing XMLSchema keyword
cause: The XMLSchema keyword is missing
action: Specify the XMLSchema URL and element name.

description: cannot insert XML fragments
cause: An XML fragment could not be inserted because it was not a well-formed XML document.
action: Convert the XML fragment into a single well-formed XML document before insertion.

description: Character string buffer is too small.
cause: The requested string result is too big to return.
action: Get the result as CLOB or reduce the length of the result.

description: Cannot convert XML fragment to the required data type.
cause: A conversion to a datatype was requested but cannot be performed.
action: The XMLType may contain fragments and other elements that cannot be converted to the appropriate data type.

description: cannot create VARRAY columns containing XMLType
cause: An attempt was made to create a VARRAY column that contained an XMLType.
action: Do not store VARRAY columns containing XMLTypes in tables. Use nested tables instead.

description: Invalid XML tag identifier (%s)
cause: An invalid XML identifer was detected during XML generation
action: Fix the offending tag to not contain characters or symbols that are not allowed by the XML specification

description: Attributes cannot occur after element specifications.
cause: Attributes specified using the "@" identifier can only occur before any other element definition when creating XML.
action: Change the order of the types so that the attributes occur in the beginning.

description: Attributes can only be simple scalars
cause: Attribute values can only be simple scalar values
action: Use only simple datatypes for attribute values

description: Invalid character in XML tag '%s'
cause: A tag name was found to have an invalid XML character during XML generation.
action: Rewrite the query so that the generated XML tag, corresponding to a column name or alias, contains only valid characters.

description: Invalid context passed to DBMS_XMLGEN.GETXML().
cause: The context value passed to GETXML() was invalid.
action: Pass a valid value to GETXML().

description: invalid dereference of XMLType columns
cause: An attempt was made to dereference the attributes of an XMLType column which is not part of a base table
action: You can only dereference the attributes of a base table XMLType column

description: general event for XML operations
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code.
action: This is an Oracle internal event code.

description: unoptimized XML construct detected
cause: The XMLOptimizationCheck variable was enabled and an unrewritten XML construct was detected. This prevents the execution of the XML construct.
action: Ensure that the XML construct is being optimized. See the trace file for further information. Disable the XMLOptimizationCheck variable if you want the unoptimized XML operation to be executed.

description: The first argument to UPDATEXML operator has to be an XMLTYPE
cause: The first argument passed to the update value operator was not an XMLTYPE.
action: Rewrite the query so that the first argument to the UPDATEXML operator is XMLTYPE.

description: Cursor expression must be named.
cause: The value of context passed to GETXML was invalid.
action: Rewrite the query so that the value of context passed to GETXML is valid.

description: EXTRACTVALUE cannot extract values of multiple nodes
cause: The specified XPATH expression pointed to more than one node.
action: Correct the XPATH expression so that it points to exactly one node.

description: EXTRACTVALUE can only retrieve value of leaf node
cause: Given XPath does not point to a leaf node.
action: Rewrite the query so that a leaf node is returned.

description: event for suppressing query rewrite with XML operators
cause: This event turns off query rewrite for XML operators.
action: This is an Oracle internal event code.

description: invalid abstract data type parameter in XMLType.toObject() function call
cause: The object passed as abstract data type parameter to the XMLType.toObject() function was not of the same type, or a super-type, of the mapped type.
action: Pass an object of the correct type to the XMLType.toObject() function.

description: Cannot convert the given XMLType to the required type
cause: The passed in XMLType could not be convert to the required type
action: Binary XMLtype instances or other objects cannot be converted to the required object or collection types.

description: Method invalid for non-schema based XML Documents.
cause: The method can be invoked on only schema based xmltype objects.
action: Don't invoke the method for non schema based xmltype objects.

description: XML element or attribute %s does not match type %s.%s.
cause: The given XML tag did not match the given type.
action: Pass a valid canonical XML compatible with the given type.

description: expected XML tag not present
cause: During a conversion attempt of XML to an object, there was an invalid tag name present.
action: Pass a valid canonical XML that can map to the given object type.

description: schema mismatch: schema specified in the XML document does not match the schema parameter
cause: When creating schema-based XML, the schema specified in the XML document was different from the schema that was passed in the 'schema' parameter.
action: Change the schema parameter to match the schema specified in the XML document.

description: Type is not supported during schema generation.
cause: The object contained an unsupported type for schema generation.
action: Use a different type to generate the schema.

description: Invalid items are selected in the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy().
cause: The query should only select a number followed by an XMLType.
action: Ensure that the result set of the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy() has only two selected items: the first must be a number and the second must be an XMLType.

description: invalid query result set in newContextFromHierarchy()
cause: The result set of the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy() did not have the same property as the result set generated by a CONNECT BY query.
action: Ensure that the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy() is a CONNECT BY query or that the query returns a result set having the same property as the result set generated by a CONNECT BY query.

description: XMLType result cannot be a fragment.
cause: An XML fragment was selected in the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy().
action: Ensure that the query passed to newContextFromHierarchy() does not result in an XML fragment.

description: invalid operations on query context
cause: SetMaxRows, SetSkipRows, or SetRowTagName were applied on a query context created from newContextFromHierarchy().
action: Do not apply SetMaxRows, SetSkipRows, or SetRowTagName on a query context created from newContextFromHierarchy().

description: Keyword %s reserved for future use.
cause: The keyword is reserved for future use as a built-in function.
action: Change the name to a different one and retry.

description: Element %s does not match expected %s.
cause: The given XML document had a different root element than expected.
action: Insert/Update only the XML documents that conform to that particular schema and element.

description: XML comments cannot contain two consecutive hyphens.
cause: An XML comment contained two consecutive hyphens.
action: Eliminate the consecutive hyphens in the XML data.

description: Enclosing tag %s cannot be 'XML'.
cause: The specified enclosing tag matched 'XML' in some case combination.
action: Modify the enclosing tag so that it is not 'XML' in any case combination.

description: Multiply nested XMLROOT function is not allowed.
cause: An XMLROOT function had an operand that was also an XMLROOT function.
action: Modify the query so that there are no multiply nested XMLROOT functions.

description: character length specified for XMLSerialize is too small.
cause: An XMLSerialize function was called with a type of character type (e.g. VARCHAR2(27)), and the length specified (27 in the example) was too small.
action: Modify the query so that the character length specified is larger.

description: character set id specified for XMLSerialize not valid
cause: An XMLSerialize function was called with an invalid value for the caracter set id.
action: Modify the query so that the character set id is valid.

description: Out-of-line tables cannot be shared by two top-level tables (table "%s"."%s" and the current table being created).
cause: An attempt was made to share an out-of-line table between two top-level tables.
action: Use the existing top-level XML table.

description: cannot specify storage for individual varrays if STORE ALL VARRAYS is used
cause: An attempt was made to combine storage specification for particular varrays with the STORE ALL VARRAYS clause.
action: Either specify storage for individual varrays or use the STORE ALL VARRAYS clause.

description: cannot specify VARRAY storage in tableProps
cause: An attempt was made to store all VARRAYs as tables or LOBs in tableProps.
action: Do not specify VARRAY store as tables or LOBs in tableProps.

description: This event disables fast path inserts for XMLType tables.
cause: The flag to disable fast path inserts for XMLType tables was set.
action: No additional action is needed.

description: Event to add an ORDER BY clause ordering by array index when querying object collections.
cause: This event adds ordering by array index when selecting from object collections.
action: None. This is an Oracle internal event.

description: Internal insert method is not working for XMLType tables.
cause: An error occurred while trying to insert into an XMLType table using a different internal insert path.
action: Set event 19049 and try again.

description: Internal event
cause: NA
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Internal event
cause: NA
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Event for Granular Token Tables
cause: NA
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: unsupported use of DISABLE XML EXCHANGE
cause: The option, DISABLE XML EXCHANGE, was specified in a CREATE TABLE statement.
action: Do not specify DISABLE XML EXCHANGE in a CREATE TABLE statement.

description: Information only: Event 19056 has been set (only allowed under Oracle Support supervision).
cause: Event 19056 was set to override restrictions on maintenance DDLs for XML tokens.
action: This event should only be set under the supervision of Oracle Support during debugging situations. Setting this event and executing DDLs on XML tokens can cause other functionality to fail.

description: internal error: BINARY XML [%s]
cause: The operation failed due to an internal error.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Enabling XML exchange for non-empty tables may cause data corruption.
cause: An attempt was made to enable XML exchange for a binary XML column or table with a conflicting binary XML column or table.
action: Use the XML exchange option only if at least one of the two involved tables is empty.

description: XML exchange has not been enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to disable XML exchange on a table that did not have XML exchange enabled.
action: Use the disable XML exchange option only if the table already has XML exchange enabled.

description: operation disallowed on XML token set object
cause: An attempt was made to perform a disallowed operation on a token set object for binary XML support.
action: Do not perform the attempted operation on an XML token set object.

description: granular token set operations detected for unsupported tables
cause: An attempt was made to perform some granular token set related operations on a non-binary XML table or on an older binary XML table.
action: Do not perform the attempted operation unless tables support granular token set options.

description: XML exchange is already enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to enable XML exchange on a table that had XML exchange already enabled.
action: Use the disable XML exchange option only if the table has XML exchange disabled.

description: Granular token table feature does not support schema-based storage.
cause: An attempt was made to use granular token tables with schema-based storage.
action: Use non-schema based storage for granular token tables.

description: Tablespace has XML token set objects used in another tablespace.
cause: The tablespace contained an XML token set object that was used by a binary XML table in a different tablespace and dropping it would cause some data to be lost.
action: Move the XML token set object to a different tablespace.

description: cannot drop tablespace with XML token set while XDB tablespace is offline
cause: The tablespace contained an XML token set object but the metadata could not be read since the XDB default tablespace was offline. By dropping the tablespace, some data may be lost.
action: Bring the XDB default tablespace online.

description: XML EXCHANGE is not enabled between the two tables.
cause: The two tables specified in the EXCHANGE had different XML token sets. By exchanging partitions, some data might get corrupted.
action: Enable XML EXCHANGE between the tables.

description: unable to create binary granular token on user default tablespace
cause: The user default tablespace was full.
action: Increase the size of the user default tablespace.

description: failed to disable XML EXCHANGE
cause: Either the table was in SYSTEM tablespace or it was partitioned and the default tablespace was SYSTEM. Granular token tables are forbidden on SYSTEM tablespace.
action: Move the table to a different tablespace or change the default tablespace if the table is partitioned.

description: cannot enable XML EXCHANGE with itself
cause: An XML EXCHANGE was performed with the same table.
action: Do not enable XML EXCHANGE with the same table.

description: cannot enable XML EXCHANGE in this type of table
cause: XML EXCHANGE was not allowed in global temporary tables or external tables.
action: Do not use a global temporary table or external table.

description: Table does not have an XMLType stored as BINARY XML.
cause: The table was not an XMLTable or did not have an XMLType column stored as BINARY XML.
action: Use an XMLType or XMLTable stored as BINARY XML.

description: Only STORE AS CLOB is supported with XMLType on the sharded table.
cause: STORE AS CLOB was not specified with XMLType on the sharded table.
action: Specify the STORE AS CLOB clause in the query.

description: unsupported column type specified for granular token set enabled table
cause: An attempt was made to add or modify a column with an unsupported type for a granular token set enabled table.
action: Do not use user-defined Abstract Data Types (ADTs) or an ANYDATA column with granular token sets.

description: Table does not have a granular token set.
cause: The table was not used with a granular token set.
action: Use an XMLType stored as BINARY XML with a granular token set.

description: Failed to move the token table indexes. Run dbms_csx_admin.RebuildTokenTablesIndexes before using the table.
cause: An attempt to move the indexes to the given tablespace failed.
action: Run dbms_csx_admin.RebuildTokenTablesIndexes.

description: cannot move the XML token set to tablespace where the table owner does not have privileges
cause: The table owner did not have privileges in the given tablespace.
action: Use a tablespace where the table owner has privileges.

description: event for remapping CSX during TTS

cause: NA

description: XQST0012 - imported schemas violate validity rules
cause: The imported schemas did not satisfy the conditions for schema validity specified in the XMLSchema specification.
action: Fix the imported schemas to satisfy the validity rules.In particular, the definitions must be valid, complete, and unique -- that is, the pool of definitions must not contain two or more schema components with the same name and target namespace.

description: XQST0013 - invalid XQuery PRAGMA content
cause: An XQuery PRAGMA was specified with invalid content.
action: Specify the PRAGMA with the valid content.

description: XQST0014 - invalid or unsupported must-understand extension
cause: The must-understand extension specified was either invalid or unsupported.
action: remove the unsupported must-understand extension or fix the error.

description: XQST0015 - unsupported must-understand extension
cause: The XQuery flagger was enabled and the query contained a must-understand extension.
action: remove the unsupported must-understand extension.

description: XQST0016 - module declaration or import not supported
cause: The given query had a module declaration or module import.
action: Remove the import module or module declaration.

description: XPST0017 - unable to resolve call to function - %s:%s
cause: The given name and the number of the function call parameters could not be matched with any in-scope function in the static context.
action: Fix the name of the function or the number of parameters to match the list of in-scope functions.

description: XPTY0018 - It is a type error if the result of the last step in a path expression contains both nodes and atomic values
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XPTY0019 - It is a type error if the result of an step (other than the last step) in a path expression contains an atomic value
cause: The step expression returned a sequence containing an atomic value.
action: Fix the path expression to return only nodes.

description: XPTY0020 - context item must be node in an axis expression
cause: The context item that was used in the axis epression is not a node.
action: Change the context item to be a node.

description: XPDY0021 - cast to type %s failed
cause: The value inside a cast expression could not be cast to the required type.
action: Fix the input to the cast expression to be of a castable type.

description: XQST0022 - namespace declaration attribute must be a literal
cause: The namespace declaration attribute was not a literal string.
action: Fix the namespace declaration to be a literal string.

description: XQTY0023 - invalid document node content in element constructor
cause: The content sequence in an element constructor contained a document node.
action: Change the content of the element constructor so that it does not contain a document node.

description: XQTY0024 - invalid attribute node in element constructor
cause: The content sequence in an element constructor contains an attribute node following a node that is not an attribute node.
action: Change the content sequence of the element constructor so that it does not contain the attribute node.

description: XQDY0025 - duplicate attribute name %s
cause: The content sequence of the element constructor contained more than one attribute that had the same name.
action: Remove the duplicate attributes.

description: validation failed - element %s not found in in-scope element declarations
cause: The validation mode was strict and the element-constructor contained an element name that was not present in the in-scope element declarations.
action: Fix the validation mode to be lax or import the schema definition that contains the required element declaration.

description: XQDY0027 - validation error
cause: An error was encountered during the validation of the expression.
action: Fix the validation error.

description: XQTY0028 - invalid node in document constructor
cause: The content sequence in a document constructor contained either a document or an attribute node.
action: Fix the content so it does not contain any of the above node types.

description: XQDY0029 - value does not match facet of the target type
cause: The input value to a cast expression did not satisfy the facets of the target type.
action: Fix the value to conform to the facets of the target type.

description: XQTY0030 - too many values to validate expression
cause: The argument of a validate expression returned more than one element or document node.
action: Fix the argument of the validate expression to return a single element or document node.

description: XQST0031 - unsupported query version
cause: The query version specified in the prolog was not supported.
action: Supply the version of the query that is supported.

description: XQST0032 - too many declarations for base URI
cause: The query prolog contained multiple declarations for the base URI.
action: Remove the duplicate definitions for the base URI.

description: XQST0033 - too many declarations for namespace prefix %s
cause: The query prolog contained multiple declarations for the same namespace prefix.
action: Remove the duplicate definitions for the namespace prefix.
params: 1) namespace_prefix: The namespace prefix that was defined multiple times.

description: XQST0034 - too many declarations for function %s
cause: The query module contained more than one function, either declared or imported, which have the same expanded QName.
action: Remove the duplicate function definitions.

description: XQST0035 - too many declarations of %s in imported schemas
cause: Two schemas were imported that defined the same name in the same symbol space and in the same scope.
action: Fix the schema imports to remove the name conflict.

description: XQST0036 - missing type definitions in imported module
cause: A module was imported, which contains references to type names that are not defined in the in-scope type definitions inside the module.
action: Fix the module definintion to include the in-scope type definition.

description: XQST0037 - function or variable %s in module already defined
cause: A module being imported contained the function or variable that is already declared in the static context of the importing module.
action: Remove the conflicting declarations.

description: XQST0038 - unsupported or duplicate default collation specified
cause: The query prolog either specified more than one default collation, or the collation specified was not supported.
action: Remove the duplicate definition or specify a supported collation.

description: XQST0039 - duplicate parameter name %s in function declaration
cause: The function declaration contained more than one parameter with the same name.
action: Fix the function declaration to remove the duplicate parameters.

description: XQST0040 - invalid namespace node in element constructor
cause: The content sequence in an element constructor contained a namespace node node following a node that was not a namespace node.
action: Remove the namespace node in the element constructor.

description: XQDY0041 - non empty URI in QName
cause: The name expression in a computed processing instruction or computed namespace constructor returned a QName whose URI part was not empty.
action: Fix the processing instruction or computed namespace constructor to return the QName with an empty URI part.

description: XQST0042 - namespace constructor not inside an element constructor
cause: The enclosing expression of a computed namespace constructor was not a computed element constructor.
action: Fix the namespace constructor to be inside an element constructor.

description: XQST0043 - duplicate namespace prefix %s
cause: Two or more computed namespace constructors within the same computed element constructor attempted to bind the same namespace prefix.
action: Remove the duplicate namespace definitions.

description: XQDY0044 - invalid namespace in attribute constructors
cause: A computed attribute constructor returned a QName that is in the pre-defined XML namespace (corresponding to namespace prefix xmlns).
action: Change the namespace for the computed attribute constructor.

description: XQST0045 - invalid or unknown prefix %s in function declaration
cause: The declared function name in a function declaration had no namespace prefix or had one of the predefined namespace prefixes other than local.
action: Fix the function declaration to have the correct prefix.

description: XQST0046 - invalid URI
cause: The given URI contained a lexical form that was not valid according to the definition of xs:anyURI in XML Schema.
action: Fix the URI.

description: module %s not found
cause: The module with the given target URI could not be found.
action: Fix the prolog to import only available modules.

description: XQST0048 - namespace %s does not match target namespace %s
cause: The module contained a function or variable whose namespace did not match the target namespace of the module.
action: Fix the namespace of the function or variable to match the target namespace of the module.

description: XQST0049 - variable %s defined multiple times
cause: The module defined or imported the same variable multiple times.
action: Fix the import or the module definition to remove duplicate definitions.

description: XPDY0050 - treat failed - expected %s got %s
cause: The type of the operand to the treat expression does not match the required type.
action: Fix the input operand to be of the correct type.
params: 1) expected_operand_type: The required operand type. 2) actual_operand_type: The input operand type.

description: XPST0051 - invalid atomic type definition
cause: The QName used as an AtomicType in a SequenceType was not defined as an atomic type in the in-scope type definitions.
action: Use the correct atomic type name.

description: XQDY0052 - invalid atomic value in attribute or element constructor
cause: The content of the element or attribute constructor included an atomic value that could not be cast into a string.
action: Fix the content to contain atomic values that can be cast to a string.

description: XQST0053 - empty string in namespace declaration
cause: An empty string was used in a namespace declaration.
action: Fix the namespace declaration to have a non-empty string.

description: XQST0054 - variable initialization failed due to circularity
cause: A circular definition was encountered when the variable was initialized.
action: Remove the circularity in the initialization.

description: XQST0055 - schema path %s not found in list of in-scope schema definitions
cause: The ElementTest specified a schema path that could not be found in the list of in-scope schema definitions.
action: Include the appropriate schema that can be used to resolve the ElementTest.

description: XPST0005 - XPATH step specified an invalid element/attribute name: (%s).
cause: The XPATH step specified an invalid element or attribute name that did not match any nodes according to the input XML schema or structure.
action: Correct the element or attribute name, because the name may have been misspelled.

description: XPST0005 - XPath step specifies an item type without matching node: (%s)
cause: The XPath step specified an item type that did not match any nodes according to the input XML schema or structure.
action: Correct the item type definition because the node of such type does not exist in the input XML schema or structure.
params: 1) xpath_step: The XPath used to match the desired nodes.

description: Invalid value: (%s) for type: (%s)
cause: The value was invalid for the type.
action: Correct the value or change the type.

description: XPTY0004 - XQuery dynamic type mismatch: expected singleton sequence - received multi-item sequence
cause: The XQuery sequence passed in has more than one item.
action: Correct the XQuery expression to return a single item sequence.

description: XQuery dynamic type mismatch: expected atomic value - got node
cause: A node was passed in to the expression where an atomic value was expected.
action: Correct the XQuery expression to return an atomic value.

description: XQST0055 - It is a static error if a Prolog contains more than one copy-namespaces declaration
cause: The query prolog contained multiple copy-namespaces declarations.
action: Remove the duplicate copy-namespaces declarations.

description: XQST0068 - It is a static error if query prolog contains more than one XMLSPACE declaration.
cause: The query prolog contained multiple XMLSPACE declarations.
action: Remove the duplicate XMLSPACE declarations.

description: XQST0031 - It is a static error if the version number specified in a version declaration is not supported by the implementation.
cause: The query contained a version declaration that is not supported by this implementation.
action: Change the version declaration to 1.0, which is the version supported by this implementation.

description: Encoding specification in version declaration is not supported.
cause: The version declaration contained an encoding specification.
action: Remove the encoding specification from the version declaration.

description: FODC0002 - error retrieving resource
cause: The URI provided could not be resolved to a valid resource.
action: Provide a valid URI for a resource.

description: XPST0017 - unable to resolve call to function - %s
cause: The name and arity of the specified function call cannot be matched with any in-scope function in the static context.
action: Fix the name of the function or the number of parameters to match the list of in-scope functions.
params: 1) function_name: The name of the unmatched called function.

description: XPST0017 - invalid number of arguments to function - %s:%s
cause: The name and arity of the function call given could not be matched with any in-scope function in the static context.
action: Fix the name of the function or the number of parameters to match the list of in-scope functions.

description: XPST0017 - invalid number of arguments to function - %s
cause: The name and arity of the function call given could not be matched with any in-scope function in the static context.
action: Fix the name of the function or the number of parameters to match the list of in-scope functions.

description: XQST0034 - function %s:%s declared or defined multiple times
cause: Multiple functions declared or imported by a module had the same expanded QName and the same number of arguments.
action: Fix the function declaraction or definition to remove duplicates.

description: XQST0069 - more than one empty order declaration declared in the prolog
cause: A prolog had more than one empty order declaration.
action: Fix the prolog to have just one empty order declaration.

description: XPST0081 - specified QName cannot be expanded into a namespace URI
cause: The namespace prefix of the QName could not be expanded into a namespace URI by using the statically known namespaces.
action: Use a namespace prefix that can be resolved into a namespace URI from the statically known namespaces.

description: XQST0057: It is a static error if a schema import binds a namespace prefix but does not specify a target namespace other than a zero-length string
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQST0058: It is a static error if multiple schema imports specify the same target namespace
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQST0059: It is a static error if an implementation is unable to process a schema or module import by finding a schema or module with the specified target namespace
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQST0060: It is a static error if the name of a function in a function declaration is not in a namespace (expanded QName has a null namespace URI)
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQDY0061: It is a dynamic error if the operand of a validate expression is a document node whose children do not consist of exactly one element node and zero or more comment and processing instruction nodes, in any order
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQDY0064: It is a dynamic error if the value of the name expression in a computed processing instruction constructor is equal to "XML" (in any combination of upper and lower case
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQST0065: A static error is raised if a Prolog contains more than one ordering mode declaration
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: XQST0066: A static error is raised if a Prolog contains more than one default element/type namespace declaration, or more than one default function namespace declaration
cause: An error occurred during the processing of the XQuery expression.
action: Check the detailed error message for the possible causes.

description: An error occurred in URI processing of %s.
cause: An error occurred when processing the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).
action: Check all error messages, fix the appropriate problem, and retry the operation. If the problem persists, contact Oracle Support.

description: Host name not specified in HTTP URL
cause: A host name was not specified in the HTTP url
action: Specify a host name in the HTTP url when creating the URL string

description: Could not open HTTP connection to host (%s): port (%s)
cause: A HTTP connection could not be opened to the host
action: Specify a valid host name and port to connect to

description: An error occurred while reading from host (%s): port (%s)
cause: An error occurred while reading from the HTTP host
action: Specify a valid host name and port to read from

description: Invalid url string
cause: The URL must be a valid URL string
action: Specify a valid url string

description: Type '%s'.'%s' is not installed. Install the type before using the SYS_DBURIGEN function.
cause: The type required for the SYS_DBURIGEN function was not installed correctly.
action: Read the installation notes to install the type correctly.
params: 1) schema_name: The schema name of the type. 2) type_name: The name of the type.

description: Last argument to SYS_DBURIGEN function must be a column.
cause: The final argument to the SYS_DBURIGEN function was not a column to which the reference was being created.
action: Specify a valid column name in the query.

description: invalid column used in the SYS_DBURIGEN function call
cause: The argument to the SYS_DBURIGEN function was not a valid column.
action: Specify a valid column name for the operation.

description: invalid flags for CREATE_DBURI operator
cause: An invalid flags argument was given to the CREATE_DBURI operator.
action: Specify a valid flag value (TEXT) for the CREATE_DBURI operator.

description: invalid column specification for the SYS_DBURIGEN function
cause: The DBURI generation had columns that were either invalid or did not point to the same table or view.
action: Specify a valid list of columns that are from the same table or view.

description: Invalid format type object
cause: An invalid format type object was specified for the XML function
action: Specify a valid format type object

description: XML root element is missing.
cause: The generated XML does not have an enclosing root element.
action: The generated XML must have a root element.

description: ONLINE option not allowed with this type of index
cause: The ONLINE option was specified to validate the structure of a system-generated metadata index
action: The ONLINE option can not be used with system-generated metadata indexes such as an LOB index, an IOT Top index, an Index on Clusters etc., Run query without using the ONLINE option.

description: invalid update option
cause: The user attempted to call load_sqlset with an update option that is different than REPLACE and ACCUMULATE.
action: Adjust the update option and retry the operation.

description: invalid update condition
cause: The user attempted to call load_sqlset with an invalid update condition.
action: Check the update condition (e.g., NEW.COL1_NAME >= OLD.COL2_NAME) and retry the operation.

description: invalid staging table or tablespace
cause: The user attempted to create a staging table and specified an invalid staging table (or one that already exists) or tablespace
action: Check the arguments and try again.

description: invalid staging table
cause: The user specified an invalid staging table to one of the pack, unpack, or remap stgtab routines, or the user does not have the correct privileges on the staging table
action: Provide a correct staging table or grant the appropriate privileges

description: no CREATE TABLE privilege on schema "%s"
cause: The user tried to create a staging table when he is missing the CREATE TABLE privilege on the specified schema.
action: Grant the privilege to the user and retry

description: no privileges on tablespace provided or tablespace is offline
cause: The user tried to create a staging table on a tablespace on which he does not have any space allocated, or it is offline
action: Allocate space on the tablespace, bring it online, and retry

description: no "SQL Tuning Set" with name like "%s" exists for owner like "%s"
cause: The user specified a filter to a pack/unpack function for the SQL Tuning Set that targets no STS in the SYS schema or the staging table, respectively
action: Provide a different filter after checking the state of the system

description: invalid mode
cause: The user specified an invalid mode argument to the capture function.
action: Provide a mode argument that was defined in the dbmssqlt file

description: invalid time_limit or repeat_interval
cause: Either a NULL value was specified for the time_limit or the repeat_interval value, or the repeat_interval value was greater than the time_limit value.
action: Provide a non-NULL value and ensure that time_limit value is greater than or equal to the repeat_interval value.

description: invalid plan filter
cause: The user specified an invalid filter for the plan when calling the select_sqlset table function.
action: Adjust the the filter to be one of the following values and retry the operation: MAX_ELAPSED_TIME, MAX_CPU_TIME, MAX_DISK_READS, MAX_OPTIMIZER_COST, MAX_BUFFER_GETS, FIRST_LOADED LAST_LOADED, FIRST_GENERATED, or LAST_GENERATED.

description: cannot create staging table in SYS schema
cause: The user attempted to create a staging table in the sys schema
action: Create the table in another schema.

description: timeout encountered during sqltune test-execute
cause: This is an internal error code used internally to signal a timeout during a SQL Tune test-execute operation
action: NA

description: all plans encountered errors during sqltune test-execute
cause: This is an internal error code used to signify that a sqltune test-execute operation in RESILIENT mode ended with all plans encountering errors.
action: Examine the errors stored in the plans one by one.

description: cannot pack into staging table from previous version
cause: An attempt was made to perform a pack operation on a staging table from a previous version.
action: Create a staging table in the current version and retry the operation.

description: staging table is empty
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation on an empty staging table.
action: Check the staging table to ensure that it has rows.

description: target object already exists for tuning task "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to set a target object for a tuning task when one had already been set.
action: Create a new task if another target object is needed.

description: "SQL Tuning Set" "%s" belongs to another tuning task
cause: The user attempted to tune a task-managed SQL Tuning Set belonging to one task within the scope of another task.
action: Check the SQL Tuning Set and retry the operation.

description: operation not supported for "SQL Tuning Set" type
cause: The attempted operation was unsupported for the type of the given SQL Tuning Set.
action: Check the SQL Tuning Set and retry the operation.

description: LOB types are not supported for SQL binds
cause: A LOB type was provided in a SQL bind list.
action: Replace the LOB binds with legal bind types or try another SQL.

description: The profile type is not valid
cause: The profile type is not valid.
action: Check the available profile types.

description: Direct nfs - kgnfs tracing level
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is the level used to control trace output of Direct NFS kgnfs. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - kgnfs tracing bitmask
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control trace output of Direct NFS kgnfs. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - skgnfs tracing level
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is the level used to control trace output of AutoNFS skgnfs. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - skgnfs tracing bitmask
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control trace output of AutoNFS skgnfs. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - kgodm tracing level
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is the level used to control trace output of Direct NFS kgodm. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - kgodm tracing bitmask
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control trace output of Direct NFS kgodm. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - config mask
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control config settings for Direct NFS. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: Direct nfs - event flags
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control event settings for Direct NFS. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: OPC ODM tracing level
cause: This is an Oracle internal event code. This event is bitmask used to control trace outout for OPC ODM library. DO NOT USE.
action: N/A, this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: System type conflict with object SYS.%s
cause: The user had an object with the same name as one of the system types. The system types were not initialized properly.
action: Remove the conflicting object and rerun migration.

description: device block size %s is invalid
cause: the device block size returned by sequential I/O OSD is invalid
action: If the block size was set by using the PARMS option of the Recovery Manager ALLOCATE CHANNEL command, then the specified block size must be changed. If no PARMS option was specified on the ALLOCATE CHANNEL command, then this is an internal error that should be reported to Oracle.

description: read error on file "%s", block number %s (block size=%s)
cause: read error on input file
action: check the file

description: write error on file "%s", block number %s (block size=%s)
cause: write error on output file
action: check the file

description: cannot obtain information on device, name="%s", type="%s", parms="%s"
cause: call to get device information returned an error
action: check device name, type and parameters

description: failed to create file "%s"
cause: call to create file returned an error
action: check additional messages, check access permissions.

description: failed to identify file "%s"
cause: call to identify the file returned an error
action: check additional messages, and check if the file exists.

description: failed to create sequential file, name="%s", parms="%s"
cause: call to create the sequential file returned an error
action: check additional messages, check access permissions.

description: failed to retrieve sequential file, handle="%s", parms="%s"
cause: call to retrieve the sequential file returned an error
action: check additional messages, and check if the file exists.

description: failed to delete, resize, or close file "%s"
cause: A request to delete, resize, or close a file failed.
action: No action is required. Check the additional messages in the trace file.

description: failed to delete sequential file, handle="%s", parms="%s"
cause: call to delete the sequential file returned an error
action: check additional messages.

description: failed to set size of %s blocks for file "%s" (block size=%s)
cause: call to resize the file returned an error
action: check additional messages.

description: non RMAN, but media manager or vendor specific failure, error text: %s
cause: An error occurred in the media management software which is linked with the Oracle server to perform backup and restore in cooperation with Recovery Manager.
action: If the text of message 19511 does not provide enough information to resolve the problem, then you should contact the vendor of the media management software.

description: file search failed
cause: Recovery manager or Oracle Server attempted to discover files that matched the specified pattern but failed.
action: Check errors on the error stack for an explanation why the search for files could not be successfully executed.

description: failed to identify sequential file
cause: Unable to identify the sequential file.
action: Check additional messages, and check if the file exists on media.

description: removal of a pattern from %s not allowed
cause: An existing pattern could not be removed from the named initialization parameter because it was being used to map from the primary file name to the standby file name.
action: New patterns can be added to the end of the existing set of patterns, or the setting can be reset in the SPFILE and the database restarted.

description: Failed to commit object store file "%s"
cause: A failure to commit a multi-part object store file has occurred. This failure can be the result of a failed network connection or be caused by an internal software issue.
action: Review the related errors in the output logs and retry the operation if there is any indication of network problems like HTTP status errors or other kinds of error codes mentioning network problems. Confirm that the network ACL is configured properly for the user or users requesting the network connection. Confirm that any proxy servers configured are working properly. Check that the SSL certificates stored in the SSL wallet are valid. If the problem persists, contact Oracle support.

description: tempfile for the clone database must be renamed
cause: Opening a clone database failed because Oracle server forces the tempfile to be renamed, in order to avoid overwriting the primary tempfile.
action: Rename the tempfiles manually or automatically by using the DB_FILE_NAME_CONVERT initialization parameter.

description: only one location allowed for parameter %s
cause: A list of default locations was provided in an Oracle-managed files parameter.
action: Edit the parameter to include a single location.

description: physical standby redo log must be renamed
cause: An attempt was made to clear redo log at a physical standby database. Clearing an OMF redo log will not work unless DB_CREATE_FILE_DEST, DB_CREATE_ONLINE_LOG_DEST_n or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST parameter is specified. Clearing a non-OMF (or user-defined) redo log file will not work unless the LOG_FILE_NAME_CONVERT initialization parameter is set.
action: Set DB_CREATE_FILE_DEST, DB_CREATE_ONLINE_LOG_DEST_n or DB_RECOVERY_FILE_DEST parameter for OMF redo log files and re-issue the operation that attempted to clear redo log. Set LOG_FILE_NAME_CONVERT parameter for non-OMF redo log files and re-issue the operation that attempted to clear redo log.

description: redo logs being cleared may need access to files
cause: The redo logs are being cleared. This procedure may need the files this operation is being applied to.
action: Wait for the redo logs to be cleared.

description: Pattern %s in initialization parameter %s has an Oracle Managed Files file name.
cause: An attempt was made to convert a database file name to an Oracle Managed Files file name using DB_FILE_NAME_CONVERT, PDB_FILE_NAME_CONVERT or LOG_FILE_NAME_CONVERT initialization parameter. This was not a valid operation.
action: Retry the operation with a pattern template instead of a full Oracle Managed Files file name.

description: During the back up, the data file %s is moved or rekeyed to %s.
cause: The data file has been moved or rekeyed.
action: Check the status of the data file and try this command again.

description: Test event to specify time to delay catalog operations and delete duplicate operations
cause: NA
action: This test event is set to specify the number of seconds to delay searchFiles or processSearchFileTable or delete control file record with duplicate name. 19886 test event is used to select if the delay is in searchFiles or processSearchFile or delete duplicate name.

description: Pluggable database %s cannot access file '%s'.
cause: Pluggable databases (PDBs) have restrictions in accessing resources when connected through the DBMS_BACKUP_RESTORE package. The PDB is not permitted to access the file.
action: Perform the operation through a ROOT connection. (ROOT can access any file.)
params: 1) pdb_number: The PDB identifier that tried to access the file. 2) file_name: The name of the file that is being accessed.

description: cannot use backup/restore functions while using dispatcher
cause: Attempted to use backup/restore functions while connected to the dispatcher in a shared server. This is not allowed because the device that is used for backup and restore must remain allocated to a single process.
action: Connect directly to the instance then re-execute the backup or restore function.

description: device is busy, device type: %s, device name: %s
cause: The indicated device could not be allocated because it is allocated to another session, or no device was named, or all devices of the requested type are busy.
action: Either attempt to allocate another device or wait until the required device is no longer busy.

description: device type %s is invalid
cause: The device type indicated is invalid.
action: Supply a correct device type and retry the allocation.

description: device name %s is invalid
cause: The device name indicated is invalid.
action: Supply a valid device name and retry the allocation.
params: 1) device_name: The device name specified in the Recovery Manager (RMAN) command.

description: error allocating device, device type: %s, device name: %s
cause: The specified device could not be allocated.
action: One or more other messages should be displayed to help pinpoint the cause of the error. Correct the error and retry the allocation.

description: invalid LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST parameter value
cause: The value of parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST was not set within the valid range.
action: Specify a correct value for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST. If the archive log parameters LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST or LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST are in use, set parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_MIN_SUCCEED_DEST to either 1 or 2.

description: required destination LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST currently is deferred
cause: The destination for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST was deferred when it was required to be enabled. The destination was deferred automatically when an ALTER SYSTEM command for parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST defined a destination which duplicated an existing LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST parameter destination.
action: Change the destination value for the LOG_ARCHIVE_DUPLEX_DEST parameter.

description: device error, device type: %s, device name: %s
cause: An error occurred in the platform-specific device code.
action: One or more other messages should be displayed to help pinpoint the cause of the error. Correct the error and retry the allocation.
params: 1) device_type: The device type specified in Recovery Manager (RMAN). 2) device_name: The device name of the device type.

description: error de-allocating device
cause: The specified device could not be de-allocated.
action: One or more other messages should be displayed to help pinpoint the cause of the error. Correct the error and retry the allocation.

description: error sending device command: %s
cause: An error occurred while sending the indicated command to the session device.
action: One or more other messages should be displayed to help pinpoint the cause of the error. Correct the error and retry the allocation.

description: %s is not a valid device limit name
cause: An invalid name of device limit was specified in a call to DBMS_BACKUP_RESTORE.SETLIMIT.
action: Use one of the device limit names described in dbmsbkrs.sql

description: %s requires a DISK channel
cause: The attempted command requires that a DISK device channel be allocated to the session, but a non-DISK device was found.
action: Deallocate the current device and allocate a DISK channel, then then retry the command.

description: File %s is empty.
cause: The indicated file, which is an archived log, control, or data file, was found to be empty during a copy, backup, or scan operation.
action: Ensure that the correct files are being specified for the copy or backup operation.

description: %s header validation failed for file %s
cause: When opening the file to be placed in a copy or backup set to be inspected or used as the target for an incremental restore, the header was not recognized as a valid file header for a file of the indicated type (data file, archived log, or control file) belonging to the current database.
action: Ensure that the correct files are being specified for the copy or backup operation.
params: 1) operation: The operation encountering an error. 2) file_name: The name of the file being processed.

description: error occurred writing %s bytes at block number %s
cause: An error occurred while writing to a file.
action: One or more other messages should be displayed to describe the cause of the error. Correct the error if possible, then retry the copy, backup, or restore operation.
params: 1) number_bytes: The number of bytes to write on the target file. 2) block_number: The target file block number.

description: BACKUP_TAPE_IO_SLAVES not enabled when duplexing to sequential devices
cause: An attempt was made to specify duplexing to sequential devices, but the BACKUP_TAPE_IO_SLAVES initialization parameter was not enabled.
action: Specify BACKUP_TAPE_IO_SLAVES=TRUE in the INIT.ORA file, or do not specify duplexing to sequential devices.

description: exceeded limit of %s corrupt blocks for file %s
cause: The user-specified limit of allowable corrupt blocks was exceeded while reading the specified data file for a data file copy or backup.
action: None. The copy or backup operation fails. The session trace file contains detailed information about which blocks were corrupt.
params: 1) corrupt_limit: The corrupt block upper limit. 2) data_file: The data file to be backed up.

description: cannot shrink file %s because it is being backed up or copied
cause: An ALTER statement attempted to reduce the size of the indicated file while the same file is being backed up or copied.
action: Retry the resize after the backup or copy is complete.

description: A device is already allocated to this session.
cause: An attempt was made to allocate a device to a session when another device was already allocated.
action: Deallocate the current device.

description: No device is allocated to this session.
cause: An operation was attempted that requires a device to be allocated to the current session, and there is no device allocated.
action: Allocate a device then retry the operation.

description: file number %s is outside valid range of 1 through %s
cause: A file number used in a copy, backup, or restore operation was not valid for the current database.
action: Specify a valid file number.
params: 1) file_number: The target file number. 2) max_file_number: The maximum supported file number.

description: %s RECID %s STAMP %s not found in control file
cause: The input file specified for a copy or backup operation could not be opened because the record describing the file is not found in the control file.
action: Specify a correct RECID/STAMP and retry the copy or backup.

description: cannot process file %s, file is being being resized
cause: The input file specified for a copy or backup operation could not be opened because the file is being resized.
action: Wait for the resize to complete then retry the copy or backup.

description: cannot obtain %s enqueue for datafile %s
cause: The file access enqueue could not be obtained for a file specified in a backup, copy or restore operation. If the enqueue type shown is 'shared', then the file is the input file for a backup or copy. If the type is 'exclusive', then the file is the output file for a datafile copy or restore which is attempting to overwrite the currently active version of that file - in this case, the file must be offline or the database must be closed. If the type is 'read-only', then you are attempting to back up or copy this file while the database is in NOARCHIVELOG mode.
action: Wait until the conflicting operation is complete, then retry the copy or backup. If the database is in NOARCHIVELOG mode, then all files being backed up must be closed cleanly.

description: output file name must be specified
cause: This type of copy or restore requires an output file name.
action: Specify an output file name and retry the copy.

description: Expected %s blocks in file %s, but found %s.
cause: During a backup, restore, copy, or scan operation the specified file did not contain as many blocks as were indicated in the file header.
action: The input copy or backup piece specified is probably corrupt. If there is another copy or backup piece of the file being restored, delete the corrupt file from the recovery catalog and retry.

description: data file %s not defined in control file
cause: The specified file number was not found in the control file.
action: Specify a valid file number and retry the Recovery Manager (RMAN) operation.
params: 1) datafile_number: The data file number specified in the RMAN command.

description: File %s is missing.
cause: A COPYDATAFILECOPY, RESTOREDATAFILETO or PROXYRESTOREDATAFILE function specified a file number but did not specify an output file name, indicating that the output file name should be taken from the control file. However, the control file entry for this file indicates that it was created for a file that was present in the data dictionary but not named during the last CREATE CONTROLFILE statement, so the name in the control file cannot be used for restoration.
action: Either specify an output file name or issue a SQL RENAME statement to enter a valid name for this file in the control file.
params: 1) file_name: The file to create during the COPYDATAFILECOPY, RESTOREDATAFILETO or PROXYRESTOREDATAFILE operation.

description: end of volume while duplexing to sequential files, backup piece incomplete
cause: An end of volume (EOV) condition was detected while duplexing to sequential files, and this condition cannot be handled currently.
action: Before retrying the backup, make sure the backup pieces will fit in the volume, or disable duplexing.

description: archived log record for %s not found
cause: No archived log record corresponding to input file could be found in the control file.
action: Specify a valid archived log file name and retry the operation.

description: %s conversation not active
cause: A backup, restore, or related operation is being attempted before the conversation is started.
action: Start a conversation first, and then retry the operation.

description: no files have been named
cause: An attempt was made to proceed from the file naming phase to the piece processing phase of a backup or restore conversation before any files have been specified for backup or restore.
action: Specify some files then retry the operation.

description: archived log file header validation for %s failed
cause: The archived log file header was corrupt and could not be validated.
action: Provide a valid archived log file and retry the operation.
params: 1) log_filename: The archived log file name.

description: conversation terminated due to error
cause: An error occurred which forced the termination of the current backup or restore conversation.
action: There should be other error messages to help identify the cause of the problem. Correct the error and begin another conversation.

description: file %s already in use
cause: The indicated file, which was specified as the target for a copy, restore, or delete operation is already in use by the database.
action: Specify a different name and retry the operation.

description: premature end of volume on piece %s
cause: While creating the indicated backup piece, an end-of-volume condition was encountered before all of the backup set control data was written to the backup piece. This is most likely a media error, because the amount of backup set control data is very small in relation to the total amount of data in a backup set.
action: Retry the piece with a larger piece of output media.

description: The %s k-byte limit is too small to hold piece directory.
cause: The user-specified limit for the MAXPIECESIZE parameter for this channel is not enough to hold the backup set control data.
action: Allocate a channel specifying a larger value for the MAXPIECESIZE parameter, and retry the operation.
