description: ORDER SIBLINGS BY clause not allowed here
cause: ORDER SIBLINGS BY clause is specified in a query which doesn't have CONNECT BY clause.
action: Remove ORDER SIBLINGS BY clause or add CONNECT BY clause.

description: NOCYCLE keyword is required with CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE pseudocolumn.
cause: CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE was used in a query which does not include the NOCYCLE keyword.
action: Remove CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE or add NOCYCLE.

description: Element '%s' cannot contain mixed text.
cause: An XML element was not declared as mixed and therefore could not contain multiple text nodes.
action: Declare this element type as mixed in its schema.

description: reference node '%s' not contained in specified parent node '%s'
cause: The reference node used did not have the specified parent node.
action: Use a node in the specified parent as the reference.
params: 1) reference_node: The reference node in use. 2) parent_node: The parent node for the reference node.

description: Element '%s' may not appear at this point within parent '%s'.
cause: The ordering specified by the content model of the parent did not allow for this element to occur at this position.
action: Reorder the child elements to comply with the content model of the parent element.
params: 1) element_name: The element name. 2) parent_name: The parent name.

description: '%s' node cannot be inserted in parent node (%s type) '%s'
cause: The schema did not allow the child node to be inserted into the parent node of this type. For example, only element nodes can be inserted into a document.
action: Insert only child nodes that are allowed for this node type.
params: 1) node_name: The child node that was trying to insert into the parent node. 2) parent_node: The parent node for this insertion. 3) node_type: The type of the defined parent node.

description: XML maxoccurs value (%s) exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to insert more than maxoccurs values into a schema-based XML document.
action: Do not insert more than maxoccurs values into the document.

description: maximum number (%s) of the XML node '%s' exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to insert more than the allowed number of elements (specified by the MAXOCCURS facet) into an XML document.
action: Do not attempt to add more than the maximum number of elements allowed to an XML document.
params: 1) maximum_number: The maximum number of elements allowed. 2) xml_node: The name of the XML node.

description: no schema definition for the node '%s' (namespace '%s') in the parent '%s'
cause: The schema definition for the parent node being processed did not allow for the specified child node in its content model. Note that any type casting using xsi:type must occur before the schema definitions before the new type can be used.
action: Only insert elements and attributes declared in the schema. Ensure that xsi:type (if used) is specified first.
params: 1) node: The specified child node. 2) namespace: The namespace of the child node. 3) parent: The parent node being processed.

description: no prefix defined for namespace '%s' (particle %s)
cause: An XML namespace mapping (xmlns:<prefix>=<namespace URL>) was not defined for each particle (element or attribute) stored in a schema constrained XMLType document.
action: Add an xmlns attribute definition (attribute name="xmlns:prefix" and value="namespace URL") to the current XMLType document. The safest place to add this attribute is in the root node of the document to ensure that the mapping will be in scope.
params: 1) xml_namespace: The XML namespace. 2) particle_name: The name of the element or attribute.

description: order violation: element '%s' may not follow element '%s'
cause: The XML schema specified a content model that was sequential. The order of the nodes in the instance must follow the order specified by the schema and this instance relies on the schema validity to avoid maintaining instance order information.
action: Insert elements only in the order specified in the schema.
params: 1) element_name: The element name. 2) element_name: The element name.

description: cannot resolve prefix '%s' for QName node '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to store a QName value without having a valid namespace in scope for that prefix.
action: Declare the namespace for the prefix used.
params: 1) prefix: The prefix used. 2) QName_node: The name of the node.

description: cannot specify empty URI for non-default namespace '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to insert a namespace declaration for a non-default namespace using an empty Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) string.
action: Specify a non-empty URI for namespace declarations other than the default namespace.
params: 1) namespace: The namespace. ////// Errors 30942 to 30950 reserved for XML Schema Evolution

description: XML schema evolution error for schema '%s' table %s column '%s'
cause: The given XMLType table/column that conforms to the given schema had errors during evolution. For more information, see the more specific error following this one.
action: Take corrective action based on the schema, table and column information in this error and the more specific error that follows this one.

description: XML schema '%s' is dependent on XML schema '%s'.
cause: Not all dependent XML schemas were specified or the XML schemas were not specified in a proper order.
action: Include the URL of all participant and dependent XML schemas through the procedure argument SCHEMAURLS in a correct order. For example, if XML schema S depends on XML schema T, then T must appear before S.

description: failed roll back of the evolution of XML schema '%s' on table '%s' column '%s'
cause: The specified XMLType table/column conforming to the specified XML schema produced errors during schema evolution. There are errors accompanying this one that detail the causes of the failed evolution and roll back.
action: See the additional error messages for details.
params: 1) schema: The XML schema URL. 2) table: The table name. 3) column: The column name.

description: failed to create mapping table '%s'
cause: A mapping table could not be created during XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the specified table does not exist and that you have the CREATE TABLE privilege, then retry the operation.

description: XML Schema Evolution warning: temporary tables not cleaned up
cause: An error occurred after the schema was evolved while temporary tables were being cleaned up. The schema evolution was successful.
action: If you must remove the temporary tables,use the mapping table to get the names of the temporary tables and then drop them.

description: Dependent table '%s' of XML schema '%s' is version-enabled.
cause: An evolving XML schema had dependent XMLType tables that were version-enabled.
action: Disable versioning on the XMLType table.

description: operation not allowed in in-place XML schema evolution : %s
cause: An attempt to change an XML schema was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument of DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve() are permitted.
params: 1) operation: The schema evolution operation. ///// End of XML Schema Evolution errors (30942 to 30950 reserved)

description: Element or attribute at XPath %s exceeds maximum length.
cause: An attempt was made to insert a node exceeding the maximum length (specified by the maxLength facet) into an XML document.
action: Do not attempt to add a node exceeding the maximum length into XML documents.

description: invalid configuration of HTTP/HTTPS in XDBCONFIG.XML
cause: Updating XDBCONFIG.XML when either a value is specified for http2-port but not for http2-protocol (or the other way round), or http-port and http2-port are set to the same value is invalid.
action: Specify values for both elements http2-port and http2-protocol, and set different values for http-port and http2-port.

description: XML minoccurs value (%s) violated
cause: An attempt was made to delete more than the required minimum number of elements (specified by the minoccurs facet) from an XML document.
action: Do not attempt to delete more than the required minimum number of elements that must be present from the XML document.

description: Character '%s' is invalid in '%s'.
cause: An invalid XML character was found.
action: Use only characters allowed by the XML specification.
params: 1) character: The ASCII code for a character. 2) node: The name or type of the XML node. ////// Errors 30955 to 30989 reserved for XML Index

description: The XML index does not exist or is not asynchronous.
cause: An attempt was made to synchronize a nonexistent XML index or a synchronous XML index.
action: Create the XML index in asynchronous mode.

description: invalid option for XML index
cause: The option specified for the XML index was invalid.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: cannot downgrade because there are XML indexes
cause: An attempt was made to downgrade a database that has XML indexes.
action: Drop all XML indexes before attempting the downgrade.

description: Operation directly on the pending table is not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to directly operate on the pending table of an XML index.
action: Perform the operation on the XML index instead.

description: The column to be indexed is not stored in CLOB.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML index on an XMLType column with object relational storage format.
action: Create the XML Index on an XMLType column stored in CLOB.

description: The entity is neither an XPATH nor a NAMESPACE.
cause: The given string had invalid syntax.
action: Check the syntax for XPATH and NAMESPACE.

description: Internal SQL statement is too long.
cause: An internal error occurred during an XML index DDL operation.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: inconsistent ODCI input arguments
cause: An internal error occurred during an XML operation.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: The indexed column is not of XMLTYPE.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML index on a non-XMLTYPE column.
action: Re-create the XML index on an XMLTYPE column.

description: The XML Index was not usable.
cause: The domain index for XML was not created properly. The Path Table is missing.
action: Drop and re-create the XML Index.

description: fragment does not fit into the VARCHAR2 VALUE column
cause: The fragment size exceeded the max size.
action: Re-create the XML Index with values stored in CLOB.

description: error detected in the XMLIndex layer
cause: An unexpected internal error occurred while performing an XMLIndex operation.
action: Check the Oracle trace files for errors and contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Operation directly on the path table of an XML Index is not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to directly operate on the path table of an XML index.
action: Do not directly operate on the path table of an XML index. Perform the operation on the XML index instead.

description: invalid XPATH or NAMESPACE option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
action: Use the appropriate option.

description: invalid syntax for PARAMETERS
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid option.
action: Check and use valid options.

description: unsupported option for XMLIndex
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid option for the XMLIndex.
action: Check and use valid options for the XMLIndex.

description: illegal operation on the Path Table
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
action: Use the appropriate command on the XML Index.

description: invalid ALTER INDEX option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid or unsupported option.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: invalid Path Table option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid or unsupported option.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: invalid path ID index option for XML index
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid or unsupported option.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: invalid Order Key Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid or unsupported option.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: invalid Parent Order Key Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an unsupported option.
action: Use the appropriate option.

description: invalid Value Index option for XML Index
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid or unsupported option.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: The XML index is not locally partitioned.
cause: An attempt was made to create a global partitioned XML Index.
action: Do not attempt to create global partitioned XML index or to maintain a non-local partitioned XML index.

description: Partitioned XML Index is not supported.
cause: An attempt was made to create a partitioned XML index.
action: Do not attempt to create partitioned XML index.

description: null or invalid value specified for parameter: %s
cause: The value specified for the mandatory parameter was null or invalid.
action: Ensure that all the input parameter values are valid. Consult the Oracle documentation for valid parameter values.

description: Internal event to configure Compact XML / Streaming XPath.
cause: N/A
action: Do not document.

description: invalid option for a partition of an XML Index
cause: An invalid option was specified at the partition level of an XML Index.
action: Correct or remove the invalid option.

description: maximum order key depth exceeded
cause: The document could not be indexed because its nesting depth was more than that allowed by the XML Index.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: The XMLTYPE column has to be declared as virtual.
cause: The XMLTYPE column was not declared as virtual when creating a structured XML Index.
action: The XMLTYPE column has to be declared as virtual when creating a structured XML Index.

description: The virtual XMLTYPE column for chaining is missing.
cause: The virtual XMLTYPE column for chaining was missing when creating a structured XML index.
action: A virtual XMLTYPE column for chaining has to be specified when creating a structured XML Index.

description: XMLIndex with more than one virtual column is not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XMLIndex with more than one virtual column.
action: Create an XMLIndex with only one virtual column.

description: XMLIndex on Oracle XML DB repository does not exist.
cause: An attempt was made to operate on a nonexistent XMLIndex on Oracle XML DB repository.
action: First, create the index using DBMS_XDB_ADMIN.CREATEREPOSITORYXMLINDEX, and then retry the operation.

description: corrupted XML Index metadata
cause: An attempt to locate the XML Index failed.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: XMLIndex on an Index Organized Table is not yet supported.
cause: XMLIndex on an Index Organized Table is not supported.
action: XMLIndex is supported only on Heap Organized Table.

description: User %s has insufficient privileges to change owner of resource %s.
cause: An attempt was made to change the <owner> field of an XML database resource without sufficient privileges.
action: Switch to SYS before performing the ownership change, or have the intended recipient of the resource perform the transfer.

description: cannot use DOM to add special attribute to schema-based parent
cause: An attempt was made to add or remove an xsi:schemaLocation, xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation, xsi:type, or xsi:nil attribute to or from a schema-based XML node using DOM.
action: Use the UPDATEXML operator instead of DOM.

description: error occurred at the XPath %s
cause: An error occurred at the XPath.
action: Check the error in the XPath.

description: Complex type %s is not referred to by any global element.
cause: An attempt was made to use a complex type that was not referred to by any global element.
action: Add a dummy global element to the schema that refers to the complex type.

description: invalid argument for DOM stream
cause: Either a NULL or a non-Leaf node was passed.
action: Use a combination of Document Object Model (DOM) API and DOM streams to produce the desired effect.

description: DOM streams operations cannot be performed on a NULL or invalid node.
cause: The node passed to Document Object Model (DOM) streams operations was NULL or invalid.
action: Check the input parameters.

description: streams operations over non-existent stream
cause: The stream passed was NULL or invalid.
action: Check the input parameters.

description: XSL processing of XML failed with error LPX-%s.
cause: An LPX routine (XML/XSL processing) returned an error while transforming an XML document.
action: Look up the LPX error and follow its corrective action.

description: transformation error: %s
cause: An unexpected error occurred while transforming an XML document with an XSL style sheet.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: XML context creation failed while %s.
cause: An unexpected error occurred while creating XML context.
action: Contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) operation: The action while creating XML context.

description: Resource '%s' is not an XML schema document.
cause: The specified schema URL did not refer to a registered XML schema.
action: Check that schema URL refers to a registered XML schema.

description: invalid resource handle or path name "%s"
cause: An invalid resource handle or path name was passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver.
action: Pass a valid resource handle or path name to the XDB hierarchical resolver.

description: Path name %s is not a container.
cause: The specified path name did not represent a container.
action: Specify a path name or resource handle that represents a container.

description: Parent with name %s already contains a child entry with name %s.
cause: An attempt was made to insert a duplicate child into the XDB hierarchical resolver.
action: Insert a unique name into the container.

description: Length %s of the BLOB in XDB$H_INDEX is below the minimum (%s).
cause: The calculated size of the BLOB in the CHILDREN column of the XDB$H_INDEX table was less than the required minimum without being chained.
action: Set the value of the DB_BLOCK_SIZE initialization parameter to at least 2000. For XDB to run at its fastest, set DB_BLOCK_SIZE to 8000.

description: Path name length %s exceeds maximum length %s.
cause: The length of a path name passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length.
action: Choose a shorter path name and retry the statement.

description: Path name segment length %s exceeds maximum length %s.
cause: The length of a path name segment passed to the XDB hierarchical resolver exceeded the maximum length of a path name segment.
action: Choose a shorter path name segment and retry the statement.
params: 1) segment_length: The length of a segment of the path. 2) max_segment_length: The maximum length of a path segment.

description: Attempted to delete non-empty container %s/%s. Use recursive deletion.
cause: An attempt was made to delete a non-empty container in the XDB hierarchical resolver.
action: Either perform a recursive deletion, or first delete the contents of the container.
params: 1) parent_path: The path of the parent container. 2) container_name: The name of the container.

description: LPX context creation failed while %s.
cause: An error occurred while creating LPX context because of an unexpected NULL value.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: access denied for property %s
cause: An attempt was made to access a property that was not accessible.
action: Check or modify the access control list (ACL) to ensure that you have privileges to access this property.

description: XML element index %s exceeds maximum insertion index %s.
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML element at an invalid index location in the node.
action: Choose an index that falls within the allowed range.
params: 1) index_1: The XML element index. 2) index_2: The maximum index allowed.

description: XML parsing failed
cause: XML parser returned an error while trying to parse the document.
action: Check if the document to be parsed is valid.

description: unsupported XPATH expression
cause: The XPATH expression passed to the function was not supported.
action: Check the XPATH expression and change it to use a supported expression.

description: invalid XPATH expression
cause: The XPATH expression passed to the function was invalid.
action: Check the XPATH expression for possible syntax errors.

description: attempted to delete the root container
cause: An attempt was made to delete the root container in the hierarchical index.
action: Do not delete the root container.

description: attempted to insert entry without a name
cause: An attempt was made to insert an entry into the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
action: Supply a child name and try inserting again.

description: Attempted to delete entry without name
cause: An attempt was made to delete an entry from the hierarchical resolver without a child name.
action: Supply a child name and try deleting again.

description: Error generating unique OID for XML document
cause: An error occurred while generating a globally unique OID for storing an XML document.
action: NA

description: error in deleting XML document
cause: The XMLType object pointed to by the given REF could not be deleted because either the REF was invalid or it pointed to a non-existent table.
action: Either use FORCE deletion or supply a valid REF.

description: Recursive deletion snapshot too old for %s/%s
cause: Changes were made to the structure of a directory while it was being recursively deleted.
action: Try deleting the directory again.

description: The operation is not allowed, Reason: %s
cause: The operation attempted is not allowed
action: See reason and change to a valid operation.

description: element definition not found
cause: The element definition was not found.
action: Supply the definition for the element or use a defined element.

description: Specified XML element is not found.
cause: The XML element was not found.
action: Ensure that the specified XML element exists.

description: Index size error
cause: The index is greater than the allowed value.
action: Make sure the index is less than allowed value.

description: Parser initialization failed with LPX-%s error while %s.
cause: An error occurred while initializing a parser.
action: Contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) error: The LPX error code. 2) operation: The operation being executed.

description: invalid document element
cause: An attempt was made to replace the data at an invalid index number in the XML document.
action: Supply a valid index number and try again.

description: unable to allocate additional memory while %s
cause: A dynamic memory allocation failure occurred.
action: Report this problem to a database administrator.

description: Pathname or handle %s does not point to a resource.
cause: An attempt was made to retrieve a resource based on a pathname or resource handle that pointed to an entity other than a resource.
action: Do not attempt to retrieve a resource based on that pathname or resource handle.

description: Resource metadata length %s exceeded maximum length %s
cause: An attempt was made to insert resource metadata that exceeded the maximum length of that type of metadata.
action: Keep resource metadata within its allowed length.

description: Cannot bind to unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to bind to a resource that had not been saved to disk.
action: Bind only to saved resources.

description: Unable to retrieve XML document.
cause: The resource has an invalid (dangling) REF to an XML document.
action: Rebind the resource using a valid XMLType REF.

description: cannot create context to parse an XPath %s
cause: Error occurred while parsing an XPath.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: XML parsing failed with error LPX-%s while %s.
cause: An LPX routine returned an error while transforming an XML document.
action: Look up the LPX error and follow its corrective action.
params: 1) error: The LPX error code. 2) operation: The operation being executed.

description: Requested number of XML children %s exceeds maximum %s.
cause: An attempt was made to add more than the maximum number of allowed children in an XML element.
action: Redefine the schema to allow distribution of the children among siblings.
params: 1) requested_number: The number of XML children requested. 2) maximum_number: The maximum number allowed for an XML element.

description: invalid node set encountered while executing %s
cause: The specified node set was either NULL or had an invalid type associated with it.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Could not bind locked resource to path %s/%s
cause: An attempt was made to bind an existing resource to a new location in the hierarchy, but a lock could not be obtained on the resource.
action: Commit or roll back the transaction that has the lock on the resource.

description: XSL processing context initialization failed
cause: An error occurred while creating an Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL) context.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Invalid XML attribute name %s
cause: The attribute name in the XML document did not match anything in the associated schema.
action: Supply only schema-defined or XML standard attributes.

description: invalid %s value: "%s"
cause: The text in the XML document did not represent a valid value based on the data type and other constraints in the schema.
action: Ensure that the specified value in the XML document is valid with regard to the data type and other constraints in the schema.
params: 1) value_name: The expected type or name for the value. 2) data_type: The data type in the XML document.

description: XML namespace length %s exceeds maximum length %s.
cause: The length of the disk-formatted XML namespace exceeded the maximum length allowed.
action: Ensure that the XML namespace declarations do not exceed the maximum length allowed.
params: 1) length: The XML namespace length. 2) maximum_length: The maximum length for the XML namespace.

description: XML type (%s) is not compatible with internal memory type (%s) of property %s.
cause: The specified XML data type was inconsistent with the database data type and a conversion could not be made.
action: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Register the schemas again or contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) xml_type: The XML data type specified in the XML schema property. 2) in_mem_type: The internal Oracle data type. 3) property_name: The XML schema property name.

description: property %s: memory type (%s) not compatible with database type (%s)
cause: The memory type associated with this property was mapped to an incompatible database type, and a conversion could not be made.
action: This is an internal error, generally resulting from corruption of the compiled XML schema. Re-register the schemas, or contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) property_name: The property name defined in the schema. 2) memory_type: The memory type defined in the schema. 3) database_type: The database type stored in the schema.

description: too many properties in type '%s'
cause: Too many properties were specified for the type. The type can only have the same number of properties (elements and attributes) as the number of columns in a table.
action: Modify the XML schema to move properties into sub-elements that are not inlined.

description: element '%s' not globally defined in schema '%s'
cause: The specified element name was not defined globally (at the top level) of the XML schema. Elements must be defined globally to be the root of an XMLType object.
action: Check the XML schema definition to ensure that the specified element name has been defined globally (at the top level).

description: Top-level prefix length (%s) exceeds the maximum allowed (%s).
cause: An attempt was made to save to a disk of a top-level XML namespace prefix whose length exceeded the maximum.
action: Do not define XML namespace prefixes that exceed the maximum length allowed.
params: 1) prefix_length: The length of the XML namespace prefix. 2) max_length: The maximum length allowed for an XML namespace prefix.

description: Cannot store more than %s extras outside the root XML node
cause: An attempt was made to store more than the maximum number of XML extras (e.g. comments and processing instructions) either before or after the document's root node.
action: Keep the number of extras outside the root node below the maximum.

description: Incorrect argument(s) specified in the operator
cause: One or more of the arguments specified in the operator in the query are incorrect
action: Correct the arguments specified in the operator

description: Could not retrieve resource data at path %s.
cause: An error occurred while retrieving the contents and/or metadata of a resource.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Unsaved resource %s cannot be updated. Unsaved resources need to be inserted.
cause: An attempt was made to update a resource that was not saved to the disk.
action: Perform a resource insertion instead.

description: internal event to turn off direct path loading of XML
cause: Do not document.
action: Do not document.

description: access denied
cause: The requested access privileges were not granted to the current user. The user must be granted privileges prior to resource access.
action: Ensure that the set of requested access privileges are included in the set of access privileges granted to the user.

description: requested access privileges not supported
cause: The requested access privileges were not supported for the specified resource.
action: Ensure that the set of requested access privileges are valid access privileges for the specified resource.

description: cannot delete ACL %s while used by other resources
cause: The access control list (ACL) resource could not be deleted because it was used by other resources.
action: Remove the resources that reference the ACL.
params: 1) ACL_name: The name of the ACL.

description: The value of the DEPTH argument in the UNDER_PATH condition cannot be negative.
cause: The optional DEPTH argument in the UNDER_PATH condition indicates the number of levels down from the specified path_string that Oracle should search. The documentation might also refer to this parameter as "levels". The value provided was a negative number. Oracle expects any non-negative integer.
action: Correct the value for the depth or levels argument to a non-negative integer.

description: The %s operator cannot have an ancillary operator
cause: An ancillary operator was used with an operator which does not does not support ancillary operators
action: Remove the ancillary operator in the query

description: cannot insert NULL XMLType element into RESOURCE_VIEW
cause: The element which was being inserted into RESOURCE_VIEW was NULL.
action: Specify a XMLType element that is not NULL to insert into RESOURCE_VIEW.

description: The XML element or document being inserted does not conform to XML schema %s.
cause: The XML element or document being inserted did not conform to the registered XML schema identified by the URL.
action: Insert an element or document that conforms to the specified XML schema.

description: Display Name of the element being inserted is NULL.
cause: The Display Name of the element which is being inserted into the RESOURCE_VIEW was NULL.
action: Specify the Display Name and insert the element into RESOURCE_VIEW.

description: Cannot modify read-only XML objects.
cause: Read-only XML objects could not be modified.
action: Use only read operations on such an XML object.

description: Cannot insert root XML document node if it already exists
cause: An attempt was made to insert a root node into an XML document that already had a root node.
action: Call the appropriate replace function to replace the node instead of inserting it anew.

description: Resource at path %s could not be deleted.
cause: An error occurred when an attempt was made to delete the named resource.
action: Check the error stack for detailed information on this issue. Examine the next error on the stack, take appropriate action, and then retry the operation.

description: XDB error: %s
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot delete an unsaved resource
cause: An attempt was made to delete a resource that had not been saved to disk.
action: Delete only saved resources.

description: XPath compilation failed: %s. %s
cause: XPath compilation failed for specified reason.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot instantiate abstract element or property [%s]
cause: An attempt was made instantiate an abstract element.
action: Use only read operations on such elements.

description: Cannot modify read-only property [%s]
cause: An attempt was made to modify an immutable XML node.
action: Use only read operations on such properties.

description: Insertion of %s into %s creates a cycle.
cause: An attempt was made to insert a link into the XDB hierarchy that would create a cycle in the tree.
action: Ensure that links to existing resources do not cause cycles.

description: wrong XML node type
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML() to update an XML node with a node of another type.
action: Ensure that the node that XPATH specifies matches the type of new data that is provided.

description: updateXML expected data format [%s] instead of [%s]
cause: An attempt was made to use updateXML to update data with a node of the incorrect type. Text and attribute nodes must be updated with string data, whereas element nodes must be updated with XMLType data.
action: Use CREATEXML or getStringVal to coerce the new data to the proper format.

description: Cannot apply typed changes to non-schema-based XMLType nodes.
cause: Attempted to insert, delete, or update a non-schema-based XMLType node using an XML schema definition.
action: Change non-typed nodes only by referencing their tag names.

description: invalid database user ID %s
cause: An attempt was made to set an invalid user ID in an XDB resource metadata property.
action: Verify the validity of the user ID and try again.

description: Invalid database username or GUID %s
cause: An attempt was made to set an invalid username or GUID into an XDB resource metadata property.
action: Verify the validity of the username or GUID and try again.

description: Too many child nodes in XMLType fragment for updateXML
cause: An attempt was made to pass an XMLType fragment with multiple children as new data for the updateXML operator.
action: Extract the desired child from the XMLType before passing it to updateXML as the desired new XML node.

description: resource not retrieved using pathname
cause: An attempt was made to access the pathname of a resource that was either never saved to disk or was loaded using a method other than with its pathname.
action: Perform the pathname operations only on resources obtained using a pathname.

description: XML comment length %s exceeds maximum %s
cause: The length of the disk-formatted XML comment exceeded the maximum.
action: Keep outer XML comments declarations below the maximum length.

description: invalid %s declaration in XML Schema
cause: The XML Schema contained an invalid declaration identified by the message.
action: Fix the identified error and try again.
params: 1) decl: The outstanding schema declaration (e.g. complexType).

description: required attribute "%s" not specified
cause: The XML schema does not specify a required attribute.
action: Specify a value for the required attribute.

description: invalid attribute "%s" specified
cause: The XML Schema specified an invalid attribute.
action: Remove the specification of the invalid attribute.

description: error in SQL mapping information
cause: There was an error in the SQL type and table specification within the XML Schema.
action: Ensure that all specified SQL types and tables are valid and compatible with the corresponding XML types.

description: unable to resolve reference to %s "%s"
cause: The identified type, attribute or element could not be resolved.
action: Ensure that the specified name corresponds to a valid XML (simple or complex) type, attribute or element and try again.
params: 1) decl: The outstanding declaration (e.g. xsi:type, element). 2) name: The name of the outstanding declaration.

description: type not specified for attribute or element "%s"
cause: The identified attribute or element does not have a type.
action: Make sure that every attribute and element has a valid type specification.

description: name not specified for global declaration
cause: The XML schema did not specify the name for the global declaration of attribute, element, simpleType, or complexType.
action: Specify names for all the global declarations.

description: Invalid attribute "%s" specified in declaration of "%s".
cause: The XML schema specified an invalid attribute.
action: Remove the specification of the invalid attribute.
params: 1) attr: The outstanding XML attribute. 2) decl: The name of the outstanding declaration.

description: An error occurred while creating SQL type "%s"."%s".
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the SQL type based on the specification of a complex type.
action: Correct the error in the SQL type and retry.
params: 1) owner: The owner of the outstanding SQL type. 2) name: The name of the outstanding SQL type.

description: error while creating table "%s"."%s" for element "%s"
cause: An error occurred while trying to create the table based on the declaration of the identified element.
action: Fix the identified error and try again.
params: 1) owner: The owner of the table. 2) table: The name of the table. 3) element: The XML element.

description: schema "%s" already registered
cause: An attempt was made to register a schema with the same URL as a previously registered schema.
action: Register the schema with a different URL.

description: insufficient privileges to register schema "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to register a schema without sufficient privileges.
action: Ensure that the user has sufficient privileges to register the schema.
params: 1) schema: The URL for the XML schema.

description: insufficient privileges to delete schema "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to delete a schema resource without sufficient privileges.
action: Ensure that you have sufficient privileges to delete the schema.

description: Object "%s"."%s" depends on the XML schema.
cause: An attempt was made to delete an XML schema that had dependent objects.
action: Either drop the dependent objects prior to deleting the XML schema or use the CASCADE or FORCE options.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner of the dependent object. 2) object_name: The name of the dependent object.

description: Schema "%s" does not target namespace "%s".
cause: The XML schema document contained references (through INCLUDE and IMPORT definitions) to other XML schemas that do not belong to any valid namespaces.
action: Ensure that all XML schemas included have the same target namespace as the specified XML schema. Also, ensure that all imported XML schemas have namespaces matching the actual target namespace of the specified schema.
params: 1) schema: The XML schema URL. 2) namespace: The target XML namespace.

description: invalid database schema name "%s"
cause: The XML schema document contained an invalid database schema name for attributes such as SQL schema.
action: Ensure that all the database user or schema names specified in the XML schema document refer to existing database users or schemas.

description: An empty string was specified as a SQL name.
cause: The XML schema document contained a null value for attributes such as SQLName, SQLType, and defaultTable.
action: Ensure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema document are valid SQL names. Otherwise, remove these attributes from the schema and then try again.

description: invalid SQL name "%s"
cause: The XML schema document contained an invalid SQL name. For example, the values of attributes SQLName, SQLType, and defaultTable.
action: Ensure that all names of SQL schema objects specified in the XML schema documents are valid SQL names. This implies that the database length and other restrictions on names are satisfied.

description: null or invalid value specified for parameter %s
cause: The argument value passed for the specified parameter was null or invalid.
action: Ensure that all of the input argument values are valid.

description: incompatible SQL type "%s" for attribute or element "%s"
cause: The SQL type information provided in the XML schema was not compatible with the XML schema definition (XSD) type for the specified attribute or element.
action: Ensure that the specified SQL types are compatible with the declared XSD types.
params: 1) type: The SQL type. 2) prop: The name of the outstanding XML element or attribute.

description: cannot generate %s: "%s"."%s" already exists
cause: The type or table name specified in the XML schema document was already in use, therefore it could not be generated.
action: Use different names for types or tables, or use the NOGEN mode so that the schema compiler does not generate new types or tables.
params: 1) object_category: The category of the object (e.g. "table" or "type"). 2) owner_name: The owner of the object. 3) object_name: The name of the object.

description: validation failed for XML schema "%s"
cause: The XML schema could not be validated. For more information, see the more specific error following this one.
action: Ensure that the SQLType and other data type mapping is valid. Further information can be retrieved from the more specific error that follows this one.

description: Hierarchical index must be empty to be rebuilt.
cause: An attempt was made to rebuild the hierarchical index which was not empty.
action: Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

description: internal event to turn on XDB tracing
cause: None.
action: None.

description: internal XDB security error
cause: An unexpected internal XDB security error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: internal XDB locking error
cause: An internal XDB locking error has occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: token "%s" not given while locking resource "%s"
cause: An attempt was made to lock a resource when the principal already owned a lock given by the token.
action: Attempt the lock again with the token.

description: cannot acquire lock on resource %s, already locked in exclusive mode
cause: A lock could not be acquired because the resource was already locked in exclusive mode.
action: Wait until the existing lock on the resource has been removed or remove the existing lock and try again.

description: cannot obtain an exclusive lock on the resource because it is already locked in shared mode
cause: An exclusive lock could not be obtained because the resource was already locked in shared mode.
action: Choose a compatible lock mode such as a shared lock or wait for the shared lock to be released.

description: cannot find lock with token "%s" on "%s"
cause: The specified lock could not be located because the token was incorrect, unlocked, or expired.
action: Ensure the specified token and state are correct for the specified lock. After this, retry the operation.

description: User does not own lock with supplied token "%s".
cause: The lock corresponding to the supplied token was not owned by the user.
action: Supply the correct token while being connected as the correct user.

description: parent container locked
cause: The action failed because a parent container was locked.
action: Supply the lock token on the parent container or unlock it.

description: resource "%s" locked by name lock
cause: The operation failed because the lock requests caused the whole requested Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) to be locked.
action: Supply a lock token or unlock the lock.

description: The action failed because resource %s is locked.
cause: A delete or rename command failed because of an existing lock.
action: Release the lock and try again.

description: Deletion on %s failed because parent resource %s is locked.
cause: A delete operation failed because a parent resource was locked.
action: Remove the lock.

description: action failed as resource %s is locked
cause: A delete or rename operation failed because one of the children resources was locked.
action: Either wait until the child resource is unlocked or remove the lock and try again.

description: table %s cannot be hierarchically enabled
cause: Trigger <tabname>_xdb_pitrigger already exists
action: Either the table is already hierarchically enabled or the user trigger <tabname>_xdb_pitrigger needs to be dropped. Delete all rows in the hierarchical index and then rebuild it.

description: failed to %s %s port using XDB configuration
cause: The port number for the specified port type could not be registered or unregistered.
action: Either the port number is already in use or it is protected. Specify another port number.
params: 1) operation: Either "register" or "unregister". 2) type: The port type.

description: XDB configuration may not be updated with non-schema compliant data.
cause: An attempt was made to update the XDB configuration resource with non-schema or non-schema compliant data.
action: Check the document to ensure that it is schema based and schema compliant.

description: XDB configuration has been deleted or is corrupted.
cause: The XDB configuration resource was deleted or corrupted.
action: Reinstall XDB, or reinsert a valid configuration document.

description: XDB configuration error: %s
cause: An error related to XDB configuration occurred.
action: Ensure the configuration resource contains valid data.

description: Tablespace not specified correctly
cause: XDB cannot be moved to the specified tablespace.
action: Specify a valid tablespace.

description: Table "%s"."%s" is not resource metadata enabled
cause: This table does not have a RESID column for resource metadata
action: Use disable/enable_hierarchy to enable resource metadata

description: System schema "%s" is already registered.
cause: An attempt was made to register an XML schema with the same URL as a system XML schema.
action: Change the schema URL to avoid conflicts with system XML schemas.

description: XDB configuration cannot be updated on all instances.
cause: An attempt was made to update an XDB configuration.
action: Ensure that each instance is correctly configured with its listener.

description: USEDPORT function cannot be called in a pluggable database.
cause: An attempt was made to call USEDPORT function in a pluggable database.
action: Connect to the root container and call the USEDPORT function.

description: The value of operator %s cannot be FALSE.
cause: The value of the operator that was specified was FALSE.
action: Specify an operator that evaluates to TRUE.

description: The right hand side value for operator %s did not evaluate to TRUE.
cause: The value on the right hand side that was specified for the operator did not evaluate to TRUE.
action: Specify a value on the right hand side that evaluates to TRUE.

description: Internal event for Structure XMLIndex debugging
cause: N/A
action: N/A

description: RCList cannot contain noncommitted resource configurations.
cause: A commit was not executed after adding a resource configuration to an RCList by calling DBMS_RESCONFIG.ADDRESCONFIG().
action: Ensure that a commit is executed after calling DBMS_RESCONFIG.ADDRESCONFIG().

description: The event handler calls cannot exceed the depth of %s.
cause: An attempt was made to fire an event with depth exceeding the maximum.
action: Ensure that the event is not fired recursively (either by calling itself or other functions or procedures).

description: unable to retrieve repository's resource configuration
cause: An attempt was made to access a deleted resource configuration from the XDB repository.
action: Disassociate the resource configuration from the repository.

description: specified resource configuration not associated with given resource
cause: An attempt was made to delete a nonexistent resource configuration from the configuration list of the target resource.
action: Ensure that the resource and resource configuration names are specified correctly, and the resource configuration belongs to the configuration list of the given resource.

description: RCList element contains OID that is not a resource configuration.
cause: The OID in the RCList element was not a resource configuration OID.
action: Correct the RCList element.

description: could not invoke event handler "%s"."%s"
cause: A attempt failed to invoke an invalid event handler. Either the handler did not exist or the handler could not be compiled successfully.
action: Verify that the named handler exists and recompile it. Ensure that the recompilation is successful.

description: invoker's rights not currently allowed for handler "%s"."%s"
cause: An attempt was made to invoke an event handler with invoker's rights when the SET-INVOKER attribute in the resource configuration that defines the handler was not set to TRUE.
action: Either redefine the named handler with definer's rights or change the SET-INVOKER attribute in the resource configuration that defines the named handler to TRUE.
params: 1) schema_name: The schema of the handler. 2) handler_name: The name of the handler.

description: cannot delete a configuration that is referenced by other resources
cause: An attempt was made to delete a resource configuration that was referenced by other resources.
action: Remove all references to the target resource configuration by executing DELETERESCONFIG or DELETEREPOSITORYRESCONFIG procedures in DBMS_RESCONFIG package or specify the DELETE_FORCE option in the DELETERESOURCE statement.

description: Resource has already been rendered.
cause: One of the following has occurred: 1) An attempt was made to invoke a setRender* method after the resource was rendered through a setRender* method or after data was written to the output stream. 2) An attempt was made to access the output stream of the resource after a setRender* method was executed on the resource.
action: Remove the method invocation causing the problem.

description: resource configuration %s already associated with resource %s
cause: An attempt was made to add a resource configuration that already existed in the resource configuration list of the resource or the repository.
action: Ensure that this resource configuration really needs to be added. If it does, remove it from the resource and repository lists before adding it back.

description: index out of range
cause: The specified position was not valid.
action: Ensure that the positional value is greater than or equal to zero and smaller than the size of the configuration list of the target resource.

description: Resource configuration is being referenced by another resource.
cause: Attempted to add a resource configuration to the repository that was referenced by an existing resource.
action: Remove the resource configuration from other resource before you retry adding it to the repository.

description: invalid resource configuration list
cause: An attempt was made to create or update a resource that had duplicate resource configurations or a conflict with the repository configurations.
action: Correct the resource configuration list.

description: invalid operation: %s
cause: An attempt was made to call an invalid operation.
action: Do not execute this operation.

description: invalid path
cause: The path specified for the <defaultChildConfig> or <defaultChildACL> element did not refer to an existing resource.
action: Correct the path to refer to an existing resource.

description: Listener does not have an assigned schema.
cause: One or more listeners did not have an assigned schema.
action: Specify a schema for each listener.

description: XDB_SET_INVOKER role required
cause: The SET-INVOKER attribute could not be set to TRUE because the XDB_SET_INVOKER role was not set.
action: Add the XDB_SET_INVOKER role.

description: implementation language for %s not specified
cause: The implementation language for the specified listener source was not specified.
action: Specify an implementation language.
params: 1) listener_name: The name of the listener.

description: duplicate listener %s in resource configuration
cause: A duplicate listener source was found in the resource configuration.
action: Remove the duplicate listener source.
params: 1) listener_name: The name of the listener.

description: invalid listener source %s.%s
cause: The listener source specified in the resource configuration did not exist or was invalid.
action: Correct the listener source in the listener element.
params: 1) schema_name: The schema name of the listener. 2) listener_name: The name of the listener.

description: %s not an ACL resource
cause: The specified resource did not conform to acl.xsd schema.
action: Specify a valid path for the defaultChildACL element.
params: 1) resource_name: The name of the resource.

description: %s not a valid resource configuration
cause: The resource specified in the defaultChildConfig element while creating a resource configuration or the resource specified as the rcpath in a call using the DBMS_RESCONFIG package did not conform to XDBResConfig.xsd schema.
action: Specify a valid path and resubmit the statement.

description: nonexistent schema: %s
cause: A nonexistent schema was defined in the resource configuration.
action: Specify a valid schema in the resource configuration, and retry the operation.
params: 1) schema_name: The name of the schema.

description: unrecoverable error in handler %s
cause: The named handler raised an exception.
action: This message is followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.
params: 1) handler_name: The XDB repository event handler.

description: cyclic definition encountered for %s: "%s"
cause: The schema definition for this type had cycles.
action: Remove cyclic definition and recompile schema.

description: Internal event to enable lru XOBs
cause: N/A
action: Do not document

description: cannot create schema URL with reserved prefix "http://xmlns.oracle.com/xdb/schemas/"
cause: This prefix was reserved for XDB extended schema URLs and could not be used in a user specified URL.
action: Modify the prefix to a different one.

description: invalid XML document
cause: The XML document is invalid with respect to its XML Schema.
action: Fix the errors identified and try again.

description: attribute %s not in XDB namespace
cause: The specified attribute was not prefixed with the XDB namespace.
action: Ensure that all XDB specified attributes are prefixed with the XDB namespace, and then try again.

description: internal event to turn off validation during schema registration
cause: None.
action: None.

description: HTTP Content-Type header has an invalid or unsupported character set.
cause: The HTTP Content-Type header had an invalid or unsupported character set.
action: Change the Content-Type header in the HTTP request to a supported character set.

description: schema "%s" currently being referenced
cause: The specified schema URL is currently being referenced by the same session. This could happen because of PLSQL XMLType variables still in scope.
action: Ensure all references to this schema in this session are released, and then try the operation again.

description: Oracle XML DB is in an invalid state.
cause: Oracle XML DB internal tables are in an invalid state, probably because the database was not upgraded or the upgrade was not successful.
action: Ensure that the database is upgraded successfully. If the problem persists, then contact Oracle Support.

description: max substitution group size %s exceeded by "%s" (%s) for head element "%s" (%s)
cause: The maximum limit on nested substitution groups has been exceeded by an element.
action: Delete specified schema and re-register it after removing the offending substitution element.

description: Element or attribute "%s" cannot be stored out of line.
cause: An element or attribute of a simple type has "SQLInline=FALSE".
action: Remove "SQLInline=FALSE" for the offending element or attribute.

description: Element or attribute "%s" has no SQLType specified.
cause: Schema registration was invoked with FALSE GENTYPES without specifying the SQLType attribute for some elements or attributes.
action: Specify the SQLType attribute for the offending element or attribute and register the schema again.
params: 1) xml_name: The outstanding XML element or attribute.

description: Element or attribute "%s" has invalid value "%s" (should be "%s").
cause: An element or attribute for a complexType derived by restriction had an attribute whose value was different from that in the base type.
action: Remove the mismatched attribute values from the offending element or attribute.
params: 1) xml_name: The outstanding XML element or attribute. 2) value_name_1: The invalid value given. 3) value_name_2: The expected value.

description: Cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path.
cause: The table being loaded contained an XML column with object-relational storage. The XMLType column contained a type with subtypes. This type of attribute cannot be loaded with direct path.
action: Perform the load with a conventional path mode.

description: cannot load object-relational XML attribute using direct path
cause: The table that was loaded contained an XML column with object-relational storage. The XMLType column either contains an out-of-line partitioned table or the table itself is partitioned by one of the attributes of XMLType. This type of table cannot be loaded with direct path.
action: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

description: not match with ignorable attributes
cause: The attribute was not ignorable.
action: Check the attributes.

description: XML nodes over 64K in size cannot be inserted
cause: An attempt was made to insert an XML Text Node with a size greater than 64K. This is not supported.
action: Create text nodes under 64K.

description: Node localname and namespace values should be less than 64K
cause: An attempt was made to specify an XML Node with localname or namespace value greater than or equal to 64K. This is not supported.
action: Node localnames and namespace values should be under 64K.

description: Number of children (%s) defined in '%s' exceeds maximum (%s).
cause: An attempt was made to define more than the allowed number of children in a complexType element of an XML schema document.
action: Modify the XML schema document to move children of a complexType into sub-elements that are not stored inline.

description: cyclic schema registration without using FORCE option
cause: An attempt was made to register cyclic schemas with FORCE = FALSE.
action: Use FORCE = TRUE when registering cyclic schemas.

description: schema processing error LSX - %s while %s
cause: An LSX routine returned an error.
action: Look up the LSX error and follow the corrective action.
params: 1) error: The LSX error number. 2) operation: The operation on the XML schema.

description: cannot load ADT column or XMLType column using direct path
cause: The table being loaded contained an ADT column or XMLType column with object-relational or binary storage and supplemental logging was enabled for the table. Direct path load is not supported for such tables when supplemental logging is enabled.
action: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

description: internal event used by XDB schema cache
cause: None.
action: None.

description: internal event used by XDB repository
cause: N/A
action: N/A

description: API not supported in this release
cause: This API was not supported.
action: None

description: The referenced resource configuration does not exist.
cause: The referenced resource did not exist.
action: Ensure the referenced resource configuration exists or contact Oracle Support.

description: miscellaneous event for XDB
cause: N/A, this is an internal Oracle event code.
action: N/A, this is an internal Oracle event code.

description: internal XDB event for ftp test harness
cause: N/A
action: Do not document ////// 31180 - 31189 reserved for PL/SQL DOM API

description: DOM Type mismatch in invalid PL/SQL DOM handle
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM handle is referencing a DOM Node whose DOM Type that does not match the one available in the session. This could happen because the pl/sql handle was reused, or the original document is no longer available.
action: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

description: PL/SQL DOM handle accesses node that is no longer available
cause: The specified pl/sql handle is referencing a node in a DOM Document that is no longer available.
action: Ensure that the pl/sql handle for the target node is valid and try the operation again.

description: Too many PL/SQL DOM handles specified
cause: An attempt was made to create a PL/SQL DOM handle that exceeded the maximum allowable number of PL/SQL DOM handles.
action: Free PL/SQL DOM handles and try the operation again.

description: Node type %s cannot be converted to desired type
cause: The given node's type cannot be converted correctly for this operation. For example, a DOM Element cannot be converted to Document Fragment
action: Pass a valid node type for the conversion.

description: A wrong or null XML element is being inserted.
cause: The XML element being inserted was NULL or was different from the element expected by the insert operation (for example, function INSERTCHILDXML).
action: Ensure that the XML element being inserted is not NULL and that it matches the element indicated by the insert operation.

description: DOM Nodes do not belong to the same DOM Document
cause: The specified PL/SQL DOM Node does not belong to the parent DOM Document of the referring DOM Node.
action: Ensure that both the DOM Nodes are part of the same DOM Document.

description: Document contains too many nodes
cause: Unable to load the document because it has exceeded the maximum allocated number of DOM nodes.
action: Reduces the size of the document.

description: cannot add node '%s' (type='%s') to simple type node '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to add attribute or element nodes to a simple type against the schema definition. But, a simple type can only have special attributes like namespaces or xsi:nil.
action: Add a node complying with the simple type.
params: 1) node_name: The node added to the simple type node. 2) node_type: The node type added to the simple type node. 3) simple_type_node: The node that is the simple type node.

description: The specified printing option is invalid.
cause: The printing option specified in the operation was invalid.
action: Use a valid printing option for the operation.

description: Resource %s is not a version-controlled resource.
cause: Either one of the following was the cause: - Checkout was requested for a resource that was not under version control. Only version-controlled resources can be checked out. - Checkout was requested for a row of a non-versioned table.
action: Put the resource under version-control before checking out.

description: Resource %s is already checked out.
cause: Checkout was requested for a resource that is already checked out of the workspace by the same or a different user.
action: Check in the resource from the workspace before checking out.

description: Resource %s has not been checked out.
cause: An attempt was made to check in or uncheck out a resource that was not checked out by a user in a workspace.
action: Check out the resource from the workspace before checking in.

description: Resource %s cannot be put under WEBDAV version control.
cause: The VERSIONING feature was specified for a resource type that did not support it.
action: Remove the VERSIONING feature from the resource, and retry the operation.

description: Resource %s is already deleted
cause: Access a version-controlled resource that is already deleted.
action: Recreate the resource. Remove the cyclic definitions in the type and retry compilation.

description: XML node '%s' of type '%s' does not support this operation.
cause: The given node's type is not supported for this operation. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
action: Use a valid node type for the operation.

description: XML nodes over the limit %s in size cannot be printed.
cause: An attempt was made to use either an XML text node with a size greater than 64K or an XML comment node with a size greater than 4K. These cannot be printed. For example, trying to add children to an attribute node, or passing in a document node as a child, are unsupported operations.
action: Use getClobVal() or getStringVal() to print the document.
params: 1) limit_value: The size limit in bytes.

description: error in processing file %s
cause: An error occurred while operating on the specified file. A possible cause is that the file header is corrupt.
action: Ensure that the specified file is correct. Examine the next error on the stack and take the appropriate action.

description: Mismatch in the number of bytes transferred due to non-binary mode.
cause: An error occurred while reading the specified file. The error might have occurred due to the transfer that was initiated in ASCII mode.
action: Ensure that the transfer mode is set to BINARY.

description: warning in processing file %s
cause: A warning was raised while operating on the specified file. However, the current operation was completed successfully.
action: This is primarily an informational message. Look at the next error on the stack to obtain further information.

description: Invalid ACL Argument
cause: A System Constraining ACL was passed as one of the arguments to this function.
action: Please ensure that none of the aclid arguments are for the System Constraining ACL. ////////////////////////// DBMS_LDAP & OiD messages

description: DBMS_LDAP: generic error: %s
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP package.
action: Please report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: LDAP client/server error: %s
cause: There is a problem either on the LDAP server or on the client.
action: Please report this error to the LDAP server administrator or your Database administrator.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Init Failed.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP Init operation.
action: Please check the host name and port number, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Session.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP bind operation.
action: Please check the session handler that you use for binding, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Auth method.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP bind operation.
action: Please check the authentication credentials that you use for binding, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP search scope.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP search operation.
action: Please check the search scope that you use for search, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP search time value.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP search operation.
action: Please check the search time value that you use for search, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP Message.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP message that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - LDAP count_entry error.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP count_entry operation.
action: Please check the LDAP count_operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - LDAP get_dn error.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP get_dn operation.
action: Please check the LDAP get_dn, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP entry dn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the entry dn that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod_array.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP mod_array that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod option.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
action: Please check the LDAP mod option that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod type.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
action: Please check the LDAP mod type that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP mod value.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP populate_mod_array operation.
action: Please check the LDAP mod value that you use for LDAP populate_mod_array operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP rdn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP rdn value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP newparent.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP rename_s operation.
action: Please check the LDAP newparent value that you use for LDAP rename_s operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP deleteoldrdn.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP rename_s operation.
action: Please check the LDAP deleteoldrdn value that you use for LDAP rename_s operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP notypes.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP explode_dn or explode_rdn operation.
action: Please check the LDAP notypes value that you use for LDAP explode_dn or explode_rdn operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL wallet location.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP sslwrl value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL wallet passwd.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP sslpasswd value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: PL/SQL - Invalid LDAP SSL authentication mode.
cause: There has been an error in the DBMS_LDAP operation.
action: Please check the LDAP sslauth value that you use for LDAP operation, or report the error number and description to Oracle Support.

description: DBMS_LDAP: cannot open more than %s LDAP server connections
cause: An attempt was made to open more than the maximum allowed LDAP server connections.
action: Free unused connections.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid LDAP session
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use an LDAP session which is not valid and might have already been closed.
action: Check the LDAP session handle in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid BER_ELEMENT
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a BER_ELEMENT which is not valid and might have already been freed.
action: Check the BER_ELEMENT in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: MOD_ARRAY size limit exceeded
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to add an element beyond the MOD_ARRAY size limit.
action: Increase the MOD_ARRAY size limit in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid LDAP MESSAGE handle
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use an LDAP MESSAGE handle which is not valid and might have already been freed.
action: Check the LDAP MESSAGE handle in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid MOD_ARRAY
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a MOD_ARRAY which is not valid and might have already been freed.
action: Check the MOD_ARRAY in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid input parameter
cause: An invalid argument has been passed by a PL/SQL module to a DBMS_LDAP subprogram
action: Check the input argument to the DBMS_LDAP subprogram in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: unable to dynamically allocate additional memory
cause: An error occurred during dynamic memory allocation from session heap.
action: Verify that adequate memory resources are available.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid PROPERTY_SET
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a PROPERTY_SET which is not valid and might have already been freed.
action: Check the PROPERTY_SET in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: invalid MOD_PROPERTY_SET
cause: An attempt was made by a PL/SQL module to use a MOD_PROPERTY_SET which is not valid and might have already been freed.
action: Check the MOD_PROPERTY_SET in PL/SQL module involving DBMS_LDAP.

description: DBMS_LDAP: Shared servers are not supported.
cause: The session executing functions from the DBMS_LDAP package is being handled by a shared server in the Database.
action: Use dedicated database sessions to execute functions in the DBMS_LDAP package.

description: Cannot contact LDAP server %s at port %d
cause: The LDAP server specified could not be contacted. This can happen if the server is down or inaccessible.
action: Contact the administrator of the LDAP server

description: DBMS_LDAP: missing or invalid scheduler credential
cause: An attempt was made to perform a simple username and password-based authentication to the directory server using a non-existent or an invalid scheduler credential. This error could also occur if the credential existed as a synonym and there was insufficient privileges on the base credential pointed to by the synonym.
action: Reissue the command using a scheduler credential object that exists or create a new credential object and then reissue the command. Do not qualify the credential name with a schema name. The credential name should be owned by the current user invoking the DBMS_LDAP method. If the credential is owned by a different user, create a synonym pointing to the credential, request the database administrator to grant EXECUTE privilege on the credential and then reissue the command.

description: change source %s is not an existing change source
cause: The caller did not use the name of an existing change source. The name given does not match the name of any existing change source.
action: Check the spelling of the change source name. Choose an existing change source.

description: unrecognized parameter %s
cause: Unrecognized parameter was detected.
action: Check for too many parameters in the call.

description: change table %s already contains a column %s
cause: Issued ALTER_CHANGE_TABLE with an add operation but a column by this name already exists in the specified table.
action: Check the names and call the procedure again.

description: all input parameters are null
cause: All input parameters are null. At least one property must be altered.
action: Call the procedure again, making sure that all the required parameters have been specified. Ensure that at least one parameter is not null. Refer to user documentation for the correct way of calling this procedure.

description: cannot make changes while change set %s is advancing
cause: The change set is currently advancing. Change sources related to an advancing change set cannot be altered. Change tables related to the advancing change set cannot be created, altered or dropped. Some or all the parameters of the change set cannot be altered while the set is advancing.
action: Wait until the change set has finished advancing, then reissue the command. If altering the change set, only the advance_enable parameter can be altered during an advance.

description: change source %s is referenced by a change set
cause: The operation cannot complete because this change source is referenced by one or more change sets.
action: Drop the change sets first, then re-issue the command. May have to drop some change tables before the change sets are dropped.

description: end_date must be greater than the begin_date
cause: The end data of the change set is earlier than the begin date. The end date must always be later in time than the begin date, so that the duration between the begin and end dates is a positive amount of time.
action: Change the begin date and/or the end date, so that the end date is later than the begin date.

description: invalid value specified for begin_scn or end_scn
cause: The begin_scn was not greater than zero. The end_scn was less than zero. The end_scn was less than the begin_scn.
action: Check the values of both begin_scn and end_scn. Correct them to make sure that they form a legal SCN range. An end_scn value of zero indicates an infinite scn range.

description: One or more values for input parameters are incorrect.
cause: One or more of the inputs to the procedure had invalid values.
action: Identify the bad parameters and supply correct values to the procedure.

description: change set %s is not an existing change set
cause: Could not find an existing change set by this name.
action: Check the spelling of the change set name. Call the procedure again, passing the correct change set name.

description: change set %s is referenced by a change table
cause: The operation cannot be performed because the change set contains one or more change tables.
action: You will need to drop the change table(s) first, then repeat the operation

description: change set %s is disabled and cannot be advanced
cause: The specified change set is disabled. The change set needs to be enabled for the operation to succeed.
action: Determine why the change set is disabled and correct this condition. Alter the change set specifying 'y' for advance_enable then retry the operation.
