description: data mining model export failed, job name=%s, error=%s
cause: The model export job failed.
action: Check export job settings as required by DataPump.

description: data mining model import failed, job name=%s, error=%s
cause: The model import job failed.
action: Check import job settings as required by DataPump.

description: must specify a valid ID column name when setting %s is provided
cause: The training data is transactional. A valid ID column must be specified.
action: Specify a valid ID column name as input.

description: model is currently in use by another process
cause: The model is currently in use by another process.
action: Retry if necessary.

description: model upgrade/downgrade must be performed by SYS
cause: Upgrade/Downgrade routines are being invoked by a user with insufficient privilieges.
action: Run the routines as SYS during migration.

description: invalid transformation attribute
cause: Transformation list provided to CREATE_MODEL has duplicate or NULL attributes. Case ID or target attribute has attribute_subname that is not NULL. Attribute provided to ALTER_REVERSE_EXPRESSION does not exist in the model.
action: Remove NULLs and duplicates and fix case ID and target attributes or provide a valid attribute for a given model.

description: scoring cost matrix already exists
cause: The model already has a scoring cost matrix.
action: To add a new scoring cost matrix the existing one should be removed first.

description: scoring cost matrix not found
cause: The model does not have a scoring cost matrix.
action: To remove a scoring cost matrix the model should have one.

description: invalid transformation expression
cause: The expression had syntax or semantic errors.
action: Provide a valid expression.

description: transactional input incompatible with specified algorithm
cause: Training data in transactional format is not accepted for model creation using the specified mining algorithm.
action: Pivot the data into 2D tabular format, or provide the transactional input through a nested table column.

description: transactional input - incompatible datatype for column %s
cause: The data type of the column in the input training data is not supported.
action: Cast or change the type of the column to one of CHAR, VARCHAR, NUMBER or FLOAT

description: transactional input - case id should be provided with id %s
cause: The training data is transactional by virtue of presence of a and item id - but does not have a case id specification.
action: Specify a valid case id column name as input

description: reverse expression incompatible with model cost matrix
cause: A cost matrix existed for this model with actual and predicted values which were inconsistent with the values resulting from the specified reverse transformation.
action: Either remove the cost matrix table and re-add it with the new actual and predicted values, or respecify the reverse transformation to be consistent with the existing cost matrix.

description: invalid setting value for setting ASSO_AGGREGATES: %s
cause: The setting ASSO_AGGREGATES was not valid.
action: Specify valid aggregates column names.

description: number of aggregates %s exceeded the maximum of permitted of 10
cause: Too many aggregates were specified in the ASSO_AGGREGATES setting.
action: Reduce the number of aggregates. A maximum of 10 aggregates are allowed.
params: 1) number_of_aggregates: The number of aggregates specified in the ASSO_AGGREGATES setting.

description: duplicate case IDs in training table
cause: The same value occurred more than once in the case ID column of the training table.
action: Eliminate the duplicate case IDs in the training table.

description: invalid linear algebra shared library %s
cause: The shared library containing platform-optimized linear algebra routines was not loaded.
action: Verify that the shared library is correctly installed.

description: too many different categorical predictor and target values in training data
cause: The count of row instances associated with every possible unique target and predictor value combination in the training data has become too sparse to produce valid results.
action: Consider reducing the number of unique categorical predictor and target values in the training data.

description: the vectors should have the same dimension
cause: The vectors have different dimensions.
action: Make sure the vectors have the same dimension.

description: The initial centroid vector dimension is incorrect.
cause: The initial centroid vectors have different dimensions than the input data.
action: Ensure that the initial centroid vectors have the same dimension as the input data.

description: the vector dimension of centroid table and input data are mismatched
cause: The dimension of centroid table did not match the dimension of the input data.
action: Make sure the centroid table have the same dimension as the input data.

description: incorrect schema for %s
cause: The centroid table or initial centroid table whose name being specified in the settings did not match the required schema. A centroid table and an initial centroid table should have the schema (centroid_id, centroid_vector) for non-partitioned model, and have the schema (partition_id, centroid_id, centroid_vector) for partitioned model.
action: Modify the schema of the centroid table or initial centroid table so that it matches with the ones provided here in the Cause section, and also as provided in the documentation.

description: No meaningful partitions were found due to numeric overflows.
cause: Extreme values in the input data resulted in numeric overflows.
action: Consider using cosine distance or scale the input data appropriately.

description: The vector precision of centroid table and input data are mismatched.
cause: The precision of the centroid table does not match the precision of the input data.
action: Ensure that the centroid table has the same precision as the input data.

description: Vector type is not supported.
cause: Vector type columns are not supported for this feature.
action: Modify the code to avoid usage of the feature.

description: For Explicit Semantic Analysis with embedding size %s, the number of rows in the input data cannot exceed %s.
cause: Input data contains too many rows for Explicit Semantic Analysis with embedding enabled.
action: Either shrink the data to include fewer number of rows, decrease the embedding size, or disable embedding.
params: 1) embedding_size: The number of embedding specified in the ESAS_EMBEDDING_SIZE setting. 2) rows: The maximum number of rows allowed in the input data.

description: Sparse vectors are not supported.
cause: The data includes sparse vector columns that are not supported.
action: Ensure that there are no sparse vector columns in the data.

description: Binary vector format is not supported.
cause: Binary vector format is not supported.
action: Use a different format other than BINARY for vector columns in the data.

description: The vectors should have the same precision.
cause: The vectors have different precisions.
action: Ensure that the vectors have the same precision.

description: no support vectors were found
cause: The input data is non-predictive in nature, or one of the input settings is incorrect/incompatible with respect to the input data.
action: Provide additional data or change model setting value.

description: no target values were found
cause: No target values were identified during load.
action: Validate that the target is correctly specified.

description: no target counter examples were found
cause: One or more of the target classes have only positive examples.
action: Provide counter examples or remove that target class.

description: Priors or weights cannot be specified for one-class models.
cause: Priors or weights were specified.
action: Do not specify priors or weights for one-class models.

description: specified priors or weights table has an incorrect schema
cause: The priors or class weights table whose name was specified in the settings did not have the prescribed schema. A priors table should have the schema (target_value, prior_probability) and a class weights table should have the schema (target_value, class_weight).
action: Modify the schema of the input priors or class weights table so that it matches with the ones provided here in the Cause section, and also as provided in the documentation.

description: The initial centroid vector precision is incorrect.
cause: The initial centroid vectors have different precisions than the input data.
action: Ensure that the initial centroid vectors have the same precision as the input data.

description: FLEX vector dimension and precision are not supported for %s.
cause: The centroid table or initial centroid table whose name is being specified in the settings has either FLEX vector dimension or precision for non-partitioned model or vertical-partitioned model.
action: Ensure that the centroid table or initial centroid table has a fixed dimension and precision vector column for non-partitioned model or vertical-partitioned model.
params: table_name: KMNS_CENTROID_TABLE for centroid table and KMNS_INIT_CENTROID_TABLE for initial centroid table.

description: input data for model build contains negative values
cause: The input data contains negative values, which is not acceptable for a Non-negative Matrix Factorization model.
action: Provide clean data for build without any negative values.

description: NMF: number of features not between [1, %s]
cause: The number of requested features must be greater than 1, and less than the smaller of the number of attributes and the number of cases in the dataset.
action: Specify the desired number of features within the acceptable range.

description: no meaningful matrix factorization found
cause: Input data was not significantly different from 0.
action: Check your data for problems or add a positive constant to all the numeric attributes.

description: number of mining attributes (%s) exceeds maximum (%s)
cause: Input data was found to contain a number of mining attributes exeeding the maximum allowed.
action: Check the input data for categorical fields with high cardinality.

description: no statistically significant features were found
cause: Input data inadequate in volume and/or quality to derive statistically significant predictors for building a data mining model.
action: Provide a well-prepared training data set.

description: apply rules prohibited for this model mode
cause: Adaptive Bayes Network rules are only generated for SingleFeature ABN models
action: Rebuild model in SingleFeature mode and then apply with rules.

description: invalid model type %s for Adaptive Bayes Network algorithm
cause: The valid values for the abns_model_type settings are: abns_multi_feature, abns_single_feature, abns_naive_bayes.
action: Use a valid value for the abns_model_type setting.

description: the Adaptive Bayes Network algorithm is desupported
cause: An attempt was made to score an Adaptive Bayes Network model.
action: Drop the existing model and build a new model using a supported classification algorithm.

description: invalid model name
cause: A model name is invalid or does not exist.
action: Check spelling. A valid model name must begin with a letter and may contain only alphanumeric characters and the special characters $, _, and #. The name must be less than or equal to 30 characters and cannot be a reserved word.

description: invalid cost matrix
cause: Cost matrix specification is invalid.
action: Provide valid cost matrix specification. Check syntax for data mining functions.

description: missing cost matrix
cause: Cost matrix specification is missing.
action: Provide valid cost matrix specification. Check syntax for data mining functions.

description: model does not exist
cause: The model entered does not exist.
action: Check spelling.

description: label not in the model
cause: The user-specified label was not present in the model.
action: Provide a valid label. The set of valid labels can be retrieved from a classification model by invoking PREDICTION_SET, from a clustering model by invoking CLUSTER_SET, and from a feature extraction model by invoking FEATURE_SET.

description: remote operations not permitted on mining models
cause: An attempt was made to perform queries or DML operations on remote tables using local mining models.
action: Remove the reference to remote tables in the statement.

description: invalid data for model - cosine distance out of bounds
cause: The norm computed using attribute values from the incoming row for the cosine model is outside the range 0-1.
action: Remove or correct the data in the offending row.

description: event to debug and trace mining model load
cause: N/A
action: Level 1 - force 4031 during shared model load Level 2 - trace model load info

description: duplicate attributes provided for data mining function
cause: A duplicate, non-nested attribute was provided as input to the data mining function. A duplicate attribute is one which is present in the model signature, occurs more than once in the USING clause after tablename expansion, and is not a collection element in a nested table column.
action: Eliminate the duplicate attribute(s).

description: model incompatible with data mining function
cause: The supplied model cannot be operated upon by the data mining function because the model is built for a mining function and/ or based on an algorithm that is incompatible with function.
action: Provide the name of the model suitable for the function.

description: model cost not available
cause: The supplied model was assumed to have been built with a cost matrix specification, when in reality, it was not.
action: Provide a model name that corresponds to a model that was built with an appropriate cost matrix specification.

description: confidence level must be greater than 0 and less than 1
cause: The specified value for confidence level is out of range.
action: Specify a value for confidence level in the range 0 < level < 1

description: input class is invalid for the specified predictive model
cause: The specified model is either not a classification model, or does not have the input class label as one of its target values.
action: Provide the correct target value (class label) or provide the appropriate classification model with the target attribute that has the specified class label as one of its values.

description: corrupted model
cause: The model object was in an inconsistent state.
action: Drop the corrupted model.

description: model does not fit in system global area
cause: The model was too large to fit in shared memory.
action: No action is needed. The model is automatically loaded to program global area (PGA).

description: invalid cost matrix specification
cause: A valid cost matrix is not specified.
action: Consult documentation for valid cost matrix specification.

description: invalid classname %s in cost matrix specification
cause: Actual or predicted classname specified is not present in training data
action: Provide valid classname(s) in cost matrix specification

description: invalid prior probability specification
cause: Valid prior probabilities not specified. Valid probabilities should be between 0 and 1.
action: Consult documentation for valid prior probability specification.

description: invalid classname %s in prior probability specification
cause: Actual or predicted classname specified is not present in training data.
action: Provide valid classname(s) in prior probability specification.

description: invalid impurity metric specified
cause: Impurity metric specified is not valid. Examples of valid metrics are TREE_IMPURITY_GINI, TREE_IMPURITY_ENTROPY.
action: Consult documentation for valid impurity metrics and specification.

description: dm_nested types not supported by this algorithm
cause: The training input to the CREATE_MODEL routine contained one or more columns of DM_NESTED type (DM_NESTED_NUMERICALS or DM_NESTED_CATEGORICALS). These columns are currently not supported by Orthogonal Partitioning Clustering (O-Cluster).
action: Remove columns of these data types from the input data source.

description: nested attribute combined name and value too long
cause: The data that was presented to the decision tree algorithm was too long. The length is computed from the sum of the length of the nested attribute name and the length of the attribute value.
action: Reduce the length of the attribute name or reduce the length of the categorical value (perhaps by recoding).

description: RFOR_MTRY is greater than attribute count or negative or 0
cause: The setting for RFOR_MTRY was either 0 or >= number of attributes. The default behavior in this scenario is to use all of the attributes for the model build.
action: Consider a different value for RFOR_MTRY.

description: The Random Forest sample size exceeds available memory.
cause: The sample did not fit into available memory.
action: No action needed. The sample size was adjusted automatically to fit into memory.

description: Number of features and distinct target values is too high
cause: The data has too many features, possibly due to multiple text or nested predictors, and too many distinct target values for the available memory.
action: Remove one or more of the text or nested predictors or reduce the number of distinct targets and retry.

description: invalid bin number, is zero or negative value
cause: Input bin number has zero or negative values.
action: Provide positive bin numbers starting from 1.

description: bin number too large
cause: Bin number is too large.
action: Reprocess build data by choosing smaller bin numbers.

description: Attribute %s has too many distinct values (%s)
cause: Exceeded maximum number of distinct values allowed in an attribute.
action: Bin numerical data with fewer than 1024 bins or recode categorical data with fewer than 1024 unique values.

description: All rows contain the same data
cause: All rows contained the same data and could not be clustered using k-Means with cosine distance metric.
action: Use Euclidean distance metric.

description: maximum number of clusters exceeded
cause: The maximum number of clusters was exceeded.
action: Reduce the number of clusters.

description: no mining attributes after filtering
cause: All mining attributes were filtered out.
action: Disable attribute filtering.

description: access violation on model storage object
cause: An attempt was made to directly access/modify a schema object that stores model metadata and content.
action: Perform all mining operations (create,drop,alter, and select using data mining functions) against named model objects. Contact your DBA or Oracle Support if you suspect that an orphaned schema object.

description: model was not correctly upgraded
cause: An attempt was made to use a model, but the model was not correctly upgraded to the current release. This is most likely caused by importing a model from an old release without upgrading it, but could also be caused by a failed database upgrade.
action: Invoke the SYS.DMP_SYS.UPGRADE_MODELS() procedure.

description: invalid version specified in UPGRADE_MODELS
cause: An invalid version was specified when invoking the UPGRADE_MODELS procedure. Valid values for the version are 10.2.0, 11.0.0, 12.0.0, and NULL.
action: Specify a valid version for UPGRADE_MODELS.

description: One or more models exist that cannot be downgraded
cause: There are data mining models in the database that were created in a release beyond the selected release for downgrade.
action: Prior to downgrade, drop data mining models that cannot be downgraded to the selected release.

description: invalid object privilege specified for the mining model
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a mining model.
action: Only SELECT and ALTER object privileges are valid for mining models. Do not attempt to grant or revoke any other object privileges on mining models.

description: invalid object "%s"."%s" specified in the GRANT statement
cause: An attempt was made to grant a privilege on an invalid object.
action: Ensure that the dependents of the object are valid before attempting to grant a privilege on an object.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner of the object. 2) object_name: The name of the object.

description: An attempt to grant administrative privileges to SYS user failed.
cause: An attempt was made to grant SYSOPER or SYSDBA privileges to SYS user. These administrative privileges cannot be granted to SYS, since SYS always has SYSOPER and SYSDBA privileges.
action: Grant administrative privileges to users other than SYS.

description: Use of BECOME USER functionality is restricted.
cause: This is an internal error message.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: cannot lock SYS user in current password file format
cause: An attempt was made to lock the SYS user account by executing the DDL statement ALTER USER SYS ACCOUNT LOCK while the password file was created in LEGACY or 12 format.
action: The password file must be created in 12.2 format to support granting administrative privileges to external users and enable SSL and Kerberos authentication for administrative users.

description: Administrative privilege cannot be granted to this user.
cause: An attempt was made to grant administrative privilege to a user who has been created with NONE as its authentication type. Such grants are not allowed.
action: Do not grant administrative privilege to user with NONE as its AUTHENTICATION_TYPE in DBA_USERS view.

description: An Administrative user cannot be altered to have no authentication type.
cause: An attempt was made to alter an administrative user to have no authentication type.
action: Revoke administrative privilege from the user before attempting to alter the user.

description: User who can be connected to by another user as a proxy user cannot be marked as dictionary protected.
cause: An attempt was made to mark a user as dictionary protected. However, this user can be connected to by another user as a proxy user and such a user is not allowed to be marked as dictionary protected.
action: Revoke connection through proxy from the user and retry the operation.

description: Only NO AUTHENTICATION user can be marked as dictionary protected.
cause: An attempt was made to add dictionary protection to a user with AUTHENTICATION_TYPE set to a value other than NONE. Query SELECT USERNAME,AUTHENTICATION_TYPE FROM DBA_USERS to confirm that the user has an AUTHENTICATION_TYPE other than NONE. Only database users with AUTHENTICATION_TYPE=NONE can be configured with dictionary protection.
action: Find the correct user with AUTHENTICATION_TYPE=NONE by running SELECT USERNAME,AUTHENTICATION_TYPE FROM DBA_USERS or change the user to have no authentication type. If the user has a database password, run ALTER USER <user name> NO AUTHENTICATION.

description: IDENTIFIED clause not allowed for user marked as dictionary protected
cause: The IDENTIFIED clause was used for a user that has been marked as dictionary protected.
action: Disable DICTIONARY PROTECTION on the user and retry the operation.

description: Cannot connect as a dictionary protected user.
cause: The connect was done with a user that has been marked as dictionary protected.
action: Disable DICTIONARY PROTECTION on the user and retry the connection.

description: ACCOUNT UNLOCK not allowed for a user marked as dictionary protected.
cause: ACCOUNT UNLOCK was used for a user who had been marked as dictionary protected.
action: Disable DICTIONARY PROTECTION and retry ACCOUNT UNLOCK operation.

description: only CREATE, CREATE ANY, ALTER, DROP are valid for property graph
cause: An attempt was made to grant or revoke an invalid privilege on a property graph.
action: Do not attempt to grant or revoke any privilege besides CREATE, CREATE ANY, ALTER, or DROP on property graphs.

description: Dictionary protection feature is supported for only Oracle maintained users.
cause: A non Oracle maintained user attempted to use the dictionary protection feature.
action: Use the dictionary protection feature for only Oracle maintained users.

description: Dictionary protection feature is not supported for SYS user.
cause: An attempt was made to mark SYS user as dictionary protected.
action: SYS user cannot be marked as dictionary protected. Retry the operation specifying a different user.

description: Invalid field specification for: %s
cause: The derived field was incorrectly defined.
action: Ensure that the field is correctly defined in the PMML document.

description: More than one linear regression equation in the model
cause: More than one linear regression equation was in the model.
action: Ensure that there is only one linear regression equation in the model.

description: No model found in PMML document
cause: There was no model found in the PMML document.
action: Ensure that the PMML document contains a model section.

description: Only one model allowed in PMML document
cause: More than one model existed in the PMML document.
action: PMML model import only supports one model per PMML document. Ensure that only one model exists in the PMML document.

description: Target has more than two categories
cause: The target contained more than two categories.
action: PMML model import supports only binary logistic regression. Ensure that the target contains no more than two categories.

description: NormContinuous must include at least two LinearNorm elements
cause: NormContinuous included less than two LinearNorm elements.
action: NormContinuous must include at least two LinearNorm elements. Ensure that at least two LinearNorm elements are included.

description: Invalid interval for Discretize field: %s
cause: The intervals were incorrect.
action: Ensure that that both margins are not missing.

description: Unsupported feature in PMML document: %s
cause: The feature was not supported by Predictive Model Markup Language (PMML) model import.
action: Ensure that you use the supported features.

description: Unsupported PMML transformation: %s
cause: The transformation was not supported.
action: Ensure that you use the supported transformations.

description: PMML DerivedField must have a unique name specified: %s
cause: "The Predictive Model Markup Language (PMML) DerivedField did not reference another defined field and did not have a unique name."
action: "Specify a unique name for each DerivedField."

description: PMML DerivedField depends on a undefined field: %s
cause: A DerivedField referenced an undefined field.
action: Ensure that the DerivedField references other defined fields.

description: PMML regression equation references an undefined field: %s
cause: The Predictive Model Markup Language (PMML) Regression equation did not reference defined fields. PMML Regression equation may only reference defined fields.
action: Ensure that all fields are defined.

description: categorical attributes are not supported by this algorithm
cause: The build data provided to the CREATE_MODEL routine contained one or more categorical attributes of types CHAR, VARCHAR2, or DM_NESTED_CATEGORICAL. These attributes are currently not supported for the SVD algorithm.
action: Remove the categorical attributes from the build data.

description: Cannot output U matrix without a valid case identifier column.
cause: A U matrix was requested, but there was no case identifier column in the build data.
action: Provide a non-null case identifier column in the build data.

description: model does not have any valid features
cause: All singular values in the SVD model were equal to zero. This can occur if the build data contains only zeros or all build columns have constant values and automatic data preparation is turned on.
action: Inspect and modify the build data.

description: approximate computation cannot be disabled for the build data
cause: The build data had a very high number of attributes. An SVD model can be built only by enabling approximate computation.
action: Enable approximate computation.

description: Full SVD solvers cannot be used for the build data.
cause: The build data had a very high number of attributes. A Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) model cannot be built using full SVD solvers.
action: Select a truncated SVD solver.

description: missing text policy name
cause: The text policy name was either missing or invalid.
action: Provide a valid text policy name created using CTX_DDL.CREATE_POLICY().

description: TEXT attribute types not supported by this algorithm
cause: The training input to the CREATE_MODEL routine contained one or more attributes of TEXT type. These attributes are currently not supported by Orthogonal Partitioning Clustering (O-Cluster).
action: Remove attributes of these types from the input data source.

description: Extraction of tokens from text failed.
cause: Extraction of tokens from an attribute of TEXT type failed.
action: Check the text policy, policy owner, other settings for TEXT type, and computer resources.

description: JSON syntax error
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had invalid syntax and could not be parsed.
action: Provide JSON data with valid syntax.

description: JSON path expression syntax error ('%s')%s
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression had invalid syntax and could not be parsed.
action: Specify a JSON path expression with the correct syntax.
params: 1) path_string: The JSON path string. 2) error_message: A detailed error message string.

description: unsupported JSON path expression
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression contained unsupported features.
action: Remove unsupported features from JSON path expression.

description: JSON processing error
cause: The requested JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation failed.
action: Ensure that the JSON operation is invoked correctly.

description: unsupported JSON operation
cause: The requested JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation was not supported.
action: None.

description: expecting keyword STREAM
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator expected the keyword STREAM.
action: Add the keyword STREAM to the JSON operator.

description: expecting PASSING clause
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator expected a PASSING clause.
action: Add a PASSING caluse to the JSON operator.

description: expecting RETURNING clause
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) function expected a RETURNING clause.
action: Add a RETURNING clause to the JSON function.

description: invalid data type for return value
cause: The provided data type for the return value was invalid or unsupported.
action: Provide a supported return value.

description: invalid or unsupported ON ERROR option
cause: The specified ON ERROR option is invalid or not supported in this operation.
action: Provide a valid ON ERROR option. Common options are ERROR ON ERROR, NULL ON ERROR, or DEFAULT <literal> ON ERROR.

description: invalid default value provided
cause: The provided default value was not valid.
action: Provide a valid default value.

description: default value not matching type defined in RETURNING clause
cause: The specified default value did not match the type defined in the RETURNING clause.
action: Ensure that the default value and RETURNING clause are of the same type.

description: JSON operator syntax error
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator had invalid syntax.
action: Provide JSON operator with correct syntax.

description: path expression not a literal
cause: The provided path expression was not a literal (a constant).
action: Provide a constant path expression.

description: value for DEFAULT clause not a constant
cause: The specified default value for the DEFAULT clause was not a runtime constant.
action: Specify a SQL literal or a bind variable for the DEFAULT value.

description: JSON path '%s' evaluated to non-scalar value.
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression selected an object or array when a scalar value was expected.
action: Correct the JSON path expression or use JSON_QUERY.

description: JSON path expression contained an invalid array index ('%s')%s
cause: The provided JSON path expression contained an invalid array index.
action: Provide a valid array index. The first element in the array has the index 0.
params: 1) error_code: The JZN error code. 2) error_position: Line and position of error within path string.

description: JSON_EXISTS used outside predicate
cause: The operator JSON_EXISTS was used outside of a predicate.
action: Use JSON_EXISTS inside a predicate. For instance, by embedding it inside a CASE expression or WHERE clause.

description: output value too large (actual: %s, maximum: %s)
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator generated a result which exceeded the maximum length specified in the RETURN clause.
action: Increase the maximum size of the data type in the RETURNING clause or use a CLOB/BLOB in the RETURNING clause.

description: default value too large
cause: The specified default value exceeded the maximum length specified in the RETURNING clause.
action: Increase the maximum size of the data type in the RETURNING clause or reduce the length of the default value.

description: Unsupported character set
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator does not supported the current database character set.
action: Chose a different database character set, for instance AL32UTF8, AL16UTF16, or a single byte character set.

description: JSON path '%s' evaluated to no value.
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression did not select a value.
action: Correct the JSON path expression.

description: JSON_QUERY only can use min()/max() aggregate trail functions
cause: The provided trail function cannot be used in JSON_QUERY.
action: Remove the provided trail function and use min()/max() aggregate trail functions only.

description: JSON PASSING clause contained duplicate variable name '%s'.
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) PASSING clause contained duplicate variable names.
action: Rename the duplicate variables and ensure that each variable name is unique within the PASSING clause.
params: 1) variable_name: The name of the variable.

description: Multivalue index processing error.
cause: The requested multivalue index (MVI) operation failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Invalid parameter in IS [NOT] JSON predicate
cause: The IS [NOT] JSON predicate containes an invalid parameter.
action: Remove or correct the parameter.

description: JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() cannot be evaluated without a JSON-enabled context index
cause: There was no JavaScript Object Notation (JSON)-enabled context index available.
action: Create a JSON-enabled context index.

description: First input parameter to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() must be a column.
cause: The first input parameter to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() was not a column.
action: Pass a column to the first input parameter to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS().

description: JSON path expression in JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() is invalid
cause: A predicate or array position was used in JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression, or the length of a JSON field name in the path expression exceeded the JSON search index token length limit.
action: Neither use a predicate or array position in a JSON path expression nor a step with length longer than the JSON search index token length limit.

description: JSON query '%s' evaluated to multiple values.
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression selected more than one value.
action: Correct the JSON path expression or use JSON_QUERY.

description: selected value not JSON array or object
cause: The selected value was not a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) value. (object or array)
action: Use CAST AS ARRAY to return this value.

description: invalid escape sequence in JSON data
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had an invalid escape sequence.
action: Provide JSON data with corrected escape sequence.

description: duplicate key names '%s' in JSON object
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had duplicate key names in one object.
action: Provide JSON data with unique key names in each JSON object.

description: invalid UTF-8 byte sequence in JSON data
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had an invalid UTF-8 byte sequence.
action: Specify JSON data with the corrected UTF-8 byte sequence or escape the characters.

description: JSON data nested too many levels
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had too many levels of nesting.
action: Provide JSON data with fewer levels of nesting.

description: JSON key too long
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data that was provided had a key which exceeded the maximum length.
action: Provide JSON data with shorter key names.

description: internal JSON error '%s'
cause: There was an internal error in the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) processing layer.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: output value too large (maximum: %s)
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator generated a result which exceeds the maximum length specified in the RETURN clause.
action: Increase the maximum size of the data type in the RETURNING clause or use a CLOB or BLOB in the RETURNING clause.

description: internal JSON serializer error
cause: There was an internal error in the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) serializer.
action: Contact Oracle Support if the error persists.

description: JSON array wrapper needed for result of JSON query '%s'
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expressions selected a result that can only be returned inside an array.
action: Add WITH ARRAY WRAPPER to the JSON function.

description: ASCII or PRETTY not supported for non-textual return data type.
cause: Attempted to PRETTY print or escape non-ASCII characters for a non-textual output of a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation.
action: Change return data type to VARCHAR2 or CLOB or remove the PRETTY or ASCII serialization option.

description: JSON_TEXTCONTAINS used outside of the predicate of a WHERE clause.
cause: JSON_TEXTCONTAINS was used outside of the predicate of a WHERE clause.
action: Use JSON_TEXTCONTAINS inside of a predicate of a WHERE clause or remove the JSON_TEXTCONTAINS.

description: incorrect search string to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS()
cause: An incorrect search string to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() was used.
action: The search string to JSON_TEXTCONTAINS() needs to be a non-zero length compile time constant.

description: invalid data type for JSON_TABLE column '%s'
cause: A column in the provided JSON_TABLE had an unsupported data type.
action: Provide a supported data type.

description: keyword PRETTY not valid for column "%s"
cause: A JSON_TABLE column could not be pretty-printed because it had no JSON_QUERY semantics.
action: Change the column semantics to JSON_QUERY or remove the keyword PRETTY.

description: array wrapper not valid for column %s
cause: A JSON_TABLE column used the ARRAY WRAPPER clause where it was not allowed because the column did not have JSON_QUERY semantics.
action: Change the column semantics to JSON_QUERY or remove the array wrapper.

description: invalid usage of keyword EXISTS
cause: A JSON_TABLE column with JSON_EXISTS semantics had invalid parameters.
action: Remove the invalid parameters.

description: invalid ON ERROR clause for column "%s"
cause: An ON ERROR clause was provided that was not valid for the selected column semantics.
action: Change or remove the ON ERROR clause or change the column semantics.

description: keyword ASCII not valid for column "%s"
cause: The column did not have JSON_VALUE or JSON_QUERY semantics and and did not allow the ASCII printing option.
action: Change the column semantics to JSON_VALUE or JSON_QUERY or remove the keyword ASCII.

description: COLUMNS clause required
cause: The provided JSON_TABLE row source did not specify a COLUMNS clause.
action: Provide a COLUMNS clause and then retry the operation.

description: invalid input data type for JSON_TABLE
cause: The provided input to JSON_TABLE has an unsupported datatype.
action: Provide a (N)VARCHAR2, (N)CLOB, RAW, BLOB, or BFILE datatype input.

description: invalid definition in JSON_TABLE for column "%s"
cause: A column definition inside JSON_TABLE was invalid.
action: Correct the column definition.

description: invalid option or parameter in JSON_TABLE for column "%s"
cause: The specified JSON_TABLE definition contained an invalid option or parameter near the column referred to in the error message.
action: Correct the JSON_TABLE definition.

description: error during execution of JSON_TABLE
cause: The provided JSON_TABLE definition could not be evaluated.
action: Correct the JSON_TABLE definition.

description: internal error in JSON_TABLE
cause: The provided JSON_TABLE definition could not be evaluated due to an unexpected internal error.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: too many keys for JSON_OBJECTAGG
cause: The number of rows in a JSON_OBJECTAGG aggregation group exceeded the maximum number of keys for a JSON object.
action: Reduce the number of rows in each group, or remove the WITH UNIQUE KEYS check.

description: Only one ordinality column is permitted.
cause: The provided JSON_TABLE definition contained more than one ordinality column.
action: Remove the extra ordinality column or columns from the JSON_TABLE definition.

description: binary format requested for non-binary data type
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) format was binary but the input data type was not binary.
action: Either change the format clause or use an input of binary data type.

description: no format defined for binary data type
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) input was of binary type but a format was not defined.
action: Define a format for binary input.

description: general event for JSON operations
cause: This is a general event for JSON operations.
action: None necessary; this is an Oracle internal event code.

description: cannot open an encrypted log file
cause: An attempt was made to open a log file that has been encrypted for storage and management by the Oracle Availability Machine. Only the processes involved in shipping such a log to or from the Oracle Availability Machine can open the log.
action: Allow the Oracle Availability Machine to manage the log file.

description: file %s created before last CREATE CONTROLFILE, could not proceed with recovery
cause: An attempt at media recovery found that the data file already existed before the last CREATE CONTROLFILE statement was executed. The information needed for doing the media recovery was lost with the control file that existed when the data file was added to the database.
action: Restore a more recent backup of the data file and retry the recovery.

description: tablespace #%s has been dropped
cause: An attempt was made on the physical standby database to access the tablespace that was being dropped by Redo Apply. Note that the target tablespace was dropped on the primary database and the physical standby database was applying the redo that was generated at the primary database for the target tablespace drop.
action: None.

description: event to help in testing of Auto BMR to fix file header corruption
cause: Simulate an error in a file header in order to test automatic block media recovery support for file header fix.
action: Level is bitmap of file numbers.

description: The file header of data file %s is corrupt. Automatic block repair is trying to fix the file header.
cause: A corrupt data file header was encountered during a checkpoint.
action: Run the query after the data file header is fixed by the automatic block repair.

description: Abstract data type created on primary database. Need to wait for it to be replicated at standby database.
cause: Simulate an error to cause cursor recompilation at standby database.
action: No user action needed. This error is used internally during remote abstract data type creation

description: cursor compilation failed because %s
cause: Cursor compilation failed for the given reason.
action: Fix the condition that caused the failed cursor compilation and run the query again.
params: 1) reason: Explanation about why the cursor could not be compiled.

description: This type of file cannot be renamed.
cause: An attempt was made to rename a file for which renaming is not supported.
action: Do not attempt to rename files of this type.

description: Data file %s is not accessible to recovery.
cause: The data transfer cache was sent and rejected blocks for a file that was not accessible to the recovery. Either the file had not yet been added by the recovery or the file was offline.
action: No action is required. If the recovery adds the file or the standby media recovery is restarted after bringing the file online, then the data blocks are fetched automatically.

description: PDB recovery stopped at SCN %0!s, time %1!s, before reaching target time %2!s on an orphan database incarnation.
cause: The target time was on an orphan database incarnation and the pluggable database (PDB) recovery could not proceed further.
action: Examine if the current state of the pluggable database satisfies the requirement. If you indeed need the pluggable database to be recovered to the previously specified time, consider performing flashback or point-in-time recovery of the entire Container Database(CDB) to the target time.

description: not supported on standby database
cause: An attempt was made to reset the pluggable database (PDB) incarnation on the standby database.
action: This is an informational message only.

description: You may need to restore an older backup for recovery to orphan PDB incarnation
cause: Oracle can not verify that the specified file is a correct file for this database. This may be because Oracle is recovering to an orphan PDB incarnation.
action: Restore an older backup for this file. See alert log for additional details.

description: No source of foreign redo could be found for PDB %s.
cause: The named standby pluggable database was waiting for a new source pluggable database to be identified.
action: Try the action again once the role change to primary of the new source pluggable database has completed.

description: Cannot create a pluggable database restore point on standby when the pluggable database has orphaned from the primary.
cause: An attempt was made to create a pluggable database (PDB) restore point on the standby when the PDB had orphaned from the primary.
action: Restore and recover the pluggbale database to follow the primary and then attempt to create the restore point.

description: Insufficient privileges to perform media recovery.
cause: Media Recovery has been attempted without proper privileges.
action: Please connect as SYSBACKUP/SYSDG/SYSDBA for performing this operation.

description: exceeded maximum size for a JSON schema literal
cause: The maximum size permitted for a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) schema literal was exceeded.
action: Ensure that the JSON schema literal does not exceed the maximum size permitted

description: use of EJSON not allowed for this operation
cause: An extended JavaScript Object Notation (EJSON) document was used as an input to a JSON operation that does not support EJSON documents.
action: Ensure that the input is not using the EJSON format.

description: invalid alias definition
cause: A column alias was used in an expression that does not allow aliases.
action: Remove the column alias definition.

description: CHECK expression of '%s' constraint not possible to use as PRECHECK condition
cause: The CHECK constraint expression has no equivalent in the JSON schema definition.
action: Remove the PRECHECK keyword from the constraint definition.
params: 1) constraint: The constraint name for constraints named by the user or the constraint expression for constraints where the name is generated by the database.

description: The table intended to back the collection already exists.
cause: The table intended to back the collection already existed.
action: Ensure that the table intended to back the collection does not exist.

description: Error mapping the object as a collection. The mapped object has a column '%s' of length %s which is different from the %s length specified in the metadata.
cause: The mapped object had different sized columns than specified in the metadata.
action: Ensure that the column lengths specified in the collection metadata is equal to those of the object being mapped.

description: cannot set the precheck state for a non CHECK constraint
cause: The specified constraint is not a CHECK constraint. Only CHECK constraints can be set to one of the two precheck states: PRECHECK or NOPRECHECK.
action: Select another constraint that is a CHECK constraint and retry the statement.

description: Type mismatch for column: %s, expected type as specified in the metadata or defaulted: %s, actual type in the mapped object: %s
cause: The column type of the specified column in the collection metadata or as defaulted did not match the type of the corresponding column in the mapped table or view backing the collection.
action: Ensure that the column types of the columns specified in the collection metadata or defaulted match their type in the table or view backing the collection.

description: Specifying JSON data type for $orderby requires a collection with content column of type JSON and Oracle Database release 23c or later.
cause: $orderby data type is specified as JSON, but the collection did not have content column of type JSON or the Oracle Database release was not 23c or later.
action: To specify $orderby data type as JSON, ensure that the collection has a content column of type JSON and the Oracle Database release is 23c or later. Alternatively, specify a different data type for $orderby.

description: Aliases are not allowed for %s columns. Invalid alias definition for column '%s'
cause: A column alias was used in an expression that does not allow aliases.
action: Remove the column alias definition.
params: 1) directive_name: Name of the directive 2) column_name: Name of the column to which the user tried to assign an invalid alias

description: internal BSON/JSON conversion error [%s]
cause: BSON/JSON conversion failed with internal error.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: invalid data type
cause: The BSON/JSON converter was invoked with an invalid data type.
action: Ensure that both the input and output is of data type BLOB.

description: path expression with predicates not supported in this operation
cause: A path expression with predicates was specified in a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation that does not support predicates.
action: Only JSON_EXISTS supports predicates.

description: invalid input data type in PASSING clause for variable '%s'
cause: The specified PASSING clause had an unsupported data type.
action: Use a supported data type in the PASSING clause.
params: 1) variable_name: The unsupported SQL data type name.

description: bind variable missing in PASSING clause
cause: The PASSING clause contained an expression that did not specify a bind variable name.
action: Specify a bind variable name for each value in the PASSING clause.

description: unsupported chaining of two JSON_TABLE expressions
cause: The output of one JSON_TABLE expression was provided as direct input to a second JSON_TABLE expression (possibly from a view definition). Such chaining should be avoided for performance reasons.
action: First, try to combine multiple JSON_TABLE expressions into one using the JSON_TABLE NESTED PATH clause. If this is not possible, then apply a JSON or JSON_SERIALIZE operator to the input of the second JSON_TABLE to break the chain.

description: cannot update a JSON value
cause: An attempt was made to update a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) value.
action: Update the entire JSON object instead.

description: Simple Oracle Document Access (SODA) requires that the Oracle Database compatible parameter is set to 12.0.0.0.0 or higher.
cause: DBMS_SODA_ADMIN package was used when the database was operating at a compatible setting lower than 12.0.0.0.0.
action: Upgrade the database compatible setting to 12.0.0.0.0 or higher to enable the desired new features.

description: one or more JSON objects exist that cannot be downgraded.
cause: There were JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) objects in the database that were created in a release beyond the selected release for downgrade.
action: Prior to downgrade, drop the JSON objects that cannot be downgraded to the selected release.

description: JSON_TABLE nested path expressions not disjunct
cause: The JSON_TABLE expression contained two or more nested path expressions that (partially or fully) selected the same fields.
action: Correct or combine the nested path expressions so that they become disjunct.

description: invalid path '%s' in JSON_TABLE NESTED PATH clause
cause: The JSON_TABLE expression contained a NESTED PATH clause with an invalid path expression. For example, '$' is an invalid path because it selects the current context instead of accessing the nested data.
action: Correct the NESTED PATH expression or remove the NESTED PATH clause.

description: Conversion from JSON to SDO_GEOMETRY failed.
cause: The selected value could not be converted to a SDO_GEOMETRY object.
action: Ensure that the path expression selects one valid JSON value.

description: default value not allowed for object types
cause: The error handler specified a default value and the returned data type was an object type. These cannot be combined.
action: Use a scalar return type for the operator, or choose a different error handler such as 'NULL ON ERROR' or 'ERROR ON ERROR'.

description: invalid JSON specification
cause: The provided JSON specification was invalid.
action: Correct the specification and then retry the operation.

description: JSON path expression did not select a value.
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression did not select a value.
action: Correct the JSON path expression.

description: JSON path expression selected a value of different data type.
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression selected a data type value different than the requested data type.
action: Use another 'get-method' to retrieve the value selected by the JSON path expression.

description: JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) patch operation failed.
cause: The JSON patch operation failed.
action: Correct the specification and retry.

description: cannot modify read-only target
cause: An attempt to modify a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) structure failed because the structure cannot be modified.
action: None.

description: Unimplemented JSON feature.
cause: An attempt was made to execute an unimplemented JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) feature.
action: None.

description: JSON conversion failed.
cause: A conversion between a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) value and another type failed.
action: Check the type definition or the selected JSON value.

description: JSON key name '%s' not found.
cause: A key with the specified name was not found in the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data.
action: Correct the key name.

description: Invalid JSON array position %s.
cause: An attempt was made to access an item inside a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) array with a position that is either out of bounds or invalid.
action: Correct the position value.

description: invalid use of PL/SQL JSON object type
cause: An attempt was made to use a PL/SQL JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) object type in an invalid context.
action: Use PL/SQL JSON object types only inside PL/SQL functions or procedures. PL/SQL JSON object types cannot be used directly in SQL statements.

description: JSON operation on redacted column %s not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to use a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation on a column that had an Oracle Data Redaction policy.
action: Drop the Oracle Data Redaction policy. Re-create the Oracle Data Redaction policy on a new view over the column, if needed.
params: 1) col_name: The redacted column name on which the operation was attempted.

description: JSON operation only supports scalar types.
cause: An attempt was made to use a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operation on a non-scalar value.
action: Apply the operation on a scalar value.

description: Bind variable '%s' has to be a constant in this operation.
cause: An attempt was made to bind a variable in a SQL/JSON path to a value that may change during the execution of a SQL statement.
action: Use either a compile time constant or a run-time constant such as a statement-level bind variable as the SQL/JSON variable value.

description: invalid key name '%s'
cause: The specified key name was not valid."
action: Specify a valid key name."

description: invalid or nonexistent array position %s
cause: The specified array position was invalid or nonexistent.
action: Specify a valid array position or use the APPEND function to add new items to the array.
params: 1) array_position: The invalid or nonexistent array position.

description: wildcard star expansion '*' not allowed
cause: The wildcard character '*' was used in a context where a list of column names was expected and the wildcard character was not allowed.
action: Explicitly specify the column names.

description: STRICT or WITH UNIQUE KEYS not allowed for JSON type
cause: An attempt was made to use IS JSON with the STRICT or UNIQUE KEYS option on a JSON type input. A JSON type instance is always STRICT and has unique keys.
action: Apply the STRICT and UNIQUE KEYS options on a textual JSON value. Remove these options form the IS JSON operation if the input is a JSON type.

description: package functions are unsupported below compatible %s
cause: The package was used with a database that was operating at a compatible setting lower than expected.
action: Upgrade the database to a compatible setting that is the expected release or higher to enable the desired new features.

description: cannot find a data guide-enabled context index
cause: A data guide-enabled context index for the specified column in the specified table was not found.
action: Ensure that the table and column exist, the column is a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) column, and a data guide-enabled context index exists on the JSON column before invoking the procedure or function.

description: view name or table name or JSON column name cannot be null
cause: The view name or table name or JSON column name was null.
action: Pass in a valid view name or table name or JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) column name to the function or procedure.

description: JSON column %s does not exist
cause: The given table did not have a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) column with the given name.
action: Ensure that the table name and JSON column name are specified correctly.

description: invalid frequency
cause: The specified frequency was invalid.
action: The range of frequency must be between 0 to 100.

description: error occurred in the execution of %s
cause: A internal error occurred.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: invalid JSON type
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) type was invalid.
action: Ensure that the JSON type is specified correctly.

description: invalid estimate percentage
cause: The specified estimate percentage was invalid.
action: The range of estimate percentage has to be 0.000001 to 100.

description: Path '%s' does not exist.
cause: The specified path was not found.
action: Ensure that the specified path exists.

description: invalid or unsupported FORMAT clause
cause: The specified FORMAT for JSON is either invalid or not supported in this operation.
action: Ensure that a valid and supported JSON format is specified. For example, 'JSON' or 'OSON'.

description: empty data guide on JSON column
cause: No data was inserted into the JSON column.
action: Insert data and commit.

description: name conflicts were found during execution of DBMS_JSON.ADD_VIRTUAL_COLUMNS: %s
cause: An attempt was made to create virtual columns using an annotated Javascript Object Notation (JSON) data guide with the name of a column that already exists.
action: Change the preferred name of the virtual column in the annotated Javascript Object Notation (JSON) data guide. An alternative is to set parameter resovleNameConflicts in procedure DBMS_JSON.ADD_VIRTUAL_COLUMNS to TRUE and the procedure will automatically resolve the virtual column name conflicts by appending a sequence number.

description: name conflicts were found during execution of DBMS_JSON.CREATE_VIEW: %s
cause: An attempt was made to create a view using an annotated Javascript Object Notation (JSON) data guide with the name of a column that already exists.
action: Change the preferred name of the column in the annotated Javascript Object Notation (JSON) data guide. An alternative is to set parameter resovleNameConflicts in procedure DBMS_JSON.CREATE_VIEW to TRUE and the procedure will automatically resolve the view column name conflicts by appending a sequence number.

description: invalid data guide: %s
cause: The specified data guide was invalid.
action: Ensure that the specified data guide follows data guide rules.

description: Name input to JSON generation function cannot be null.
cause: The name input given to the Javascript Object Notation (JSON) generation function was null.
action: Ensure that the input has a valid value.

description: An internal error occurred when evaluating the JSON operation.%s
cause: Evaluation of the specified JSON operation is returning an error.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: JSON path expression syntax error ('%s')
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression had invalid syntax and could not be parsed.
action: Specify JSON path expression with the correct syntax.

description: JSON path expression contained an invalid array index ('%s').
cause: The specified JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression contained an invalid array index.
action: Specify a valid array index. The first element in the array has the index 0.
params: 1) path_string: The path expression with the invalid array index.

description: IS JSON check constraint cannot be dropped.
cause: An IS JSON check constraint could not be dropped because there was a JSON search index present on the column.
action: Drop the JSON search index first before dropping the IS JSON check constraint. Alternatively, disable the IS JSON check constraint to prevent a JSON syntax check.

description: JSON_EQUAL used outside of a predicate
cause: The JSON_EQUAL operator was used outside of a SQL predicate.
action: Use the JSON_EQUAL operator inside a SQL predicate such as a WHERE clause, HAVING clause, or a CASE expression.

description: missing data for object type conversion
cause: The input JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data was missing data to match all of the attributes in the specified object type.
action: The input JSON data must include the fields that are missing.

description: extra data for object type conversion
cause: The input JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had extra fields that did not match any attribute in the specified object type.
action: The input JSON data should not include fields that do not match an attribute in the specified object type.

description: type error mismatch for object type conversion
cause: The input JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data had fields that nominally matched an attribute in the specified object type, but had an incompatible data type.
action: The input JSON data should not have fields that do not match the data type of an attribute with which they nominally match in the specified object type.

description: exceeded maximum size for a JSON data type object
cause: The JSON data type object exceeded the maximum size permitted.
action: Ensure that the JSON data type object does not exceed the maximum size permitted.

description: invalid value for OCI_ATTR_SODA_FETCH_ARRAY_SIZE attribute
cause: An invalid value was specified for OCI_ATTR_SODA_FETCH_ARRAY_SIZE attribute.
action: Use a non-zero value not exceeding MINSWORDMAXVAL for the OCI_ATTR_SODA_FETCH_ARRAY_SIZE attribute.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Table '%s' does not have a primary or unique key.
cause: The specified table did not have a primary or unique key, which is required to uniquely identify the Duality View object.
action: Add a primary or unique key to the table and select all columns of the key in the view.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': All primary or unique key columns of table '%s' must be selected.
cause: Not all columns in the primary or unique key of the specified table were selected, which is required to uniquely identify the Duality View object.
action: Select all the columns belonging to the primary or unique key.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': join query to construct subobject '%s' must use all columns of a primary or unique key of table '%s'.
cause: Not all columns of the primary or unique key, which are required to uniquely identify an object, were used in the join to construct the specified subobject.
action: Specify all the primary or unique key columns in the join.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': foreign key column '%s' of table '%s' should be part of the primary or unique key of the same table, or it should not be selected to construct subobject '%s'.
cause: The foreign key column could only be selected if it was also part of a primary or unique key of the same table, which is required to uniquely identify the Duality View objects.
action: Add the foreign key columns to the primary or unique key of the same table, or remove it from the select statement.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': All joining columns of table '%s' must have a foreign key constraint to table '%s'.
cause: A table joined with another did not have foreign key constraint on (all) the joining columns, which is required to uniquely identify the Duality View objects.
action: Define foreign key constraint on the joining columns of the specified table to the primary or unique key of the other.

description: Only one table is allowed in the FROM clause for JSON Relational Duality Views.
cause: More than one table was specified in the FROM clause.
action: Restructure the SQL statement to specify only one table in the FROM clause.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': operator or expression not permitted.
cause: SQL set operators (union, intersect, minus), SQL expressions, or PL/SQL functions could not be used in Duality Views.
action: Remove the disallowed operator or expression.

description: JSON key name cannot be reserved keyword '%s' for JSON Relational Duality Views.
cause: A reserved keyword was used as the JSON key name.
action: Do not use the reserved names "_row_etag", or "_id" as the JSON key names.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Key name must be a string literal enclosed by single quotation marks for JSON Relational Duality Views.
cause: The specified key name is not a string literal.
action: Specify the key name in single quotation marks.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': RETURNING clause must return a JSON type.
cause: Only a JSON type could be returned when constructing a JSON Relational Duality View.
action: Change the type of the RETURNING clause to be JSON.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': using ABSENT ON NULL in JSON_OBJECT() is not permitted.
cause: ABSENT ON NULL clause was used as part of the JSON_OBJECT() function.
action: Remove the ABSENT ON NULL clause from the Duality View declaration, or use NULL ON NULL instead.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': using ABSENT ON NULL or NULL ON NULL clauses in JSON_ARRAYAGG() is not permitted.
cause: ABSENT ON NULL or NULL ON NULL clause was used as part of the JSON_ARRAYAGG() function.
action: Remove the ABSENT ON NULL or NULL ON NULL clause from the Duality View declaration, or use EMPTY ON NO ROWS instead.

description: Invalid ETAG value used in the SQL function.
cause: An invalid ETAG value was used.
action: Ensure a valid ETAG value is used.

description: missing column '%s' in CHECK ETAG list
cause: The mentioned column was not found in the CHECK ETAG list of a JSON relational duality view.
action: Add the column to the CHECK ETAG list.

description: total length of key names in JSON object too long
cause: The length of all the key names combined exceeded the maximum length permitted for a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) object.
action: Use fewer keys or shorter key names.

description: Collection create mode %s is not supported.
cause: An invalid collection create mode was specified.
action: Use a valid collection create mode.

description: Creating a collection backed by view or package in ''NEW'' mode is not allowed.
cause: Creating a collection backed by view or package in NEW mode was not allowed.
action: Do not specify a view or package when creating the collection in NEW create mode, or specify a create mode that supports view or package-based collections.

description: The table intended to back the collection does not exist.
cause: The table intended to back the collection did not exist.
action: Ensure that the table intended to back the collection exists.

description: Column %s specified in the collection metadata or defaulted is not present in the mapped table.
cause: A column specified in the collection metadata or defaulted was not found in the mapped table backing the collection.
action: Ensure that columns specified in the collection metadata or defaulted exist in the mapped table backing the collection.

description: The view intended to back the collection does not exist.
cause: The view intended to back the collection did not exist.
action: Ensure that the view intended to back the collection exists.

description: The table or view underlying the collection cannot be dropped.
cause: The table or the view underlying the collection could not be dropped. There could be uncommitted writes to the collection.
action: Ensure that all writes to the collection are committed.

description: Column %s specified in the collection metadata or defaulted is not present in the mapped view.
cause: A column specified in the collection metadata or defaulted was not found in the mapped view backing the collection.
action: Ensure that columns specified in the collection metadata or defaulted exist in the mapped view backing the collection.

description: Projection specification is not valid JSON
cause: Projection specification was not expressed in valid JSON.
action: Ensure that projection specification is expressed in valid JSON.

description: Patch specification is not valid JSON
cause: Patch specification was not expressed in valid JSON.
action: Ensure that patch specification is expressed in valid JSON.

description: Versioning method '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified versioning method was not valid.
action: Specify a valid versioning method.

description: The last-modified column index can only be set when the last-modified column name is set.
cause: The last-modified column index was specified without setting the last-modified column name.
action: Specify the last-modified column name if the last-modified column index is required.

description: Key column length value cannot be less than 0.
cause: The specified key column length value was less than 0.
action: If the key column length value is specified, then ensure that it is greater than 0.

description: When using GUID or UUID to assign character type key values, the key column length must be 32 bytes or greater.
cause: The specified key column length for a GUID or UUID character type key value was less than 32 bytes.
action: Ensure that the specified key column length for a GUID or UUID character type key value is 32 bytes or greater.'

description: Key assignment method '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified key assignment method was not valid.
action: Specify a valid key assignment method.

description: If the key assignment method is 'SEQUENCE', a key column sequence name must be specified.
cause: The key assignment method 'SEQUENCE' was specified, but the key column sequence name was not set.
action: If the key assignment method is 'SEQUENCE', ensure that the key column sequence name is set.

description: Content column type '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified content column type was not valid.
action: Specify a valid content column type.

description: Content column maximum length value cannot be less than 0.
cause: The specified content column maximum length value was less than 0.
action: Specify a content column maximum length value greater than 0.

description: Content column validation mode '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified content column validation mode was not valid.
action: Specify a valid content column validation mode.

description: Content column compress setting '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified content column compress setting was not valid.
action: Specify a valid content column compress setting.

description: Content column LOB cache setting '%s' is not valid (must be 'true' or 'false').
cause: The specified content column LOB cache setting was not valid.
action: 'Specify a valid content column LOB cache setting.

description: Content column LOB encrypt setting '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified content column LOB encrypt setting was not valid.
action: Specify a valid content column LOB encrypt setting.

description: The collection cannot have a media type column unless the content column type is BLOB.
cause: The content column type was set to a type other than Binary Large Object (BLOB), and the media type column was requested.
action: If the media type column is requested, set the content column type to BLOB.

description: INITIAL storage clause parameter value cannot be less than 0.
cause: The specified INITIAL storage clause parameter value was not valid.
action: Specify a valid INITIAL storage clause parameter value.

description: PCTINCREASE storage clause parameter value cannot be less than 0.
cause: The specified PCTINCREASE storage clause parameter value was not valid.
action: Specify a valid PCTINCREASE storage clause parameter value.

description: If the key column sequence name was specified, the key column assignment method must be set to 'SEQUENCE'.
cause: The key column sequence name was specified, but the key column assignment method was not 'SEQUENCE'.
action: If the key column sequence name is specified, ensure that the key column assignment method is 'SEQUENCE'.

description: SecureFile LOB settings cannot be used when the content column type is '%s'.
cause: SecureFile LOB settings were specified, but the content column was not of LOB type.
action: If SecureFile LOB settings are specified, ensure that the content column is of LOB type.

description: A non-zero content column maximum length cannot be set for LOB content types.
cause: A non-zero content column maximum length was specified, but the content column was of a LOB type.
action: If non-zero content column maximum length is specified, ensure that the content column is not of a LOB type.

description: Versioning method other than 'NONE' can only be specified if version column name is specified.
cause: Versioning method other than 'NONE' was specified, but the version column name was not specified.
action: If a versioning method other than 'NONE' is specified, ensure that the version column name is set.

description: Key column maximum length cannot be greater than 255 bytes.
cause: A key column maximum length value greater than 255 bytes was specified.
action: Ensure that the key column maximum length value is not greater than 255 bytes.

description: The specified key column type cannot be used with a maximum length.
cause: A key column type that does not support maximum length was specified.
action: Ensure that if a key column maximum length is set, the key column type supports a maximum length setting.

description: Key column type '%s' is not valid.
cause: The specified key column type was not valid.
action: Specify a valid key column type.

description: Read-only setting is not valid (must be 'true' or 'false').
cause: The specified read-only setting was not valid.
action: Specify a valid read-only setting.

description: Spatial data type MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY not found.
cause: The spatial data type MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY could not be found.
action: Create data type MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY by installing Oracle Spatial and Graph or Oracle Locator, or check package permissions.

description: Input to JSON generation function has unsupported data type.
cause: An input parameter to the JSON generation function had a data type that is not supported.
action: Use the correct input or a conversion function to convert the input to a supported data type.

description: no PASSING clause specified
cause: The PASSING clause was not specified for the bind variables in the query.
action: Add a PASSING clause to specify the values for bind variables.

description: Variable '%s' in JSON path expression has no value in PASSING clause.
cause: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression contained a variable name that had no corresponding value in the external PASSING clause.
action: Add a variable to the external PASSING clause and ensure that the names match.

description: Variable in PASSING clause has no name.
cause: The expression provided in the PASSING clause had no name.
action: Name the expression in the PASSING clause.

description: Collection name cannot be null for this operation.
cause: An attempt was made to perform the operation without a name.
action: Specify the collection name for the operation.

description: Data type does not match the specification in the collection metadata.
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid data type.
action: Use the data type that is specified in the collection descriptor.

description: Content value cannot be null for instantiating a document.
cause: An attempt was made to instantiate a document with a null content.
action: Specify non-null content for instantiating the document.

description: Key value cannot be null for this operation.
cause: Attempted to perform an operation with a NULL key.
action: Specify non-null key for the operation.

description: Document cannot be NULL for this operation.
cause: An attempt was made to perform an operation with a NULL document.
action: Instantiate the document using the constructor before this operation.

description: cannot modify a read-only collection
cause: An attempt was made to modify a read-only collection.
action: None.

description: cannot add additional IS JSON check constraint
cause: An attempt was made to add an IS JSON check constraint to a column that already had an IS JSON check constraint.
action: Do not add additional IS JSON check constraints.
