description: A client-assigned key cannot be used for this operation.
cause: An attempt was made to use a client-assigned key for this collection.
action: Remove the client-assigned key from the document.

description: Internal error '%s' received from JSON processor
cause: An internal error was received during a JSON operation.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Patch operation cannot remove JSON_ELEMENT_T type.
cause: An patch specification operation attempted to remove the top-most container (object or array) from the JSON_ELEMENT_T type.
action: Modify the patch specification by either removing the operation that deletes the top-most container or by adding an operation that adds a new top-most container.

description: collection metadata too long
cause: The collection metadata which was passed was too long.
action: Reduce the size of the collection metadata.

description: Collection create failed: collection with same name but different metadata exists.
cause: Creation of the collection failed because there was an existing collection with same name but different metadata.
action: None.

description: Unable to complete collection create due to an interfering collection DDL operation.
cause: Existing collection with the same name was encountered, but dropped from another process before its metadata could be checked.
action: Retry creating the collection.

description: Collection not found.
cause: Collection was not found.
action: None.

description: Specified key column max length of %s bytes exceeds maximum allowed 255 bytes.
cause: Key column max length specified in the supplied metadata exceeded maximum allowed length of 255 bytes.
action: Ensure key column max length specified in the supplied metadata does not exceed 255 bytes.

description: %s argument cannot be NULL.
cause: Supplied argument was NULL.
action: Provide a valid argument.

description: Length of %s metadata value cannot exceed %s bytes.
cause: Length of the supplied metadata value exceeded allowed limit.
action: Provide a valid metadata value.

description: Metadata descriptor must be specified using valid JSON.
cause: JSON supplied for the metadata descriptor was not valid.
action: Supply valid JSON for the metadata descriptor.

description: invalid Query-By-Example (QBE) filter specification %s
cause: The Query-By-Example (QBE) filter specification was invalid.
action: Correct the filter specification.

description: internal SODA error
cause: There was an internal error in the Simple Oracle Document Access (SODA) processing layer.
action: None.

description: The total number of keys specified using the attributes key, keys, and filter is %s; exceeds the maximum allowed limit of %s.
cause: The number of keys exceeded allowed limit.
action: Reduce the number of keys to below the maximum allowed limit

description: Lob length of %s bytes exceed maximum supported length of %s bytes
cause: The large object (LOB) content that was fetched exceeded the maximum supported length
action: None.

description: encountered identifier "%s" when expecting a path expression in JSON_TABLE
cause: An identifier with double quotation characters was used in place of a path expression.
action: Use single quotation characters to specify the path expression.

description: OCI_SODA_AS_STORED cannot be used if the content column type is CLOB, or VARCHAR2.
cause: An attempt was made to use OCI_SODA_AS_STORED on a collection whose content column type was CLOB, or VARCHAR2.
action: Use either the OCI_DEFAULT or OCI_SODA_AS_AL32UTF8 mode of execution.

description: invalid combination of flags used
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid combination of flags.
action: Use only one of the flags. (OCI_DEFAULT, OCI_AS_STORED or OCI_SODA_AS_AL32UTF8)

description: Value '%s' is not valid for field '%s' (must be 'true' or 'false').
cause: The specified setting was not valid.
action: Specify a valid setting ('true' or 'false').

description: maximum number of key names exceeded
cause: An attempt was made to return a list of keys names for a JSON object that had more than 32767 keys.
action: Reduce the number of keys in the JSON object to 32767 or less.

description: UTF-32 encoding is not supported for JSON documents.
cause: UTF-32 encoded content was specified for a document of type "application/json".
action: Use a UTF-8 or UTF-16 encoding for JSON documents.

description: For a JSON-only collection, media type of the input document must be 'application/json'.
cause: An attempt was made to write a document with media type other than 'application/json' to a JSON-only collection.
action: Provide a document with media type 'application/json'.

description: CREATE_MODE parameter of CREATE_COLLECTION function is invalid.
cause: Invalid value was supplied as CREATE_MODE parameter of CREATE_COLLECTION function.
action: Supply MAP or DDL constant for the CREATE_MODE parameter of CREATE_COLLECTION function.

description: The date or time stamp string value does not conform to ISO 8601 format.
cause: A string value that did not conform to the ISO 8601 format was used as input to an operation that attempted to convert it to a date or timestamp value.
action: Supply a string value conforming to ISO 8601 format to the date or timestamp conversion operation.

description: Skip value cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for skip.
action: Specify a non-null value for skip in the operation.

description: Limit value cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for limit.
action: Specify a non-null value for limit in the operation.

description: The cursor for the operation has already been closed.
cause: An attempt was made to use a cursor that has already been closed.
action: Do not use the cursor that has already been closed or retry the operation after removing the close.

description: Version value cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for version.
action: Specify a non-null value for version in the operation.

description: Filter value cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for filter.
action: Specify a non-null value for filter in the operation.

description: Query-by-example (QBE) with clauses other than $id, $textContains is not supported on heterogeneous collections.
cause: An attempt was made use QBE on a heterogeneous collection with clauses other than $id, $textContains.
action: Do not use QBE on heterogeneous collection with clauses other than $id, $textContains.

description: The collection does not have version column.
cause: An attempt was made to use version in the operation on a collection with no version column.
action: Do not use version on a collection with no version column.

description: invalid type for index property %s: expected %s
cause: An invalid index property type was specified.
action: Supply a valid type for the index property.

description: invalid value specified for index property 'dataguide'
cause: An invalid value for the index property 'dataguide' was specified.
action: Supply a valid value for the 'dataguide' index property. Valid values are 'on' or 'off'.

description: invalid value specified for index property 'search_on'
cause: An invalid value for the index property 'search_on' was specified.
action: Specify a valid value for the 'search_on' index property. Valid values are 'none', 'text', or 'text_value'.

description: invalid value specified for index property 'order'
cause: An invalid value for the index property 'order' was specified.
action: Specify a valid value for the 'order' index property. Valid values are 'asc', 'desc', '-1', or '1'.

description: missing %s index property
cause: A mandatory index property was missing.
action: Specify the mandatory index property.

description: null case ID column - cannot provide row importance
cause: The row importance was enabled, but without a corresponding case or row identifier column in the build data.
action: Provide a valid case identifier column in the build data.

description: incompatible index field properties %s and %s
cause: Incompatible index field properties were specified.
action: Specify compatible index field properties.

description: Index property %s cannot be specified without specifying the 'fields'.
cause: An index property was specified without specifying the 'fields' property.
action: Specify the properties of index fields.

description: Index property 'lax' cannot be specified with 'scalarRequired'.
cause: Index properties 'lax' and 'scalarRequired' were both specified.
action: Specify either 'lax' or 'scalarRequired' but not both.

description: data type %s not recognized or acceptable for an index column
cause: An invalid data type property was used.
action: Specify a valid data type (for example, STRING, VARCHAR, VARCHAR2, NUMBER, DATE, or TIMESTAMP).

description: Index property 'maxLength' cannot be specified with non-string data types.
cause: Index property 'maxLength' was specified with a non-string data type.
action: Remove the 'maxLength' index property if a non-string data type must be used.

description: Text indexing is not supported on heterogeneous collections.
cause: An attempt was made to create a text index on a heterogeneous collection.
action: Do not create a text index on a heterogeneous collection.

description: Functional indexing is not supported on heterogeneous collections.
cause: An attempt was made to create a functional index on a heterogeneous collection.
action: Do not create a functional index on a heterogeneous collection.

description: Geospatial indexing is not supported on heterogeneous collections.
cause: An attempt was made to create a geospatial index on a heterogeneous collection.
action: Do not create a geospatial index on a heterogeneous collection.

description: invalid index property %s
cause: An invalid index property was specified.
action: Specify a valid index property.

description: Text indexing is not supported on collections with key column of NVARCHAR2 data type.
cause: An attempt was made to create a text index on a collection with a key column of NVARCHAR2 data type.
action: Do not create an index on a collection that has a key column of NVARCHAR2 data type.

description: Text indexing is not supported on collections with content column of NVARCHAR2 or NCLOB data type.
cause: An attempt was made to create a text index on a collection with a content column of NVARCHAR2 or NCLOB data type.
action: Do not create an index on a collection that has a content column of NVARCHAR2 or NCLOB data type.

description: Text indexing is not supported on collections with encrypted content column.
cause: An attempt was made to create a text index on a collection with an encrypted content column.
action: Do not create an index on a collection with an encrypted content column.

description: index specification cannot be null
cause: An attempt was made to specify a null index specification.
action: Specify a non-null index specification.

description: array steps in the fields path is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to use array steps in fields path.
action: Do not use array steps in the fields path.

description: path for the field in the index specification cannot be null
cause: An attempt was made to specify a null value for the field's path in the index specification.
action: Specify a non-null value for the field's path in the index specification.

description: path for the field in the index specification is invalid
cause: An attempt was made to specify an invalid path in the index specification.
action: Specify a valid path for the field in the index specification.

description: number of paths with string data type exceeds the maximum permissible limit of 16
cause: Number of paths with string data type exceeds the maximum permissible limit of 16.
action: Reduce the number of paths with string data type.

description: missing dot separator in path %s at position %s.
cause: A dot separator was missing in the path expression.
action: Specify the missing dot step separator in the path expression.

description: unclosed quote at end of path %s
cause: A quote that was not closed was detected at the end of the path.
action: Specify the missing back quote at the end of the path expression.

description: an invalid character detected in the escape string in the path %s at position %s
cause: An attempt was made to use a path containing invalid charcters in the escape string.
action: Specify a valid escape string in the path expression.

description: invalid quoted step in the path %s at position %s
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid quoted step in the path.
action: Specify a valid quoted step in the path expression.

description: incomplete escape sequence in the path %s
cause: An attempt was made to use an incomplete escape sequence in the path.
action: Specify an escape sequence that is complete in the path expression.

description: An index with the specified name already exists in the schema.
cause: An attempt was made to create an index with the same name as another index in the schema.
action: Specify an index name that does not match the name of any indexes already existing in the schema.

description: key for the document to replace must be specified using the key attribute
cause: An attempt was made to replace a document without setting the key attribute.
action: Set the key attribute for the replace operation.

description: Query-By-Example (QBE) filter is not valid JSON %s
cause: QBE filter was not expressed in valid JSON.
action: Ensure that the QBE filter is expressed in valid JSON.

description: partitionColumn.path is missing
cause: partitionColumn.name was specified, but partitionColumn.path was missing.
action: Specify partitionColumn.path.

description: partitionColumn.name is missing
cause: One or a combination of partitionColumn.path, partitionColumn.maxLength, or partitionColumn.sqlType was specified, but partitionColumn.name was missing.
action: Specify the partitionColumn.name value.

description: Partition column type %s is not valid.
cause: The specified partition column type was not valid.
action: Specify a valid partition column type.

description: cannot use JSON format '%s' with content columns of type '%s'
cause: An invalid combination of content column settings was specified.
action: Specify a valid combination of content column settings.

description: cannot use JSON format '%s' with a heterogeneous collection
cause: An invalid combination of heterogeneous collection settings was specified.
action: Specify a valid combination of heterogeneous collection settings.

description: Content column JSON format '%s' is invalid.
cause: An invalid JSON format was specified for the content column.
action: Provide a valid JSON format content column setting.

description: Partition column length value cannot be less than 0.
cause: The specified partition column length value was less than 0.
action: If the partition column length value is specified, then ensure that it is greater than 0.

description: Specified partition column max length of %s bytes exceeds maximum allowed %s bytes.
cause: Partition column max length specified in the supplied metadata exceeded the maximum allowed length.
action: Ensure that the partition column max length specified in the supplied metadata does not exceed the maximum allowed length.

description: The specified partition column type cannot be used with a maximum length.
cause: A partition column type that does not support maximum length was specified.
action: Ensure that, if a partition column maximum length is set, the partition column type supports a maximum length setting.

description: keyColumn.path must be set with '%s' key assignment method.
cause: keyColumn.path was not set with the specified EXTRACT or INSERT key assignment method.
action: Ensure that keyColumn.path is set when the key assignment method is EXTRACT or INSERT.

description: The value %s is not a valid key of type %s.
cause: The key value was not of a valid type.
action: Ensure that the input for key is of a valid type.

description: SKIP and LIMIT attributes cannot be used for count operation.
cause: An attempt was made to use SKIP and LIMIT attributes in a count operation.
action: Do not use SKIP or LIMIT attributes in a count operation.

description: Index property %s cannot be specified without specifying the fields or spatial properties.
cause: An index property was specified without specifying the fields or spatial properties.
action: Specify either the properties of the index fields or spatial.

description: Column of Large Object (LOB) type cannot be used for sorting.
cause: The specified sort condition included a LOB column such as CLOB, BLOB or JSON.
action: Ensure that the sort column data type is not a large object such as CLOB, BLOB or JSON.

description: Document flags are not the same in all the input documents.
cause: The document flags were not the same in all the input documents supplied to the insert operation.
action: Ensure that the document flags are the same in all the input documents supplied to the insert operation.

description: Input document array length must be greater than 0.
cause: The supplied input document array length was less than or equal to 0.
action: Supply the input document array length that is greater than 0.

description: The current user is not the owner of the index.
cause: The current user was not the owner of the index. Only the owner of the index can perform the operation.
action: Connect as the owner of the index and retry the operation. If you connect as the owner of the base table and get the error, then the owner of the index has to be the owner of the base table in order to perform the operation. Connect as the owner of the base table then create the index.

description: Collection name cannot be null for this operation.
cause: Collection name was null for the operation.
action: Specify a non-null collection name.

description: Index name cannot be null for this operation.
cause: Index name was null for the operation.
action: Specify a non-null index name.

description: descendant step in the path expression is not supported
cause: The specified path contained a descendant step.
action: Do not use descendant step in the path expression.

description: A dot (.) cannot appear as the first or last character of a path. To signify a zero-length field name, a pair of backquotes must be used before or after the dot.
cause: A dot (.) was used as the first or last character of the path.
action: Do not use a dot (.) as the first or last character of the path. To signify a zero-length field name, a pair of backquotes must be used before or after the dot.

description: unquoted special character %s used as step in the path %s at position %s
cause: Special characters such as $, @ cannot be used as a path step by itself unless backquoted.
action: Backquote the special character if used as a path step by itself.

description: wildcard step in the path expression is not supported
cause: The specified path contained a wildcard step.
action: Do not use a wildcard step in the path expression.

description: Index with the specified name did not exist on the collection.
cause: Index with the specified name did not exist on the collection.
action: Specify the name of the index that exists on the collection.

description: OCI_SODA_AS_STORED cannot be used if the content column JSON format is not textual JSON.
cause: An attempt was made to use OCI_SODA_AS_STORED on a Binary Large Object (BLOB) collection whose content column format was not textual JavaScript Object Notation (JSON).
action: Use OCI_DEFAULT or OCI_SODA_AS_AL32UTF8.

description: missing value in JSON_TRANSFORM
cause: An attempt was made to perform a JSON_TRANSFORM operation on a value that was missing in the document that was being transformed. The error occurred because the JSON path expression did not match any key in the input document.
action: Correct your path expression or change the ON MISSING clause in the JSON_TRANSFORM operation.

description: value already exists in JSON_TRANSFORM
cause: An attempt was made to insert a field that already existed with a JSON_TRANSFORM operation.
action: Correct your path expression or change the ON EXISTING clause in the JSON_TRANSFORM operation.

description: invalid option for ON EXISTING clause in JSON_TRANSFORM for path %s
cause: An option for the ON EXISTING clause was provided that was not valid for the specified JSON_TRANSFORM operation.
action: Specify a different option for ON EXISTING or omit the ON EXISTING clause and use the default option.

description: invalid option for ON MISSING clause in JSON_TRANSFORM for path %s
cause: An option for the ON MISSING clause was provided that was not valid for the specified JSON_TRANSFORM operation.
action: Specify a different option for ON MISSING or omit the ON MISSING clause and use the default option.

description: error in JSON_TRANSFORM execution
cause: An operation raised an unexpected internal error.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: field with this name already exists (%s)
cause: A RENAME operation was attempted to rename a field to a name that already existed in the same Javascript Object Notation (JSON) object.
action: Choose another field name, remove the existing field, or choose the REPLACE ON EXISTING clause.

description: field with name '%s' does not exist
cause: A RENAME operation attempted to rename a field that did not exist.
action: Check the field name or use the IGNORE ON MISSING clause.

description: value not a JSON array
cause: An attempt was made perform a JSON_TRANSFORM array operation on a value that was not an array.
action: Ensure that the path expressions of array operations match the JSON arrays in the data.

description: removal of root value not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to remove the topmost object, array or scalar value in the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data.
action: Do not use path expression '$' in the REMOVE operation.

description: JSON array subscript 'last' not permitted
cause: An attempt was made to use the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) array subscript 'last' with an operator that does not support 'last'.
action: Replace 'last' with the actual subscript or use another operator.

description: Truncation is not supported on a collection that is not table based.
cause: An attempt was made to truncate a collection that was not table based.
action: Ensure that the collection being truncated is table based.

description: Input JSON document contents are not in the same encoding.
cause: Encoding of JSON content in all input documents was not the same.
action: Ensure that all JSON documents content are in the same encoding.

description: Metadata component %s has value %s which differs from expected value %s.
cause: An attempt was made to use unsupported collection metadata value.
action: Provide a supported collection metadata value.

description: Only table-backed collections are supported.
cause: An attempt was made to create a collection not backed by a table.
action: Specify collection metadata appropriate for a collection backed by a table.

description: SCN value for 'as of' operation cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for system change number (SCN).
action: Specify a non-null value for the SCN in the operation.

description: Timestamp value for 'as of' cannot be set to null.
cause: An attempt was made to set a null value for the timestamp value.
action: Specify a non-null value for the timestamp in the operation.

description: SCN and timestamp attributes for SELECT and COUNT operations only.
cause: An attempt was made to use system change number (SCN) and timestamp attributes in an 'as of' operation that was not SELECT or COUNT.
action: Do not use SCN or timestamp attributes in operations other than SELECT and COUNT.

description: Truncation is not supported with data type in RETURNING clause.
cause: An attempt was made to use the TRUNCATE keyword with a non-textual data type in the RETURNING clause. This is not supported.
action: Remove the TRUNCATE keyword or change the RETURNING clause to use a textual data type like VARCHAR2 or CLOB.

description: JSON syntax error %s
cause: The provided JSON data had invalid syntax and could not be parsed.
action: Provide JSON data with the correct syntax.

description: A buffer underflow occurred during the execution of OCI JSON function %s.
cause: An operation on an Oracle Call Interface (OCI) JSON descriptor resulted in an underflow error.
action: Supply a larger buffer for the operation to prevent underflow.

description: Invalid parameter value '%s' was specified for an OCI JSON function call.
cause: A function call on an Oracle Call Interface (OCI) JSON descriptor could not be processed due to the specified invalid parameter value.
action: Use valid input for the OCI JSON descriptor function.

description: invalid binary JSON data %s
cause: The specified binary JSON data is invalid.
action: Supply valid binary JSON data.

description: Error occurred while reading from the input stream.
cause: An error occurred while reading from the input stream due to incorrect initialization.
action: Ensure that the read input stream is valid and initialized correctly for read operation.

description: Error occurred while writing to the output stream.
cause: An error occurred while writing to the output stream due to incorrect initialization.
action: Ensure that the write output stream is valid and initialized correctly for write operation.

description: JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression evaluated to a non-Boolean value.
cause: The JSON path expression evaluated to a non-Boolean value.
action: Correct the JSON path expression or use an operator such as JSON_QUERY or JSON_VALUE to produce a result.

description: invalid input data type for JSON_TRANSFORM
cause: The specified input to the JSON_TRANSFORM function had an unsupported data type.
action: Specify an input value that is either a JSON data type or a type capable of representing textual JSON data.

description: JSON_TRANSFORM function INSERT operation contains invalid path (%s)
cause: An attempt was made to insert a value into a JSON object or array using a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression that could potentially select multiple positions inside the same array or multiple keys in the same object. This is not allowed.
action: Do not use the asterisk (*) wildcard or range specification in the JSON path expression of an INSERT operation.

description: JSON_TRANSFORM operation invalid or not supported
cause: An attempt was made to invoke JSON_TRANSFORM with an invalid or unsupported operation or parameter.
action: Check and correct the syntax of the JSON_TRANSFORM expression.

description: invalid null input value for JSON_TRANSFORM
cause: The specified input to JSON_TRANSFORM had a SQL null value.
action: Convert the input value to a JSON null.

description: invalid option for ON NULL clause in JSON_TRANSFORM for path %s
cause: An invalid option for the ON NULL clause is provided for the JSON_TRANSFORM operation.
action: Specify a different option for ON NULL, or omit the ON NULL clause and accept the default ON NULL option for this operator. Common ON NULL options are ERROR ON NULL, NULL ON NULL, or IGNORE ON NULL.

description: duplicate option for %s clause in JSON_TRANSFORM for path %s
cause: The specified JSON_TRANSFORM option is already defined.
action: Specify only one option for each JSON_TRANSFORM handler.

description: invalid JSON descriptor detected: [%s]
cause: An invalid JSON descriptor was detected.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: warning: empty input
cause: The operation succeeded, but processed a NULL or an empty input. The Oracle Call Interface (OCI) error code OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO was returned to indicate this.
action: Ensure that the input is not empty.

description: Cannot perform a write operation on a JSON descriptor in a C callout if the PL/SQL argument type is IN.
cause: Attempted to perform a write operation on a JSON descriptor passed as an IN argument to a C callout.
action: Use either IN/OUT or OUT type argument for the JSON type in the C callout.

description: invalid comparison operation involving JSON type value
cause: An attempt was made to perform a comparison against a JSON type value.
action: Add a JSON trailing type cast function to compare the JSON type value against a scalar value. Use JSON_EQUAL to compare two JSON type values.

description: An error occurred during conversion of the Oracle Call Interface (OCI) JSON descriptor to textual JSON %s.
cause: The conversion function produced an output result that exceeded the the input buffer size.
action: Increase the size of the input buffer.

description: Boolean conversion is not supported for the specified data type.
cause: An attempt was made to use the Boolean number conversion with a data type that was not NUMBER.
action: Change the data type in the RETURNING clause to NUMBER.

description: cannot convert Boolean value to number
cause: An attempt was made to convert a Boolean value to a number with a JSON path that used a number() or numberOnly() function.
action: Remove the number() or numberOnly() function from the JSON path expression.

description: Cannot create a JSON_VALUE functional index with a predicate ending the path expression.
cause: An attempt was made to create a JSON_VALUE functional index with a predicate as the last step in the path expression.
action: Do not include a predicate as the last step in the path expression in a JSON_VALUE functional index.

description: metadata descriptor cannot be null
cause: An attempt was made to specify a null metadata descriptor.
action: Specify a non-null metadata descriptor.

description: Collection create mode %s cannot be used if collection is backed by a view.
cause: An invalid collection create mode was specified.
action: Use a valid collection create mode.

description: JSON_TRANSFORM operation called with NULL input
cause: A JSON_TRANSFORM operation was called with a NULL input value and the operation had ERROR ON NULL handling specified.
action: Ensure that the specified value is not NULL or remove the ERROR ON NULL option.

description: operation on an empty JSON descriptor
cause: The operation succeeded, but the input JSON descriptor was empty. The Oracle Call Interface (OCI) error code OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO was returned to indicate this.
action: Ensure that the input is not empty.

description: cannot add an IS JSON check constraint to a JSON type column
cause: An attempt was made to add an IS JSON check constraint to a column of JSON type.
action: None.

description: warning of replacement characters in the converted textual JSON due to bad character data in the source %s
cause: Conversion to textual JSON completed successfully but with replacement characters in the output. The Oracle Call Interface (OCI) error code OCI_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO was returned to indicate this.
action: Check if the source was encoded correctly.

description: Validation value '%s' cannot be specified with '%s' content column type.
cause: Content column type for which validation is not supported was used.
action: Do not specify validation.

description: Content column tablespace cannot be specified with '%s' content column type.
cause: Content column type for which content column tablespace is not supported was used.
action: Do not specify content column tablespace.

description: memOptimizeRead cannot be set to 'true' with '%s' content column type.
cause: Content column type for which memOptimizeRead is not supported was used.
action: Do not specify memOptimizeRead, or set its value to 'false'.

description: update of root value not allowed
cause: An attempt was made to update the top-most object, array or scalar value in the JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) data.
action: Do not select the entire document (with path expression '$') in a JSON_TRANSFORM SET operation.

description: piecewise write operation failed on a LOB column with persistent binary JSON
cause: An attempt was made to update a piece of Large Objects (LOB) column with persistent binary Javascript Object Notation (JSON) data.
action: Do not use DBMS_LOB write operations on a LOB column with persistent binary JSON data.

description: cannot specify both WITH ARRAY WRAPPER and OMIT QUOTES
cause: The clause OMIT QUOTES ON SCALAR STRING conflicted with the clause WITH ARRAY WRAPPER.
action: Change OMIT to KEEP, or use WITHOUT ARRAY WRAPPER.

description: cannot specify ASIS with KEEP QUOTES or OMIT QUOTES
cause: The ASIS clause could not be used together with the clauses OMIT QUOTES or KEEP QUOTES.
action: Remove the ASIS clause.

description: selected value not a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) object
cause: An attempt was made to perform a JSON_TRANSFORM object operation on a value that was not an object.
action: Correct the path expression.

description: cannot create JSON array inside another array
cause: An attempt was made to create a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) array using the CREATE ON MISSING clause to add this new array to another existing array. This is not possible because a newly created array using the CREATE ON MISSING clause can only be added to an object.
action: Correct your path expression to either add the new array to a JSON object or to append it to the existing array.

description: invalid JSON key name %s
cause: An attempt was made to set or rename a key in a JSON object with a a name that was invalid.
action: Correct the key name.
params: 1) key_name: The invalid JSON key name.

description: Metadata field %s is either invalid, or missing in the original collection metadata.
cause: An invalid field, or a field missing in the original collection metadata, was specified in the interim collection metadata.
action: Ensure that all interim collection metadata fields are valid and, if required, present in the original collection metadata.

description: Metadata field %s has a value %s unsupported in online redefinition.
cause: A field with a value unsupported in online redefinition was supplied in the interim collection metadata.
action: Ensure that all interim collection metadata fields have values supported in online redefinition.

description: Metadata field %s cannot be specified when metadata field %s has value %s.
cause: An invalid combination of fields was specified in the interim metadata.
action: Ensure that only allowed combinations of fields are specified in the interim metadata.

description: Cannot set LOCK attribute on the operation if SKIP or LIMIT attributes are set.
cause: An invalid combination of operation attributes was specified.
action: Specify a valid combination of operation attributes.

description: LOCK attribute cannot be set for %s operation.
cause: An attempt was made to set LOCK attribute in this operation.
action: Do not set LOCK attribute in this operation.

description: SecureFile LOB settings cannot be used when the content column stores binary JSON.
cause: SecureFile LOB settings were specified for a binary JSON content column.
action: Do not specify SecureFile LOB settings.

description: Validation cannot be specified when the content column stores binary JSON.
cause: Validation was specified for a binary JSON content column.
action: Do not specify validation.

description: Content column tablespace cannot be specified when the content column stores binary JSON.
cause: Content column tablespace was specified for a binary JSON content column.
action: Do not specify content column tablespace.

description: memOptimizeRead cannot be set when the content column stores binary JSON.
cause: memOptimizeRead was specified for a binary JSON content column.
action: Do not specify memOptimizeRead.

description: Collection create mode '%s' is not supported on this cloud service.
cause: An unsupported collection create mode was specified.
action: Specify a supported collection create mode.

description: keyColumn.path must not be set with '%s' key assignment method.
cause: keyColumn.path was set with a key assignment method that does not requre a key path.
action: Ensure that keyColumn.path is set only with a key assignment method that requires it.

description: keyColumn.sqlType must be set to '%s' for the specified key column assignment method.
cause: Key column SQL type incompatible with the specified key column assignement method was used.
action: Ensure that appropriate key column SQL type is used.

description: keyColumn.maxLength must be set to '%s' for the specified key column assignment method.
cause: Key column SQL type length incompatible with the specified key column assignement method was used.
action: Ensure that appropriate key column SQL type length is used.

description: ROWID is not a valid JSON_TABLE column.
cause: Attempted to select a ROWID column from a JSON_TABLE.
action: Use an ORDINALITY column instead of a ROWID column.

description: CONS_VPD_AUTO is not applicable to online redefinition for SODA collections
cause: An attempt was made to specify CONS_VPD_AUTO for redefining SODA collections.
action: Set the COPY_VPD_OPT value to CONS_VPD_MANUAL or CONS_VPD_NONE.

description: Dependent %s on %s column is missing from the interim collection.
cause: A required dependent was not defined on the interim collection.
action: Define the required dependents or call procedure COPY_COLLECTION_DEPENDENTS to copy all of the dependents from the original collection.

description: empty input to JSON operator
cause: Empty input (for example, an empty CLOB) was provided to a JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator that expected non-empty input.
action: Check and correct the input.

description: invalid input to JSON parse or load function
cause: An invalid value such as a NULL CLOB was provided as input to the JSON parse or load functions.
action: Check and correct the input.

description: invalid path '%s'
cause: Only a simple JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) path expression was allowed. Predicates, wildcard steps, descendant steps, array steps, or trailing functions were not allowed.
action: Remove disallowed components from the path expression.

description: invalid character in o:preferred_column_name '%s'
cause: Double quotation was not allowed in a column name.
action: Check the Oracle identifier naming convention.

description: invalid materialized view refresh mode
cause: The specified materialized view refresh mode was invalid.
action: Ensure that the refresh mode is specified correctly.

description: Metadata specification must be an object.
cause: The metadata specification root was an array or scalar. A metadata specification must be an object.
action: Ensure that the metadata specification root is an object node.

description: invalid field type in the metadata %s, expected: %s
cause: The metadata specification contained a field with an incorrect type.
action: Ensure that the metadata field type is correct.

description: unsupported field %s in the metadata
cause: The metadata specification contained a field that is not supported.
action: Do not use this field or try upgrading your client library to the supported version.

description: invalid scalar type in the metadata field %s, expected: %s
cause: The metadata specification contained a field with an incorrect scalar type.
action: Ensure that the metadata field has the correct scalar type.

description: unsupported value %s in the metadata for the field %s
cause: The metadata specification contained a value that is not supported.
action: Do not use this value.

description: Multiple KEEP operations used in JSON_TRANSFORM.
cause: A JSON_TRANSFORM expression was used that contained more than one KEEP operation.
action: Use multiple path expressions in the same KEEP operation instead of multiple KEEP operations.

description: invalid array step in JSON multivalue index path expression '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to create a multivalue JSON index that had a path expression with a JSON array step that has a position greater than zero.
action: Correct the path expression. Do not use array steps with positions greater than zero.
params: 1) path_expr: The path expression containing an invalid array step.

description: failed to create object
cause: An attempt to create an object failed because there was not enough memory.
action: None.

description: Redefining to contentColumn.sqlType BLOB with jsonFormat OSON is not allowed if the original collection's contentColumn.sqlType is JSON.
cause: An invalid request was made to redefine a collection with contentColumn.sqlType JSON to contentColumn.sqlType BLOB with jsonFormat OSON.
action: Ensure that the requested redefinition can be supported.

description: Redefining to contentColumn.sqlType BLOB with jsonFormat OSON is not allowed if the original collection has user-defined constraints.
cause: An invalid request was made to redefine a collection with user-defined constraints to contentColumn.sqlType BLOB with jsonFormat OSON.
action: Ensure that the requested redefinition can be supported.

description: Metadata field %s cannot be specified when metadata field %s has value %s and metadata field jsonFormat has value OSON.
cause: An invalid combination of fields were specified in the interim metadata.
action: Ensure that only allowed combinations of fields are specified in the interim metadata.

description: Redefining to contentColumn.sqlType BLOB with jsonFormat OSON is not allowed if compatibility is 20 or above.
cause: An invalid combination of fields were specified in the interim metadata.
action: Redefine to contentColumn.sqlType JSON instead.

description: cannot create a composite JSON multivalue index on nested sibling paths '%s' and '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to create a composite JSON multivalue index on nested sibling paths.
action: Create separate JSON multivalue indexes for nested sibling paths instead of one composite JSON multivalue index.
params: 1) sibling_path1: The path expression of nested sibling one. 2) sibling_path2: The path expression of nested sibling two.

description: Cannot create a composite multivalue index with ordinality column that is not the last column in the index.
cause: Attempted to create a composite multivalue index with an ordinality column that was not the last column in the index.
action: Either use the ordinality column as the last column in the index or remove the ordinality column from the index.

description: SKIP and LIMIT attributes cannot be used for dataguide getter operation.
cause: An attempt was made to use SKIP and LIMIT attributes for dataguide getter operation.
action: Do not use SKIP or LIMIT attributes in dataguide getter operation.

description: Multi-Value Index (MVI) must be created with ERROR ON ERROR, NULL ON EMPTY and NULL ON MISMATCH.
cause: An attempt was made to create a multi-value index without using ERROR ON ERROR, NULL ON EMPTY, and NULL ON MISMATCH.
action: Add ERROR ON ERROR, NULL ON EMPTY, and NULL ON MISMATCH when creating a multi-value index.

description: A multivalue index is defined on table %s.
cause: A direct load was specified for a table on which a multivalue index was defined.
action: Take one of the following actions: - Drop the multivalue index that is defined on the table. - Do not use direct load. - Use the SKIP_INDEX_MAINTENANCE option. - Mark the multivalue index as unusable prior to loading.

description: operation not allowed on SODA collection table "%s"."%s"
cause: An attempt was made to alter or drop a SODA collection table.
action: No action required.

description: Hint for Simple Oracle Document Access (SODA) cannot contain '/*' or '*/'.
cause: The SODA hint contained '/*' or '*/', and this is not supported.
action: Remove "/*" and "*/" from the SODA hint.

description: JSON_VALUE returned an object type that is not SDO_GEOMETRY.
cause: The object type that was returned was not of SDO_GEOMETRY type.
action: If an object is returned in JSON_VALUE, ensure that it is SDO_GEOMETRY type.

description: Cannot create a JSON_VALUE functional index with bind variables.
cause: An attempt was made to create a JSON_VALUE functional index with bind variables in the JSON_VALUE operator.
action: Do not include bind variables in a JSON_VALUE functional index declaration.

description: A JSON path expression was too long.
cause: A Java Script Object Notation (JSON) path expression exceeded the maximum length allowed.
action: Take one of the following actions: - Ensure that simple path expressions are 4000 bytes or less. - Ensure that predicate expressions are 32767 bytes or less.

description: invalid combination of flags used
cause: An attempt was made to use an invalid combination of flags in the DBMS_JSON package.
action: Use the combination of the flags that are defined in the DBMS_JSON package.

description: JSON System Error [%s]
cause: An internal system error occurred during a Java Script Object Notation (JSON) operation.
action: Use the error message to locate the issue and correct the command. If the issue persists, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: contentColumn.jsonFormat cannot specified with a contentColumn.sqlType other than BLOB.
cause: contentColumn.jsonFormat was specified with a contentColumn.sqlType other than BLOB.
action: Ensure that contentColumn.jsonFormat is only specified with a contentColumn.sqlType of BLOB.

description: contentColumn.jsonFormat can only be set to OSON.
cause: contentColumn.jsonFormat was set to a value other than OSON.
action: Ensure that contentColumn.jsonFormat is set to OSON.

description: contentColumn.jsonFormat cannot be set with a media type column.
cause: contetColumn.jsonFormat was set in conjunction with a media type column.
action: Ensure that contentColumn.jsonFormat is not set in conjunction with a media type column.

description: JSON DOM operation was attempted on a container of an incorrect type.
cause: Either an array operation was attempted on an object, or an object operation was attempted on an array.
action: Ensure that the instance container is of the correct type for the desired operation.

description: JSON document operation was attempted on a non-scalar node.
cause: A scalar DOM operation was attempted on a node that was not a scalar value.
action: Ensure that the instance value is a scalar.

description: Embedded key path cannot contain more than a single step.
cause: Embedded key path with multiple steps or a descendant step has been encountered.
action: Ensure the embedded key path contains a single step only.

description: Embedded key path cannot contain an empty step.
cause: Embedded key path contained an empty step, represented by two consecutive backquotes.
action: Ensure the embedded key path does not contain an empty step.

description: SAMPLE percentage attribute value must be in the range .000001 to, but not including, 100.
cause: An invalid value was specified for the SAMPLE percentage attribute. The percentage can only be in the range .000001 to, but not including, 100.
action: Use a value greater or equal to 0 and less than 100 for the SAMPLE percentage attribute.

description: SAMPLE seed attribute value must be between -1 and 4,294,967,295.
cause: An invalid value was specified for the SAMPLE seed attribute.
action: Use a value between -1 and 4,294,967,295 for the SAMPLE seed attribute.

description: SAMPLE attribute cannot be used for remove or replace operation.
cause: An attempt was made to use the SAMPLE attribute for a remove or replace operation.
action: Do not use the SAMPLE attribute in a remove or replace operation.

description: unexpected token in JSON_TABLE (near '%s')
cause: An unexpected token was found in the JSON_TABLE function.
action: Correct the JSON_TABLE function and retry the operation.

description: invalid JSON_TABLE column name '%s'
cause: An invalid column name was specified in the JSON_TABLE function.
action: Correct the column name.

description: Bind variable not supported in this operation.
cause: A PASSING clause was provided for an operation that does not allow bind variables.
action: Remove the bind variable PASSING clause.

description: JSON schema validation error
cause: The input JSON document instance failed schema validation.
action: Correct the JSON document. Use DBMS_JSON_SCHEMA.VALIDATE_REPORT() PL/SQL function to find the schema validation error in the JSON document.

description: invalid JSON schema document
cause: An invalid JSON schema document was used.
action: Correct the JSON schema document. Use DBMS_JSON_SCHEMA.VALIDATE_REPORT() PL/SQL function to find the errors in the JSON schema document.

description: cannot use empty policy name on INMEMORY TEXT
cause: An empty policy name was specified on an Oracle Database In-Memory (Database In-Memory) text column. Database In-Memory text always requires a policy.
action: Use a valid policy name.

description: unsupported data type for JSON schema validation
cause: The input JSON data to be validated was of an unsupported data type.
action: Change or convert the input data to use a supported data type.

description: invalid IS JSON option for JSON schema validation
cause: An invalid option was specified for IS JSON with JSON schema validation.
action: Check and use a valid option for IS JSON with JSON schema.

description: JSON schema has unsupported data type
cause: The provided JSON schema had an unsupported data type.
action: Correct the JSON Schema to use a supported data type, e.g. VARCHAR2.

description: JSON schema not a literal
cause: The provided JSON schema expression was not a literal.
action: Provide a constant JSON schema.

description: JSON schema not a literal
cause: The provided JSON schema expression was not a literal.
action: Provide a constant JSON schema.

description: unsupported character in an array step
cause: An unsupported character was specified in an array step.
action: Use only digits with optional surrounding whitespace in an array step.

description: array step is not closed
cause: An unclosed array step was specified.
action: Ensure that the array step is ended with a closing ']' character.

description: character following an array step must be either '.' or '['
cause: A character other than '.' or '[' was specified immediately after the array step.
action: Ensure that the array step is not followed by a character other than '.' or '['.

description: array step cannot follow a '.' step separator character
cause: An opening character of an array step was encountered following a '.' step separator character.
action: Ensure that the array step is not following the '.' step separator character.

description: Pseudo-column %s not allowed in UPDATE or INSERT
cause: An attempt was made to use a pseudo-column in an INSERT or UPDATE statement.
action: Remove the pseudo-column.

description: The predicate specified in the JSON_VALUE functional index is invalid.
cause: The predicate specified in a JSON_VALUE functional index was invalid. The predicate operator must be &&, ||, >, >=, <, <=, or ==. One side of a comparison predicate must be a relative path expression.
action: Correct the predicate in the JSON_VALUE functional index.

description: 'path' or 'nestedPath' is missing in a 'fields' array element
cause: 'path' or 'nestedPath' was not found in a 'fields' array element.
action: Ensure that 'path' or 'nestedPath' is present in a 'fields' array element.

description: 'nestedPath' and 'fields' cannot be specified in conjunction with other fields within the same object
cause: 'nestedPath' and 'fields' were specified in conjunction with another field within the same object.
action: Ensure that 'nestedPath' and 'fields' are not specified in conjunction with another field within the same object.

description: '%s' and '%s' cannot appear within the same object
cause: Incompatible fields specified within the same object.
action: Ensure that only compatible fields are specified within the same object

description: invalid element under the 'fields' array
cause: An invalid element was encountered under the 'fields' array.
action: Ensure that each element of a 'fields' array is an object.

description: Unsupported data type used in column '%s' of a JSON Relational Duality View '%s'.
cause: Unsupported data type was used in a Duality View statement.
action: Do not use columns of data types LOB, Abstract Data Type, collections, TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE or XML to compute the ETAG values.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality view '%s': Invalid or missing expression for ETAG computation.
cause: ETAG cannot be computed on the specified document because the expression is either incomplete, missing entirely, or does not result in a data type on which the ETAG computation can be performed.
action: Ensure that the duality view declaration is valid or mark the field as NOCHECK.

description: invalid SQL expression in JSON relational duality view (%s)
cause: An invalid SQL expression was used in JSON relational duality view.
action: Ensure that a JSON relational duality view is constructed solely using JSON_OBJECT and JSON_ARRAYAGG with JSON_OBJECT input. Joins must be expressed on key columns with referential integrity

description: Cannot %s JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Concurrent modification detected to document with ID '%s'.
cause: The operation failed because a concurrent modification to the same document or another document with rows overlapping with this document was detected.
action: Retry the operation. For UPDATE, fetch the latest document with a valid entity tag (ETAG) value and retry the UPDATE.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': The primary key or unique key column '%s' cannot be marked with the UPDATE annotation.
cause: An attempt was made to create a duality view with an updatable primary key or unique key column, which is not allowed.
action: Remove the WITH UPDATE annotation for all of the primary key or unique key columns, and retry the operation.
params: 1) view_name: The duality view name used in the create statement. 2) column_name: The primary or unique key column name annotated with the WITH UPDATE annotation.

description: $SYS_OBJ_ID mismatch for object '%s'
cause: A $SYS_OBJ_ID value did not match the object of the JSON relational duality view.
action: Correct the $SYS_OBJ_ID value.

description: Primary keys in WITH OBJECT ID clause do not match primary keys of table '%s'.
cause: The column names in the WITH OBJECT ID clause did not match the primary key columns of the corresponding table.
action: Ensure that the column names in the WITH OBJECT ID clause match the primary key columns of the corresponding table.

description: filestore name invalid
cause: The filestore name provided differs from the mount directory name.
action: Use a filestore name that matches the mount directory name.

description: mountpoint not specified
cause: The mountpoint was not specified.
action: Provide a valid mountpoint.

description: backingfile name invalid
cause: The backingfile name was not specified or already exists.
action: Provide a valid backingfile name.

description: filestore already mounted
cause: A filestore with same name, backing file, or mountpoint was already mounted.
action: Unmount or drop the filestore before mounting or creating it again, or specify different filestore name, backing file, and mountpoint.

description: unable to dismount: filestore not mounted
cause: The provided filestore was not mounted.
action: Mount the filestore before attempting to dismount.

description: filestore not specified
cause: The filestore name was not specified.
action: Provide a valid filestore name. to do: add integer values to error message

description: size or resize value greater than available memory
cause: Specified size or resize value was greater than the available memory size.
action: Provide a smaller value for the size.

description: resize value greater than maximum size provided
cause: The resize value was greater than the maximum size provided during creation.
action: Provide a value lower than the maximum size.

description: unable to resize: filestore not mounted
cause: The provided filestore was not mounted.
action: Mount the filestore before attempting to resize.

description: file handle not valid
cause: The provided file handle did not exist or was stale.
action: Check the target file and re-acquire file handle.

description: filestore name too long
cause: Filestore name exceeded 64 characters.
action: Limit filestore name to maximum 64 ASCII characters.

description: invalid filestore name
cause: Filestore name contained invalid sequence of characters.
action: Filestore name must begin with an alphabetic character. After that, it may be followed by zero or more alphanumeric and underscore characters. Specify a filestore name using acceptable characters.

description: invalid blocksize
cause: Value specified for BLOCKSIZE was incorrect.
action: Value for BLOCKSIZE must be 512, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16382 or 32768.

description: filestore size must not be zero
cause: Filestore size was specified as zero.
action: Specify a filestore size other than zero.

description: blocksize must not be zero
cause: BLOCKSIZE was specified as zero.
action: Specify a valid blocksize.

description: invalid backingfile name
cause: BACKINGFILE name was not valid.
action: Specify a valid file name.

description: invalid mountpoint name
cause: Specified MOUNTPOINT name was invalid.
action: Specify a valid file name.

description: filestore must be mounted
cause: This operation required filestore to be mounted.
action: Mount the filestore and retry the operation.

description: resize value must not be zero
cause: New size was specified as zero.
action: Use a new size value other than zero.

description: insufficient amount of available free space in the filestore
cause: Used storage space in the filestore exceeded specified target size.
action: RESIZE to a larger size, or delete existing files in the filestore to free up more space.

description: filestore has content
cause: Filestore was not empty.
action: Use INCLUDING CONTENTS clause in DROP PMEM FILESTORE command or delete filestore contents first.

description: operation is not allowed
cause: This operation was not allowed because database was still mounted.
action: Restart the instance in nomount mode and retry the operation.

description: You need to restart the instance and reissue the command in order for this operation to succeed
cause: This operation failed because the required OS resources could not be acquired.
action: Restart the instance and reissue the command.

description: invalid or missing maximum file size in MAXSIZE clause
cause: UNLIMITED was not specified, or an invalid integer value was specified, for the MAXSIZE clause in the persistent memory (PMEM) filestore operation. The MAXSIZE value cannot be smaller than the SIZE value.
action: Use the correct syntax.

description: invalid file increment size in NEXT clause
cause: A non-integer value was used for the NEXT clause in the persistent memory(PMEM) filestore operation.
action: Use the correct syntax.

description: File %s is of invalid file type
cause: An unsupported file type was created in the persistent memory filestore.
action: Create only supported file types in PMEM filestore.

description: internal testing event for Oracle Real Application Clusters daemon
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Development.
action: Set this as directed by Oracle Development.

description: A subquery within a JSON array constructor cannot have a select list with more than one expression.
cause: A JSON array constructor contains a subquery that has a select list with more than one expression.
action: Combine the expressions in the select list into a single expression. For example, 'SELECT a, b' would become 'SELECT JSON { 'a' : a, 'b' : b }'.

description: A subquery within a JSON array constructor contains a set operation such as UNION or INTERSECT.
cause: A JSON array contructor directly contained a subquery that used a set operation such as UNION or INTERSECT.
action: Rewrite the expression using the JSON_ARRAYAGG function.

description: missing primary key column '%s' in CHECK ETAG list
cause: The mentioned primary key column was not found in the CHECK ETAG list of a JSON relational duality view.
action: Add the primary key column to the CHECK ETAG list.

description: Cannot create JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Invalid or conflicting annotations for the JSON field.
cause: Invalid or conflicting annotations specified while creating a Duality View. Note the only valid annotations for individual fields of a Duality View are (NO)CHECK, (NO)UPDATE and HIDDEN.
action: Ensure that valid and non-conflicting annotations are used in the view definition. If using GraphQL based definition, check the directives for the particular field. If using SQL, check the WITH annotations for the particular field.

description: Cannot create JSON relational duality view '%s'.'%s' must be a table or editioning view.
cause: An invalid object is being used in the FROM clause to construct the duality view; only a table or an editioning view is allowed.
action: Ensure that the duality view is constructed from a table or an editioning view.

description: View definition error for JSON-relational duality view '%s'.
cause: An unexpected internal error is being encountered in JSON-relational duality view processing.
action: Ensure that the DDL for the duality view is correct.

description: Cannot insert into table '%s' in JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Missing INSERT annotation or NOINSERT annotation specified.
cause: INSERT annotation for the table was not specified or NOINSERT annotation was specified during duality view creation.
action: Re-create the duality view with INSERT annotation for the table and retry the operation. If it is not possible to add an INSERT annotation for the specified table, insert data into the table directly and retry the operation.

description: Cannot delete from table '%s' in JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Missing DELETE annotation or NODELETE annotation specified.
cause: DELETE annotation for the table was not specified or NODELETE annotation was specified during duality view creation.
action: Re-create the duality view with DELETE annotation for the table and retry the operation.

description: Cannot update table '%s' in JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Missing UPDATE annotation or NOUPDATE annotation specified.
cause: UPDATE annotation for the table was not specified or NOUPDATE annotation was specified during duality view creation.
action: Re-create the duality view with UPDATE annotation for the table and retry the operation.

description: Cannot update field '%s' corresponding to column '%s' of table '%s' in JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Missing UPDATE annotation or NOUPDATE annotation specified.
cause: UPDATE annotation for the column was not specified or NOUPDATE annotation was specified during duality view creation.
action: Re-create the duality view with UPDATE annotation for the column or table containing the column and retry the operation.

description: cannot specify a column name or subquery alias for JSON relational duality view
cause: A column name or subquery alias was specified for a JSON relational duality view.
action: Do not specify a column name or subquery alias for a JSON relational duality view.

description: Primary key has a virtual column in JSON relational duality view for table '%s'.
cause: A virtual column was found in the primary key columns for a table used in a JSON relational duality view.
action: Ensure that the table does not have a virtual column in its primary key.

description: Cannot %s JSON Relational Duality View '%s': Field '%s' corresponding to column '%s' in table '%s' is missing from JSON input.
cause: The specified field was missing or NULL in the JSON input, which is required because fields with CHECK annotation or fields corresponding to the primary or unique key columns must be specified in the input JSON.
action: Specify a valid value for the field in the JSON input and retry the operation.

description: Cannot %s JSON Relational Duality View '%s': The input JSON document is invalid. %s
cause: Input JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) document is invalid.
action: Resolve the JSON error and retry the operation.

description: Column '%s' of table '%s' cannot be selected in JSON relational duality view as it is virtual.
cause: A virtual column was selected in the JSON relational duality view.
action: Remove the virtual column.

description: JSON relational duality view is not supported on remote table '%s'.
cause: A remote table was used in a JSON relational duality view.
action: Ensure that no remote table is used.

description: JSON-relational duality view '%s' cannot be created with duplicate tag '%s'.
cause: A duplicate tag is specified in the JSON-relational duality view.
action: Remove the duplicate tag.

description: Cannot insert multiple values to JSON relational duality view '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to insert multiple values to JSON relational duality view.
action: Use single insert values or insert as select.

description: JSON relational duality view is not supported on sharded table '%s'.
cause: A sharded table was used in a JSON relational duality view.
action: Ensure that no sharded table is used.

description: MERGE is not supported on JSON relational duality view '%s'.
cause: The MERGE operation contained a JSON relational duality view which is not supported.
action: Ensure that no JSON relational duality view is used with MERGE.

description: unsupported operation for GRAPH_TABLE: %s
cause: This was an unsupported operation.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: Total domain columns length exceeds 32K.
cause: The sum of the sizes in bytes of the columns that were used to specify the join group exceeded the 32K limit.
action: Remove some of the columns from the join group definition to keep the sum of their size in bytes within the required 32K limit.

description: Column type mismatch: %s.
cause: Columns from different tables at the same position specified in the join group did not have the same type.
action: Ensure that columns at the same position have the same type.
params: 1) column_name: The column name of the column having a different type.

description: unknown label
cause: The specified label did not exist in the graph.
action: Specify a label that exists.

description: invalid property name format
cause: A property identifier was used without a vertex or edge variable name qualifier.
action: The property identifier must always be qualified with a vertex or edge variable name. For example, vertex_variable.property_name.

description: missing variable name
cause: A variable name was not specified for the element pattern expression.
action: Use an identifier for the variable name in the element pattern expression.

description: missing label name
cause: A label name was not specified for the label expression.
action: Use an identifer for the label name in the label expression.

description: Property graph %s could not be INMEMORY enabled because its VERTEX table %s is disconnected.
cause: The specified property graph used in the ALTER PROPERTY GRAPH command contained at least one VERTEX table which was not referenced by any EDGE tables which prevents it from being INMEMORY enabled.
action: Change the property graph so that every VERTEX table is referenced by at least one EDGE table.

description: invalid SQL data type for property
cause: An invalid SQL data type was used to define the property.
action: Use a valid SQL data type to define the property.

description: Not enough memory to compile GRAPH_TABLE operator.
cause: Compilation of GRAPH_TABLE failed due to lack of memory.
action: Increase your program global area (PGA) memory or contact your system administrator.

description: invalid property graph input to GRAPH_TABLE()
cause: An invalid property graph input was passed to GRAPH_TABLE().
action: Use valid property graph input to GRAPH_TABLE().

description: invalid dot notation for JSON type in the label
cause: An invalid dot notation for a JSON type was used in the label.
action: Use a valid dot notation for a JSON type in the label.

description: invalid argument specified in an EDGE_ID or EDGE_EQUAL operator
cause: An invalid argument was specified in an EDGE_ID or EDGE_EQUAL operator.
action: Use the edge variable name as an argument to EDGE_ID or EDGE_EQUAL operator.

description: cannot alter column present in in-memory graph element key
cause: The alter table operation caused one of the columns to become unsupported for an in-memory property graph.
action: Alter all the dependent INMEMORY graphs to NO INMEMORY first then retry the operation.

description: Property graph not in enforced mode.
cause: The property graph was not in enforced mode.
action: Re-create or alter the property graph in enforced mode.

description: data manipulation operation not legal on GRAPH_TABLE() operator
cause: An attempt was made to use an UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE statement on GRAPH_TABLE() operator.
action: UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE rows in the underlying graph element tables instead.

description: query graph on a remote database is not supported
cause: An attempt was made to query a graph on a remote database using dblink.
action: Do not attempt to access graph on a remote database.

description: invalid vertex or edge ID: '%s'
cause: The specified vertex or edge ID was not valid.
action: Pass a valid vertex or edge ID.

description: invalid argument specified in a VERTEX_ID or VERTEX_EQUAL operator
cause: An invalid argument was specified in a VERTEX_ID or VERTEX_EQUAL operator.
action: Use a vertex variable name as an argument to VERTEX_ID or VERTEX_EQUAL operator.

description: property "%s" is never defined
cause: A vertex (respectively, edge) property was not defined in any of the vertex (respectively, edge) labels of the graph.
action: Specify a property that is defined in at least one vertex (respectively, edge) label.

description: invalid value specified for bounded quantifier in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: An invalid value was specified for the bounded quantifier in a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
action: Choose a valid value and retry the operation. The lower bound value must be non-negative. The upper bound value must be positive and greater than or equal to the lower bound value.

description: unsupported quantifier for variable path pattern in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: The specified quantifier for the variable path pattern was not supported.
action: Modify the pattern specification and retry the operation.

description: unsupported nested quantified path pattern in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: The specified nested quantified path pattern was not supported.
action: Modify the pattern specification and retry the operation.

description: path pattern is not specified in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: A path pattern was not specified in a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
action: Add the path pattern specification and retry the operation.

description: Subquery is not allowed in a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
cause: An attempt was made to use a subquery in a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
action: Remove the subquery from the GRAPH_TABLE operator and retry the operation.

description: no value specified for bounded quantifier in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: No value was specified for the bounded quantifier in a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
action: Choose a valid value and retry the operation. The lower bound value must be non-negative. The upper bound value must be positive and greater than or equal to the lower bound value.

description: invalid reference of group variable %s in the COLUMNS clause of a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: A group variable was referenced outside of the quantified path pattern in which it was declared.
action: Remove the invalid use of the group variable and retry the operation.

description: Variable %s is not declared in the MATCH clause of a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
cause: A variable used in a predicate or column clause was not declared in the MATCH clause of a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
action: Remove the undeclared variable and retry the operation.

description: invalid path pattern expression is specified in a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: A path pattern expression was specified with a syntax error.
action: Modify the path pattern specification and retry the operation.

description: invalid reference of group variable %s in the WHERE clause of a GRAPH_TABLE operator
cause: A group variable was referenced outside of the quantified path pattern in which it was declared.
action: Remove the invalid use of the group variable and retry the operation.

description: Edge pattern missing in a quantified path pattern of the MATCH clause of a GRAPH_TABLE operator.
cause: A quantified path pattern did not contain an edge pattern.
action: Modify the path pattern specification and retry the operation.

description: session id list not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the session id list specified was null.
action: Check the session id list, and try again with a valid value.

description: destination instance not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the destination instance specified was null.
action: Check the destination instance , and try again with a valid value.

description: client id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the client id specified was null.
action: Check the client id, and try again with a valid value.

description: percentage not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the percentage specified was null.
action: Check the percentage, and try again with a valid value.

description: session id list not specified
cause: An attempt to cancel migration was made, which failed because the session id list specified was null.
action: Check the session id list, and try again with a valid value.

description: session id not specified
cause: An attempt to get migration status was made, which failed because the session id specified was null.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: sid field is null
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had a null sid field.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: serial# field is null
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had a null serial# field.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: Migration failed because session number %s, serial number %s does not exist.
cause: An invalid session number or serial number was specified in the migration operation.
action: Provide a valid session number and serial number, and retry the migration operation.

description: No more memory to hold connection state information
cause: An attempt to reference more connections than configured
action: Check the connection information and try again.

description: migrate operation for session id %s, serial number %s failed
cause: A migration related operation failed because of contention between sessions.
action: Check the additional error codes for more information, and retry the operation later.

description: session number %s, serial number %s cannot be migrated
cause: The specified session could not be migrated by using the transparent session migration due to its current state.
action: Verify the session number and serial number, and try again.

description: instance name not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed because the instance name specified was null.
action: Check the instance name, and try again with a valid value.

description: session number %s with serial number %s is already being migrated
cause: An attempt was made to migrate a session that was already being migrated.
action: Check the session number and serial number and try again.

description: destination connect string not specified
cause: A migration attempt was made, which failed because the connect string specified was null.
action: Check the connect string and try again.

description: Session recreation failed
cause: Session recreation failed at the destination instance.
action: Check session state and try migration again

description: Session prepare failed for session number %s, serial number %s
cause: A migration attempt was made, which failed because session prepare failed.
action: Retry migration again after checking all arguments.

description: Session begin at the destination instance failed.
cause: Session BEGIN failed at the destination instance because the shadow connection could not be established.
action: Check the CONNECT string and try starting the session again.

description: invalid value "%s" specified for parameter "%s"
cause: An invalid value was specified for the the given parameter.
action: Correct the value being specified for the parameter.

description: OCI error during transparent session migration
cause: An OCI operation failed during transparent session migration.
action: Check the OCI error signalled, and take corrective action.

description: instance name not specified
cause: An attempt to recover after instance death was made, which failed because the instance name specified was null.
action: Check the instance name, and try again with a valid value.

description: death time not specified
cause: An attempt to recover after instance death was made, which failed because the death time specified was null.
action: Check the death time, and try again with a valid value.

description: Cursor needs to be parsed again
cause: An SQL operation failed because the cursor state was lost.
action: Reissue all operations starting from parse.

description: sid field %s is invalid
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had an invalid sid field.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: serial# field %s is invalid
cause: A session id instance passed into a dbms_tsm procedure or function had an invalid serial# field.
action: Check the serial#, and try again with a valid value.

description: Error status %s during OCI operation at %s
cause: An OCI operation failed during transparent session migration.
action: Check the OCI error signalled, and take corrective action.

description: Session id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the session id specified by the client was null.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: Destination session id not specified for sid %s serial# %s
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the destination session id specified by the client was null.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: Session id not specified
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the session id specified by the client was null.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.

description: Destination session key not specified for sid %s serial# %s
cause: An attempt to migrate was made, which failed during migration because the destination session key specified by the client was null.
action: Check the session id, and try again with a valid value.
