action: Ensure the list of columns is the same across all instances of the specified table or mark the non-common columns across instances of the table with NOCHECK.

description: Cannot enable logical replication for JSON-relational duality view '%s' because the identifying (primary or unique) key column(s) or _id field for the table '%s' were not selected in the view
cause: Logical replication cannot be enabled for the specified duality view because an identifying key was not selected for at least one table included in the view. Every table in the duality view must select a primary or unique key, or have an '_id' field that refers to any column.
action: Ensure that the JSON-relational duality view selects primary or unique key on all tables or define the JSON field '_id' for each instance of a table without an identifying primary or unique key.

description: JSON array dimension cannot be specified with binary size limit.
cause: JSON binary size limit is specified with the JSON array dimension in the JSON type modifier.
action: Do not specify the JSON binary size limit when the JSON array dimension is specified in the JSON type modifier.

description: JSON binary encoding exceeds JSON binary size limit %s specified in JSON type modifier.
cause: The input JSON instance is too large for binary encoding.
action: Reduce the input JSON size or increase the JSON binary size limit specified in the JSON type modifier.

description: Invalid JSON array dimension value
cause: An invalid value is being specified for the JSON array dimension in the JSON type modifier.
action: Choose an appropriate integer value and retry the operation.

description: Invalid JSON binary size limit value specified in JSON type modifier
cause: An invalid value is being specified for the JSON binary size limit in the JSON type modifier.
action: Choose an appropriate integer value between 9 and 33554432 and retry the operation.

description: JSON Array Operation Error
cause: Invalid json array operation error encountered.
action: Remove json array operation.

description: Transaction rolled back due to an error during the commit-time processing of logical replication or directives for JSON-relational duality views.
cause: Logical replication and certain directives for JSON-relational duality views are processed at the time of transaction commit. For example, dump modified JSON duality view documents to supplemental log or to a notifications table. This error occurs when this commit-time processing fails.
action: Refer to other errors in the error stack for specific reasons and address them accordingly.

description: Invalid JSON type modifier for JSON array specification
cause: An invalid JSON array specification is specified in the modifier."
action: Remove the invalid JSON array specification in the JSON type modifier.

description: Only read operations are supported on JSON collection views.
cause: An attempt to write a document is made to a JSON collection view.
action: Remove the write operation.

description: JSON modifier cannot specify both an array of scalar and scalar types.
cause: An invalid JSON modifier is specified that combines array of scalar and scalar types.
action: Change the JSON modifier specification.

description: Cannot create JSON-relational duality view '%s'. The _id field at root level is not mapped to identifying key (primary or unique) of the root table.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a duality view with a _id field at root level not mapped to identifying key of the root table, which is not allowed.
action: Map the _id field at root level to the identifying key of the root table

description: Documents without a JSON descriptor cannot be used with a 'save' operation on a JSON collection.
cause: An attempt is being made to save a document without a JSON descriptor to a JSON collection table.
action: Supply a document backed by a JSON descriptor when using the 'save' operation on a JSON collection.

description: Operation on EMBEDDED_OID collection with VARCHAR2 key column is not supported.
cause: Operation was requested on a collection configured with keyColumn.assignmentMethod EMBEDDED_OID and keyColumn.sqlType VARCHAR2, which is not a supported.
action: Consider using a supported collection configuration such as the default SODA collection.

description: JSON_SCHEMA is not supported in JSON_DIFF.
cause: JSON schema based diff is not supported in JSON_DIFF.
action: Consider using JSON_DIFF without a schema in positional diff mode or with a duality view schema in keyed diff mode.

description: Validation schema can only be specified for JSON collection table.
cause: Validation schema is being specified for a collection other a JSON collection table.
action: Ensure that the collection is a JSON collection table.

description: Unsupported option in json_behavior parameter
cause: Unsupported option is being specified in json_behavior parameter.
action: Ensure that only supported options are specified in json_behavior parameter.

description: Classic collection cannot be under a different user.
cause: Classic collection creation under a different user is being attempted.
action: Ensure that a different user is not specified as the owner of the classic collection.

description: The specified attribute association ("%s", "%s") is already attached to existing VPD policies with the specified policy function "%s"."%s".
cause: An attempt was made to add an attribute association which was already attached to shared context-sensitive policies with the specified Virtual Private Database (VPD) policy function. All shared context-sensitive policies with a common policy function need to have the same set of attribute associations. Attribute associations of an existing shared context-sensitive policy which is using the specified policy function will be automatically added to the new policy.
action: Review existing VPD policy contexts in the DBA_POLICY_CONTEXTS view and retry the operation without specifying the namespace and attribute values.
params: 1) namespace: The name of the namespace. 2) attribute: The name of the attribute. 3) owner: The policy function owner name. 4) name: The policy function name.

description: The value is not set for the application context attribute ("%s", "%s") used by the VPD security policy "%s".
cause: A value was not set for every application context attribute for the Virtual Private Database (VPD, Row Level Security, and Fine-grained access control) policy. These attributes are used by VPD policy_type CONTEXT_SENSITIVE or SHARED_CONTEXT_SENSITIVE. A value must be set for every VPD policy of these types.
action: Update the application procedure or function to set all of the application context attributes needed by the VPD policy and retry the operation.
params: 1) namespace: The name of the application context namespace. 2) attribute: The name of the application context attribute. 3) policy_name: The name of the row-level security policy.

description: Could not read attribute associations from an existing shared context-sensitive policy which is using the specified policy function.
cause: An existing shared context-sensitive policy using the specified policy function was dropped from another session.
action: Reissue the command. If the error persists, contact the system administrator.

description: cannot use bind variable in VERSIONS clause when the object has a VPD row-level security policy
cause: The object being accessed had an Oracle Virtual Private Database (VPD) row-level security policy defined on it and the VERSIONS clause contained a bind variable.
action: Rewrite the query without using a bind variable in the VERSIONS clause.

description: The operation can disclose rows protected by row-level security policy.
cause: The object being accessed had a row-level security policy defined on it and the statement that was executed could disclose rows protected by the row-level security policy.
action: Rewrite the statement to conform with the security policy to not disclose the rows protected by the policy.

description: The number of VPD policies on an object exceed the maximum number that is allowed.
cause: A maximum of 255 Virtual Private Database (VPD) policies that can be enforced on an object was exceeded.
action: Drop an existing policy before creating a new policy.

description: Cannot delete Virtual Private Database (VPD) policy group "%s" as the group contains one or more policies.
cause: An attempt was made to delete a VPD policy group which contained one or more policies. A policy group can be dropped only if there is no policy in the group.
action: Query DBA_POLICIES to check if there is a policy associated with the policy group which is getting deleted. If there is any such policy, drop the policy with DBMS_RLS.DROP_GROUPED_POLICY procedure. Retry DBMS_RLS.DELETE_POLICY_GROUP after dropping all policies associated with the policy group.
params: 1) Policy Group: The name of the policy group.

description: A Virtual Private Database (VPD) policy cannot be applied to an object owned by SYS.
cause: An attempt was made to apply a VPD policy to an object owned by SYS. VPD policies cannot be applied to SYS-owned objects.
action: Do not apply a VPD policy to any SYS-owned object. You can apply a VPD policy to an object that is not owned by SYS.

description: cannot create an OLS policy in an application root
cause: An Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy creation was attempted in an application root.
action: Switch to an application pluggable database to create an Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy.

description: cannot apply OLS policy on common objects
cause: An attempt was made to apply an Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy on a multitenant container database (CDB) common or an application common object.
action: Apply OLS policy on local objects only.

description: cannot use virtual column as OLS policy column
cause: An attempt was made to use the virtual column as an Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy column.
action: Create OLS policy with a different label column name.

description: An OLS privilege for a policy cannot be set for a common user.
cause: An attempt was made to set an Oracle Label Security (OLS) privilege for a policy to a common user.
action: The Oracle Database documentation for SA_USER_ADMIN.SET_USER_PRIVS PL/SQL package lists the user types that can be set. Set the OLS policy privilege to a user that is of the appropriate type.

description: Full table access is restricted by Oracle Label Security.
cause: The user did not have permission to bypass reads for Oracle Label Security policies.
action: Grant the appropriate privileges or change the policy configuration.

description: Cannot apply an OLS policy on an external table.
cause: An attempt was made to apply an Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy on an external table.
action: Review your security requirements. If the data in the external table needs to be protected with an OLS policy, design a way to move the data from the external table to a regular database table and apply the OLS policy on the new table.

description: An undefined OLS data label cannot be used as a row label.
cause: An attempt was made to assign an undefined Oracle Label Security (OLS) data label as a row label in an OLS-protected table when OLS was integrated with Oracle Internet Directory (OID).
action: Ensure that the row label is a defined data label. Review the OLS documentation topic on creating data labels and constraints when inserting data when OLS is configured with OID.

description: Cannot apply OLS policy with a labeling function when Oracle Database Vault operations control is enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to apply an Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy with a labeling function when Oracle Database Vault operations control was enabled. This error also occurs when and OLS policy with a function is already applied and then the Oracle Database Vault operations control is enabled.
action: If Oracle Database Vault operations control is necessary, then an OLS policy cannot be applied with a labeling function.

description: cannot be executed by an Oracle Real Application Security user
cause: An attempt was made to execute Oracle Label Security (OLS) API by an Oracle Real Application Security (RAS) user.
action: Execute as a database user with necessary privileges and roles.

description: cannot be executed outside datapump export
cause: An attempt was made to execute the function outside datapump export.
action: Do not execute outside datapump export.

description: cannot be processed because user session label is modified
cause: An attempt was made to alter the user session after the session label changed.
action: Do not process after modifying the user session label.

description: cannot administer Oracle Label Security policy
cause: An attempt was made to administer Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy by an admin user within cloud database.
action: Administer OLS policy using a designated OLS administrative user.

description: Oracle Label Security cannot be configured.
cause: Configuration of Oracle Label Security (OLS) failed because the LBAC_TRIGGER schema already exists.
action: Drop LBAC_TRIGGER schema and retry configuring Oracle Label Security (OLS).

description: invalid %s name %s while applying or enabling OLS policy
cause: Applying or enabling Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy on the table or schema failed because of an invalid table, schema or policy name.
action: Correct the table, schema or policy name.
params: 1) object_type: One out of table, schema or policy. 2) object_name: Table, schema or policy name.

description: An existing data label cannot be changed to a user-only label.
cause: An existing data label that is available for data and users can not be altered to only be a user label.
action: Review existing labels in DBA_SA_LABELS. The LABEL_TYPE column defines if the label is used as a data label. Determine your requirements and: - Run the same operation but use NULL for the new_data_label parameter. - Create a new label that will only be a user label.

description: A circular reference was detected while trying to alter the existing OLS group %s with the parent %s.
cause: The new Oracle Label Security (OLS) parent group in the operation is already a descendent for the current OLS group. OLS groups can only be configured in a hierarchy and not in a circular reference.
action: Do not specify one of the descendent groups as the new parent in the OLS SA_COMPONENTS.ALTER_GROUP_PARENT procedure to prevent forming a circular reference.
params: 1) group_name: The OLS group being altered. 2) parent_group_name: Parent group specified while trying to alter group.

description: The OLS policy %s is already applied to schema %s.
cause: The Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy is already protected by this policy.
action: No action needed if the intent is to apply the same OLS policy to the schema. If you intended to change options, predicate, or the label function, then either run the SA_POLICY_ADMIN.ALTER_SCHEMA statement or remove and apply the policy after making the required changes.
params: 1) policy name: Name of the Oracle Label Security policy. 2) schema_name: Name of the schema.

description: The user who created the current session does not have any labels assigned for the OLS policy.
cause: No labels exist for the user who created the current session for the Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy specified in the SA_SESSION.SET_LABELS procedure.
action: Ask your DBA to assign you OLS labels. Restart the session and then execute SA_SESSION.SET LABELS procedure.

description: OLS level already exists in policy %s.
cause: This is an attempt to create an Oracle Label Security (OLS) level that already exists for the specified policy.
action: Query the view ALL_SA_LEVELS to find out all the levels that already exist for any policy. Create a new level if required for that policy with a different level number, short name and long name than the already existing levels.
params: 1) policy_name: Name of the OLS policy.

description: OLS %s %s is already in use by one or more labels.
cause: This is an attempt to alter an Oracle Label Security (OLS) level, compartment or group that is already in use by one or more labels.
action: Review your requirements to see if a new OLS level, compartment or group needs to be created.
params: 1) component_type: One out of level, group or compartment. 2) componet_num: Level, group or compartment number.

description: OLS %s is in use by existing policy %s labels.
cause: This is an attempt to drop an Oracle Label Security (OLS) level, compartment or group that is still in use by one or more labels.
action: Check all the labels for the level, compartment or group that you are trying to drop and verify if they are needed anymore. If none of the labels are needed, drop the labels and then drop the level, compartment or group.
params: 1) component_type: One out of level, group or compartment. 2) policy_name: Name of the OLS policy.

description: Creating new audit policies for OLS can only be done using Unified Auditing.
cause: This is an attempt to create a new Oracle Label Security (OLS) audit configuration using a desupported API.
action: Use Unified Auditing to create audit policies and configurations for OLS auditing. Refer to Oracle Database documentation for more information on Unified Auditing for OLS and for more information about Unified Auditing in general.

description: Configuring OLS can only be done as SYS.
cause: This is an attempt to configure Oracle Label Security (OLS) as a non-SYS user.
action: Log into the database instance as user SYS with the SYSDBA administrative privilege to configure OLS.

description: pkcs11 library not found
cause: The PKCS11 library could not be found.
action: Make sure that the pkcs11 library is at the location specified in the wallet.

description: pkcs11 token not found
cause: The PKCS11 token could not be found.
action: Make sure that a token with correct label is present in slot.

description: pkcs11 passphrase is wrong
cause: The PKCS11 passphrase is wrong.
action: Make sure that the token passphrase specified is correct.

description: pkcs11: C_GetFunctionList() returned error
cause: NA
action: NA

description: pkcs11: C_Initialize returned error
cause: NA
action: NA

description: pkcs11: No tokens present
cause: a token is not present in the slot
action: Place a pkcs11 token in the slot

description: pkcs11: C_GetSlotList returned error
cause: NA
action: NA

description: pkcs11: C_GetTokenInfo returned error
cause: NA
action: NA

description: Symbol not found in pkcs11 library
cause: NA
action: NA

description: pkcs11: Token login failed
cause: To login to the pkcs11 token a correct passphrase is needed
action: Check the token passphrase.

description: pkcs11: Failed to change certC provider
cause: NA
action: Check trace message.

description: pkcs11: finding private key on token error
cause: error occurred while finding private key on token
action: Make sure the private key corresponding to the certificate in wallet is on the token. Check trace message

description: pkcs11: key pair gen error
cause: error occurred while generating key pair using HSM
action: Check trace message

description: pkcs11: wallet already contains pkcs11 information
cause: NA
action: NA

description: pkcs11: No certificate found on the smart card/HSM
cause: No certificate was found on the smart card/HSM.
action: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to populate the smart card/HSM with certificate.

description: pkcs11: No user certificate found on the smart card/HSM
cause: No user certificate was found on the smart card/HSM.
action: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to populate the smart card/HSM with certificate and private key.

description: pkcs11: No certificate found on smart card/HSM label with given cert label
cause: There were no certificate labels on the smart card/HSM that matched the certificate label specified in the wallet.
action: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to set certificate label in smart card/HSM.

description: pkcs11: Multiple certificates found on smart card/HSM with given cert label
cause: Certificates with identical labels were found in the smart card/HSM.
action: Follow smart card/HSM vendor documentation to assign unique certificate labels to certificates.

description: pkcs11: Certificate with given cert label is not a user cert
cause: The certificate with the specified certificate label did not have a matching private key in the smart card/HSM.
action: Follow smart card/HSM vendor instructions to create credentials (certificate/private key) in smart card/HSM.

description: CRYPTO toolkit error. See trace output.
cause: NA
action: Provide the trace output to Oracle Support for further diagnostics.

description: Certificate is using forbidden or unsupported signature algorithm.
cause: Certificate may be using MD2 or MD5 signature algorithm.
action: Review wallet content and remove or replace certificates using obsolete algorithms.

description: SSL/TLS : received invalid ClientHello message.
cause: NA
action: Provide a network trace to Oracle Support for further diagnostics.

description: SSL/TLS : received invalid ServerHello message.
cause: NA
action: Provide a network trace to Oracle Support for further diagnostics.

description: Cannot enable logical replication on JSON-relational duality view '%s': The ORACLE RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update is not yet complete.
cause: Logical replication cannot be enabled on a JSON-relational duality view until all instances of the cluster have installed the RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update.
action: Logical replication can be enabled on a JSON-relational duality view after all instances have completed their RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates and ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES has been executed.

description: Static value '%s' specified instead of table name.
cause: A table name is expected, but a static integer value is specified instead.
action: Replace the static value with a valid table name.

description: @OBJECT directive cannot be used if the @LINK directive has been specified with only the TO parameter or if the @ARRAY directive has been specified or if the sub-object has been enclosed in square brackets.
cause: If the @LINK directive is specified with only the TO parameter, then the sub-object is an array of objects, but using the @OBJECT directive indicates that the sub-object is a simple object.
action: Remove the @LINK directive or specify both the FROM and TO parameters in the @LINK directive or remove the @OBJECT directive.

description: Invalid identifier: '%s' does not match the table name '%s'.
cause: The table name specified with the column is different from the table to which the column belongs.
action: Specify the correct table name and retry. If @ALIAS directive is used then the table name specified with column should be the same as the table alias.

description: Value '%s' is out of bounds.
cause: The specified value does not fall within the supported range. For integers, the range is [0, 18446744073709551614] and for float, the range is [0.0, 3.4E+38].
action: Replace the out of bound value with a value from the supported range.

description: Unsupported value for the _IS_NULL operator
cause: True and False are the only supported values for the _IS_NULL operator.
action: Specify the correct value for the _IS_NULL operator.

description: The array for _BETWEEN operator should have exactly 2 values.
cause: The array for the _BETWEEN operator does not have 2 values.
action: Specify exactly two values in the array for the _BETWEEN operator.

description: Expected a scalar value for the '%s' operator. An array of scalar values is specified instead.
cause: An array of scalar values is being specified in place of a scalar value.
action: Replace the array of scalar values with an appropriate scalar value.

description: Expected an array of scalar values for the '%s' operator. A scalar value is specified instead.
cause: A scalar value is being specified in place of an array of scalar values.
action: Replace the scalar value with an appropriate array of scalar values.

description: The root table '%s' in the JSON-relational duality view '%s' cannot be accessed as a JSON array.
cause: The root table has been specified within the JSON_ARRAYAGG operator in SQL syntax for the JSON-relational duality view creation or the root table has @ARRAY directive in the GraphQL syntax for the JSON-relational duality view creation.
action: In SQL syntax, replace the JSON_ARRAYAGG operator for the root table with the JSON_OBJECT operator, and in the GraphQL syntax either remove the @ARRAY directive for the root table or replace the @ARRAY directive with the @OBJECT directive.
params: 1) root_table_name: Name of the root table. 2) view_name: Name of the JSON-relational duality view.

description: Invalid directive '%s' for the %s '%s'
cause: The directive specified by the user is not supported.
action: Refer to Oracle documentation for the list of supported directives.
params: 1) directive_name: The name of the directive specified by the user. 2) field_type: The type of field for which the directive specified by the user is not supported. The field type can be column or table. 3) field_name: The name of the field for which the directive specified by the user is not supported.

description: Invalid item-method operator '%s'
cause: The specified item-method operator is not supported.
action: Replace the invalid item-method operator with a valid item-method operator.

description: Missing parameters for the GET_GRAPHQL_SCHEMA procedure.
cause: No parameter is specified in the GET_GRAPHQL_SCHEMA procedure.
action: Provide at least one valid parameter to GET_GRAPHQL_SCHEMA. Valid parameters are "tableNames" and "schema".

description: The value for the parameter '%s' should be %s.
cause: The wrong type of value is specified for a parameter.
action: Specify the correct type of value for each parameter.
params: 1) parameter_name: The parameter for which the specified value is of incorrect type. 2) value_type: Valid type of the value for the specified paramter.

description: The @nest directive cannot be used together with any other directives.
cause: Another directive is being used with the @nest directive.
action: Remove any other directives that conflict with @nest and retry the query.

description: Incorrect number of arguments specified for the directive @%s.
cause: An incorrect number of arguments have been specified for the directive.
action: Specify the correct number of arguments for the directive.

description: @UNNEST directive cannot be used in conjuction with @GENERATED directive on the same sub-object.
cause: Both @UNNEST and @GENERATED directives have been specified for a sub-object.
action: Either remove the @UNNEST directive or remove the @GENERATED directive.

description: Invalid token '%s'. Expected %s.
cause: An invalid token has been specified.
action: Replace the invalid token with the expected token.
params: 1) invalid_token: Specified invalid token. 2) expected_token: Expected token.

description: GraphQL variable '%s' has no value in the PASSING clause.
cause: The variable specified in the GraphQL expression is not mapped to a bind variable in the PASSING clause.
action: Map the GraphQL variable to a bind variable using the PASSING clause.

description: Insufficient privileges or the object does not exist.
cause: The connected user does not have READ or SELECT privilege on the tables or the specified table does not exist.
action: Specify the correct table names and grant the SELECT or READ privilege on the required tables.

description: Query by Example check clause and GraphQL arguments cannot be used in conjuction with @NEST directive.
cause: Query by Example check clause or GraphQL arguments have been used over an object annotated with @NEST directive.
action: Remove the Query by Example check clause or the GraphQL arguments.

description: Oracle GraphQL syntax does not support backslash character (\) in identifier names.
cause: An identifier name having a backslash character is being used in the GraphQL syntax.
action: Use the SQL syntax or remove the backslash character.

description: Invalid value for the LIMIT clause.
cause: An invalid value is specified for the LIMIT clause.
action: Value for the LIMIT clause should be a positive integer less than or equal to 4294967295.

description: The backslash character (\) can only be used to escape the double quote character (") in the SQL argument of directives in the Oracle GraphQL syntax.
cause: The backslash character is followed by a character other than the double quote character (\") in the SQL argument of directives in the Oracle GraphQL syntax.
action: Use the SQL syntax or remove the backslash character.

description: Order by clause cannot be used for the table '%s' mapped to a JSON object returning a single row.
cause: Order by clause is specified for the JSON object returning a single row.
action: Remove the order by clause.
params: 1) table_name: Table for which the order by clause is invalid.

description: The root object cannot be an array of scalars.
cause: The root object is an array of scalars. The root object can only be a singleton JSON object.
action: Change the type of root object.

description: A literal value in the SQL expression of @%s directive is not enclosed in single quotes (').
cause: Unmatched single quote (') found in the SQL expression of the specified directive.
action: Ensure that all literal values are properly enclosed in single quotes (').

description: A quoted identifier value in the SQL expression of @%s directive is not enclosed in double quotes (").
cause: Unmatched double quote (\") found in the SQL expression of the specified directive.
action: Ensure that all quoted idenfitifers are properly enclosed in double quotes (\").

description: Extra or missing parentheses found in the SQL expression of @%s directive.
cause: Unmatched parentheses or round brackets found in the SQL expression of a directive.
action: Ensure that the SQL expression of the specified directive has no unmatched parentheses.

description: Cannot create JSON-relational duality view '%s'. A generated field cannot be declared on a flexible column.
cause: The duality view definition includes a field marked as both generated and flexible.
action: Remove the field or change the definition of the field to either flexible or generated.
params: 1) duality_view_name: Specified name for duality view.

description: Cannot create directive: Directive name is invalid
cause: An invalid directive name is specified while creating the directive.
action: Verify that the directive name is not a reserved keyword.

description: Cannot create directive: Directives owned by PUBLIC cannot be created
cause: An attempt is made to create a directive owned by PUBLIC.
action: Do not create a directive owned by PUBLIC.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Missing VALIDATE, AUGMENT or NOTIFY keyword
cause: The VALIDATE, AUGMENT or NOTIFY keyword is not specified for the directive.
action: Specify the VALIDATE, AUGMENT or NOTIFY keyword.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': '%s' keyword is specified more than one time
cause: A keyword is specified more than once in the action List of CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Do not duplicate the INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or SELECT keyword in the Action List of the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': An invalid keyword is specified after ON keyword in PROCESSING STAGE clause
cause: An invalid keyword is specified after the ON keyword in the PROCESSING STAGE clause of the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT after the ON keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Missing VIEW, OBJECT or ALL keyword after SCOPE keyword
cause: The VIEW, OBJECT or ALL keyword is not found after the SCOPE keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either VIEW, OBJECT or ALL after the SCOPE keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Missing SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE keyword after ON keyword
cause: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE is not found after the ON keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE after the ON keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': DELETE is not allowed after ON keyword for %s
cause: The ON keyword can be followed by either SELECT, INSERT, or UPDATE for the VALIDATION and AUGMENTATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either SELECT, INSERT or UPDATE after the ON keyword for the VALIDATION and AUGMENTATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': SELECT keyword is not allowed after ON keyword for the NOTIFICATION DIRECTIVE
cause: The ON keyword can be followed by either INSERT, DELECT or UPDATE for the NOTIFICATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either INSERT, DELETE or UPDATE after the ON keyword for the NOTIFICATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Missing OBJECT after BEFORE keyword in PROCESSING STAGE clause
cause: An invalid PROCESSING clause is used. The PROCESSING clause can either be BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT after the ON keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Missing OBJECT or STATEMENT after AFTER keyword in PROCESSING STAGE clause
cause: An invalid PROCESSING clause is used. The PROCESSING clause can either be BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT after the ON keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': An invalid option after USING keyword
cause: An invalid clause is used after the USING keyword. The CREATE DIRECTIVE statement should end after the USING clause.
action: Do not specify options after the USING clause. Put all the valid options before the USING clause.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': An invalid keyword is specified after USING keyword for the NOTIFICATION DIRECTIVE
cause: An invalid keyword is specified after the USING keyword in CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either DUALITY VIEW LOG, EVENT QUEUE or SUPPLEMENTAL LOG after the USING keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Mandatory VALIDATE or NOVALIDATE keyword is missing for VALIDATION DIRECTIVE
cause: The VALIDATE or NOVALIDATE keyword is mandatory for the VALIDATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify either the VALIDATE or NOVALIDATE keyword for the VALIDATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Mandatory PROCESSING clause is missing for %s
cause: The PROCESSING clause ( BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT ) is mandatory for the VALIDATION or NOTIFICATION DIRECTIVE in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify the PROCESSING clause LIKE BEFORE OBJECT, AFTER OBJECT, AFTER STATEMENT, or ON COMMIT in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': Invalid function name is specified in USING clause
cause: An invalid function name is specified in the USING clause for the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify a valid function name in the USING clause in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on base object '%s': only AFTER OBJECT processing stage is allowed for the SELECT VALIDATION DIRECTIVE
cause: The SELECT keyword as the ON clause only allows AFTER OBJECT as the PROCESSING clause in the VALIDATION DIRECTIVE.
action: Specify AFTER OBJECT as the PROCESSING clause if SELECT keyword is mentioned in the ON clause of the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot alter directive '%s': SQL keyword '%s' is specified more than one time
cause: A keyword is specified more than once in the action list of the ALTER DIRECTIVE statement. This can be in one of the following lists: 1. ENABLE or DISABLE 2. VALIDATE or NOVALIDATE
action: Do not duplicate the keyword in the action list of the ALTER DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot alter directive '%s': SQL keyword '%s' is not syntactically valid
cause: An unexpected keyword is being encountered in the SQL ALTER DIRECTIVE statement at or near the position printed in the error message. One of the following occurred: 1. There is a spelling error in the SQL statement. 2. An unsupported or unknown keyword is specified in the statement.
action: Take the action that corresponds to the Cause: 1. Check that your SQL statement has no typo. 2. Check Oracle Database documentation to find the correct syntax for the statement and remove the unsupported or unknown keyword.

description: Cannot use REPLACE while creating a notification directive '%s'
cause: The REPLACE keyword is not allowed in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement for a notification directive.
action: Do not use the REPLACE keyword in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot specify key columns or logged columns list when creating or altering notification directive '%s' on JSON-relational duality view '%s'
cause: Specifying key columns or logged columns list is not allowed when the directive is being created on a JSON-relational duality view.
action: Do not specify key columns or logged columns list in the CREATE or ALTER DIRECTIVE statement while creating or altering notification directive on JSON-relational duality view.

description: Directive '%s' does not exist
cause: The directive name is invalid.
action: Check the directive name.

description: Base object '%s' not found or type not supported.
cause: The base object is not found, or the type of the base object is not supported.
action: Ensure that the base object exists and that it is a table or a JSON- relational duality view.

description: Table name for notification table '%s' already exists.
cause: The table name for notification table already exists.
action: Enter a unique name for the notification table, or modify or drop the existing object so that it can be reused.

description: View name for notification view '%s' already exists.
cause: The view name for notification view already exists.
action: Enter a unique name for the notification view, or modify or drop the existing object so that it can be reused.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': SQL keyword '%s' is not syntactically valid
cause: An unexpected keyword is being encountered in the SQL CREATE DIRECTIVE statement at or near the position printed in the error message. One of the following occurred: 1. There is a spelling error in the SQL statement. 2. An unsupported or unknown keyword is specified in the statement.
action: Take the action that corresponds to the Cause: 1. Check that your SQL statement has no typo. 2. Check Oracle Database documentation to find the correct syntax for the statement and remove the unsupported or unknown keyword.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': Key column not found in base table '%s'
cause: The key columns is not a subset of base table columns.
action: Ensure the key columns are a subset of the base table columns.

description: Cannot %s directive '%s': key column '%s' is not present in LOGGED COLUMNS clause
cause: All key columns must be present in the logged columns.
action: Include all the key columns in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': Key column is not specified
cause: The key column needs to be specified while creating a notification directive on the table.
action: Ensure that the key column is specified while creating a notification directive.

description: Invalid directive name
cause: An invalid directive name is specified.
action: Verify that directive name is not a reserved keyword.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on view '%s': this view is not a JSON-relational duality view
cause: The base object is a view but not a JSON-relational duality view or a table.
action: Ensure that if the base object is a view then it is a JSON-relational duality view, else the base object should be a table.

description: Cannot alter directive '%s': The specifed logged column '%s' is not a valid column of the table '%s'.'%s'
cause: One or more columns specified in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause is not a valid column in the base table.
action: Ensure that all columns specified in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause are valid columns in the base table.

description: Cannot %s directive '%s': number of columns specified in the %s COLUMNS clause is more than the maximum number of columns allowed: %s.
cause: The number of columns present in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause cannot be more than the maximum number of columns allowed in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause.
action: Ensure the number of columns present in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause is less than maximum number of columns allowed in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause.

description: Cannot create notification directive '%s': only one notification directive can be created on '%s'
cause: A noticiation directive already exists on the base object. Only one notification directive can be created on an object.
action: Ensure that the existing notification directive is dropped.

description: Cannot create notification directive '%s': notification directive cannot be created on %s '%s'
cause: The creation of a notification directive on a temporary table, JSON collection table, notification table, or a queue table is not supported.
action: Do not create a notification directive on a temporary table, JSON collection table, notification table, or a queue table.

description: Cannot create notification directive '%s': data type '%s' is not supported
cause: The data type of one or more logged columns is not supported when creating a notification directive.
action: Ensure the data type of all the logged columns is supported.

description: no options specifed for ALTER DIRECTIVE
cause: No ALTER DIRECTIVE option was specifed.
action: Specify at least one option for the ALTER DIRECTIVE statement.

description: DDL operations are not allowed on the notification %s '%s'.'%s'.
cause: An attempt is being made to use the SQL DDL statement on the notification table or notification view.
action: Do not perform this operation directly on notification directive base objects. Use the directive DDLs instead to modify the notification table or view.

description: Cannot create notification directive '%s': owner of the notification table or the notification view is not the same as the owner of the directive
cause: The specified owner of the notification table or view is different from the owner of directive.
action: Ensure that the owner of the notification objects and the owner of the directive is the same.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': notification table with JSON columns cannot be created in non-Automatic Segment Space Management tablespace '%s'
cause: When a notification directive is created on a duality view, a notification table is automatically created. The notification table has one or more JSON columns. Tables with JSON data type columns are not supported in non-Automatic Segment Space Management (ASSM) tablespaces.
action: Modify the directive to specify a tablespace with Automatic Segment Space Management (ASSM).

description: Cannot alter notification directive '%s': data type '%s' is not supported
cause: The data type of one or more logged columns is not supported when altering a notification directive.
action: Ensure that the data type of all the logged columns is supported.

description: Cannot create or alter directive '%s': Specified %s column list is not a valid comma-seperated list of column names
cause: Specified Logged or Key Column list is not a valid list containing comma-seperated values of column names.
action: Ensure that the Logged or Key Column list only contains comma-seperated column names.

description: Cannot create directive '%s' on JSON-relational duality view '%s': notification directive cannot be created on an invalid JSON-relational duality view
cause: The creation of a notification directive on an invalid JSON-relational duality view is not supported.
action: Ensure that the JSON-relational duality view is valid.

description: Cannot create or alter directive '%s': retention time specified is more than the maximum retention time allowed: %s minutes.
cause: The retention time specified in the RETENTION clause cannot be more than the maximum retention time allowed.
action: Ensure that the retention time specified in the RETENTION COLUMNS clause is less than the maximum retention time allowed in the RETENTION clause.

description: DML operations are not allowed on the notification table or the notification view '%s'.'%s'.
cause: An attempt is being made to run a DML statement on the notification table or the notification view, which is not allowed.
action: Do not perform this operation directly on notification table or view.

description: Cannot purge notification table: the value of PURGE_SCN argument is invalid
cause: The value specified for PURGE_SCN argument is invalid.
action: Ensure that the value of the PURGE_SCN argument is valid.

description: Cannot create notification directive '%s': notification directive cannot be created on an editioned JSON-relational duality view '%s'
cause: The creation of a notification directive on an editioned JSON-relational duality view is not supported.
action: Do not create a notification directive on an editioned JSON-relational duality view.

description: Cannot create or alter notification directive '%s': column name '%s' conflicts with a column name reserved for use by the notification table
cause: An attempt is being made to create or alter a notification directive that logs one or more columns with names that are reserved for use by the notification table.
action: Do not specify a base table with the following reserved column names: USN, SLOT, SQN, OPCODE, BASE_TABLE_ROWID, XCN, COMMIT_SCN, or formatted as CONTEXT$*, OLD$*. Alternatively, create or modify the LOGGED COLUMNS clause to exclude the offending columns.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': Invalid tablespace name specified
cause: An invalid or non-existent tablespace name has been specified in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.
action: Specify a valid tablespace name in the CREATE DIRECTIVE statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': number of columns in the base table is more than the maximum number of columns allowed: %s
cause: The number of columns present in the base table cannot be more than the maximum number of columns allowed.
action: Ensure that the number of columns present in the base table is less than the maximum number of columns allowed.

description: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX operation is not allowed on the notification table %s.%s.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a unique index on a notification table.
action: Unique index creation is not allowed on a notification table.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': EDITIONABLE or NONEDITIONABLE keywords are not allowed
cause: A directive object is not editionable, so the keywords EDITIONABLE or NONEDITIONABLE are not allowed when creating a directive.
action: Do not specify EDITIONABLE or NONEDITIONABLE keywords in the CREATE DIRECTIVE DDL statement.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': missing required keyword KEY or optional keyword LOGGED COLUMNS in NOTIFICATIONS_COLUMNS clause
cause: The NOTIFICATIONS_COLUMNS clause is missing the required keyword KEY or the optional keyword LOGGED COLUMNS.
action: Specify the required keyword KEY or the optional keyword LOGGED COLUMNS in the NOTIFICATIONS_COLUMNS clause.

description: The notification context or attribute name is either missing or invalid.
cause: A valid context or attribute name is expected.
action: Specify a valid notification context or attribute name.

description: The combined size of the notification context and attribute name exceeds the 119 byte limit.
cause: The total length of the notification context and attribute name exceeds 119 bytes for notifications.
action: Specify a valid notification context or attribute name with a combined length of no more than 119 bytes.

description: Cannot create or alter directive '%s': SYS_CONTEXTs are not allowed for directives on JSON-relational Duality View
cause: SYS_CONTEXT for directives on a JSON-relational Duality View is not supported.
action: Do not specify SYS_CONTEXT clause when creating a directive on a JSON-relational Duality View.

description: Cannot create or alter notification directive '%s': key column cannot be encrypted with salt
cause: Any column specified in the key columns clause of create or alter notification directive cannot be a column that is encrypted with salt because notification directive creates an index on the KEY column(s), and indexes cannot be created on an encrypted column with salt. An encrypted column without salt is allowed.
action: Choose a non-salted column as key.

description: Cannot perform this DDL operation on table '%s': a notification directive exists on this table or one of its dependent JSON-relational duality views
cause: An attempt is being made to perform one of the disallowed DDLs on a table with a notification directive on itself or one of its dependent JSON-relational duality views.
action: Drop all notification directives on this table or its JSON-relational duality views if you want to perform this DDL operation on the table.

description: Cannot mark column unused in table '%s' because it is a key column in notification directive '%s'
cause: An attempt is being made to mark a key column in a notification directive as unused, which is disallowed.
action: Do not mark a key column as unused or use the ALTER DIRECTIVE DDL to modify the key columns clause.

description: Cannot encrypt column with salt on table '%s': notification directive '%s' cannot have a key column be encrypted with salt
cause: A column specified as key column in a notification directive cannot be encrypted with salt because notification directive has created an index on this key column, and indexes are not supported on encrypted columns with salt.
action: Encrypt key column without salt or change the notification directive's key column to a non-salted column using ALTER DIRECTIVE.

description: Cannot modify column on table '%s': notification table '%s' contains some rows with data having a higher precision or scale
cause: An attempt is being made to decrease the scale or precision of a numeric column when the notification table already contains data that has a higher scale or precision than the specified reduced scale or precision.
action: Decreasing the precision or scale of a numeric column is not allowed on a notification table containing data.

description: Cannot modify column on table '%s': notification table '%s' contains some rows with data having a greater column length
cause: An attempt is being made to decrease the length of a character column when the notification table already contains data that has a greater length than the specified lower column length.
action: Decreasing the length of a character column is not allowed on a notification table containing data.

description: Cannot modify column on table '%s': notification table '%s' contains some rows with existing data type
cause: An attempt is being made to change the column data type when the notification table already contains data with the older data type.
action: Data type change is not allowed on the base table containing a notification directive with the notification table containing data.

description: Cannot create or alter notification directive '%s': Data type %s is not supported as a key column
cause: A column of type LOB is being passed into the list of key columns, which is not supported.
action: Remove the LOB column from the key column list.

description: Cannot %s notification directive '%s' on %s '%s': Oracle GoldenGate replication is not enabled
cause: Notification directive cannot be created or altered because Oracle GoldenGate replication is not enabled.
action: Ensure that the Oracle GoldenGate replication is enabled using the ENABLE_GOLDENGATE_REPLICATION parameter.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': notification %s creation failed
cause: An error happened during the creation of notification table or notification view or index on the base table.
action: Review the error stack for other errors that led to the DDL failure.

description: Cannot create directive '%s': insufficient privilege on %s
cause: An attempt is being made to create a directive without required privilege.
action: Get granted for the 'create table' and 'create view' privilege.

description: Cannot perform this DML operation: notification directive %s is enabled on invalid JSON-relational duality view %s
cause: An attempt is being made to perform DML on an invalid JSON-relational duality view with a notification directive enabled.
action: Make the JSON-relational duality view valid.

description: Insertion of one or more rows failed into the table having a notification directive
cause: The combined size of all the key columns of notification directive exceeded the maximum index length.
action: Select the key columns of the notification directive such that the size of all key columns does not exceed the maximum index length.

description: Creation of Oracle Label Security (OLS) policy on a notification table is not allowed
cause: An attempt is being made to create OLS policy on a notification table which is not allowed.
action: Do not create OLS policy on a notification table.

description: Cannot drop tablespace '%s' because it contains notification table '%s' of directive '%s' whose base object is either a table located in a different tablespace or is a view
cause: An attempt is being made to drop a tablespace containing a notification table whose base object is either a table located in another tablespace, or a view (which is not dropped by the DROP TABLESPACE statement).
action: Drop the notification directive associated with the notification table before retrying the operation.

description: XA or database link transaction on tables with notification directive enabled is not allowed.
cause: XA or database link transaction is not allowed on tables with notification table enabled.
action: If there is an existing XA / distributed transaction, please commit or rollback and retry the statement, or If you want to start a XA / distributed transaction please commit or rollback the present transaction and retry the statement.

description: Cannot %s index with name '%s' on the notification table '%s'.'%s'
cause: Cannot drop the default index created on the notification table or cannot create an index that conflicts with the default index name created on the notification table.
action: Use a different index name for creating an index on the notification table or use alter directive statement to modify the key columns of the default index of the notification table or use drop directive statement for dropping the default index of the notification table along with the directive.

description: Cannot %s notification directive '%s': The ORACLE RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454 is not yet complete
cause: A notification directive cannot be created/altered/dropped until all instances of the cluster have installed the RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454.
action: Notification directives can be created/altered/dropped after all instances have completed their RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454 and ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES has been executed.

description: Cannot perform a DML on table/JSON-relation duality view '%s' with a notification directive created on it: The ORACLE RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454 is not yet complete
cause: A DML cannot be performed on a table/JSON-relational duality view with notification directive created on it until all instances of the cluster have installed the RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454.
action: A DML can be performed on a table/JSON-relational duality view after all instances have completed their RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update 37628454 and ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES has been executed.

description: Cannot %s directive '%s': all key columns must be present in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause
cause: All key columns must be present in the logged columns.
action: Include all the key columns in the LOGGED COLUMNS clause.

description: Cannot %s notification directive '%s' on %s '%s': _notification_directive is set to DISABLE or DISABLE_DDL
cause: Notification directive cannot be created or altered because the parameter _notification_directive is set to DISABLE or DISABLE_DDL.
action: Set the _notification_directive parameter to ENABLE.

description: Cannot create or alter directive '%s': notification directives cannot track old value columns on a JSON-Relational duality view
cause: An attempt is being made to create a notification directive with old value tracking on a JSON-Relational duality view.
action: Do not create notification with old values on a duality view base object.

description: Cannot create or alter an audit policy on the notification table or the notification view %s
cause: An attempt is being made to create or alter an audit policy on a notification table or view.
action: Do not create or alter an audit policy on a notification table or view.

description: Cannot create or alter notification directive '%s': encrypted character column '%s' with a non-BIS collation is not supported as a key column
cause: An encrypted character column with a non-BIS collation is being passed into the list of key columns, which is not supported.
action: Remove the encrypted character column with a non-BIS collation from the key column list.

description: Cannot rename JSON-relational duality view '%s' with logical replication or directives enabled.

action: Ensure that logical replication or directives is disabled before the rename.

description: invalid collation specified for a CLOB or NCLOB value
