cause: An attempt is being made to create a vector index with DISTRIBUTE or DUPLICATE ALL clause without enabling the feature.
action: Enable the feature and retry creating vector index.

description: CREATE VECTOR INDEX WITH INCLUDED COLUMNS failed. HNSW index with Included Columns does not support index creation on sparse vector column.
cause: An attempt to create an HNSW index with included columns is being made with sparse vector index column.
action: HNSW index with Included Columns is not supported on Sparse Vector Columns.

description: CREATE VECTOR INDEX [%s].[%s] ONLINE failed. Cannot create vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37782449.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37782449.
action: Install and enable the patch on this node and create the index again.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner of the index. 2) index_name: The index name.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Cannot rebuild vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37956740.
cause: An attempt is being made to rebuild a vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37956740.
action: Install and enable the patch on this node and rebuild the index again.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner of the index. 2) index_name: The index name.

description: CREATE VECTOR INDEX with HNSW SCALAR QUANTIZATION failed. Cannot create vector index without enabling the required Two-Stage patch.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a vector index for HNSW SCALAR QUANTIZATION without enabling Two-Stage patch 37956731 and 38586272.
action: Install and enable the patch on this node and create the index again.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Invalid value %s specified for the %s PARAMETER field. Valid values are between 1 and 10000000.
cause: The value specified for the PARAMETER field in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE DDL is invalid.
action: Ensure that the value specified for the PARAMETER clause in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE VECTOR INDEX DDL is between 1 and 10000000.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name. 3) given_value: The value of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause. 4) field_name: The name of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Invalid value %s specified for the %s PARAMETER field. Valid values are between 0 and 4294967295.
cause: The value specified for the PARAMETER field in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE DDL is invalid.
action: Ensure that the value specified for the PARAMETER clause in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE VECTOR INDEX DDL is between 0 and 4294967295.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name. 3) given_value: The value of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause. 4) field_name: The name of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Invalid value %s specified for the %s PARAMETER field. Valid values are between 1 and 4294967295.
cause: The value specified for the PARAMETER field in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE DDL is invalid.
action: Ensure that the value specified for the PARAMETER clause in the ALTER INDEX REBUILD ONLINE VECTOR INDEX DDL is between 1 and 4294967295.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name. 3) given_value: The value of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause. 4) field_name: The name of the field specified in the PARAMETER clause.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. The parameter %s is specified more than once.
cause: The same parameter is specified more than once in the parameter list.
action: Ensure that each parameter is specified only once in the parameter list.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name. 2) field_name: The name of the field specified in the VECTOR INDEX clause.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Invalid syntax in PARAMETERS.
cause: There is an extra comma found in vector index PARAMETERS list.
action: Remove the extra comma from the vector index PARAMETERS list.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD [SUB]PARTITION ONLINE failed. WITH TARGET ACCURACY not supported.
cause: WITH TARGET ACCURACY not supported for partition index.
action: Remove the WITH TARGET ACCURACY clause when rebuilding [SUB]PARTITION
params: 1) owner_name: The owner name. 2) index_name: The index name.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD ONLINE failed. Invalid value %s for TARGET ACCURACY value. Valid values are between 1 and 100.
cause: An attempt is being made to specify an invalid value for the TARGET ACCURACY vector index parameter.
action: Use the valid value that is within the range as specified in the documentation.
params: 1) index_name: The index name. 2) given_val: The value specified for TARGET ACCURACY in the VECTOR INDEX clause.

description: ALTER INDEX [%s].[%s] REBUILD PARTITION ONLINE failed. Cannot rebuild partition local vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37874653.
cause: An attempt is being made to rebuild a partition local vector index in an online manner without enabling Two-Stage patch 37874653.
action: Install and enable the patch on this node and rebuild the index again.
params: 1) owner_name: The owner of the index. 2) index_name: The index name.

description: CREATE VECTOR INDEX %s failed. Cannot create vector index with DISTRIBUTE or DUPLICATE ALL without enabling Two-Stage patches 38320710 and 38542926.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a vector index with DISTRIBUTE or DUPLICATE ALL clause without enabling Two-Stage patches 38320710 and 38542926.
action: Install and enable the patches on this node and create the index again.

description: One or more vector indexes exist that cannot be downgraded.
cause: The database contains vector indexes that are unsupported in Oracle releases or versions pre-23.10.
action: Drop the unsupported vector indexes before downgrading the database to the selected release.

description: recycle constraint id event
cause: NA
action: The following levels can be combined: 0x01 - Disable adding deleted con# to con$recycle metadata table. 0x02 - Disable reusing con# from con$recycle. 0x04 - Use mutiple recursive txns to replenish cache when fetching con# from con$recycle. If this bit is not set, use select for update nowait to replenish cache. 0x08 - Enable diag tracing in kkdl, kqd and kqld.

description: Argument %s is null.
cause: A non-null value was expected for the property being fetched, but the value passed was null.
action: Check your program and ensure that the caller of the routine does not pass a null argument value.
params: 1) property_name: The property name specified by the user.

description: Argument %s is null or invalid.
cause: The argument was expecting a non-null, valid value, but the value of the passed argument was null or invalid.
action: Check your program and ensure that the caller of the routine does not pass a null or invalid argument value.

description: internal error, argument [%s]
cause: The internal argument was invalid.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: security violation
cause: A possible security violation was detected.
action: Check the alert log and trace file for more information.

description: The error, %s, occurred while attempting to process XML metadata.
cause: The specified error occurred during XML metadata processing.
action: Verify that Oracle XDB and all related XML schemas are properly installed. Also, verify that the mapping and anonymity documents are valid.
params: 1) error_code: The XSLT error code returned from the Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT) processor.

description: unimplemented feature: %s
cause: The specified feature is not implemented.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Virtual column feature not yet implemented
cause: Feature has not been implemented.
action: Feature is being implemented.

description: %s: invalid identifier specified for virtual column expression
cause: Column expression referenced a column that does not exist in the table.
action: Rewrite column expression to reference only scalar columns in the table.

description: only pure functions can be specified in a virtual column expression
cause: Column expression contained a function whose evaluation is non-deterministic.
action: Rewrite column expression to reference only pure functions.

description: specified data type is not supported for a virtual column
cause: Only scalar data types are supported for virtual columns. LONG, BLOB, REF, and BFILE data types are not supported for virtual columns.
action: Specify the expression column with a supported scalar data type.

description: resultant data type of virtual column is not supported
cause: The data type of the underlying expression is not supported. Only scalar data types are supported for virtual columns. LONG, BLOB, REF, and BFILE data types are not supported for virtual columns.
action: Specify the expression of virtual column to return a supported scalar data type.

description: keyword VIRTUAL cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword VIRTUAL was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
action: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

description: keyword VISIBLE cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword VISIBLE was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
action: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

description: keyword HIDDEN cannot be specified here
cause: The keyword HIDDEN was either repeated or incorrectly specified.
action: Remove the keyword from the specified syntax.

description: expression column is not supported for an index organized table
cause: Attempt to create/alter an index organized table with an expression column
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: expression column is not supported for an external table
cause: Attempt to create/alter an external table with an expression column
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: expression column is not supported for a temporary table
cause: Attempt to create/alter a temporary table with an expression column
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: expression column is not supported for a clustered table
cause: Attempt to create/alter a clustered table with an expression column
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: virtual column is referenced in a column expression
cause: This virtual column was referenced in an expression of another virtual column
action: Ensure the column expression definition for any virtual column does not refer to any virtual column

description: INSERT operation disallowed on virtual columns
cause: Attempted to insert values into a virtual column
action: Re-issue the statement without providing values for a virtual column

description: Resulting table from a CTAS operation contains virtual column(s)
cause: Table being created by a CTAS operation contains a virtual column definition
action: Remove the virtual column definition from the table being created

description: Duplicate column expression was specified.
cause: Expression of the virtual column being added or created conflicted with an existing or previously specified functional index expression or virtual column expression.
action: Change the expression of the virtual column so that there are no duplicate expressions.

description: Invalid column expression was specified
cause: Virtual column expression is not a valid arithmetic expression. it probably refers to another column in the table
action: Change the expression of the virtual column

description: UPDATE operation disallowed on virtual columns
cause: Attempted to update values of a virtual column
action: Re-issue the statement without setting values for the virtual column

description: A virtual column exists for this expression
cause: Specified index expression matches an existing virtual column"
action: Re-issue the statement by replacing the index expression with the matching virtual column

description: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because it is a partitioning column
cause: Attempted to modify the expression of a virtual column that was also a partitioning column.
action: This is not supported.

description: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because it is a subpartitioning column
cause: Attempted to modify the expression of a virtual column that was also a subpartitioning column.
action: This is not supported.

description: Cannot use PL/SQL expressions in partitioning or subpartitioning columns
cause: Attempted to partition a table on a virtual column that contained PL/SQL expressions.
action: This is not supported.

description: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because an index is defined on column
cause: Attempted to change the expression of a virtual column that was indexed.
action: Drop the index and then change the expression.

description: Virtual column expression cannot be changed because a constraint is defined on column
cause: Attempted to change the expression of a virtual column that had a constraint defined on it.
action: Drop constraint and then change expression.

description: expression column is not supported for an organization cube table
cause: Attempted to create or alter an organization cube table with an expression column
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: Virtual column cannot have a default value
cause: Attempted to alter a virtual column to have a default value.
action: This is not valid, change the DDL.

description: Real column cannot have an expression
cause: Attempted to alter a real column to have an expression.
action: This is not valid, change the DDL.

description: cannot modify data-type of virtual column
cause: Attempted to change the data-type of virtual column without modifying the underlying expression
action: change the underlying expression to be compatible with the data-type change

description: cannot change the HIDDEN/VISIBLE property of a virtual column
cause: Attempted to change the HIDDEN/VIRTUAL property of a virtual column
action: re-issue the DDL without the virtual column property change

description: Virtual column cannot be updated in trigger body
cause: Attempted to change the value of virtual column in a trigger body"
action: This is not valid, change the trigger definition.

description: datatype mismatch between virtual column and expression
cause: virtual column expression was changed after column was created"
action: change the underlying expression to return datatype that conforms to the virtual column

description: column to be dropped or modified is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to drop or modify a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
action: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be dropped.

description: column to be renamed is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to rename a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
action: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be renamed.

description: column to be modified is used in a virtual column expression
cause: Attempted to modify the data type of a column that was used in a virtual column expression.
action: Drop the virtual column first or change the virtual column expression to eliminate dependency on the column to be modified.

description: virtual columns not allowed in functional index expressions
cause: An attempt was made to create a functional index with an expression defined on one or more virtual columns.
action: Specify the index expression using only regular columns.

description: keyword HIDDEN cannot be specified here
cause: Attempted to specify HIDDEN key word for a virtual column
action: This is not supported.

description: cannot define referential constraint with ON DELETE SET NULL clause on virtual column
cause: Attempted to specify ON DELETE SET NULL clause for a referential integrity constraint on a virtual column.
action: Reissue the statement without specifying ON DELETE SET NULL clause.

description: table must have at least 1 column that is not virtual
cause: An attempt was made to create a table with only virtual columns.
action: Include at least 1 column that is not virtual in the table being created.

description: Virtual column cannot be encrypted
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter a virtual column to have encryption.
action: Encryption is unnecessary for a virtual column as the data is not stored on disk.

description: table must have at least one column that is not invisible
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter a table to have only invisible columns.
action: Include at least one column that is not invisible in the table being created or altered.

description: Visibility of a system-generated column cannot be changed.
cause: An attempt was made to alter the visibility of a system-generated column.
action: This is not supported.

description: Visibility of an abstract data type column cannot be changed.
cause: An attempt was made to alter the visibility of an abstract data type column.
action: Specify the column visibility change with a supported data type.

description: Invisible column is not supported on this type of table.
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter the visibility of a column on an unsupported table type. Invisible columns are only supported for heap and index-organized tables (IOT).
action: These columns are not supported, change the DDL.

description: Including column of an IOT cannot be an invisible column.
cause: An attempt was made to alter the visibility of the included column of an index-organized table (IOT).
action: This is not supported.

description: Visibility of a column having a column-level object privilege cannot be changed.
cause: An attempt was made to alter the visibility of a column with a column-level object privilege.
action: Revoke the column-level object privilege before making the column invisible.

description: Column level object privilege cannot be granted on an invisible column.
cause: An attempt was made to grant a column level object privilege on an invisible column.
action: Modify the column to make it visible and then grant the column level object privilege.

description: Column visibility modifications cannot be combined with any other modified column DDL option.
cause: An attempt was made to combine the modification of the visibility of a column with other modified column property changes.
action: Separate column visibility modifications into a standalone DDL.

description: virtual columns not allowed for XMLType tables with object-relational storage
cause: An attempt was made to create an object-relational XMLType table with virtual columns.
action: Do not create virtual columns for XMLType tables with object-relational storage . This feature is not available.

description: Column expression modifications cannot be combined with any other column DDL operation.
cause: An attempt was made to combine the modification of the expression of a column with other column operations.
action: Separate column expression modifications into a standalone DDL.

description: expression edition column is not supported for an external table
cause: An attempt was made to create or alter an external table with an edition expression column.
action: These columns are not supported; change the DDL.

description: Unsupported type or attribute on redacted column.
cause: An attempt was made to alter a column with a redaction policy, so as to give that column an unsupported type or attribute. Virtual columns are not supported by data redaction. Columns with the INVISIBLE attribute are not supported by data redaction (this applies to both user-specified hidden columns and system-generated hidden columns). Vector encoded columns are not supported by data redaction.
action: Specify the name of a non-redacted column, or use the DROP_POLICY PL/SQL procedure in the DBMS_REDACT package to remove the redaction policy from the column before altering it. Look in the REDACTION_POLICIES and REDACTION_COLUMNS catalog views for a list of all redaction policies and redacted columns.

description: System-generated virtual column cannot be a primary key.
cause: An attempt was made to specify a system-generated virtual column * as a primary key.
action: None.

description: System-generated functional index virtual column cannot be renamed.
cause: An attempt was made to rename a system-generated functional index virtual column.
action: None.

description: The visibility of a column from a table owned by a SYS user cannot be changed.
cause: An attempt was made to alter the visibility of a column from a table owned by SYS user.
action: Execute the DDL on a table not owned by a SYS user.

description: System-generated virtual column or guard column cannot be in a constraint.
cause: An attempt was made to add a constraint containing the system generated virtual column or guard column.
action: None.

description: In-Memory virtual column expression cannot refer to a system-generated or hidden column.
cause: An attempt was made to create a virtual column expression on a system-generated or hidden column.
action: Avoid creating a virtual column expression on a system-generated or hidden column.

description: There is an unsupported operation on a sensitive column "%s".
cause: An attempt was made to either alter the visibility of a sensitive column or change the sensitive column to vector encode.
action: Specify the name of a non-sensitive column, or use DBMS_TSDP_MANAGE.DROP_SENSITIVE_COLUMN PL/SQL procedure to remove the sensitivity of the column before altering it.
params: 1) column_name: The column name being protected with an incorrect security policy.

description: A column which is a audit column of a Fine Grained Auditing policy cannot be modified to an invisible column.
cause: An attempt was made to modify a column which was a audit column of a FGA policy to an invisbile column.
action: Drop the FGA policy containing the column as audit column before modifying the column.

description: '*' not allowed in SELECT expressions without FROM clause
cause: An attempt was made to use '*' in select expression list without a FROM clause.
action: Specify explicit columns or expressions in select list that does not include a '*'

description: cannot update an immutable column (%s) to a different value
cause: An attempt is being made to update an immutable column with a different value.
action: An immutable column cannot be mutated using an UPDATE statement. You can delete the row and insert a new value.

description: cannot load table with a materialized expression column and a first class LOB or other data type stored in LOB using direct path.
cause: The table being loaded contained a materialized expression column and a first class LOB or other data type column stored in LOB and supplemental logging was enabled for the table. Direct path load is not supported for such tables when supplemental logging is enabled.
action: Perform the load with conventional path mode.

description: User specified column name "%s" conflicts with a partition by expression column name.
cause: Name of the partition by expression column conflicts with a user specified column name.
action: Do not use column names starting with the prefix ORA_. These are reserved for internal oracle objects.

description: Invalid BLOB size
cause: The BLOB specified as Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model to the import_onnx_model procedure has an invalid size.
action: Ensure that the BLOB specified as Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model to the import_onnx_model procedure is valid and has a valid size.

description: ONNX runtime error: "%s"
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) runtime returned a non-zero status code.
action: Ensure that the imported ONNX model is valid.

description: The "function" field is missing in the JSON metadata.
cause: The "function" field is not specified in the metadata.
action: Ensure that the "function" field is specified in the JSON metadata, and set to one of the following: regression, classification, clustering, or embedding.

description: Invalid value for the "function" field in the JSON metadata
cause: The "function" field specified in the JSON metadata is invalid.
action: Ensure that the "function" field of the JSON metadata is one of the following: regression, classification, or clustering.

description: The "%s" field is not a string in the JSON metadata.
cause: The field in the JSON metdata is not a string.
action: Ensure that the field in the JSON metadata is a string.

description: The "input" field is not a JSON object in the JSON metadata.
cause: The "input" field specified in the metadata is not a JSON object.
action: Ensure the "input" field in the JSON metadata is an object.

description: Missing input mapping for "%s".
cause: There is no input mapping specified in the metadata for the given model input and the model input has a size greater than one.
action: Ensure that all model inputs that have a size greater than one are specified in the input field in the JSON metadata.

description: The "input.%s" field is not a list.
cause: Not all elements in the "input" field of the JSON metadata are a list.
action: Ensure that all elements of the "input" field of the JSON metadata are a list.

description: The "input.%s" field in the JSON metadata is not a model input.
cause: A name in the "input" field of the JSON metadata does not correspond to any input tensor name of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model.
action: Ensure that all of the names in the JSON metadata "input" field correspond to an input tensor name.

description: The "input.%s[%s]" element in the JSON metadata is not a string.
cause: An element in the array of an "input" field in the JSON metadata is not a string.
action: Ensure that the array of every "input" field in the JSON metadata contains strings only.

description: The "defaultOnNull" field in the JSON metadata is not a JSON object.
cause: The "defaultOnNull" field is not a JSON object.
action: Ensure that the "defaultOnNull" field in the JSON metadata is an object.

description: The "defaultOnNull.%s" field in the JSON metadata is not a string.
cause: The field in the defaultOnNull field in the JSON metadata is not a string.
action: Ensure that the JSON metadata defaultOnNull field only contain strings.

description: The "%s" field in the JSON metadata is missing.
cause: The field is missing in the JSON metadata and the model has more than one output.
action: Either specify a field to identify what output tensor to use as model output, or ensure that the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model has a single output tensor with a name matching the default output name for the specified mining function.

description: Cannot find model output "%s", specified by "%s"
cause: There is no tensor output with the given name in the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model.
action: Ensure that the specified model output corresponds to a tensor output name.

description: The "defaultOnNull.%s" field in the JSON metadata does not exist as an input attribute.
cause: The "defaultOnNull" field in the JSON metadata contains a value that does not exist as an input attribute.
action: Ensure that the JSON metadata "defaultOnNull" field only contains valid model attributes names. Model attribute names are by default the names of the input tensor of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model, but this can be overriden by specifying the "input" field in the JSON metadata.

description: Invalid value "%s" for "normalizeProb" field
cause: The "normalizeProb" field in the JSON metadata is incorrectly specified.
action: Ensure that if the field "normalizeProb" is specified, its value is "softmax".

description: The "labels" field is not an array.
cause: The "labels" field in the JSON metadata is not an array.
action: Ensure that the "labels" field in the JSON metadata is an array.

description: The value of the "labels[%s]" element in the JSON metadata has an invalid type.
cause: The value of the "labels" field in the JSON metadata is not an array of strings or an array of numbers.
action: Ensure that the "labels" field in the JSON metadata is an array of strings or an array of numbers.

description: The array value for the "labels" field has an incorrect length: JSON: %s, model: %s.
cause: The array holding the labels had an incorrect length.
action: Ensure that the length of the array specified for the "labels" field is equal to the size of the ouput tensor holding the probability output.

description: Duplicate attribute name: %s
cause: The same attribute name is specified more than once.
action: Ensure that each attribute name is unique in the JSON metadata.

description: Incorrect number of elements in the "input.%s" array in the JSON metadata (JSON: %s, model: %s)
cause: The number of elements in the array in the JSON metadata is not equal to the size of the corresponding input tensor of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model.
action: Ensure that the JSON metadata input arrays have a size equal to that of their corresponding input tensors.

description: Missing mining attribute: %s
cause: Not all mining attributes are present during model scoring.
action: Ensure that the data that is scored contains all the mining attributes of the model.

description: The size of the output tensor "%s" (%s) exceeds the maximum of %s.
cause: The output tensor is too large to be used in classification or clustering.
action: Ensure that the number of classes or clusters is less than or equal to the maximum.

description: Tensor "%s" has an invalid number of dimensions (%s) of fixed size for an embedding output.
cause: The embedding output tensor has no dimensions of fixed size or more than one dimension of fixed size.
action: Ensure that the embedding output tensor of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model has exactly one dimension of fixed size.

description: The type of the tensor "%s" is not supported.
cause: The mentioned tensor has a type that is not supported.
action: Ensure that all input and output tensors of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model have a supported type.

description: Tensor "%s" contains a dimension whose size is either zero or less than -1.
cause: An input or output tensor contains a dimension that is either zero or less than -1.
action: Ensure that all input and output tensors of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model have a dimension that is at least -1 and different than zero.

description: Tensor "%s" contains multiple dimensions (%s) of variable size.
cause: An input or output tensor has more than one dimension of variable size.
action: Ensure that all input and output tensors of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model contain only a single variable size dimension.

description: Tensor "%s" contains multiple dimensions (%s) greater than one.
cause: An input or output tensor has more than one dimension of a size greater than one.
action: Ensure that all input and output tensors of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model contain only a single dimension of a size greater than one.

description: Invalid type for probability output tensor: "%s"
cause: The data type specified for a probability output tensor is invalid.
action: Ensure that the probability output tensor has a valid type.

description: Invalid type for distance output tensor: "%s"
cause: The data type specified for a distance output tensor is invalid.
action: Ensure that the distance output tensor has a valid type.

description: Invalid type for regression output tensor: "%s"
cause: The data type specified for the regression output tensor is invalid.
action: Ensure that the regression output has a valid type.

description: Invalid size for a regression output tensor: "%s"
cause: The size of the output tensor is invalid for a regression mining function.
action: Ensure that the output tensor has a valid size.

description: Attribute name "%s" is reserved.
cause: The model is using a reserved attribute name.
action: Ensure that all model attribute names are valid.

description: The clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput tensors are both undefined.
cause: The clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput tensors are both undefined and the model has more than one output.
action: Define at least one of the clustering output tensors or ensure that the model has only one output.

description: The clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput tensors have a different size.
cause: The clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput tensors are both used but have different size.
action: Ensure that both output tensors have the same size.

description: Invalid JSON field: "%s"
cause: One of the JSON fields specified in the metadata is invalid for the given mining function.
action: Ensure that only supported JSON fields are in the metadata.

description: Attribute name (%s) is invalid.
cause: The attribute name is invalid. It should be a valid Oracle identifier and should not be an Oracle reserved word.
action: Use an attribute name that is a valid Oracle identifier and that is not an Oracle reserved word.

description: Both "labels" and "classificationLabelOutput" fields are specified.
cause: Both "labels" and "classificationLabelOutput" fields are specified in the JSON metadata.
action: Ensure that only one of the mentioned fields is specified in the JSON metadata.

description: The classificationLabelOutput tensor can only use a string or an integer type.
cause: The classificationLabelOutput tensor has an invalid type.
action: Ensure that the classificationLabelOutput tensor only uses a string or an integer type."

description: The classificationLabelOutput tensor has an invalid size.
cause: The classificationLabelOutput tensor has an invalid size.
action: Ensure that the classificationLabelOutput tensor has a valid size.

description: Duplicate label: "%s"
cause: A duplicate label is specified in the JSON metadata.
action: Ensure that the label array in the JSON metadata does not contain duplicates.

description: Invalid value "%s" for "normalizeEmb" field
cause: The "normalizeEmb" field in the JSON metadata is specified incorrectly.
action: Ensure that the field "normalizeProb" is either absent (not specified) or has a value of L2.

description: Incorrect batch size location in tensor "%s"
cause: The batch dimension is at the wrong place in the mentioned tensor.
action: Ensure that the batch dimension is the first dimension in the tensor.

description: Invalid tensor element data type for an embedding output: "%s"
cause: The data type specified for an embedding output is invalid.
action: Ensure that the element type of the output is supported for vector embedding.

description: The number of dimensions for the generated vector (%s) is greater than the maximum allowed (%s).
cause: The number of dimensions of the embedding output is larger than the maximum allowed.
action: Ensure that the imported model generates vector embedding with a number of dimensions less than or equal to the maximum allowed.

description: The value of the "labels[%s]" element in the JSON metadata is too large.
cause: The value of a label specified in the "labels" field in the JSON metadata is larger than 4000 bytes.
action: Ensure that every label value specified in the "labels" field in the JSON metadata is no larger than 4000 bytes.

description: The embedding input tensor "%s" has an invalid element data type.
cause: The embedding input tensor has an invalid type.
action: Ensure that the embedding input tensor has the string type."

description: Input tensor "%s" exceeds the maximum size of 4096.
cause: The mentioned input tensor exceeds the maximum number of columns allowed in Oracle.
action: Ensure that the imported model only has input tensors with size smaller than 4096.

description: Model input tensors exceed maximum size of 4096.
cause: The total number of scalar value from all the input tensor of the model exceeds the maximum number of columns allowed in Oracle.
action: Ensure that the total number of scalar value from all the input tensors of the imported mode is smaller than 4096.

description: Invalid embedding metadata: %s
cause: The specified embedding metadata does not follow the format specified in the documentation.
action: Ensure that the embedding metadata specified follows the format specified in the documentation.

description: Operation on ONNX models is disabled
cause: The operation on the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model is disabled.
action: Contact the DBA to understand why the operation was disabled. Only the user with DBA privilege can re-enable the operation.

description: Failed to convert attribute name (hex: %s) from UTF-8 to the database character set.
cause: The specified attribute name cannot be converted to the database character set.
action: Specify a string of valid UTF-8 characters that can be represented in the database character set.

description: Failed to convert a "defaultOnNull" string value (hex: %s) from UTF-8 to the database character set.
cause: The specified string value cannot be converted to the database character set.
action: Specify a string of valid UTF-8 characters that can be represented in the database character set.

description: A string value (hex: %s) from an ONNX model or the JSON metadata contains a null character.
cause: A string value from an ONNX model or the JSON metadata contains a null character, which is illegal.
action: Specify a string not containing any null characters.

description: Failed to parse the "defaultOnNull" string value (%s) in the JSON metadata as a number.
cause: The "defaultOnNull" string value cannot be parsed as a number.
action: Specify a number literal.

description: The ONNX model has a size of 0 bytes.
cause: The size of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model being imported is 0."
action: Ensure that the size of the ONNX model is greater than 0.

description: clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput are the same tensor.
cause: clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput are the same output tensor.
action: Ensure that if both clusteringProbOutput and clusteringDistanceOutput are specified in the JSON metadata, they refer to two different output tensors.

description: Size of contiguous memory requested for loading ONNX model is too large: %s
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) runtime is attempting to allocate a contiguous range that is too large while loading an ONNX model.
action: You may have to modify the ONNX model to require a smaller range of contiguous memory. For example, you may want to quantize the ONNX model.

description: The "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is not an array.
cause: The field "inputAsVector in the JSON metadata is not an array.
action: Ensure that the field inputAsVector in the JSON metadata is an array.

description: The value of the "inputAsVector[%s]" element in the JSON metadata has an invalid type.
cause: The value of the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is not an array of strings.
action: Ensure that the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is an array of strings.

description: The "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata comprises names that are not name of input tensors.
cause: The array holding the "inputAsVector" in the JSON metadata comprises names that are not names of input tensors.
action: Ensure that all the elements of the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata are names of input tensors.

description: Duplicate tensor name "%s" in the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata.
cause: The same tensor name is specified more than once in the "inputAsVector" field the JSON metadata.
action: Ensure that each tensor name is unique in the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata.

description: Incorrect number of elements in the "inputAsVector" array in the JSON metadata.
cause: The number of elements in an array in the "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is greater than the number of input tensors of the Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model.
action: Ensure that the array "inputAsVector" field of the JSON metadata has a size no larger than the number of input tensors of the ONNX model.

description: The "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is not supported for mining function other than "embedding".
cause: The "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata is used for a function that is not "embedding".
action: Ensure the function in the metadata is "embedding".

description: The tensor "%s" referenced from "inputAsVector" field in the JSON metadata cannot be used as a VECTOR data type.
cause: The tensor referenced from "inputAsVector" cannot be used as a vector for any of the following reason: the data type of the tensor is not supported, or the tensor as a rank higher than one, or the number of dimensions of the vector is larger than what is supported for the VECTOR data type.
action: Ensure the tensor referenced in "inputAsVector" can be represented by a VECTOR data type.

description: Failed to use MGA namespace for importing an ONNX model or scoring with an ONNX model.
cause: The Managed Global Area (MGA) reported an error to the ONNX model runtime.
action: Check MGA error messages for additional information.

description: Failed to allocate MGA segment of size %s for ONNX operation.
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) runtime is attempting to allocate a contiguous range of memory via MGA, which is too large.
action: You may have to modify the ONNX model to require a smaller range of contiguous memory. For example, you may want to quantize the ONNX model. You can also try to increase pga_aggregate_target.
params: 1) size: Size of the buffer attempted to be allocated

description: Out of memory when trying to load a ONNX model.
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) runtime is attempting to allocate a contiguous range of memory, which is too large.
action: You may have to modify the ONNX model to require a smaller range of contiguous memory. For example, you may want to quantize the ONNX model. You can also try to increase pga_aggregate_target.

description: Invalid offset/size in the external data JSON for tensor "%s". Offset %s, size: %s.
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the offset and size values of a tensor are invalid.
action: Fix the values for offset and size in the JSON for the tensor.
params: 1) tensor_name: Name of the tensor 2) offset: Offset of the tensor, as specified in the JSON 3) size: Size of the tensor, as specified in the JSON

description: Tensor for external data "%s" has a size of 0.
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the size of a tensor is set to 0.
action: Fix the values for size in the JSON for the tensor.

description: External tensor's offset (%s) and size (%s) in JSON exceeds total external data groups' size (%s) for tensor "%s".
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the offset and size values of a tensor are inconsistent with the given groups' BLOBs.
action: Fix the values for offset and size in the JSON for the tensor.
params: 1) offset: Offset of the tensor, as specified in the JSON 2) size: Size of the tensor, as specified in the JSON 3) groups_size: Total size of the groups 4) tensor_name: Name of the tensor

description: Total external data groups' size (%s) does not match the sum of the external tensors' sizes in JSON (%s).
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the size of the tensors are smaller than the given groups' BLOBs.
action: Fix the sizes in the JSON for the tensors.
params: 1) groups_size: Total size of the groups 2) tensors_size: Total size of the tensors

description: "%s" is not a valid tensor type name for tensor "%s".
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the type of a tensor is invalid.
action: Fix the type in the JSON for the tensor. Refer to the ONNX documentation for valid types.
params: 1) type: Type of the tensor 2) tensor_name: Name of the tensor

description: Invalid tensor shape for the ONNX model's external tensor "%s". The "shape" field must be set to an array of integers.
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the shape of a tensor is invalid.
action: Fix the shape in the JSON for the tensor. The "shape" field must be set to an array of integers, consistent with the tensor size.

description: Invalid name for the ONNX model's external tensor "%s". The name must not exceed %s characters.
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the name of a tensor is invalid.
action: Use a smaller name.
params: 1) tensor_name: Name of the tensor 2) max_length: Max length

description: Invalid tensor shape for the ONNX model's external tensor "%s". The "shape" array contains too many entries, must not exceed %s entries.
cause: In the JSON metadata for the external data for the ONNX model, the shape of a tensor is invalid.
action: Fix the shape in the JSON for the tensor. Use an array with fewer dimensions.
params: 1) tensor_name: Name of the tensor 2) max_length: Max length

description: Failed to allocate prepacked weights when loading the ONNX model.
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) runtime ran out of memory, when loading the model.
action: Drop and reload the model.

description: Maximum number of INMEMORY-enabled models exceeded. Current capacity: %s entries, current number of INMEMORY-enabled models: %s.
cause: The current maximum number of inmemory models has been exceeded.
action: Either set some models NO INMEMORY or increase the maximum number of inmemory models. (via _dmm_onnx_max_num_inmemory_models).
params: 1) capacity: Current capacity of INMEMORY models 2) num_models: Current number of INMEMORY-enabled models

description: Cannot reduce the maximum number of INMEMORY-enabled models.
cause: Too many models are set INMEMORY currently. The maximum number of inmemory models cannot be decreased below the number of models currently INMEMORY.
action: Move some models out of memory before reducing the maximum number of INMEMORY-enabled models.

description: Cannot reduce the allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models; %s are currently used for INMEMORY models.
cause: The maximum allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models cannot be decreased below the current memory usage of models INMEMORY.
action: Move some models out of memory before reducing the allocated memory size of INMEMORY-enabled models.
params: 1) current_usage: Current memory usage for INMEMORY models

description: Cannot increase the allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models; _dmm_shared_memory_size must not be greater than %s percent of PGA aggregate limit (%s).
cause: The maximum allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models cannot be increased above the current limit for memory usage of models INMEMORY.
action: Either increase pga_aggregate_limit or _dmm_inmemory_limit before increasing the allocated memory size of INMEMORY-enabled models.
params: 1) limit_percentage: Percentage of PGA aggregate limit which _dmm_shared_memory_size cannot go above 2) pga_aggregate_limit: Value of PGA aggregate limit

description: Cannot reduce _dmm_inmemory_limit; _dmm_shared_memory_size (%s bytes) must always be lower than '_dmm_inmemory_limit' percent of PGA aggregate limit (%s bytes).
cause: The new value of _dmm_inmemory_limit, combined with the current PGA aggr limit, would result in a value below the current maximum allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models.
action: First decrease _dmm_shared_memory_size or increase pga_aggregate_limit.
params: 1) dmm_shared_memory_size: Value of _dmm_shared_memory_size 2) pga_aggregate_limit: Value of PGA aggregate limit

description: Cannot reduce PGA aggregate limit below %s bytes: _dmm_shared_memory_size must not be greater than %s percent of PGA aggregate limit.
cause: The new value of pga_aggregate_limit, combined with the current limit for memory usage of models INMEMORY, would result in a value below the current maximum allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models.
action: First decrease _dmm_shared_memory_size or increase _dmm_inmemory_limit.
params: 1) lower_bound: Lower bound for _dmm_shared_memory_size 2) limit_percentage: Percentage of PGA aggregate limit which _dmm_shared_memory_size cannot go above

description: Failed to set model INMEMORY-enabled: not enough memory. Required: %s bytes, only %s bytes available over %s bytes.
cause: There is not enough memory available to set the ONNX model INMEMORY.
action: Either move some models out of memory or increase _dmm_shared_memory_size.
params: 1) model_size: Bytes needed for the model 2) imm_available: Number of bytes available for INMEMORY models 3) imm_size: Number of bytes dedicated for INMEMORY models

description: Failed to set model INMEMORY-enabled: not enough memory: model size (%s bytes) exceeds allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models (%s bytes).
cause: The allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models is lower than the model size.
action: Increase _dmm_shared_memory_size first.
params: 1) model_size: Bytes needed for the model 2) imm_size: Number of bytes dedicated for INMEMORY models

description: Only ONNX models with external initializers can be INMEMORY-enabled.
cause: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) model does not have any external initializers.
action: Use a model that has external initializers.

description: Failed to set model INMEMORY-enabled: not enough PGA memory available. Required: %s bytes, only %s bytes available over %s bytes.
cause: There is not enough PGA memory available to set the ONNX model INMEMORY.
action: Wait until concurrent queries release PGA memory and then retry the operation.
params: 1) model_size: Bytes needed for the model 2) avail_bytes: Current number of available bytes in PGA 3) pga_target: Current PGA target

description: Cannot increase the allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models on this PDB; _dmm_shared_memory_size must not be greater than the value on the CDB (%s).
cause: The maximum allocated memory size for INMEMORY-enabled models cannot be increased above the value on the CDB.
action: First increase the value of _dmm_shared_memory_size on the CDB.
params: 1) cdb_value: Value of _dmm_shared_memory_size on the CDB

description: ONNX testing event
cause: NA
action: NA

description: ONNX session reclamation debugging event
cause: NA

description: invalid combination of elements
cause: The geometry did not start from the correct level in the hierarchy.
action: Correct the hierarchy in the geometry.

description: no holes expected
cause: The geometry contained one or more unexpected holes.
action: Remove any holes in the geometry.

description: solid not closed
cause: The solid geometry was not closed i.e., faces of solid are not 2-manifold due to incorrectly defined, oriented, or traversed line segment because each edge of a solid must be traversed exactly twice, once in one direction and once in the reverse direction.
action: Correct the orientation of the edges of the neighboring polygons.

description: incorrect solid orientation
cause: The orientation of the solid was not correct.
action: Correct the orientation or specification of the outer or inner solid geometry according to the geometry rules for such a solid.

description: multiple outer geometries
cause: The geometry contained more than one outer geometry.
action: Remove all but one of the outer geometries.

description: ring does not lie on a plane
cause: The ring was not flat.
action: Make sure all of the vertices of the ring are on the same plane.

description: compound curve not supported for 3-D geometries
cause: The 3-D geometry contained one or more compound curves, which are not supported for 3-D geometries.
action: Remove all compound curves from the geometry.

description: duplicate points in multipoint geometry
cause: The multipoint geometry had two points that either had identical coordinates or were the same point considering the geometry tolerance.
action: Make sure all points are different, considering the tolerance.

description: overlapping surfaces in a multisolid geometry
cause: The multisolid geometry contained one or more fully or partially overlapping surfaces.
action: Ensure that the multisolid geometry contains no overlapping areas.

description: solid not attached to composite solid
cause: To connect solids in a composite solid geometry, at least one of the faces of a solid must be shared (fully or partially) with only another solid. However, at least one of the faces in this composite solid was not shared by exactly two solids only.
action: Ensure that at least one face in a composite solid is shared by exactly two solids.

description: no outer geometry expected
cause: An outer geometry was found when only inner geometries were expected.
action: Remove all outer geometries.

description: edges of inner and outer solids intersect
cause: An inner solid had a common edge with outer solid.
action: Ensure that edges of inner and outer solids do not intersect.

description: a vertex of an inner solid is outside corresponding outer solid
cause: A solid geometry contained an inner solid with at least one vertex outside its corresponding outer solid.
action: Ensure that all vertices of inner solids are not outside their corresponding outer solid.

description: inner solid surface overlaps outer solid surface
cause: One or more faces of an inner solid surface either fully or partially overlapped an outer solid surface.
action: Ensure that inner and outer surfaces have no shared (fully or partially overlapping) faces.

description: overlapping areas in multipolygon
cause: A multipolygon geometry contained one or more common (shared, fully or partially overlapped) polygons.
action: Ensure that no polygons in a multipolygon overlap.

description: outer rings in a composite surface intersect
cause: Outer rings, either on the same plane or different planes, in a composite surface intersected.
action: Ensure that outer rings do not intersect. They can share edges.

description: adjacent outer rings of composite surface cannot be on same plane
cause: The conditional flag was set, and a composite surface had at least two outer rings sharing a common edge on the same plane.
action: Change those outer rings into one larger outer ring.

description: outer ring is on the same plane and overlaps another outer ring
cause: An outer ring in a composite surface shared a common area with another outer ring.
action: Ensure that no outer rings fully or partially overlap.

description: shared edge of composite surface not oriented correctly
cause: A shared edge (one shared by two polygons) in a composite surface was not correctly oriented. Each shared edge must be oriented in one direction with respect to its first polygon and then in the reverse direction with respect to its second polygon.
action: Reverse one of the directions of the shared edge with respect to its polygons.

description: polygon (surface) not attached to composite surface
cause: Not all polygons of a surface had a common (fully or partially shared) edge.
action: Ensure that each polygon is attached to the composite surface by one of its edges.

description: inner ring not on the same plane as its outer ring
cause: An inner ring was not on the same plane as its outer ring.
action: Ensure that each inner ring is on the same plane as its outer ring.

description: inner ring is not inside or is touching outer ring more than once
cause: An inner ring either was not inside its outer ring or touched its outer ring more than once.
action: Ensure that the inner ring is inside its outer ring and does not touch the outer ring more than once. If an inner ring touches its outer ring more than once, then the outer ring is no longer a topologically simple or singly connected polygon (ring).

description: inner rings of same outer ring cannot intersect or share boundary
cause: Two inner rings of the same outer ring intersected or shared a boundary.
action: Ensure that line segments of an inner ring do not intersect or fully or partially coincide with line segments of another inner ring sharing the same outer ring.

description: inner rings of same outer ring cannot touch more than once
cause: Two inner rings of the same outer ring touched more than once.
action: Ensure that inner rings of the same outer ring touch at no more than one point.

description: inner ring cannot be inside another inner ring of same outer ring
cause: An inner ring was inside another ring of the same outer ring.
action: Ensure that no inner ring is inside another inner ring of the same outer ring.

description: incorrect box volume due to wrong ordinates
cause: The rectangular box in shortcut format did not have its first x,y,z coordinates either all greater or less than its second x,y,z coordinates.
action: Make sure that the first x,y,z coordinates are either all greater or all less than the second x,y,z coordinates.

description: multi or composite geometry must be decomposed before extraction
cause: The extraction could not be performed because the multi or composite geometry must first be decomposed into simple geometries (with or without inner geometries). The multi or composite geometry had a gtype of GTYPE_MULTISOLID, GTYPE_MULTISURFACE, GTYPE_MULTICURVE, GTYPE_MULTIPOINT, or GTYPE_COLLECTION, or the geometry was a line string.
action: Use the MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor to decompose the multi or composite geometry to a simple geometry.

description: operation not permitted on a simple geometry
cause: A MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor was attempted on a geometry that is already simple.
action: Do not use the MULTICOMP_TOSIMPLE parameter to element extractor on simple geometries.

description: inner composite surfaces or surfaces with inner ring(s) expected
cause: An INNER_OUTER parameter to element extractor was attempted on a surface that was not simple or composite.
action: Ensure that the etype of the geometry for the INNER_OUTER parameter to element extractor is ETYPE_SURFACE or ETYPE_COMPOSITESURFACE.

description: geometry should have multi-level hierarchy (like triangle)
cause: The geometry did not have the multi-level hierarchy required for this operation. For example, if the parameter to element extractor (hierarchy level) is not LOWER_LEVEL, but the geometry etype is ETYPE_SOLID and gtype is GTYPE_SOLID, an extract operation is not allowed, because a simple solid can only be decomposed into lower level geometries, such as composite surfaces.
action: Ensure that the geometry has the appropriate hierarchy. For example, if the geometry etype is ETYPE_SOLID and gtype is GTYPE_SOLID, the parameter to element extractor (hierarchy level) should be LOWER_LEVEL.

description: invalid etype for element at element offset
cause: An invalid etype was encountered.
action: Correct the etype of the geometry.

description: invalid orientation for element at element offset
cause: The orientation of the current geometry was not valid.
action: Reverse the orientation of the geometry.

description: incomplete composite surface
cause: The end of composite surface was reached before all necessary surfaces were defined.
action: Add more surfaces to match the geometry definition, or reduce the specified number of surfaces.

description: invalid etype in composite surface of solid
cause: The etype of the composite surface of a solid was not valid.
action: Ensure that the etype is orient*1000+ETYPE_SOLID, where orient is 1 for outer solid and 2 for inner solid.

description: incorrect box surface due to wrong specification
cause: The elemInfo definition was not correct for the surface of the axis aligned box.
action: Change the interpretation to 3 in the elemInfo definition.

description: incorrect box surface because it is on arbitrary plane
cause: The axis aligned box surface was not on the yz, xz, or xy plane.
action: Ensure that the first and fourth coordinates, or the second and fifth coordinates, or the third and sixth coordinates are the same. This means that the surface is on the yz, xz or xy plane, respectively.

description: axis aligned box surface not defined properly
cause: The inner geometry etype did not start with 2, or the outer geometry etype did not start with 1, or both occurred.
action: Use the correct etype for the inner and outer geometries.

description: incorrect box surface due to wrong orientation
cause: The rectangular surface in shortcut format did not have its first x,y,z coordinates all greater than or equal to or all less than or equal to its second x,y,z coordinates.
action: Ensure that the first x,y,z coordinates are either all greater than or equal to or all less than or equal to the second x,y,z coordinates.

description: unexpected gtype
cause: The gtype of the geometry was not GTYPE_SOLID, GTYPE_SURFACE, GTYPE_CURVE or GTYPE_POINT.
action: Correct the elemInfo array to fix any invalid gtype and etypes that violate the geometry hierarchy.

description: cannot process the geometry(s) for this operation
cause: The geometry had errors in it.
action: Validate the geometry or geometries to ensure that each is valid.

description: at least one element must be a surface or solid
cause: One of the geometries had holes, and the geometries were neither (A) simple, composite, or multisurfaces, or (B) simple, composite, or multisolids. (Surfaces and solids are the only geometries that can have holes. Points and curves cannot have holes.)
action: Ensure that each geometry having holes is a surface or solid (simple, composite, or multi).

description: holes incorrectly defined
cause: The holes were defined with incorrect etype.
action: Ensure that the etype is correct in the definition of the inner geometry.

description: volume of solid cannot be 0 or less
cause: The solid geometry having one outer and multiple inner geometries had a negative or zero volume.
action: Correct the orientation or specification of the outer solid geometry to obey outer geometry rules so that the outer geometry has a positive volume. Additionally, correct the orientation or specification of inner solid geometries to obey inner geometry rules so that each inner geometry has a negative volume.

description: wrong input for COUNT_SHARED_EDGES
cause: The COUNT_SHARED_EDGES parameter value was not 1 or 2.
action: Ensure that the COUNT_SHARED_EDGES parameter value is either 1 or 2.

description: input geometry gtype must be GTYPE_POLYGON for extrusion
cause: The input geometry gtype was not GTYPE_POLYGON.
action: Ensure that the gtype of the input polygon is GTYPE_POLYGON.

description: input geometry has incorrect elemInfo
cause: The input 2-D polygon did not have only one outer ring.
action: Ensure that the input 2-D polygon has only one outer ring.

description: input 2-D polygon not valid
cause: The 2-D polygon violated the rules for polygons and rings.
action: Correct the polygon definition.

description: grdHeight and/or Height array sizes incorrect
cause: The sizes of grdHeight and Height arrays were not equal to half the size of input 2-D polygon's ordinates array. As a result, each point in the 2-D polygon could not be extruded from the grdHeight entry to the Height entry.
action: Ensure that the sizes of the grdHeight and Height arrays are half that of input 2-D polygon ordinates array.

description: height entries must be >= to ground height entries
cause: In the definition of a solid, the height values were less than the ground height.
action: Ensure that that height values are greater than or equal to ground height values.

description: incorrect geometry for appending
cause: The geometry could not be appended to a homogeneous collection (for example, multi-geometry) or to a heterogeneous geometry (for example, collection). In other words, the gtype of the geometry to be appended was neither GYTPE_COLLECTION or GTYPE_MULTI-X (where X is point, curve, surface, or solid).
action: Ensure that the geometries involved in the append operation have appropriate gtypes.

description: arcs are not supported as defined
cause: An arc was defined in a geometry type in which arcs are not supported. Arcs are supported for 2-D (circle) polygons, 2-D compound polygons, 2-D single arc, and 2-D compound (composite) curves only.
action: Remove or simplify the arcs.

description: invalid geometry dimension
cause: The geometry did not have three dimensions.
action: Ensure that geometry has three dimensions.

description: operation is not supported for 3-D geometry
cause: A 3-D geometry was passed into an operation that supports only 2-D geometries.
action: Check the Spatial documentation for operations that are supported and not supported on 3-D geometries.

description: incomplete composite solid
cause: The end of composite solid was reached before all necessary solids were defined.
action: Add more solids to match the geometry definition, or reduce the specified number of solids.

description: 3D SRID is not found for the corresponding 2D SRID
cause: In extruding a 2D polygon into a 3D geometry, the SRID conversion function did not find an equivalent 3D SRID of the 2D SRID.
action: Specify a 2D SRID that has a 3D equivalent

description: query element and source geometry cannot be the same
cause: A query element geometry and a source geometry were the same, which prevented a label pointing query element in the source geometry from being output.
action: Redefine the query element or the source geometry so that a label can be output.

description: query element cannot be a collection or multitype geometry
cause: A query element was a collection geometry or a multitype geometry. Such geometries are not permitted in a query element because they are at the top of the geometry hierarchy. A query element must be part of the source geometry.
action: Redefine the query element or the source geometry so that a label can be output.

description: CREATE_PC: invalid parameters for creation of Point Cloud
cause: An invalid or unknown parameter was specified in the creation of Point Cloud.
action: Check for valid set of parameters.

description: CREATE_PC: input points table %s does not exist
cause: The specified table for loading points into a Point Cloud did not exist.
action: Create the points table with appropriate columns, and then create the Point Cloud.

description: CREATE_PC: specified total dimensionality cannot exceed 8
cause: The specified total dimensionality for the Point Cloud exceeded the maximum limit of 8.
action: Create the Point Cloud with fewer dimensions. You can store the rest in the output points table.

description: CREATE_PC: input points table should not be empty
cause: The input points table had no data.
action: Insert data into the input points table and then create the Point Cloud.

description: CREATE_PC: scratch-tables/views (%s) exist and need to be dropped
cause: Transient tables/views from a previous CREATE_PC operation were still in existence.
action: Delete the invalid Point Cloud from the base table (for cleanup of scratch tables), and initialize and create the Point Cloud again. Alternately, use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with oidstring as the parameter.

description: CREATE_PC: error fetching data from input points table
cause: An internal read error occurred during Point Cloud creation.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

description: CREATE_PC: error writing Point Cloud LOB
cause: An internal LOB write error occurred during Point Cloud creation. The cause might be lack of table space.
action: Look for information from other errors in the stack, or contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

description: CREATE_PC: input extent cannot be null
cause: The extent of the Point Cloud was null.
action: Specify an extent for the Point Cloud that is not null.

description: CREATE_PC: input extent cannot be more than 2-D for geodetic data
cause: The extent of the Point Cloud was more than 2-D for geodetic data.
action: Change the extent to 2-D (longitude, latitude).

description: INIT: either invalid basetable/schema or they do not exist
cause: The base table or schema, or both, were invalid strings; or the base table and schema combination did not exist.
action: Ensure that the specified base table exists in the specified schema before performing the initialization operation.

description: INIT: internal error creating DML trigger
cause: The necessary privileges to create the trigger were not granted.
action: Grant the necessary privileges to create the trigger. If necessary, contact Oracle Support Services for help with privileges for trigger creation.

description: INIT: block table name has to be unique
cause: The specified block table name was not unique. For example, it might have been used for another block table.
action: Specify a different block table name.

description: INIT: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: CLIP_PC: invalid Point Cloud; extent is empty
cause: The input Point Cloud for the CLIP_PC operation was invalid.
action: Specify a point cloud that was created using the CREATE_PC procedure.

description: CLIP_PC: SRIDs of query and Point Cloud are incompatible
cause: The Point Cloud and the query geometry had incompatible SRID values.
action: Change the query SRID to be compatible with that of the Point Cloud.

description: CLIP_PC: query and BLKID parameters cannot both be null
cause: Both the query and BLKID parameters were null in the call to the CLIP_PC operation.
action: Either specify a query geometry that is not null, or specify a BLKID for use as a query.

description: CLIP_PC: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: TO_GEOMETRY: TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY not same as in INIT operation
cause: The specified TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY was invalid.
action: Ensure that the TOTAL_DIMENSIONALITY matches that specified in the call to the initialization operation.

description: TO_GEOMETRY: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: CREATE_PC: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid input parameters [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: PARTITION_TABLE utility: scratch tables exist with oidstr = %s
cause: Scratch tables/views could not be created because they already existed.
action: Use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with the specified oidstr parameter to clean up the scratch tables.

description: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid SORT_DIMENSION specified
cause: An invalid string was specified for the SORT_DIMENSION.
action: Specify the SORT_DIMENSION as 'BEST_DIM', 'DIMENSION_1', 'DIMENSION_2', or 'DIMENSION_3'.

description: PARTITION_TABLE utility: invalid WORKTABLESPACE parameter
cause: An invalid string was specified for the WORKTABLESPACE parameter.
action: Specify an existing valid tablespace for WORKTABLESPACE (to hold the scratch tables).

description: PARTITION_TABLE utility: error in reading input, output tables
cause: The names for the input/output tables were invalid, or the tables did not exist or did not have the right structure.
action: Check the Spatial documentation for PARTITION_TABLE.

description: CREATE_TIN: invalid parameters specified in creation of TIN
cause: An invalid or unknown parameter was specified in the creation of the TIN.
action: Check the Spatial documentation for CREATE_TIN.

description: CREATE_TIN: input points table %s does not exist
cause: The specified table for loading points into a TIN did not exist.
action: Create the points table with appropriate columns, and then create the TIN.

description: CREATE_TIN: specified total dimensionality cannot exceed 8
cause: The specified total dimensionality for the TIN exceeded the maximum limit of 8.
action: Create the TIN with fewer dimensions. You can store the rest in the output points table.

description: CREATE_TIN: input points table should not be empty
cause: The input points table had no data.
action: Insert data into the input points table, and then create the TIN.

description: CREATE_TIN: scratch tables/views(%s) exist and need to be dropped
cause: Transient tables from previous CREATE_TIN operation still existed.
action: Delete the invalid TIN from the base table (for cleanup of scratch tables), and initialize and create the TIN again. Alternately, use SDO_UTIL.DROP_WORK_TABLES with oidstring as its parameter.

description: CREATE_TIN: error fetching data from input points table
cause: An internal read error occurred during TIN creation.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

description: CREATE_TIN: error writing TIN LOB
cause: An internal LOB write error occurred during TIN creation. The cause might be lack of table space.
action: Look for information from other errors in the stack, or contact Oracle Support Services with the error number reported.

description: CREATE_TIN: input extent cannot be null
cause: The extent of the TIN was null.
action: Specify an extent for the TIN that is not null.

description: CREATE_TIN: input extent has to be 2-D for geodetic data
cause: The extent of the TIN was more than 2-D for geodetic data.
action: Change the extent to 2-D (longitude, latitude).

description: CLIP_TIN: invalid Point Cloud; extent is empty
cause: The input TIN for the CLIP_TIN operation was invalid.
action: Specify a TIN that was created using the CREATE_TIN operation.

description: CLIP_TIN: SRIDs of query and TIN are incompatible
cause: The TIN and the query geometry had incompatible SRID values.
action: Change the query geometry SRID to be compatible with that of TIN.

description: CLIP_TIN: query and blkid parameters cannot both be null
cause: Both the query and blkid parameters were null in the call to the CLIP_TIN operation.
action: Either specify a query geometry that is not null, or specify a blkid for use as a query.

description: CLIP_TIN: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: TO_GEOMETRY: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: CREATE_TIN: internal error [%d, %s]
cause: An internal error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: query gtype is a superset of the source geometry
cause: A query element geometry was at a higher level in the geometry hierarchy than the source geometry.
action: Try replacing the source geometry with the query geometry.

description: query element cannot be matched to an element in source geometry (%s)
cause: A query element geometry was not a part of the source geometry.
action: Redefine the query element or the source geometry.

description: a 2D SRID cannot be used with a 3D geometry
cause: A 2D SRID was used with a 3D geometry.
action: Replace the 2D SRID with an appropriate 3D SRID.

description: Event to turn off query rewrite for spatial partition pruning
cause: For internal use only.
action: Turns off query rewrite for spatial partition pruning. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to set the number of leaf nodes used in memory-resident R-tree processing
cause: For internal use only.
action: Set the number of leaf nodes used in memory-resident R-tree processing. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to turn off optimized R-tree bulk inserts
cause: For internal use only.
action: Turn off optimized R-tree bulk inserts. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to turn off R-tree node caching in bulk updates
cause: For internal use only.
action: Turn off R-tree node cache caching in bulk updates. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to set the number of cached R-tree nodes in bulk updates
cause: For internal use only.
action: Set the number of cached R-tree nodes in bulk updates. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to dump the R-tree node cache contents to trace file
cause: For internal use only.
action: Dump the R-tree node cache contents to trace file. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to enable diagnostic and informational messages to trace file
cause: For internal use only.
action: Enable or disable diagnostic and informational messages to trace file. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to enable direct-row-access performance enhancement
cause: For internal use only.
action: Enable or disable direct-row-access performance enhancement. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to enable faster geometry operations
cause: For internal use only.
action: Enable or disable faster geometry operations. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to enable within_distance optimization
cause: For internal use only.
action: Enable or disable 'within_distance' optimization. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to specify an alternate statistics collection algorithm
cause: For internal use only.
action: Specify an alternate statistics collection algorithm. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to specify the maximum number of points used for polygon orientation checking
cause: For internal use only.
action: Specify the maximum number of points used for polygon orientation checking. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to specify the maximum number of buckets to be used for statistics collection
cause: For internal use only.
action: Specify the maximum number of buckets to be used for statistics collection other than the standard 512 buckets. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to force direct-row-access usage
cause: For internal use only.
action: Enable or disable direct-row-access forced usage. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.

description: Event to specify the number of successful operations after which a simulated error will occur
cause: For internal use only.
action: Specify the number of successful operations after which a simulated error will occur. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services or development.
