cause: One of the upcgm_table type arguments is either empty or contains more than one element and the number of elements is not the same as the other upcgm_table_type arguments.
action: Correct your PL/SQL program so the upcgm_table_type arguments have at least one element and the number of elements are the same for all arguments with more than one element.

description: insufficient Resource Manager privileges
cause: An attempt was made to execute administration procedures from the DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER package without the appropriate privilege. The procedure requires the Resource Manager system privilege.
action: Ask the database administrator to grant the Resource Manager system privilege to the user.

description: Plan name %s exceeds the maximum length allowed
cause: Plan name is greater than 30 characters long.
action: Do not exceed 30 characters when naming a resource plan.

description: %s resource plan contains a reserved word
cause: The specified plan name is prefixed with a reserved prefix such as FORCE or SCHED.
action: Do not prefix resource plan name with FORCE or SCHED.

description: Category %s does not exist
cause: A non-existent category was specified as an argument to a procedure in the package, DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.
action: Specify an existing category name or create a new category with this name.

description: switch directives are set without a corresponding SWITCH_GROUP
cause: The plan directive contained a switch directive (SWITCH_TIME, SWITCH_IO_REQS, or SWITCH_IO_MEGABYTES) without a SWITCH_GROUP.
action: Specify a SWITCH_GROUP parameter in the plan directive.

description: Timeout occurred while setting resource plan
cause: A timeout occurred while waiting for one or more RAC instances to set the resource plan.
action: Since the resource plan may have actually been set successfully, first check the current resource plan for each instance by querying gv$rsrc_plan. If the resource plan was not successfully set on all instances, then retry the operation.

description: DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.CALIBRATE_IO ran into errors while spawning or communicating with calibration workers.
cause: This error occurs when the CALIBRATE_IO controller process is trying to spawn or communicate with a calibration worker process.
action: Review the calibration controller process trace file for additional details on the error. If this error is persistent across retries, contact Oracle Support.

description: I/O data limit exceeded - call aborted
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_MEGABYTES limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: I/O data limit exceeded - session terminated
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_MEGABYTES limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: I/O request limit exceeded - call aborted
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_REQS limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: I/O request limit exceeded - session terminated
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_REQS limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: ksfd calibration tracing
cause: NA
action: If this event is set then ksfd calibration module generates tracing

description: CALIBRATE_IO ran into errors while spawning the calibration worker processes.
cause: The CALIBRATE_IO controller process is trying to spawn additional calibration worker processes. There is a maximum limit of 1024 calibration worker processes.
action: Review the calibration controller process trace file to confirm that the maximum limit of calibration worker processes is being achieved. Reducing the value of the NUM_DISKS argument to the CALIBRATE_IO procedure should help limit the number of calibration worker processes.

description: Category %s is referred to by a consumer group and cannot be deleted
cause: An attempt was made to delete a category that is referred to by a consumer group.
action: Modify or remove all consumer groups that use this category and then retry.

description: Orion (%s) must be invoked using its full, absolute path
cause: Orion is spawning a child process and cannot determine the location of the executable.
action: Use the full, absolute path for Orion.

description: SQL blocks cannot be nested
cause: An attempt was made to start an SQL block using DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.BEGIN_SQL_BLOCK() while already inside an SQL block.
action: Close the existing SQL block using DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.BEGIN_SQL_BLOCK() or remove this call.

description: Failed to bind the database instance to processor group %s
cause: Binding the database instance to the processor group specified by the PROCESSOR_GROUP_NAME parameter failed.
action: Set the PROCESSOR_GROUP_NAME to a valid, configured processor group and restart the database instance.

description: pluggable database plan %s may not specify parameter %s
cause: Resource plans inside a pluggable database attempted to use the following parameters: MGMT_P2, MGMT_P3, MGMT_P4, MGMT_P5, MGMT_P6, MGMT_P7, MGMT_P8
action: Remove these parameters and try again.

description: pluggable database plan %s may not use subplans
cause: An attempt was made to set a resource plan that contains subplans. Subplans are not supported in pluggable databases (PDBs).
action: Specify a valid PDB resource plan or modify the specified plan to remove the subplan directives.

description: value %s for %s is outside valid range of 0 to 4294967295
cause: An invalid value was specified for a plan directive parameter.
action: Specify a value between 0 and 4294967295, inclusive.

description: logical I/O limit exceeded - call aborted
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_LOGICAL limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: logical I/O limit exceeded - session terminated
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_IO_LOGICAL limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: elapsed time limit exceeded - call aborted
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_ELAPSED_TIME limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: elapsed time limit exceeded - session terminated
cause: The Resource Manager SWITCH_ELAPSED_TIME limit was exceeded.
action: Reduce the complexity of the update or query, or contact your database administrator for more information.

description: SWITCH_GROUP is set without a corresponding switch directive
cause: The plan directive specified a value for SWITCH_GROUP without specifying one of the following switch directives: - SWITCH_TIME - SWITCH_IO_REQS - SWITCH_IO_MEGABYTES - SWITCH_ELAPSED_TIME - SWITCH_IO_LOGICAL
action: Specify a switch directive or remove SWITCH_GROUP directive.

description: CDB resource plan %s has more than %s profile directives.
cause: An attempt was made to create or update the specified multitenant container database (CDB) resource plan to use more than the supported number of profile directives.
action: Remove the directives for profiles that are not active on this database.

description: cannot modify max_iops or max_mbps parameter
cause: An attempt was made to alter the Resource Manager max_iops or max_mbps parameter in a non-consolidated database.
action: max_iops and max_mbps are pluggable database (PDB) only parameters and cannot be altered in non-consolidated databases. The max_iops and max_mbps parameters can only be altered from a PDB.

description: Resource plan %s does not contain mandatory group %s.
cause: An attempt was made to create or set a resource manager plan that does not contain a consumer group mandated by the administrator. The specified plan has too many plan directives for the system to automatically add the mandatory consumer group.
action: Modify the plan to contain the mandatory consumer group, or reduce the number of plan directives so that the system can automatically add the mandatory consumer group.

description: The specified plan uses multilevel management directives and cannot be set in a pluggable database.
cause: An attempt was made to set a resource plan that contains multilevel management directives: MGMT_P2, MGMT_P3, MGMT_P4, MGMT_5, MGMT_P6, MGMT_P7, or MGMT_P8. Multilevel management directives are not supported in pluggable databases (PDBs).
action: Specify a valid PDB resource plan or modify the specified plan to be a single level plan, using only the MGMT_P1 or SHARES directives.

description: cannot modify max_iops or max_mbps parameter on Oracle Exadata
cause: An attempt was made to alter the Resource Manager max_iops or max_mbps parameter on an Oracle Exadata system.
action: The max_iops and max_mbps parameters cannot be altered on Oracle Exadata systems. Use Oracle Exadata I/O Resource Manager to manage I/Os on Oracle Exadata.

description: memory_min (%s) cannot exceed memory_limit (%s) in the CDB plan '%s' for the pluggable database '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to create a multitenant container database (CDB) plan directive where memory_min was greater than memory_limit.
action: Change the CDB plan directive so that memory_min is less than memory_limit.

description: memory_min (%s) cannot exceed memory_limit (%s) in the CDB plan '%s' for the profile '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to create a multitenant container database (CDB) plan directive where memory_min was greater than memory_limit.
action: Change the CDB plan directive so that memory_min is less than memory_limit.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be smaller than parameter %s
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be smaller than %s%% of parameter %s
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be smaller than parameter %s of the root container
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be smaller than %s%% of parameter %s of the root container
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be larger than parameter %s
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: invalid value %s for parameter %s; must be larger than %s%% of parameter %s
cause: The value for this parameter was invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: PQ_TIMEOUT_ACTION is set without a corresponding PARALLEL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT directive
cause: The plan directive specified a value for PQ_TIMEOUT_ACTION without specifying a PARALLEL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT directive.
action: Specify a PARALLEL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT directive or remove the PQ_TIMEOUT_ACTION directive.

description: Oracle Database Free version (FREE) memory parameter invalid or not specified
cause: An invalid parameter or a value more than the maximum memory allowed was specified
action: Use the allowed parameter or reduce the memory size, upgrade to the Standard or Enterprise edition.

description: Calibration failed because Exadata files are not sufficiently populated.
cause: On Oracle Exadata, the calibration run was terminated because the data files did not have a sufficient percentage of populated blocks.
action: Re-run calibration after data is loaded in the data files.

description: invalid value %0!s for parameter %1!s; must be larger than the current resource usage %2!s
cause: This parameter cannot be set to a value that is lower than the current resource usage.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: Oracle Database developer's instance memory parameter is invalid or not specified.
cause: An invalid parameter or a value that exceeds the maximum memory allowed is specified.
action: Use a valid parameter or reduce the memory size or upgrade to the Oracle Database Standard or Enterprise Edition.

description: PSQ process terminated unexpectedly
cause: An explicit kill or internal error caused the termination of the PSQ background process.
action: Restart the instance.

description: DSKM process died unexpectedly
cause: An explicit kill or internal error caused the death of the DSKM background process.
action: Restart the instance.

description: ksz trace event
cause: Explicitly set.
action: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.

description: ksz test event
cause: Explicitly set.
action: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.

description: LIBCELL API error in Master Diskmon
cause: A LIBCELL operation in Master Diskmon failed.
action: Look in the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log file for additional error information.

description: Master Diskmon cannot connect to a CELL
cause: A LIBCELL operation from Master Diskmon failed to create a network connection to the target CELL.
action: Look in the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log file for additional error information.

description: LIBCELL operation network error in Master Diskmon
cause: A LIBCELL operation in Master Diskmon failed because of a network error.
action: Look in the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log file for additional error information.

description: LIBCELL SKGXP error in Master Diskmon
cause: A LIBCELL operation from Master Diskmon failed because of an SKGXP network layer error.
action: Look in the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log file for additional error information.

description: Master Diskmon "%s%s" operation cannot complete because of a LIBCELL network error
cause: A LIBCELL operation between Master Diskmon and a CELL failed because of a network error.
action: Look in the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log file for additional error information.

description: Invalid IP address in CELLINIT.ORA
cause: One or more of the specified IP addresses in CELLINIT.ORA is not valid.
action: Check that all IP addresses in CELLINIT.ORA are valid.

description: No IP parameter
cause: No IP address is set in CELLINIT.ORA.
action: Check that one or more valid IP addresses are set in CELLINIT.ORA.

description: Cannot connect to Master Diskmon on pipe "%s"
cause: Master Diskmon was not running or the listening pipe was deleted.
action: Look at the $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/diskmon/diskmon.log, $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/hasmsgs.log and $ORA_CRS_HOME/log/<hostname>/alert<hostname>.log for additional error information.

description: Duplicate IP address in CELLINIT.ORA
cause: One or more of the specified IP addresses in CELLINIT.ORA was repeated.
action: Check that all IP addresses in CELLINIT.ORA are unique.

description: Attempt to register dead cell with Master Diskmon
cause: An attempt was made by a process to register a cell that is known to be down.
action: None

description: The bind variable is not supported inside a pivot or unpivot operation.
cause: An attempt was made to use bind variables inside a pivot or unpivot operation.
action: Replace the bind variable with a constant and retry the query.

description: non-constant expression in pivot or unpivot values clause
cause: An attempt was made to use a non-constant expression for a pivot or unpivot values clause.
action: Use constants for the pivot or unpivot values.

description: non-aggregate expressions inside the PIVOT clause
cause: Non-aggregate expressions were used in the PIVOT clause of the SELECT statement, which is not allowed.
action: Only aggregate functions are allowed in the PIVOT clause. Rewrite the SELECT statement and remove all non-aggregate functions and resubmit. Refer to Oracle Database documentation for the syntax of the PIVOT clause.

description: sys_op_pivot function is not allowed here
cause: This was an invalid use of the sys_op_pivot function.
action: Remove the sys_op_pivot function.

description: Pivot or unpivot operations are not supported on lateral views.
cause: An attempt was made to do a pivot or unpivot operation on a lateral view.
action: Remove the pivot or unpivot operation or the lateral view and then retry the query.

description: pivot column or pivot value is too large
cause: Either the combined column size for multicolumn pivot was too large or a multicolumn pivot value was too large.
action: This is not supported.

description: %s: Duplicate column names are generated due to pivot values being too long or due to the absence of unique and short aliases for both pivot values and aggregates.
cause: Encountering either duplicate pivot values without unique aliases, multiple aggregates without unique aliases, or a pivot value that is too long. Truncating the pivot value to a specific maximum length can result in duplicate column names.
action: Assign unique and short aliases to the pivot values and aggregates. ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: a prepare or upgrade window or an on-demand or datapump-job loading of a secondary time zone data file is in an active state
cause: A prepare or upgrade window was started or an on-demand or datapump-job loading of a secondary time zone data file was done.
action: Make sure there is no active prepare or upgrade window and no active on-demand or datapump-job loading of a secondary time zone data file.

description: invalid time zone version
cause: Invalid time zone version passed.
action: Check and correct the time zone version.

description: Starting a prepare window failed
cause: Error(s) occurred when starting a prepare window.
action: Check alert or trace file for error(s).

description: database properties related to time zone version are not set up properly
cause: There were no database properties related to time zone version in dictionary table sys.props$.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: prepare window does not exist
cause: There was no active prepare window.
action: None.

description: Ending a prepare window failed
cause: Error(s) occurred when ending a prepare window.
action: Check alert or trace file for error(s).

description: database must be in UPGRADE mode in order to start an upgrade window
cause: Database was not in UPGRADE mode.
action: Restart database in UPGRADE mode.

description: Starting an upgrade window failed
cause: Error(s) occurred when starting an upgrade window.
action: Check alert or trace file for error(s).

description: upgrade window does not exist
cause: There was no active upgrade window.
action: None.

description: Ending an upgrade window failed
cause: Ending an upgrade window failed or there were tables containing TSTZ data which have not been upgraded.
action: Check alert or trace file for error(s) or complete upgrading of tables containing TSTZ data.

description: database must be restarted before performing upgrade of user tables
cause: Database was not restarted after starting an upgrade window.
action: Restart database.

description: inconsistent DST patching state found
cause: DST patching was in an inconsistent state.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: "%s"."%s" does not exist
cause: Specified table name was invalid.
action: Check the existence of the specified table name.

description: Table creation failed
cause: Error(s) occurred when creating the table.
action: Check the error.

description: database property DST_UPGRADE_STATE for datapump job is in an inconsistent state
cause: Database property DST_UPRGRADE_STATE was not recorded correctly.
action: Check the alert file.

description: existing datapump jobs are using a different version of time zone data file
cause: An attempt was made from a datapump job to request a different version of time zone data file from the one used by existing datapump jobs.
action: Wait until existing datapump jobs unload the secondary time zone data file.

description: datapump jobs are utilizing secondary time zone data file
cause: An on-demand loading of secondary time zone data file was requested when there was a secondary time zone data file already loaded in the database utilized by existing datapump jobs.
action: Wait until existing datapump jobs unload the secondary time zone data file.

description: failed to load the secondary time zone data file
cause: Attempt to load the secondary timezone data file failed.
action: Check alert or trace files for error(s).

description: no secondary time zone data file being loaded by on-demand or a datapump job
cause: There was no secondary timezone data file being loaded by on-demand or a datapump job.
action: None.

description: failed to unload the secondary time zone data file
cause: Attempt to unload the secondary timezone data file failed.
action: Check alert or trace files for error(s).

description: database must be restarted before ending DST upgrade window
cause: Attempt to end DST upgrade window before database is restarted.
action: Restart database.

description: DST upgrade of dictionary tables failed
cause: Attempt to perform DST upgrade of dictionary tables failed
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Read-only tables or tablespaces prevented Daylight Saving Time upgrade
cause: An attempt was made to start a DST upgrade window when there were tables with TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data that were in read-only mode or stored in read-only tablespaces.
action: Alter read-only tables with TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data to allow write operations or alter read-only tablespaces to allow write operations.

description: Table with TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data has invalid dependent triggers.
cause: An attempt was made to start a Daylight Saving Time (DST) upgrade window when table with TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data had invalid dependent triggers.
action: Remove invalid dependent triggers for the table.

description: Unable to cancel a DST upgrade window at current stage
cause: An attempt was made to cancel a DST upgrade window at a stage which does not allow cancellation.
action: Please complete DST upgrade.

description: Failed to cancel a DST upgrade window
cause: An attempt to cancel a DST upgrade window failed
action: Please retry or complete DST upgrade.

description: Patchless time zone version upgrade failed.
cause: An attempt to perform a patchless time zone version upgrade failed.
action: Retry or complete the Daylight Saving Time (DST) upgrade.

description: Affected TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data is found.
cause: An attempt to perform a patchless time zone version upgrade failed due to the existence of affected TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE data.
action: Complete the time zone version upgrade through the regular Daylight Saving Time (DST) upgrade process. ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: Invalid value for incident identifier
cause: Invalid incident identifier argument passed.
action: Check and correct the identifier

description: value of %s is null in %s constructor
cause: The attribute value was null.
action: Specify a non-null value.

description: reference plan resolves to %s plans
cause: The reference plan resolved to multiple plans.
action: Specify a unique reference plan.

description: statement_id and plan_id cannot both be null in PLAN_TABLE_OBJECT
cause: Both statement_id and plan_id attributes were null in PLAN_TABLE_OBJECT.
action: Specify a non-null value for statement_id or plan_id or both.

description: quarantined plan used
cause: A quarantined plan was used for this statement.
action: Increase the Oracle Database Resource Manager limits or use a new plan.

description: Invalid set of export options
cause: The options specified are inconsistent
action: Check and a consistent set of option parameters

description: referenced file not found
cause: One of the file specified in the test case package is mising
action: rebuild the SQL test case or make sure that all the referenced files are readable and located in the same directory as the SQL test case manifest.

description: import options do not match export options
cause: The import options specified do not match the export options
action: Check that import is being invoked with the same values for options like export environment, export data and export metadata

description: Invalid set of import options
cause: The import options specified are inconsistent
action: Check that import options are consistent and have valid values

description: invalid SQL_ID
cause: The SQL_ID specified was incorrect.
action: Cross check SYS.V$SQL for the existence of SQL_ID.

description: invalid export options: %s
cause: One or more export options were inconsistent.
action: Check that export options are consistent and have valid values.

description: invalid import options: %s
cause: One or more import options were inconsistent.
action: Check that import options are consistent and have valid values.

description: TCB root directory does not exist
cause: The root directory for Test Case Builder (TCB) does not exist.
action: Create the TCB root directory or specify any other directory during export of SQL Test Case.

description: TimesTen IMDB error: %s
cause: An error occurred during a TimesTen operation.
action: Look up the error code in the TimesTen error documentation to diagnose.

description: invalid number has been found during a TimesTen fetch
cause: An invalid number was found during TimesTen fetch.
action: Specify a valid number in TimesTen.

description: TimesTen Grid transient transaction failure: %s
cause: A transaction failed because a TimesTen Grid element was temporarily unreachable.
action: Roll back the transaction and immediately retry.

description: TimesTen Grid transaction failure: %s
cause: A transaction failed because a TimesTen Grid element was temporarily unreachable.
action: Roll back the transaction, wait for the element to recover, and retry the transaction. Element recovery may require administrator action.

description: TimesTen Grid transient statement failure: %s
cause: A statement failed because a TimesTen Grid element was temporarily unreachable.
action: Immediately retry the current statement.

description: TimesTen Grid statement failure: %s
cause: A TimesTen Grid element is temporarily unavailable.
action: Wait for the element to recover and retry the current statement. Element recovery may require administrator action.

description: Invalid field specified in embed_params while creating the vector table.
cause: The embed_params parameter contains unsupported fields. Only "model" and "embed_metadata_jsonpath" are allowed.
action: Provide only the supported fields in embed_params and retry.

description: No valid clause specified in the query_by search parameter.
cause: The query_by search parameter does not contain the required clause. One of "text", "id", or "vector" needs to be passed to perform search.
action: Provide exactly one valid clause in query_by and retry.

description: Multiple clauses specified in the query_by search parameter.
cause: The query_by search parameter includes more than one clause.
action: Provide only one of the following clauses: "text", "id", or "vector", and retry.

description: Parameter %s cannot be NULL or empty.
cause: A required parameter is passed as NULL or empty.
action: Provide a valid, non-empty value for the parameter and retry.

description: %s is not a valid value for parameter %s.
cause: An invalid name or value is provided for the specified parameter.
action: Provide a valid parameter name or value (up to 128 characters) and retry.

description: A model named %s already exists.
cause: A model with the given model name is already present.
action: Use a different model name and retry.

description: Metadata field is missing in the JSON object.
cause: The JSON object does not include the required metadata field for upsert.
action: Add the metadata field to the JSON object and retry the upsert.

description: dense_vector or metadata field is missing in the JSON object during upsert.
cause: The JSON object is missing one or both required fields: dense_vector or metadata for upsert.
action: Include both dense_vector and metadata fields and retry the upsert.

description: DBMS_VECTOR_DATABASE does not support operations when the current user and current schema different.
cause: The current user and the current schema are different.
action: Set the current schema to match the current user and retry.

description: Unsupported operator value in filter syntax: %s
cause: The filter contains an invalid operator value.
action: Use a valid operator value (string, number, or boolean) and retry.

description: Unsupported operator in filter syntax: %s
cause: The filter contains an invalid operator.
action: Use a valid operator (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, exists, and, or) and retry.

description: Maximum filter nesting levels exceeded: %s.
cause: The filter has too many nested levels.
action: Reduce the levels of nesting in the search filter and retry.

description: Boolean values are not allowed with operator: %s.
cause: A boolean value is used with an operator that does not support boolean values.
action: Provide a supported data type for the operator and retry.

description: The $exists operator must use a boolean value.
cause: The $exists operator is provided with a non-boolean value.
action: Provide only True or False with the $exists operator and retry.

description: Only one root-level key is allowed in the filter syntax.
cause: The filter JSON contains multiple keys at the root level.
action: Ensure that the filter has only one root-level key and retry.

description: Validation error: %s.
cause: One or more input parameters are invalid.
action: Correct the invalid parameters and retry.

description: CLOUD_SERVICE credentials are not configured for this database.
cause: CLOUD_SERVICE credentials for the current user are missing or not set.
action: Configure valid CLOUD_SERVICE credentials and retry.

description: Duplicate ID found during load_vectors operation.
cause: A UNIQUE constraint violation occurs because one or more IDs already exist in the table.
action: Remove or modify the duplicate IDs and retry the load.

description: Manual indexing is not supported in index parameters.
cause: The index_params specify manual indexing, which is not allowed.
action: Use "auto" for indexing or omit the parameter and retry.

description: Invalid index parameters.
cause: The provided index parameters are incorrect or incomplete.
action: Verify and correct the index parameters and retry.

description: Invalid embed_path specified during vector upsert.
cause: The JSON path in embed_path does not return a value.
action: Use the same embed_path defined during CREATE_VECTOR_TABLE_FOR_MODEL and retry.

description: Search with text is not supported for BYOV.
cause: Searching with text is not supported for the Bring Your Own Vector (BYOV) type.
action: Use ID or vector search and retry.

description: ID specified for search does not exist.
cause: The specified ID does not return any vector data for the search.
action: Provide a valid ID that has associated vector data and retry.

description: Unable to fetch input vector during search.
cause: The vector related to the query_by search parameter is not available.
action: Make sure that query_by search parameter has correct input.

description: Internal tracing, ksfdx.c
cause: None
action: An internal event used for debugging. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services.

description: %s
cause: The operation had an error in the Oracle Exadata storage server.
action: This is a supporting error message. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.
params: 1) message: A message from Oracle Exascale file layer.

description: %s
cause: The operation had an error in the Oracle Exadata storage server.
action: This is a supporting error message. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.
params: 1) message: A message from Exascale storage pool layer.

description: %s
cause: The operation had an error in the Oracle Exadata storage server.
action: This is a supporting error message. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.
params: 1) message: Message from Oracle Exadata storage, a lower-level facility.

description: cannot get logical block size for file '%s'. Location=%s.
cause: There were problems in trying to get logical block size of named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors to best proceed with the required action.

description: cannot create file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying to create the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors to best proceed with the required action.

description: cannot open file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying to open the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors to best proceed with the required action.

description: cannot resize file '%s'
cause: There were problems resizing the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file that cannot be resized.

description: cannot resize file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying to resize the named file.
action: There is difficulty in writing the header block. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: cannot share file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying to share the named file.
action: There is difficulty in opening the file to be shared. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: cannot get attributes for file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying to get attributes of the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: cannot commit the creation of file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying commit the creation of the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: cannot delete file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying delete the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: cannot close file '%s'
cause: There were problems in trying close the named file.
action: Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.

description: Internal testing, ksfdx.c
cause: None
action: An internal event used for debugging. Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services.

description: The EDSB process terminated unexpectedly.
cause: The Exascale Data Service Background (EDSB) process terminated unexpectedly due to an internal error or some outside action that was taken to terminate the process.
action: Restart the instance.

description: The EGSB process terminated unexpectedly.
cause: The Exascale Global Service Background (EGSB) process unexpectedly terminated due to an internal error or some external action taken to terminate the process.
action: Restart the instance.

description: File name '%s' contains unexpected character '%s' in vault name.
cause: A file name was specified that contained an unexpected character in the vault name. The vault name should consist of up to 30 characters that are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters _, ., -, and #.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The file name with the unexpected character. 2) unexpected_character: The unexpected character in the vault name.

description: file name '%s' contains empty vault name
cause: A file name was specified that did not contain a vault name. A vault name must follow the initial "@" character and consist of one or more characters that are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters _, ., -, and #.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file with the missing vault name.

description: file name '%s' contains vault name greater than 30 characters: '%s'
cause: A file name was specified that contained a vault name longer than 30 characters.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The file name with the long vault name. 2) vault_name: The vault name that exceeds 30 characters.

description: file name '%s' contains unexpected character '%s' in template name
cause: A file name was specified that contained an unexpected character in the template name. The template name should consist of up to 30 characters that are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters _, ., -, and #.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file containing the expected character. 2) unexpected_character: The unexpected character in the template name.

description: file name '%s' contains empty template name
cause: A file name was specified that did not contain a template name. Once a template name is indicated with an opening parentheses ( character, one or more characters that are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters _, ., -, and # must follow.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file with the empty template name.

description: File name '%s' starts a template name but does not finish the template name.
cause: A file name was specified that started a template with the open parentheses ( character, but no corresponding closing parentheses ) character was found.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The file name that contains an unfinished template name.

description: File name '%s' does not follow a template name with an expected character: '%s'
cause: A file name was specified that followed a template specification with an unexpected character. After the closing parentheses ) is found, the file name must immediately end or continue with a file name starting with the slash character /.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: Name of the file with the unexpected character. 2) unexpected_character: An unexpected character that was not a slash character /.

description: File name '%s' contains an unexpected character - '%s'.
cause: A file name was specified that contained an unexpected character. Permitted characters are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters underscore (_), period (.), hyphen (-) and number sign (#).
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file containing the unexpected character. 2) unexpected_character: The unexpected character.

description: File name '%s' contains a template name greater than 30 characters: '%s'.
cause: A file name was specified that contained a template name longer than 30 characters.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file with a template name longer than 30 characters. 2) template_name: The template name that is longer than 30 characters.

description: file name '%s' with vault name '%s' not equal to default '%s'
cause: A file name was specified that contained a vault name that was not equal to the default vault name provided.
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The file name with an unexpected vault name. 2) vault_name: The name of the unexpected vault in file name. 3) default_name: The expected vault name.

description: Cannot access ASM disk groups based on Exadata storage (path='%s') when Exascale is in use.
cause: A database instance tried to use an Oracle ASM disk group based on Exadata storage while already using Exascale storage.
action: Correct the path specification to use Exascale storage and retry.

description: Cannot access ASM disk groups based on Exadata storage when Exascale is in use.
cause: A database instance tried to use an Oracle ASM disk group based on Exadata storage while already using Exascale storage.
action: Correct the path specification to use Exascale storage and retry.

description: Cannot access Exascale (path='%s') when ASM disk groups are in use.
cause: A database instance tried to use Exascale storage while already using Oracle ASM storage.
action: Correct the path specification to use ASM storage and retry.

description: Cannot access Exascale when ASM disk groups are in use.
cause: A database instance tried to use Exascale storage while already using Oracle ASM storage.
action: Correct the path specification to use ASM storage and retry.

description: %s
cause: The operation had an error in the Oracle Exadata storage server.
action: This is a supporting error message. Consult the other reported errors and proceed with the required action.
params: 1) message: Message indicating the origin (for example, the IP address) of the other errors contained in the error stack.

description: process terminated due to fenced I/O
cause: A process was terminated because it was fenced from doing anymore I/Os.
action: Reconnect to the database. If the process termination resulted in instance termination, restart the instance.

description: Oracle Exascale file name '%s' exceeds maximum length %s.
cause: The length of the Oracle Exadata Exascale Storage file name exceeded the 256 character limit which includes a combination of the vault name, template name, file name, and punctuation.
action: Correct the file name specification.

description: Exascale file '%s' not dropped; currently being accessed
cause: An attempt is being made to drop an Exascale file. The file is being accessed by one or more clients and therefore cannot be dropped.
action: Stop all clients that are using this file and retry the drop command.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file that cannot be deleted.

description: Failure to create file '%s'. File already exists.
cause: An attempt is being made to create a database file, but a file by that name already exists.
action: Verify that the name is correct. Specify REUSE if necessary.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file that cannot be created.

description: Template '%s' does not exist.
cause: An attmpt is being made to create a database file with a non-existant template.
action: Verify that the template name is correct.
params: 1) template_name: The name of the template that cannot be used.

description: Extended Storage provisioned space in vault '%s' is exhausted.
cause: There is no Extended Storage space in the specified vault.
action: Add more Extended Storage space to the vault.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault that has no space.

description: Extreme Flash provisioned space in vault '%s' is exhausted.
cause: There is no Extreme Flash space in the specified vault.
action: Add more Extreme Flash space to the vault.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault that has no space.

description: High Capacity provisioned space in vault '%s' is exhausted.
cause: There is no High Capacity space in the specified vault.
action: Add more High Capacity space to the vault.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault that has no space.

description: Vault '%s' not found.
cause: The specified vault does not exist.
action: Create the specified vault or use a different vault.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault which does not exist.

description: Vault name '%s' contains an unexpected character.
cause: A vault name is specified that contains an unexpected character. Permitted characters are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters underscore (_), period (.), hyphen (-), and number sign (#).
action: Correct the vault name specification.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault containing the unexpected character.

description: File name '%s' contains an unexpected character.
cause: A file name was specified that contains an unexpected character. Permitted characters are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters underscore (_), period (.), hyphen (-) and number sign (#).
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file containing the unexpected character.

description: Template name '%s' contains an unexpected character.
cause: A template name is specified that contains an unexpected character. Permitted characters are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters underscore (_), period (.), hyphen (-), and number sign (#).
action: Correct the template name specification.
params: 1) template_name: The name of the template containing the unexpected character.

description: Operation is unauthorized
cause: The attempted operation is not authorized.
action: Resolve the authorization issue.

description: File name '%s' contains an unexpected character.
cause: A file name is specified that contains an unexpected character. Permitted characters are alphabetic, numeric, or the characters underscore (_), period (.), hyphen (-), and number sign (#).
action: Correct the file name specification.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file containing the unexpected character.

description: File '%s' not found.
cause: The specified file does not exist.
action: Determine if the file is correctly specified.
params: 1) file_name: The name of the file that cannot be found.

description: Unable to access vault '%s'.
cause: The specified vault is known but is not accessible at this time.
action: Determine why the vault not accessible, fix the problem, and retry.
params: 1) vault_name: The name of the vault that cannot be accessed.

description: A shutdown is in progress. Exascale operations are suspended.
cause: The instance is being shutdown. Access to Exascale storage has been suspended.
action: Restart the RDBMS instance to regain access to Exascale storage.

description: not all rebalance phases were run
cause: The previous rebalance for the group did not run all of the phases.
action: See GV$ASM_OPERATION for more details. Run all rebalance phases using the ALTER DISKGROUP REBALANCE command.

description: Disk '%s' must be online before disk '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to online a disk that contains old copies of the data present in another offline disk.
action: Online the disks in the correct order. FORCE option may be used to override this check.

description: Disk revalidation failed for ASM disk group '%s' on instance %s due to ORA-%s.
cause: The disk revalidation failure could be due to various reasons. Signaling ORA-15020 during discovery was a probable one. See the alert log for more details.
action: Ensure that the disks in operation are visible to all the nodes in the cluster before issuing a retry.

description: database is not prepared for split.
cause: Split was issued on a database which is either not prepared or did not complete the last time.
action: Prepare the database before issuing split on it or drop the existing mirror copy and then retry the split mirror operations.

description: No rebalance is running for group %s.
cause: An attempt was made to modify the property of a rebalance that was not running.
action: Issue the ALTER DISKGROUP REBALANCE command without the MODIFY keyword to schedule another rebalance.

description: Oracle ASM IOServer functionality is not supported on this platform.
cause: This platform did not support ASM IOServer functionality.
action: Refer to the documentation for the list of platforms that support Oracle ASM IOServer functionality and consider moving to one of those platforms.

description: connection request from stale database instance is rejected.
cause: The database instance was attempting to fail over from a stale IOServer cluster.
action: Restart the database instance to initiate a new connection.

description: cannot find a usable network from the client
cause: The database instance was not using any of the configured ASM networks.
action: Check the ASM network configuration in the database instance.

description: All configured ASM networks are unusable.
cause: All configured ASM networks encountered an error. ASM IOServer was unable to proceed.
action: Check the status of the configured ASM network interfaces. Restart the ASM IOServer instance after the interfaces become operational.

description: ASM IOServer instance is not ready to accept clients.
cause: ASM IOServer instance was not ready to accept clients.
action: Execute 'alter system enable client access' for ASM IOServer instance to accept clients.

description: cannot SHUTDOWN ASM IOServer instance with connected client %s.
cause: A SHUTDOWN command was issued to an ASM IOServer instance that had one or more connected clients.
action: Stop all clients that are using this ASM IOServer instance and retry the SHUTDOWN command. Alternatively, use the SHUTDOWN ABORT command to force disconnection with all the clients.

description: operation failure for group %s because too many disks are offline
cause: Too many disks were offline in the disk group.
action: Ensure that the disks are online and retry the operation.

description: Disk %0!s uses an invalid physical sector size (%1!s).
cause: The disk used a physical sector size value that is not standard or is not currently supported.
action: The disk cannot be used for an ASM disk group.

description: Disk %0!s uses an invalid logical sector size (%1!s).
cause: The disk used a logical sector size value that is not standard or is not currently supported.
action: The disk cannot be used for an ASM disk group.

description: file %0!s in disk group %1!s was not prepared for split
cause: The specified file was not prepared for split.
action: Check the accompanying error messages for information on the reason for this failure.

description: Oracle ASM scrubbing is disabled.
cause: An attempt was made to perform Oracle ASM scrubbing but it was disabled.
action: Enable Oracle ASM scrubbing.

description: Disk group %s cannot be mounted due to invalid symbols
cause: A mount operation was attempted for a disk group that contains invalid characters in its name. Starting in version 12.2.0.2.0, disk group names should only contain alphanumeric characters and the underscore character.
action: Use the 'renamedg' tool to change the disk group name to a valid name. Afterwards, change the names of the disks by mounting the disk group in restricted mode and using the ASM SQL command 'ALTER DISKGROUP name RENAME DISKS ALL'.

description: Oracle ASM scrubbing is stopping a previous operation.
cause: The system cannot accept new scrubbing operations if a previous one is being stopped.
action: Wait until the previous Oracle ASM scrubbing operation stops completely before initiating a new one.

description: Oracle ASM scrubbing requires an Allocation Unit size of at least 1 MB.
cause: The operation was not executed because the Allocation Unit was less than 1 MB.
action: Run the operation on a disk group with an Allocation Unit of at least 1 MB.

description: cannot start SCRB process
cause: The ASM Scrubbing Master (SCRB) process failed during startup.
action: Review the alert log to find out the reason behind the process startup failure.

description: Dropping mirror copy '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' already in progress.
cause: The drop mirror copy was already issued on the specified file group.
action: Wait for the previous drop mirror copy to complete. Check the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) alert log or check that the corresponding file group is deleted using the V$ASM_FILEGROUP view.

description: Dropping child file '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' is not allowed.
cause: The operation failed because child file deletion was attempted.
action: Child files can be deleted only as part of a DROP MIRROR COPY operation.

description: dropping mirror copy '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' failed as prepare is not complete
cause: Prepare of mirror copy has not completed
action: Wait for the prepare mirror copy to complete. Check the ASM alert log or check that the split status of the file group using the V$ASM_FILEGROUP view.

description: command requires attribute '%0!s' to be set to '%1!s'
cause: The disk group was still running the necessary background operations preventing the attribute <name> from setting to value <value>, which is a prerequisite for the command.
action: Confirm that all disks in the disk group are online, and wait until the attribute is set to the proper value. The attribute may not get set to the proper value if any of the disks in the disk group are offline. This may take a while.

description: dropping mirror copy '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' failed
cause: The drop of the mirror copy failed because the split of the mirror copy had already been completed.
action: Dropping the mirror copy can only be done before the database is split. This clause cannot be used to drop a database that has already been split.

description: creation of mirror copy for database '%0!s' failed
cause: Another mirror copy for the database existed when the operation was attempted or failure occurred when communicating with ASM instance.
action: If a mirror copy exists with PREPARED state, then either create another database using the existing mirror copy or drop the existing mirror copy. If a mirror copy exists in FAILED state, then drop the mirror copy. Thereafter, retry the operation.

description: Dropping file group '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' failed as the file group has prepared mirror copies.
cause: An attempt was made to drop a file group that had prepared mirror copies. This is not allowed.
action: Drop all prepared mirror copies and retry the drop file group operation.

description: A file group redundancy cannot be modified when mirror copy exists.
cause: A mirror copy of the database existed or the disk group was still running the necessary split background operations, preventing the file group redundancy change.
action: Check the split status by querying the DBCLONE_STATUS column in the V$ASM_FILEGROUP_PROPERTY dynamic view. If another database is still using the existing mirror copy, drop the database or the existing mirror copy, which will trigger a rebalance for the disk group. After you complete this action, retry the operation.

description: rebalance did not complete after the last mirror split operation on database '%0!s'
cause: Rebalance after the last mirror split operation was either still running or not scheduled yet.
action: If a rebalance is already running allow it to complete, otherwise issue a new one.

description: All ASM disks in %0!s are already online or being brought online.
cause: An attempt was made to bring disks online that were either already online or were being brought online.
action: Check the status of the disks before changing the ONLINE statement to exclude the disks in the failure group or disk group.

description: disk group '%0!s' containing file group '%1!s' has too many offline disks
cause: A mirror split operation failed because the disk group containing the files had insufficient number of online disks. This could prevent some files in the target database from being opened. The operation failed early to give the administrator a chance to fix the errors.
action: Ensure that the disk group has the required number of disks online and then retry the command.

description: operation cannot be run concurrently with other mirror split operations on mirror copy '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s'
cause: Another conflicting Mirror Split operation was already running.
action: Retry after the conflicting Mirror Split operation has finished.

description: rebalance did not complete after the last mirror split or change redundancy operation
cause: The rebalance operation after the last mirror split operation or change redundancy was either still running or not scheduled yet.
action: If a rebalance is already running, then allow it to complete; otherwise, issue the rebalance operation.

description: failed to start Oracle ASM instance because it was unable to open SPFILE '%0!s'
cause: An attempt to start the Oracle ASM instance failed because the ASM server parameter file (SPFILE) could not be opened. The SPFILE was configured in the indicated disk group. One or more of the disks in the disk group were inaccessible. This was likely due to the remote node or nodes being inactive.
action: Issue the 'olsnodes' command to retrieve the list of nodes in the cluster. Start up all the remote nodes in the cluster that were previously inactive. Issue the 'crsctl start cluster' command on this node and verify that the Oracle ASM instance is active.

description: Internal ASM event: retry due to ASMB connection changes.
cause: The network operation should be retried due to connection changes.
action: Internal event.

description: HARDCHECK error during I/O
cause: A Hardware Assisted Resilient Data (HARD) check error was encountered by ASM Rebalance (ARB) process during I/O operations; Oracle ASM cannot disable HARD check automatically due to offline disks.
action: Look for the corresponding ORA-59051 error in the alert log that shows the file number that has HARD check error. Evaluate if those files were unused or abandoned. If unused or abandoned, delete them. Bring all disks in the disk group online to allow Oracle ASM to disable HARD check automatically so that ARB process will not be interrupted.

description: Offline disks prevent data reconstruction from parity redundancy.
cause: An attempt to reconstruct data from parity redundancy failed because some disks in the disk group were offline.
action: Bring all disks in the disk group online to make data reconstruction from parity redundancy feasible.

description: Dropping mirror copy '%0!s' in disk group '%1!s' failed.
cause: An attempt was made to drop a mirror copy that did not exist.
action: Check the dynamic performance view V$ASM_DBCLONE_INFO for a list of valid mirrors. Ensure that the specified mirror copy exists and retry the operation.

description: Too many mirror copies found
cause: An attempt was made to create a mirror copy of the database that already has the maximum number of mirror copies.
action: Drop or split an existing mirror copy and retry operation.

description: Oracle ASM instance '%0!s' is already running an Oracle ASM scrubbing operation for disk group '%1!s'.
cause: An attempt is being made to issue an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing operation on an Oracle ASM instance where another scrubbing operation is still running.
action: Wait for the running operation to finish and try again. Or, stop the running operation with ALTER DISKGROUP <DG> SCRUB STOP. Or, issue a new Oracle ASM scrubbing operation for a different disk group on another Oracle ASM instance.

description: ASM file property has changed.
cause: An attempt was made to issue an ASM scrubbing operation and there was a file that changed one property.
action: Wait for the ASM scrubbing operation to retry the operation automatically.

description: database '%0!s' has data files in multiple disk groups
cause: A mirror split operation was issued on a database whose data files were located in multiple disk groups.
action: Ensure that all the data files are located on the same disk group either by moving all the data files to a single disk group or by dropping the data files of other disk groups. And, then retry the operation.

description: creation of database from '%0!s' using mirror copy '%1!s' in disk group '%2!s' failed
cause: An attempt was made to create a database from a mirror copy that did not exist.
action: Connect to the database and check V$ASM_DBCLONE_INFO for list of valid mirrors. Ensure that the specified mirror copy is created and then retry the operation.

description: ASM in-memory metadata for disk group '%0!s' is stale.
cause: ASM metadata needs to be refreshed from disk.
action: Internal event.

description: Single parity redundancy files in group '%0!s' could not be relocated.
cause: An attempt was made to relocate single parity redundancy files for balance or to restore redundancy in the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state and retry the operation. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all the missing disks and retry the operation.

description: Double parity redundancy files in group '%0!s' could not be relocated.
cause: An attempt was made to relocate double parity redundancy files for balance or to restore redundancy in the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state and retry the operation. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all the missing disks and retry the operation.

description: Allocation or relocation of a parity redundancy file in group '%0!s' failed.
cause: An attempt was made to allocate or relocate a parity redundancy file in the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state and retry the operation. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all the missing disks and retry the operation.

description: Allocation or relocation of a mirrored file in group '%0!s' failed.
cause: An attempt was made to allocate or relocate a mirrored file in the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state and retry the operation. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all the missing disks and retry the operation.

description: Insufficient failure groups to restore redundancy in disk group '%0!s'.
cause: An attempt to restore redundancy during rebalance is failing for some user data due to the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all of the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all of the missing disks.

description: Copy of OCR backup file %s failed.
cause: The specified method for copying the Oracle Cluster Registry (OCR) backup file failed. The specified method for copying is supported only from disk group to file system.
action: Use the ocrconfig -copy command to copy from file system to disk group, disk group to file system or disk group to disk group.

description: ASM disk expel failed during rebalance of group '%0!s'.
cause: Some or all ASM disks in the DROPPING or FORCING state were not expelled from the disk group during rebalance.
action: Rebalance has restarted to address this issue, so no immediate action is needed. See the alert log for more information on the reason for the failure. If rebalance keeps hitting this error, check the status of the configured ASM network interfaces. Add back all the disks in the DROPPING or FORCING state and retry the rebalance operation.

description: HARD check error in file '+%0!s.%1!s.%2!s' in disk group '%3!s'
cause: A Hardware Assisted Resilient Data (HARD) check error was encountered by an Oracle ASM Rebalance (ARB) process during I/O operations.
action: The error points to a file that has encountered HARD check errors. Check the alert log and evaluate if these files were unused or abandoned. If unused or abandoned, delete them. Otherwise, use Oracle ASM scrubbing to repair them.

description: Memory allocation failed because maximum designated memory slots are used up.
cause: An attempt to allocate memory was denied because the designated memory slots were used up.
action: Increasing the size of the memory will not prevent this error. There is a fixed number of designated memory slots for certain operations. If the error occurs in the Oracle Automatic Storage (Oracle ASM) instance, then decrease the number of disk and disk group operations. Otherwise, if the error happens in the Oracle Database instance, then decrease the number of RMAN operations. Retry the operation.

description: I/O operation failed to %0!s file block %1!s of file number %2!s located at disk %3!s in disk group %4!s, error [%5!s]
cause: An I/O operation has failed.
action: Ensure that all of the disks are operational.

description: Modifying the block size %s of a password file from an expected size of %s to size %s in ASM is not supported.
cause: An attempt to create a password file in an Oracle ASM disk group found an existing file with the same name and different block size.
action: Specify the correct logical block size to reuse the existing file. Alternatively, delete the existing file and retry.

description: failed to read attribute directory for entry number %0!s
cause: An error occurred while reading the attribute directory.
action: Check the alert log for accompanying errors.

description: Insufficient number of Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instances. Required '%0!s'
cause: An attempt to run Oracle ASM scrubbing was denied because there were too few Oracle ASM instances running.
action: Start more Oracle ASM instances and retry the 'alter diskgroup <dg> scrub' command, or run 'alter diskgroup <dg> scrub stop' to stop it and finish the current operation.

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing is paused.
cause: An attempt to run Oracle ASM scrubbing was denied because it was in a paused state.
action: Run the 'alter diskgroup <dg> scrub' command to resume scrubbing, or run 'alter diskgroup <dg> scrub stop' to stop it and finish the current operation.

description: Uninitialized or abandoned file '%s' encountered during I/O operation.
cause: A Hardware Assisted Resilient Data (HARD) check error was encountered by the Oracle ASM Rebalance (ARB) process during I/O operations because of the extent sets in uninitialized or abandoned files.
action: Check the reported file. If it is no longer in use, remove the file. If it is uninitialized or being initialized, wait until the file is fully initialized. Otherwise, use DBVerify to check the integrity of the file.

description: Both TO version and FROM version are needed.
cause: Either the TO version or the FROM version or both were missing in the command.
action: Specify both the TO version and the FROM version.

description: TO version or FROM version are not needed.
cause: Either the TO version or the FROM version or both were specified in the command.
action: Remove both the TO version and the FROM version from the command.

description: Rolling migration from version '%0!s' to '%1!s' started before finishing the disk group mount operation.
cause: An attempt to mount a disk group failed because rolling migration started before finishing the mount operation.
action: Retry the diskgroup mount operation

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) discovered an insufficient number of sites in disk group "%0!s".
cause: Oracle ASM could not find a sufficient number of sites belonging to the disk group to continue the operation.
action: Do the following: - Check that the sites in the disk group attributes have been specified. - Ensure the disk groups in the sites are present and functioning. - Ensure that the owner of the ORACLE binary has read/write permission for the disks. - Ensure that the ASM_DISKSTRING initialization parameter has been set correctly. - Query the V$ASM_DISK dynamic view to verify that Oracle ASM can discover the appropriate disks in the Oracle ASM instance.

description: Copy of XML file %s failed.
cause: The specified XML file to be copied into the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group was not correctly validated.
action: Verify the sanity of the XML file and retry the operation, or use a different XML file.

description: Oracle ASM disk %0!s in disk group %1!s is being offlined.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk was marked to be taken offline or was being offlined and therefore it could not be accessed.
action: Retry the operation after the disk is dropped or brought online.

description: Oracle ASM disk is still onlining.
cause: A write request failed because all redundant copies of a block were either unavailable or on an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk that was being onlined.
action: Wait for the disk online to complete. Then, retry the operation.

description: Multiple disk paths (%0!s) are discovering disk with identical disk header contents.
cause: The Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk discovery string had multiple paths configured for disks with an identical disk header. Oracle ASM could not distinguish whether these were separate disks with an identical disk header content or the same disk with different paths. The wrong Oracle ASM disk discovery string configuration may be responsible.
action: Remove all except one of the valid paths to the disk from the disk discovery string and retry the disk operation.

description: invalid label name
cause: Oracle ASM label name was invalid or exceeded the maximum length.
action: Specify a label name that is a valid SQL identifier and is no more than 23 bytes after any wild cards are processed.

description: Insufficient failure groups to restore redundancy in disk group '%0!s'.
cause: An attempt to restore redundancy during rebalance is failing for some Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata due to the presence of dropping or forcing disks.
action: Add back all of the disks in DROPPING or FORCING state. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all of the missing disks.

description: Oracle ASM file operation failed.
cause: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) file operation failed.
action: See the alert log for additional errors.

description: Database %0!s can not open file already opened by database %1!s.
cause: This file can only be open in one database at a time.
action: Check the db_unique_name and db_name parameters of the connected database instances. Shut down the other database and retry the operation or specify a different file to open.

description: invalid disk group or failure group name '%0!s' specified for asm_preferred_read_failure_groups parameter
cause: A disk group or failure group name does not start with a letter and does not contain letters, numbers, and underscores.
action: Ensure that the disk group and failure group name start with a letter and only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.

description: invalid value '%0!s' for asm_preferred_read_failure_groups parameter
cause: The single value contains spaces rather than multiple string values separated by a comma.
action: Quote each string value individually when specifying multiple values. For example, 's1','s2','s3' rather than 's1 s2 s3'.

description: invalid preferred read failure group name '%0!s' for asm_preferred_read_failure_groups parameter
cause: The specified value for the ASM_PREFERRED_READ_FAILURE_GROUPS parameter is invalid.
action: Specify a preferred read failure group with the format <diskgroup name>.<failure group name>

description: cannot create an Oracle ADVM volume with Oracle Exadata cluster membership.
cause: An Oracle ASM Dynamic Volume Manager (Oracle ADVM) volume creation was attempted when an Oracle Exadata volume cluster membership was active. Only Oracle ADVM cluster membership or Oracle Exadata volume cluster membership can be active at a given time.
action: Stop Oracle Exadata cluster membership using 'srvctl stop acfsapps' to allow Oracle ADVM volume creation to succeed.

description: Disks in DROPPING or FORCING state could not be expelled during rebalance of disk group '%0!s'.
cause: If there are disks in the DROPPING state, then some data is not being relocated. If there are disks in the FORCING state, then some redundancy is not being fully restored.
action: Check the alert log for more details on the rebalance operation. Also, check the expel process trace file for additional details or errors. Check if there is sufficient space on the disks in NORMAL state. Rerun rebalance on the disk group. If the issue persists, add back all the disks in the DROPPING or FORCING state. If this is an Oracle appliance, also add back all of the missing disks.

description: unable to connect to the metadata service
cause: An attempt to create or locate a file failed because the metadata service in the Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) instance is unavailable.
action: Check the alert log of the Oracle ASM instance and the ARB9 process trace file in the Oracle ASM instance for more information. Ensure that the platform supports the metadata service. If the platform supports the metadata service, verify that the Oracle ASM instance is active and that the metadata service configuration is valid.

description: insufficient failure groups to restore Oracle ASM metadata due to offline quorum disks in disk group '%0!s'
cause: An attempt to restore Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) metadata redundancy during rebalance failed due to the presence of dropping or forcing quorum disks.
action: 1. Add back all the quorum disks in DROPPING or FORCING state. 2. Online all quorum disks if they are OFFLINE.

description: Oracle Exadata does not support external redundancy disk groups.
cause: An attempt to create an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) disk group with external redundacy on Oracle Exadata failed due to external redundancy not being supported.
action: Oracle Exadata supports normal/high/flex redundancy disk groups.

description: Internal Oracle ASM testing event number 59080
cause: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle development.
action: The level controls ASM rebalance.

description: Disk group '%0!s' has an ongoing Oracle ASM scrubbing operation.
cause: An attempt is being made to issue an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing operation on an Oracle ASM disk group that has an active scrubbing operation.
action: Wait for the running operation to finish and try again. Or, stop the running operation with ALTER DISKGROUP <DG> SCRUB STOP.

description: Oracle ASM scrubbing is still running on another session.
cause: An attempt is being made to issue an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing operation on an Oracle ASM instance that has an ongoing scrubbing operation on another session.
action: Wait for the running operation to finish and try again. Or, stop the running operation with ALTER DISKGROUP <DG> SCRUB STOP.

description: Oracle ASM scrubbing process SCRB is shutting down.
cause: An attempt is being made to issue an Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing operation on an Oracle ASM instance where the SCRB process is shutting down due to an ALTER DISKGROUP <dg> SCRUB STOP command.
action: Wait for the stop operation to finish and try again.

description: Oracle Automatic Storage Management (Oracle ASM) scrubbing cannot repair external redundancy disk group '%0!s'.
cause: The REPAIR keyword is being used in an ALTER DISKGROUP <dg> SCRUB command on an external redundancy disk group.
action: Remove the REPAIR keyword from the ALTER DISKGROUP <dg> SCRUB command.

description: Expel process is interrupted.
cause: The on-going rebalance is being interrupted.
action: If the on-going rebalance is being stopped using the rebalance SQL, by using a power value of 0, then rebalance will not automatically start. Consider starting the rebalance manually using the rebalance SQL, using a non-zero value of power. If the on-going rebalance is being interrupted because of a disk group reconfiguration, such as, add disk or drop disk or online disk or because of explicitly issuing a rebalance using the rebalance SQL, then rebalance will auto-start.

description: Cluster is not homogeneous.
cause: Either when ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES is being done, or during startup, it is detected that some instances in the cluster have a different set of Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates as compared to other nodes. If Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates are enabled, all cluster nodes need to have the same set of Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates; otherwise, unexpected behavior can happen. This can also happen if local spfile or pfile are in use and they are not same across cluster.
action: Ensure that all nodes in the cluster have the same set of Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates. Run the 'ORACLE_HOME/bin/rrputil -l' command on all nodes and confirm that all nodes have the same set of Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates. Optionally, query V$RAC_TWO_STAGE_ROLLING_UPDATES to see what updates are enabled on a node and what updates could be enabled. Updates with ENABLED='Y' are enabled and updates with ENABLED='N' could be enabled in the Oracle binary. All nodes in the cluster should have the same set of rows with the same value for the BUG_NUMBER and the ENABLED column in V$RAC_TWO_STAGE_ROLLING_UPDATES. If error was due to local spfile or pfile usage, make sure they have same content across cluster.

description: operation requires server parameter file (SPFILE) to be in use
cause: The server parameter file (SPFILE) was not in use. ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES ALL requires an SPFILE.
action: Create a server parameter file for the database, restart all instances of the database to use the server parameter file, and then retry the command.

description: Either %s Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates are enabled but not present in Oracle binary, or %s Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates are present in Oracle binary but not enabled.
cause: This error could occur if a Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update was being rolled back while another Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update was being applied in the same session without restarting the cluster. Another reason for this error was that a completely unrelated node was trying to join the cluster but was incompatible with the enabled Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates in this cluster.
action: Check if there are Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates that are enabled and present in the Oracle binary and are being rolled back and if there are Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates present in the Oracle binary but are not enabled. If yes, rollback the Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates that are present in the Oracle binary but not enabled and restart the cluster. Once the rollback completes after restarting the cluster, the new Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates can be applied. If a completely unrelated node is trying to join the cluster, find out why that node was started in this cluster.

description: Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates in inconsistent state
cause: The Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates are not in a consistent state. This can happen if the ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES statement failed and that failure is not addressed.
action: Mount the database in exclusive mode and start the instance. After starting the instance, run ALTER SYSTEM ENABLE RAC TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES and ensure that it is processed successfully.

description: expecting keyword ABORT
cause: After running the ALTER SYSTEM ROLLBACK TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES statement, the only keyword allowed is ABORT.
action: If you did not intend to rollback the Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update and if you have already processed the ALTER SYSTEM ROLLBACK TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES statement, then process the ALTER SYSTEM ROLLBACK TWO_STAGE ROLLING UPDATES ABORT statement to stop the rollback."

description: Preparation of Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Update failed
cause: This internal error occurs while preparing Oracle RAC Two-Stage Rolling Updates for enable.
