action: Specify a valid common user or role name consisting of only ASCII characters.

description: Application common user or role name must not start with prefix %s.
cause: An attempt is being made to create an application common user or role with a prefix as specified in the COMMON_USER_PREFIX parameter set in CDB$ROOT or with a prefix that is reserved for multitenant container database (CDB) common users ({cC}##).
action: Specify a valid application common user or role name with a prefix as specified in the COMMON_USER_PREFIX parameter set in application root. If COMMON_USER_PREFIX is not set in application root, do not specify a prefix that matches with COMMON_USER_PREFIX parameter set in CDB$ROOT or that matches with the prefix reserved for CDB common users ({cC}##).
params: 1) common_user_prefix: The value of COMMON_USER_PREFIX parameter set in CDB$ROOT or prefix reserved for CDB common users ({cC}##).

description: invalid identifier
cause: The identifier or column name entered was invalid.
action: Ensure the following: - Enter a valid identifier or column name and verify that there are no typos in the identifier or column name. A valid identifier must begin with a letter, be less than or equal to 128 characters, and consist of only alphanumeric characters and the special characters $, _, and #. If it contains other characters, then it must be enclosed in double quotation marks. - It must not be a reserved word unless it is enclosed in double quotation marks. - If double quotation marks and mixed case were used for a column name when creating the table, then references to that column must use matching case and quotation marks.

description: invalid program
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile without specifying a valid program name.
action: Specify a valid program name while altering the lockdown profile.

description: invalid subprogram: %s
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile with an invalid subprogram name.
action: Specify a valid subprogram name while altering the lockdown profile

description: invalid schema: %s
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile with an invalid schema name.
action: Specify a valid schema name while altering the lockdown profile.

description: invalid type: %s
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile with an invalid type.
action: Specify a valid type name (for example package, function or procedure) while altering the lockdown profile.

description: invalid program: %s
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile with an invalid program name which does not exist in schema.
action: Specify a valid program name while altering the lockdown profile.

description: execution of %s disabled via lockdown profile
cause: An attempt was made to execute/recreate program (for example package, function or procedure) which is part of lockdown profile applied on Pdb.
action: Enable program by altering the lockdown profile then retry operation.

description: program: %s is not a oracle supplied CDB common object
cause: An attempt was made to alter a lockdown profile with a container database (CDB) local object.
action: Lockdown profile is only applicable with oracle supplied CDB common object. Specify a oracle supplied CDB common object

description: PDB %s(%s) is not consistent; either flashback the CDB to any SCN or recover the CDB to at least SCN %s.
cause: The pluggable database (PDB) metadata in the control file is not consistent for open resetlogs.
action: Either recover the container database (CDB) further until the control file is consistent or flashback the container database (CDB) to a past point-in-time. If flashback is not enabled, you can also restore the control file from an older backup and repeat recovery.

description: unable to set ROUTE_OUTBOUND_CONNECTIONS property
cause: An attempt was made to set the ROUTE_OUTBOUND_CONNECTIONS property from within a pluggable database (PDB) that was not created as a private endpoint (PE) enabled database.
action: If you are attempting to set the ROUTE_OUTBOUND_CONNECTIONS property, ensure that the PDB is private endpoint (PE) enabled and retry the operation.

description: Cannot unplug pluggable database %s
cause: An attempt is being made to unplug a pluggable database (PDB) that was created as a snapshot clone.
action: Materialize the snapshot PDB if it needs to be unplugged.

description: Source PDB of snapshot copy clones cannot be dropped
cause: An attempt was made to drop the Source PDB of snapshot copy clones while its snapshot copy clones exists.
action: Drop all the snapshot copy clones of Source PDB before dropping the Source PDB.

description: incompatible SBT library version used for proxy backup
cause: An attempt is being made to use an incompatible System Backup Tape (SBT) library to do a proxy backup.
action: Either upgrade the Oracle database or use a compatible version of the SBT library that supports proxy backup.

description: Value of MAX_SHARED_TEMP_SIZE property for the pluggable database is too low.
cause: The value of MAX_SHARED_TEMP_SIZE specified in the ALTER or CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE statement is less than the current space usage of data files and temporary files of the container.
action: Specify a higher value for MAX_SHARED_TEMP_SIZE.

description: Value of MAX_DIAG_SIZE property for the pluggable database is too low.
cause: The value of MAX_DIAG_SIZE specified in the ALTER or CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE statement is less than the current space usage of data files and temporary files of the container.
action: Specify a higher value for MAX_DIAG_SIZE.

description: Value of MAX_AUDIT_SIZE property for the pluggable database is too low.
cause: The value of MAX_AUDIT_SIZE specified in the ALTER or CREATE PLUGGABLE DATABASE statement is less than the current space usage of data files and temporary files of the container.
action: Specify a higher value for MAX_AUDIT_SIZE.

description: Invalid value for DIRECTORY_PREFIXES_ALLOWED system parameter
cause: An invalid value is specified for the DIRECTORY_PREFIXES_ALLOWED system parameter. The value is expected to be a comma separated list of one or more directory paths accessible to the pluggable databases (PDBs) in a multitenant container database (CDB). Every parameter value specified in the list of directory paths must satisfy the following criteria: - The path cannot contain the string '..'. - The path cannot be underneath the directory path pointed to by the ORACLE_BASE environment variable. - The length of the path cannot exceed 255 characters. - The path cannot exist as a symbolic or a hard link to another file or directory path. - The path cannot exist as an operating system file.
action: Specify a valid value for the DIRECTORY_PREFIXES_ALLOWED system parameter and retry the operation.

description: %0!s %1!s cannot be set when %2!s %3!s is already set.
cause: An attempt is being made to set the PATH_PREFIX database property in the CDB$ROOT container of a multitenant container database (CDB) even though the DIRECTORY_PREFIXES_ALLOWED system parameter is already set or vice versa.
action: Either the PATH_PREFIX property or the DIRECTORY_PREFIXES_ALLOWED system parameter is allowed to be set in the CDB$ROOT container but not both. Set the other conflicting attribute for the CDB to NULL using either "ALTER DATABASE SET PATH_PREFIX" or "ALTER SYSTEM" DDL and then reissue the command.

description: maximum number of columns in a table or view is 1000
cause: An attempt was made to create a table or view with more than 1000 columns, or to add more columns to a table or view which pushes it over the maximum allowable limit of 1000. Note that unused columns in the table are counted toward the 1000 column limit.
action: If the error is a result of a CREATE command, then reduce the number of columns in the command and resubmit. If the error is a result of an ALTER TABLE command, then there are three options: 1) If the table contained unused columns, remove them by executing ALTER TABLE DROP UNUSED COLUMNS before adding new columns; 2) Reduce the number of columns in the command and resubmit. 3) Increase compatability to 23.1

description: parameter '%s' is not user modifiable
cause: An attempt was made to set a parameter that should not be modified (via ALTER statement) or set (in parameter file) directly by the administrator. The parameter will be managed internally by Oracle.
action: Do not attempt to set this parameter directly. If the parameter is set inside the text parameter file (PFILE), remove the entry. If the parameter was set inside the SPFILE, create a pfile, remove the parameter entry and recreate a new SPFILE using the edited pfile.
params: 1) parameter_name: The name of the parameter which cannot be set directly by the administrator. //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: JSON Duality View collection "%s" metadata component value must be "%s"
cause: Invalid JSON Duality View collection metadata component value was specified.
action: Specify a valid JSON Duality View collection metadata component value.

description: Metadata component "%s" is not supported for a JSON Duality View collection
cause: An unsupported metadata component was specified for a JSON Duality View collection.
action: Ensure only supported metadata components are specified for a JSON Duality View collection.

description: The column of the table or view underlying the collection cannot be renamed.
cause: The table or view could not be altered. There could be uncommitted writes to the collection.
action: Ensure that all writes to the collection are committed.

description: invalid column name prefix
cause: The specified column name prefix was invalid.
action: Ensure that the column name prefix is specified correctly. It can not exceed 128 characters nor contain double quotation marks.

description: TTL value in index specification must be greater than or equal to 0.
cause: An invalid Time-To-Live (TTL) value was specified in the index specification.
action: Specify an integer greater than 0 for the TTL value.

description: Only TIMESTAMP data type is supported for TTL indexes.
cause: The data type of the column was not supported by Time-To-Live (TTL) indexes.
action: Choose a column of TIMESTAMP data type when creating TTL indexes.

description: FOR UPDATE on JSON-Relational Duality View does not support %s clause
cause: A "select ... for update" query on a JSON-Relational Duality View contained unsupported clause for "for update".
action: Only WAIT or NOWAIT clauses are supported on JSON-Relational Duality View. Remove the above clause and rerun the query.

description: Cannot set %s attribute on the document if %s attribute is set.
cause: An invalid combination of document attributes was specified.
action: Specify a valid combination of document attributes.
params: 1) attribute_1: The name of the document handle attribute being set. 2) attribute_2: The name of the document handle attribute already set.

description: Object %s cannot be described as a JSON schema.
cause: An attempt was made to describe an unsupported object type as a JSON schema.
action: Ensure that a valid type is described as a JSON schema.

description: Feature (%s) cannot be described as a JSON schema.
cause: An attempt was made to describe an unsupported feature as a JSON schema.
action: Ensure that a valid type is described as a JSON schema.

description: Invalid JSON type column for clustered table: %s.
cause: Column type can not be used.
action: Change column type.

description: Predicates are not allowed in multivalue index (%s) creation.
cause: There was some predicate specified in multivalue index creation.
action: Don't use predicates in multivalue index creation.

description: Can't use json_table syntax to create non-MVI(MultiValue Index): %s.
cause: An attempted was made to create a non-MVI with json_table syntax.
action: Don't use json_table syntax to create non-MVI.

description: Table Value Constructor unsupported for JSON operator.
cause: Table Value Constructor used with JSON operator.
action: Don't use Table Value Constructor with JSON operator.

description: Multivalue index is not allowed on an IOT table.
cause: An attempt was made to create multivalue index on an IOT table.
action: Do not create multivalue index on an IOT table.

description: ETAG mismatch
cause: The ETAG values provided to the ETAG_MATCHES function did not match.
action: none.

description: EMBEDDED_OID key assignment method requires collection content column to be of type JSON. BLOB with OSON (only supported on Autonomous 19c) is also a valid content column type for EMBEDDED_OID.
cause: EMBEDDED_OID key assignment method was specified with an incompatible content column type.
action: Ensure that the content column type is JSON, or BLOB (but only on Autonomous 19c database).

description: EMBEDDED_OID key assignment method with RAW key column type requires collection content column to be of type JSON.
cause: EMBEDDED_OID key assignment method with RAW key column type was specified with an incompatible content column type.
action: Ensure that the content column type is JSON when using EMBEDDED_OID key assignment method with RAW key column type.

description: Error ocurred in the execution of data guide procedure %s.
cause: An internal error occurs when executing a data guide procedure.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) procedure_name: The data guide procedure name.

description: invalid input for JSON_SCALAR conversion as %s
cause: An attempt was made to cast an input value to produce a JSON scalar value of incompatible data type.
action: Use an input value that is compatible with output JSON scalar type.

description: invalid row path (%s) specified in the JSON_TABLE function of a CREATE INDEX statement
cause: Multivalue index is created on a view generated using the JSON_TABLE function and one of the following occurred: 1. An invalid row path is used in the JSON_TABLE function. 2. An invalid JSON_TABLE syntax is used.
action: Do one of the following: 1. Specify a valid row path to the JSON_TABLE function. 2. Correct the invalid syntax in the JSON_TABLE function.

description: index maintenance failed because JSON query raised error
cause: A JSON query invoked by index maintenance raised an error. Possible causes were that the JSON path expression selected either no value, multiple values, or a value of the wrong data type.
action: Ensure that the indexed value in the JSON data matches the data type expected by the JSON path expression in that index definition.

description: output value too large (actual: %s, maximum: %s, path:'%s')
cause: The provided JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) operator is generating a result that exceeds the maximum length specified in the RETURNING clause.
action: Increase the maximum size of the data type in the RETURNING clause or use a CLOB or BLOB in the RETURNING clause.

description: Value selected by JSON path '%s' exceeds maximum (%s).
cause: The JSON path expression selected a value that exceeded the maximum length specified in the RETURNING clause.
action: Increase the maximum size of the data type in the RETURNING clause or use a CLOB or BLOB in the RETURNING clause.

description: unable to convert value selected by JSON path '%s'
cause: An attempt failed to convert a value selected by a JSON path expression to a SQL scalar type value.
action: Ensure that the selected value is convertable to the specified data type. Inspect the stacked error for more information.

description: Path '%s' refers to a non-scalar type.
cause: The provided JSON path expression in the JSON_TABLE column pattern refers to a non-scalar type while the type of the JSON_TABLE column is scalar.
action: Correct the JSON path expression in the JSON_TABLE column pattern.

description: When "ttl" is specified, "fields" must only include a single "path".
cause: "ttl" was specified, but "fields" included more than one "path".
action: Ensure "fields" includes a single path.

description: EMBEDDED_OID key assignment cannot be used with VARCHAR2 key column for collections with content column of type JSON.
cause: Collection metadata specified EMBEDDED_OID key assignment with VARCHAR2 key column for a collection with content column of type JSON.
action: For collections with content column of type JSON and EMBEDDED_OID key assignment, specify RAW as key column type. VARCHAR2 key column type is allowed for collections with content column of type BLOB storing OSON.

description: Using JSON type collections on Oracle Database release 23c or later requires a SODA driver for Oracle Database release 23c or later.
cause: A SODA driver for Oracle Database earlier than release 23c is being used to access a JSON type collection on Oracle Database release 23c or later.
action: Use a SODA driver for Oracle Database release 23c or later to access JSON type collections on Oracle Database release 23c or later.

description: unable to upgrade collection type to JSON since current type is not BLOB/OSON
cause: An attempt failed to convert collection type to JSON because current type is BLOB/OSON.
action: Ensure that the collection that is going to be updated is BLOB/OSON type.

description: More than %s paths are specified for JSON_TABLE.
cause: The number of paths specified for JSON_TABLE exceeds the maximum number of paths permitted.
action: Reduce the number of paths specified.
params: 1) max_paths: The maximum number of paths permitted for JSON_TABLE.

description: unable to fully optimize query: %s %s
cause: The given query cannot be fully optimized to query the underlying relationl tables. The reason is attached.
action: Fix the query according to the attached reason.
params: 1) reason: The reason why the given query cannot be fully optimized.

description: Path step%s does not match the input JSON documents.
cause: The given path expression step cannot be found in the input JSON documents. Therefore it may return NULL for queries with 'null on error null on empty'.
action: Fix the query path step if there is a typo.

description: JSON schema does not exist on specified collection
cause: The specified collection does not have a JSON schema defined on it.
action: Ensure that the collection has a JSON schema defined.

description: Cannot use hidden or computed column as key or part of ETAG
cause: A hidden or computed column is being used in a key or entity tag (ETAG).
action: Ensure that key and ETAG columns are not marked hidden and do not use computed columns in keys and ETAGs.

description: Cannot hide entire sub-object in JSON duality view
cause: An attempt is being made to hide an entire JSON sub-object using the HIDDEN annotation. Only individual columns can be hidden.
action: Remove the HIDDEN annotation that follows the object constructor.

description: Cannot alter JSON modifier because it conflicts with existing data.
cause: An attempt is being made to specify an alter table to change a JSON type column modifier which conflicts with data stored in the column.
action: Choose a different JSON type column modifier or drop the conflicting data.

description: JSON modifier check on IS JSON is only supported on JSON type.
cause: An attempt is being made to issue an IS JSON operation with JSON modifier on a column of data type different than JSON.
action: Remove JSON modifier option from IS JSON operation.

description: Invalid value for field 'native' in collection metadata.
cause: A value other than true or false is specified.
action: Ensure that the value is either true or false.

description: Native collection creation requires compatible parameter to be set to 23 or higher.
cause: Field 'native' is set to true in the metadata, but the compatible parameter is below 23.
action: Ensure that compatible parameter is 23 or higher, or do not specify 'native' with value true in the metadata.

description: Native collection creation with map mode is not supported.
cause: Map mode specified during native collection creation.
action: Do not specify map mode when creating a native collection.

description: When 'native' is true, '%s' should not be specified in the metadata.
cause: An attribute incompatible with native collection is specified in the metadata.
action: When 'native' is true, omit all other metadata fields.

description: For native collection, 'schemaName' specified in the metadata must match current user.
cause: 'native' is set to true in the metadata, but 'schemaName' does not match current user.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. "schemaName" will be defaulted to current user. If 'schemaName' needs to be set to a schema other than the current user, ensure that 'native' is not set to true.

description: 'keyColumn' values specified in the metadata are not valid for native collection.
cause: Values set under 'keyColumn' are incompatible with native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. If you specifiy 'keyColumn' value explicitly, they must be the following: 'keyColumn.name' is OBJECT_RESID, keyColumn.type is RAW, 'keyColumn.assignmentMethod' is EMBEDDED_OID, and 'keyColumn.path' is _id. If omitted, they will be defaulted to these values.

description: 'contentColumn' values are not valid for native collection.
cause: Values set under 'contentColumn' field are incompatible with native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. If you specify 'contentColumn' values explicitly, they must be the following: 'contentColumn.name' is DATA and 'contentColumn.type' is JSON. If omitted, they will be defaulted to these values.

description: Specified 'versionColumn' values are not valid for native collection.
cause: Values set under 'versionColumn' field are incompatible with native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. If you specify 'versionColumn' values are set explicitly, they must be the following: 'versionColumn.name' is OBJECT_ETAG and 'versionColumn.method' is 'NONE'. If omitted, they will be defaulted to these values.

description: Specified 'readOnly' value is not valid for native collection.
cause: Values set under 'readOnly' field are incompatible with native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. If you specify 'readOnly' explicitly, the value must be 'false'. If omitted, it will be defaulted to this value.

description: A native collection table cannot be mapped as a classic collection.
cause: Native collection table is attempted to be mapped as a classic collection.
action: When mapping a table as a classic collection, ensure that the table is not a native collection.

description: Last modified column settings cannot be specified for a native collection.
cause: Last modified column settings are specified for a native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. Do not specify last modified column settings as they are not supported for native collections.

description: Created on column settings cannot be specified for a native collection.
cause: Created on column settings are specified for a native collection.
action: When 'native' is set to true, omit all other metadata fields. Do not specify created on column settings as they are not supported for native collections.

description: Operation not supported for native collection.
cause: An operation unsupported for native collection is requested.
action: Do not use this operation with native collection.

description: Classic collection with the same name already exists.
cause: A classic collection with the same name already exists.
action: Use a different name or drop the classic collection using SODA (Simple Oracle Document Access).

description: Error occurred in the execution of multi-value index procedure %s.
cause: An internal error occurs when executing a multi-value index procedure.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.
params: 1) procedure_name: The multi-value index procedure name.

description: owner name or multi-value index name cannot be null
cause: The owner name or multi-value index name is null.
action: Pass in a valid owner name or multi-value index name to the function or procedure.

description: cannot find a multi-value index with given name "%s" and schema name "%s"
cause: A multi-value index with the given name and schema name is not found.
action: Ensure that the correct name and schema name are provided when invoking the procedure or function.
params: 1) index_name: The name of the multi-value index. 2) schema_name: The schema name of the multi-value index.

description: There is no multi-value index on table "%s" with schema name "%s".
cause: No multi-value index is found on the table with a given name and schema name.
action: Ensure that the correct table name and schema name are provided when invoking the procedure or function.
params: 1) table_name: The name of the table. 2) schema_name: The schema name of the table.

description: Wrong data type specified for 'empty on sql null' bind variable mode.
cause: An invalid data type is specified for 'empty on sql null' bind variable mode.
action: Use the VARCHAR, CLOB, RAW, BLOB data type for 'empty on sql null' bind variable mode.

description: Wrong data type specified for 'empty string on sql null' bind variable mode.
cause: An invalid data type is specified for 'empty string on sql null' bind variable mode.
action: Use the VARCHAR, CLOB data type for 'empty on sql null' bind variable mode.

description: Wrong data type (%s) specified in definition while reading (%s) data from cache.
cause: While reading JSON data type from cache, a different data type is specified in the definition during reexecute.
action: Use the same data type in the definition that is used during first execute.

description: Wrong usage of JSON_TABLE
cause: JSON_TABLE is either not used in the FROM clause or is not used to create a multivalue index.
action: Use JSON_TABLE in the FROM clause or when creating a multivalue index.

description: Error during data validation: Table '%s' specified in the '%s' hint type for path '%s' does not exist.
cause: The table specified for the hint does not exist.
action: Specify a valid table name for the hint.

description: Error during data validation: Multiple hints of type '%s' on the same path '%s'.
cause: Two or more hints of the same type are specified for the same path.
action: Use only one hint of a type for any path.

description: Error during data validation: Unsupported hint parameter '%s'.
cause: The hint parameter is not supported.
action: Use only valid hint parameters. Valid parameters include 'type', 'table', 'path', and 'value'.

description: Error during data validation: Unsupported or invalid value of hint parameter '%s' for hint type '%s'.
cause: The value of the parameter is not supported for the specified hint type.
action: Use a valid parameter value for the hint type.

description: Error during data validation: Unsupported or invalid value of hint parameter '%s'.
cause: Unsupported or invalid value specified for a hint parameter.
action: Use valid values for the hint parameter.

description: Error during data validation: Missing hint parameter '%s'.
cause: A hint parameter is missing in one of the hints.
action: Add the missing hint parameter.

description: Error during data validation: Primary key column limit exceeded by value specified for a key hint.
cause: More than 32 fields are specified for a key hint.
action: Specify a maximum of 32 fields for the key hints.

description: Error during data validation: Duplicate fields specified for a key hint value.
cause: A duplicate field is specified for a key hint value.
action: Remove the duplicates from the value.

description: Error during data validation: '%s' hint applied to a scalar field.
cause: The hint type cannot be applied on scalar fields.
action: Use hints with a compatible path.

description: Error during data validation: '%s' hint applied to a non-scalar field.
cause: The hint type can only be applied on scalar fields.
action: Use hints with a compatible path.

description: Error during data validation: Field '%s' specified in the key hint type for path '%s' does not exist.
cause: One of the fields specified in a key hint does not exist.
action: Provide valid fields.

description: JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product has no path expression.
cause: There is no path expression specified for JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product.
action: Ensure that there is some path expression specified.

description: JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product cannot have duplicate path expressions.
cause: Duplicate path expressions are encounted in JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product.
action: Ensure that there is no duplicate path expression.

description: Invalid path expressions in JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product
cause: Invalid path expressions are encounted in JSON_TABLE with minimal cross product, such as non-wildcard array step and predicates.
action: Ensure that valid path expressions are specified.

description: invalid boolean literal: %s
cause: The specified boolean literal was invalid.
action: Specify a valid boolean literal.

description: only boolean column or attribute can be used as a predicate
cause: The specified column or attribute was not of boolean data type and could not be used as a predicate.
action: Specify a valid boolean column or attribute as a predicate.

description: internal event for boolean support
cause: This is an internal event
action: NONE

description: argument of %s must be a column or an expression of boolean data type
cause: The specified argument of the IS [NOT] {TRUE|FALSE} clause was not a boolean column or a boolean expression.
action: Specify a boolean column or a boolean expression as an argument.

description: invalid boolean value: %s
cause: The specified boolean value was invalid.
action: Specify a valid boolean value

description: invalid boolean value.
cause: The specified boolean value was invalid.
action: Specify a valid boolean value

description: Invalid boolean size
cause: The specified size to retrieve a boolean value is invalid.
action: Specify a valid size for the boolean.

description: Oracle version mismatch between primary database and True Cache.
cause: Oracle primary database received an unsupported message format from True Cache, or vice versa.
action: Please check and ensure the binary version matches between primary database and True Cache instances.

description: True Cache instance does not allow %s operation.
cause: The specified operation was invalid on True Cache instance.
action: Do not attempt the specified operation on True Cache instance.

description: CREATE TRUE CACHE failed.
cause: An error occurred during the creation of the True Cache
action: See accompanying errors.

description: Cannot start True Cache.
cause: An error occurred during database open on True Cache
action: See accompanying errors.

description: Cannot start True Cache with non True Cache control file.
cause: There was an error when the database or control file was created or you are using the wrong control file
action: Check what error was signaled when the database was first created or when the control file was recreated. Take appropriate actions to recreate the True Cache.

description: Invalid TRUE_CACHE_CONFIG attribute.
cause: Invalid attributes were specified for the TRUE_CACHE_CONFIG parameter.
action: Check the documentation regarding the correct specification of the TRUE_CACHE_CONFIG parameter.

description: True Cache requires a valid parameter value for %s.
cause: True Cache requires a minimum set of parameters to be set or enabled.
action: Set or update parameter in the initialization file. Note that empty values can disable the parameter or that blank values can be invalid.

description: Communication with the primary database failed.
cause: True Cache processes lost connection with the primary database.
action: Check if the primary database is still alive. Check V$TRUE_CACHE, V$DATAGUARD_STATUS and the alert log for any errors or warnings regarding the disconnection. Restart True Cache if the error persists.

description: Unable to translate FAL_SERVER initialization parameter string.
cause: Invalid connect string specified in FAL_SERVER.
action: Check and correct the specification for FAL_SERVER parameter.

description: There was an error when executing a remote procedure call (op: %s-%s-%s) at primary server %s.
cause: The primary server got an error retrieving the data or metadata required by True Cache to boot.
action: Verify that the primary server is on the same version as the True Cache and that it is configured as a multitenant database with ARCHIVELOG database parameter enabled. If that is all correctly configured, check the alert log file of the primary server for more descriptive messages.

description: True Cache instance is being shutdown because it has been disconnected from the primary for too long.
cause: The primary server has not responded in a long time.
action: Check that the servers configured in the FAL_SERVER configuration parameter are up and the primary database is opened in read/write mode.

description: Unable to receive redo since standby redo log is not available.
cause: The remote file server (RFS) was unable to select a standby redo log file (SRL) to receive redo on a True Cache because SRLs were not available.
action: See the alert log and trace file for more details. No action is necessary. This is an informational message provided to record the event for diagnostic purposes.

description: %s is not configured as a multitenant database
cause: The system parameter ENABLE_PLUGGABLE_DATABASE was not enabled in either the primary or True Cache databases.
action: Set the system parameter ENABLE_PLUGGABLE_DATABASE to TRUE and restart the database for which the change was made.

description: True Cache could not be started because there was a configuration parameter mismatch with the primary. Restart the database.
cause: There was a system parameter in the PRIMARY database that was incompatible with the same parameter in True Cache.
action: The new parameter value has been automatically reconfigured on True Cache. Please restart True Cache instance. If the problem persists contact Oracle Support.

description: True Cache failed to read metadata from the primary.
cause: There was an error when trying to get the required data from the primary to open the True Cache database.
action: See the alert log to find additional information.

description: The TNS alias %s could not be translated.
cause: There was an error when converting the alias name provided into a valid connection string.
action: Check that all aliases set in the FAL_SERVER system configuration parameter in the True Cache are valid alias names in the file tnsnames.ora.

description: Some static parameters (%s) differed from the value in the primary database. These parameters have been fixed and the database will be shut down.
cause: Some static system parameters had a value that was inconsistent with the value at the primary database.
action: Restart Oracle True Cache using the most recent version of the server parameters file (SPFILE) that has been internally modified so that these inconsistent parameters match.

description: Oracle True Cache failed to restart. Shutting down.
cause: Oracle True Cache had to be restarted because the primary database restarted and it received an unexpected error.
action: Restart Oracle True Cache manually.

description: True Cache entry corresponding to the hash ID %s not found in a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter.
cause: A True Cache server tried to read some data block from a primary database but the primary server was not able to find a connection string to connect back to the True Cache.
action: Verify if the primary database has a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n parameter defined for the True Cache server. If not, restart the True Cache server.

description: Unable to connect to True Cache.
cause: The primary server was unable to establish a connection with True Cache or the communication with True Cache failed.
action: See the alert log to find additional information and restart True Cache server.

description: True Cache requires ARCHIVELOG mode to be enabled at the primary database.
cause: ARCHIVELOG mode was not enabled at the primary database or it did not have a valid destination for archive log files.
action: Set a valid LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n initialization parameter and execute ALTER DATABASE ARCHIVELOG at the primary database.

description: True Cache instance is being shut down.
cause: A normal shutdown was issued on a True Cache instance. Since media recovery is always active on a True Cache instance, an implicit shutdown abort will be performed.
action: No action needed.

description: The %s command in pluggable database %s failed because some process is keeping a lock on it for too long. True cache will be restarted.
cause: True Cache is trying to open, drop or rename a pluggable database but it is unable to get a lock in a reasonable time. This means that a previous redo marker to open, drop, close or rename the database did not finish in a reasonable time.
action: Check alert log for additional information. The True Cache instance should be automatically restarted. If it failed, the instance will have to be manually restarted.

description: True Cache could not be started because the system parameter '%s' is different in the PRIMARY database. Remove the parameter from the True Cache initialization file.
cause: There is a system parameter in the PRIMARY database that was incompatible with the same parameter in True Cache and this parameter cannot be different nor it can be internally changed.
action: Delete the parameter from the True Cache initialization file (SPFILE) or set the same value it has in the PRIMARY database.

description: cannot fetch data block from the primary database (file # %s, block # %s)
cause: There is an error while fetching data blocks from the primary database.
action: See accompanying errors.

description: There was a failure adding the system parameter LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n at the primary database. True Cache database cannot be opened without it.
cause: The request to create a LOG_ARCHIVE_DEST_n entry at the primary to set the True cache destination has failed. The reason can be that, either there are no free slots or there is a conflicting entry.
action: Check the primary database alert log for a detailed description of the failure and solve the problem. Either make room deleting unused entries or remove conflicting ones. Restart True Cache after that.

description: Failed to open True Cache because the primary database is configured for shared server.
cause: True Cache is trying to boot using a primary database configured for shared server and this is not supported.
action: Verify whether the connection string in listener.ora uses SERVER=SHARED or if sqlnet.ora contains USE_DEDICATED_SERVER=on. Set SERVER=DEDICATED in listener.ora connection string. You must disable the shared server configuration in the primary database to use True Cache.

description: True Cache recovery lags too far behind, exceeding %s seconds.
cause: A query cannot accept the most current data block because True Cache recovery lags too far behind, and must be aborted.
action: Check V$DATABASE on the True Cache instance to see if OPEN_MODE is "READ ONLY WITH APPLY" and if CURRENT_SCN is advancing. Also, check if any error is present in V$TRUE_CACHE and V$DATAGUARD_STATUS on both the primary and True Cache instance. Restart True Cache if the error persists.

description: PDB (con_id:%s) is not open on the primary database.
cause: A query on True Cache cannot fetch a block from the primary database because the container is not open on the primary database.
action: Check if the container is not open on the primary database and open it as necessary.

description: db_keep_cache_size is not configured on True Cache
cause: User attempted to set an object as a KEEP or UNKEEP object on True Cache, but db_keep_cache_size is not configured on True Cache.
action: Set db_keep_cache_size on True Cache to a desired non-zero value, and retry the operation.

description: This operation (%s) is only allowed on True Cache instance.
cause: The specified operation is only valid on True Cache instance.
action: Only attempt the specified operation on True Cache instance.

description: Failed to open True Cache because there has been an error reading metadata (%s) from the primary database %s.
cause: An error happened at the True Cache instance when it tried to read the metadata from the primary either because the primary is down, it has an incorrect version, some system parameter is incorrect or there has been a network error.
action: Verify that the FAL_SERVER system parameter contains a valid primary server service name and it is open in read-write mode. Verify that the FAL_CLIENT system parameter contains a True Cache service name. Verify that both the primary and the True Cache databases are a compatible version. If this is not the case, contact Oracle Support.

description: Cannot start Free Edition True Cache because the maximum number of configured Free Edition True Caches (%s) for the database has been reached already.
cause: There has been an attempt to start a Free Edition True Cache when the maximum allowed are already started.
action: Shut down any Free Edition True Cache that is already connected to the primary database and retry the operation.

description: The value %s for parameter %s is invalid. It must be between %s and %s.
cause: The value for this parameter is invalid.
action: Choose a value as indicated by the message.

description: Data not in True Cache
cause: User has configured _true_cache_error_on_cache_miss parameter to receive an error when requested data is not in True Cache.
action: Disable _true_cache_error_on_cache_miss and rerun query, or execute the query on a primary database.

description: True Cache data block fetch request failed, GUID=%s, TC_ID=%s
cause: Source is failing to fetch a block requested by True Cache.
action: Check alert.log of source for the preceding internal error that should provide more insights into cause of the block fetch error.

description: Source encountered an internal error while fetching a data block.
cause: Source is encountering an internal error while fetching a data block.
action: Check alert.log on True Cache for the request GUID and the source instance ID. Then look at the concerned source instance's alert.log and incident file for details of the error.

description: Test event for Cache Recovery Standby role transition (kcvs)
cause: NA
action: The lowest 8 bits are used to specify the # of CCID pairs in a CIC message

description: Trace system event for True Cache
cause: NA
action: It is used as a bitmap of 32 possible tracing values for True Cache modules.

description: not enough space for first flashback database log file
cause: An ALTER DATABASE FLASHBACK ON command failed because there was not enough space in the Flashback destination for the first flashback database log file.
action: Make more space in the Flashback destination. For example, this can be done by increasing the value of DB_FLASHBACK_LOG_DEST_SIZE

description: Test event to simulate RVWR hang
cause: NA
action: Test event to simulate RVWR hang in flashback misc

description: Invalid number of hours past retention target
cause: An invalid value is specified in the HOURS clause.
action: Specify a valid value.

description: failed to allocate %s bytes from shared pool for flashback generation buffer after %s tries
cause: An ALTER DATABASE FLASHBACK ON command is being issued while the database was open. The command failed because it could not get enough contiguous memory it needed.
action: Restart the instance in mount mode and retry the command. An ALTER DATABASE FLASHBACK ON command should always be able to get enough contiguous memory when the instance is in mount mode. ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: value for parameter cannot contain a comma
cause: Parameter value contained a comma.
action: Remove the comma from the parameter value.

description: circular dependency error while evaluating expression %(1)s for parameter %(2)s
cause: One or more of the parameters used in the expression value was dependent on the parameter being set.
action: Identify the parameter dependency or provide an absolute value for the parameter.

description: parameter set completed with errors in (%s) pluggable database(s)
cause: Parameter value was invalid or illegal for one or more pluggable databases.

description: internal event for XML and object replication
cause: None
action: None

description: encountered a value of unsupported type or size for XML nodes at path %s
cause: An XML operator, such as UPDATEXML, expected the value operands to be of type VARCHAR2 or XMLTYPE. Supplemental logging or replication is not supported for XML operators with operands of unsupported types or sizes too large.
action: Rewrite the UPDATE statement with the XMLQuery operator or set event 19027 at level 1 to dump the unexpected operands.
params: 1) xpath: The XPath to the outstanding node.

description: Cannot rewrite a newer version of XML redo diff (encountered: %s, supported: %s).
cause: An unsupported version of XML redo diff was encountered.
action: Upgrade to a newer version of the DB that supports the requested XML redo diff.
params: 1) given: The given version of the XML redo diff. 2) expected: The expected version of the XML redo diff.

description: cannot encode an invalid XML character 0x%s in a supplemental log
cause: An attribute was being populated or updated with characters that were not valid for XML and, therefore, could not be logged.
action: Store the desired value in a RAW or BLOB attribute.

description: invalid argument: %s
cause: The specified procedure argument was invalid, for example, NULL.
action: Correct the value.

description: no columns to process
cause: The specified table had no columns to scan or convert.
action: Do not call DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL for this table or verify that all affected columns are registered in DUMA Repository.

description: ROWID range is not supported for index-organized or external tables
cause: Specifying ROWID range was not supported. Index-organized and external tables must be processed in their entirety.
action: Specify NULL for START_ROWID and END_ROWID.

description: OCI error status %0!s, source line: %1!s
cause: Unexpected OCI error occurred.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

cause: Unexpected internal error occurred in DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: column "%s" has the national character set form
cause: The DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL.SCAN_TABLE procedure was called to scan a NVARCHAR2, NCHAR, or NCLOB column. This is not supported.
action: Remove the column from the table SYSTEM.DUM$COLUMNS or filter it out with help of the SCAN_ID parameter.

description: column "%0!s" has the unsupported data type %1!s
cause: The DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL.SCAN_TABLE procedure was called to scan a column of an unsupported data type. The internal ID of the data type is shown.
action: Remove the column from the table SYSTEM.DUM$COLUMNS or filter it out with help of the SCAN_ID parameter.

description: unable to allocate %0!s bytes of memory, argument: [%1!s]
cause: There was no session memory available to satisfy a memory allocation request.
action: Try with a lower value of BUFFER_SIZE parameter or free some system memory.

description: repository not installed
cause: Repository tables needed by the application were not installed in the SYSTEM schema or the current user did not have the INSERT privilege for the table SYSTEM.DUM$EXCEPTIONS.
action: Refer to documentation and install the required tables, or grant the required privilege.

description: DUMA_ROWID_MAP$ column is missing or is of wrong data type
cause: In copy mode, the target table did not have a column named DUMA_ROWID_MAP$ or the column was not of type ROWID.
action: Recreate the target table in the format required by CONVERT_LONG.

description: source row is missing
cause: In copy mode, the source table did not have a row with the ROWID stored in the column DUMA_ROWID_MAP$ in the target table.
action: Recreate the target table in the format required by CONVERT_LONG.

description: unrecognized type of the fetched attribute "%0!s"
cause: When scanning, an attribute value was encountered whose type was not among types collected during the preceding describe operation. This may mean that the type hierarchy was modified during the scan process.
action: Repeat the scan.

description: unrecognized character set %0!s for column "%1!s"
cause: The character set declared for the column was not recognized by the NLS library.
action: Specify another character set. Verify the NLS data files.

description: BLOB exceeds the size limit of LONG column
cause: The BLOB contained more data than the LONG column can hold when writing data from the BLOB into the LONG column.
action: Check the size of the BLOB and make sure it does not exceed the size limit of LONG data type.

description: invalid table ID
cause: The source table ID argument for the LONG RAW copy operation was either NULL or equal to the target table ID.
action: Correct the source table ID, the target table ID, or both.

description: column data types do not match
cause: The target table contained a LONG RAW column while the source table contained a LONG column or vice versa.
action: Make sure that source and target tables conform to requirements of CONVERT_LONG.

description: unrecognized delayed cleansing action
cause: The values in the scheduled cleansing action columns in DUMA Repository were incorrect.
action: Correct the values in the scheduled cleansing action columns.

description: exception logging not supported for external tables
cause: Exception logging was attempted for an external table.
action: Do not use 'V' or 'E' flag when calling SCAN_TABLE to scan an external table.

description: DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL tracing event
cause: Debugging event for DBMS_DUMA_INTERNAL callouts.
action: N/A

description: split brain event
cause: Debugging event that triggers a split brain after the first pass of instance or crash recovery by making the first pass of crash recovery generate redo at the nab
action: N/A

description: QESXL internal tracing event
cause: Debugging event for QE[RS]XL key vector
action: N/A

description: QESXL SO testing event
cause: Debugging event for testing key vector state object recovery
action: N/A

description: QESGV internal tracing event
cause: Debugging event for QE[RS]GV vector group-by
action: N/A

description: Invalid KEY VECTOR
cause: An internal function was called with invalid parameter.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: KEY VECTOR duplication failed
cause: Parallel query failed to duplicate KEY VECTOR across Oracle RAC instances.
action: Increase the size of the System Global Area (SGA) memory.

description: out of memory for KEY VECTOR
cause: A query undergoing vector transform ran out of memory in an unrecoverable way. This may indicate that poor statistics caused vector transform to be used for an unsuitable query.
action: Gather statistics for the pertinent tables. If the problem persists, vector transform can be disabled using hint or parameter.

description: KEY VECTOR with repeated values require join keys to match
cause: A KEY VECTOR with repeated join key values required the JOIN KEYS of SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD to match the JOIN KEYS of the related SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE.
action: Ensure that either the join key values of SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE are unique or the JOIN KEYS of SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD match the JOIN KEYS of SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE.

description: missing GROUP BY clause in statement containing KEY VECTOR function
cause: A statement containing a KEY VECTOR function did not have a GROUP BY clause.
action: Add a GROUP BY clause to the statement containing the KEY VECTOR function, or remove the KEY VECTOR function from the statement.

description: KEY VECTOR function not allowed in WHERE clause
cause: The WHERE clause contained one of the following KEY VECTOR functions, which are not allowed in the WHERE clause: SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE, SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE, SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_SUCCEEDED, SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD.
action: Remove the KEY VECTOR function from the WHERE clause.

description: KEY VECTOR ID %s is used in more than one SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE
cause: More than one SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE had the same ID.
action: Ensure each SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE ID is unique in a query.

description: SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE does not have a corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE
cause: A SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE function did not have a corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE.
action: Ensure for each SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE there is exactly one corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE.

description: The load key defined in SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE is missing a corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD function
cause: A load key defined in a SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE function had no corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD function.
action: Ensure each load key has at least one corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD function.

description: The SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR function is missing a corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE or SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE
cause: A SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD or SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_SUCCEEDED function had no corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE or SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE function.
action: Ensure each SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD and SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_SUCCEEDED has a corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE and SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_USE functions.

description: The SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD load key does not exist.
cause: The load index specified in a SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_PAYLOAD function did not exist.
action: Ensure the load key specified matches a load key defined in the corresponding SYS_OP_KEY_VECTOR_CREATE.

description: KEY VECTOR could not be loaded from disk
cause: The process ran out of memory (PGA) while loading a paged KEY VECTOR from disk.

description: duplicate or conflicting VECTOR ENCODE or NO VECTOR ENCODE specifications
cause: The specifications were either a duplicate of each other or were conflicting.
action: Remove the duplicate specification.

description: VECTOR ENCODE only valid for Oracle number column
cause: VECTOR ENCODE was specified on a column that is not an Oracle number.
action: Remove the VECTOR ENCODE clause.

description: operation not allowed for system hidden virtual column
cause: The system hidden virtual columns could not be dropped or modified directly.
action: Avoid dropping or modifying system hidden virtual columns.

description: invalid value while deserializing
cause: The value being deserialized was invalid.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on IOTs.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on index-organized tables (IOT).
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on TEMPORARY TABLE.
cause: An attempt was made to CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE with MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature is not supported on ADG.
cause: An attempt was made to populate data into hash index when in Active Data Guard mode.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be used on table with ROW MOVEMENT enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with row movement enabled.
action: None.

description: Specified schema name is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to use the DBMS_MEMOPTIMIZE.POPULATE procedure with an invalid schema name.
action: Use a valid schema name for the table.

description: Specified table name is invalid.
cause: An attempt was made to use the DBMS_MEMOPTIMIZE.POPULATE procedure with an invalid table name.
action: Use a valid table name.

description: Specified schema and table names are either non-existent or MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ is not enabled on the table.
cause: An attempt was made to use the DBMS_MEMOPTIMIZE.POPULATE procedure with invalid information. Either the specified schema and table names are non-existent or MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature is not enabled on the table.
action: Enable MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature on the table and invoke the procedure with correct schema and table names.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE memory area does not exist.
cause: An attempt was made to use the DBMS_MEMOPTIMIZE package without creating the MEMOPTIMIZE memory area.
action: Restart the instance with appropriate value for MEMOPTIMIZE memory area parameter.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE_WRITE hint disallowed for this operation
cause: MEMOPTIMIZE_WRITE hint was specified for the operation.
action: You cannot specify this hint for this operation. Remove the hint from the statement.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be used with COMPRESS option
cause: An attempt was made to use the COMPRESS option with MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature requires NOT DEFERRABLE PRIMARY KEY constraint on the table
cause: An attempt was made to use MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ on a table that did not have the PRIMARY KEY constraint or the PRIMARY KEY constraint is DEFERRABLE.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature not allowed on table with trigger.
cause: An attempt was made to set the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with trigger.
action: None

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature not allowed on table with foreign key constraint.
cause: An attempt was made to set the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with foreign key constraint.
action: None

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature not allowed on segment with deferred storage.
cause: An attempt was made to set the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with deferred storage.
action: None

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be used with COMPRESS option.
cause: An attempt was made to use the COMPRESS option with MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ operations are not allowed at PARTITION or SUBPARTITION levels.
cause: An attempt was made to use MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ option on a PARTITION table or SUBPARTITION table level.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be enabled on IOTs.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on index-organized tables (IOT).
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be enabled on table with VIRTUAL COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with VIRTUAL COLUMNS.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be enabled on table with INVISIBLE COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with INVISIBLE COLUMNS.
action: None.

description: The MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be enabled on a table with specified partitioning type.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with an unsupported partitioning type.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on table with LOBs.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with LOB columns.
action: None.

description: BLOCK SIZE is not equal to DB_BLOCK_SIZE setting.
cause: An attempt was made to use the DBMS_MEMOPTIMIZE.POPULATE procedure on a tablespace whose BLOCK SIZE was not equal to DB_BLOCK_SIZE.
action: Use a default BLOCK SIZE.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on table with VIRTUAL COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with VIRTUAL COLUMNS.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature cannot be enabled on table with LOBs.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with LOB columns.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature not allowed on segment with deferred storage
cause: An attempt was made to set the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with deferred storage.
action: None

cause: An attempt was made to use MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ clause more than once.
action: None.

cause: An attempt was made to use MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE clause more than once.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ cannot be enabled by CREATE PARTITIONED TABLE.
cause: An attempt was made to CREATE PARTITIONED table with MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ enabled.
action: Use ALTER TABLE to enable MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ for a partitioned table.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on table with INVISIBLE COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with INVISIBLE COLUMNS.
action: None.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with COLUMNS with default values.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE operations are not allowed at PARTITION or SUBPARTITION levels.
cause: An attempt was made to use MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE option on a PARTITION table or SUBPARTITION table level.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on table with IDENTITY COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with IDENTITY COLUMNS.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE feature cannot be enabled on table with ENCRYPTED COLUMNS.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with ENCRYPTED COLUMNS.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE cannot be enabled on table with specified partitioning type.
cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with an unsupported partitioning type.
action: None.

description: MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE cannot be enabled by CREATE PARTITIONED TABLE.
cause: An attempt was made to CREATE PARTITIONED table with MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE enabled.
action: Use ALTER TABLE to enable MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE for a partitioned table.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table with COLLATED COLUMNS.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a table in encrypted tablespace.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR WRITE attribute on a materialized view log.
action: None.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with encrypted columns.

cause: An attempt was made to use the MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ attribute on a table with COLLATED COLUMNS.

description: The MEMOPTIMIZE FOR READ feature is not supported on this table.
