cause: A problem occurred at the start of an XML index table function.
action: This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.

description: A problem occurred at the beginning of the XMLIndex Table function.
cause: A problem occurred at the beginning of an XMLIndex table function. This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error.
action: Check the second error message for more information and take the appropriate action.

description: A problem occurred during the evaluation of an XML index table function.
cause: A problem occurred when evaluating an XML Index Table function.
action: This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information. Contact Oracle Support Services if the error persists.

description: A problem occurred at the end of an XML index table function.
cause: A problem occurred at the end of an XML index table function.
action: This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.

description: XMLIndex: invalid namespace mapping "%s"
cause: Namespace mapping was invalid. The syntax is XMLNS="string".
action: Check the namespace string, correct the error and retry command.

description: A problem occurred when looking up the metadata of an XML index.
cause: A problem occurred when looking up of the metadata of an XML index.
action: This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.

description: A problem occurred updating the metadata of the XML Index.
cause: A problem occurred when updating the metadata of an XML Index.
action: Check the secondary error message for more details.

description: XMLIndex DML: failure of the internal "%s"
cause: See associated error message.
action: Correct the error and retry command.

description: XMLIndex DML: failure of the recursive "%s"
cause: See associated error message.
action: Correct the error and retry command.

description: A problem occurred while updating an XMLIndex.
cause: A problem occurred while updating an XMLIndex.
action: This message is followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.

description: A problem occurred when synchronizing an XML index.
cause: A problem occurred when you tried to synchronize an XML index.
action: This message will be followed by a second message giving more details about the error. Check the second error message for more information.

description: Cannot drop the XMLIndex as its internal table has been indexed using Oracle Text.
cause: An attempt was made to drop an XMLIndex whose internal table has been indexed using Oracle Text.
action: Drop the Oracle Text index on the XMLIndex internal table.

description: Cannot drop groups from an XMLIndex whose internal table has been indexed using Oracle Text.
cause: An attempt was made to drop groups from an XMLIndex whose internal table has been indexed using Oracle Text.
action: Drop the Oracle Text index on the XMLIndex internal table.

description: The type of the VIRTUAL column is not XMLTYPE.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML Index with a VIRTUAL column not of XMLTYPE.
action: Specify the type of the VIRTUAL column to be XMLTYPE.

description: missing chaining XMLTABLE for VIRTUAL column in the index
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML index with VIRTUAL column but without required chaining XMLTABLE.
action: Specify a chaining XMLTABLE after VIRTUAL column.

description: Shared table can only have a single XMLType column.
cause: Attempted to create a shared table with more than one XMLType column.
action: Specify a shared table definition with only one XMLType column.

description: Shared tables must have same semantics for truncation.
cause: An attempt was made to create shared tables with inconsistent semantics for truncation. Either all shared tables must have or must not have the TRUNCATE keyword.
action: Be consistent with the TRUNCATE keyword while defining shared tables.

description: Can only share an existing XML Index table with an XMLTYPE column.
cause: An attempt was made to share a table without an XMLTYPE column.
action: Drop the group containing the XML Index table without an XMLTYPE column and re-create the group with new definition.

description: Shared tables must have equivalent paths.
cause: An attempt was made to share a table with different paths.
action: Specify a correct shared table definition with appropriate paths.

description: XML Index rewrite failed.
cause: One of the rewrites being tried by XML Index engine failed.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support.

description: Nonblocking alter XMLIndex error
cause: Internal error.
action: NONE

description: invalid use of NONBLOCKING COMPLETE or ABORT
cause: An attempt was made to use NONBLOCKING COMPLETE or ABORT for an XML Index that is not being modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN.
action: NONBLOCKING COMPLETE or ABORT is only allowed for XML Index that is being modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN.

description: Cannot complete nonblocking alter index operation.
cause: NONBLOCKING COMPLETE is only allowed for XML Index that is being modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN and there are no pending rows left.
action: Call DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING to finish pending work.

description: invalid alter XML Index operation
cause: An attempt was made to alter an XML Index that was already being modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN, or alter an XML Index with rebuild option and NONBLOCKING operation.
action: Call DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING to finish pending work then run NONBLOCKING COMPLETE to finish existing NONBLOCKING operation, or run NONBLOCKING ABORT to cancel existing NONBLOCKING operation.

description: invalid use of DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING
cause: DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING was called on an index that was not modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN.
action: DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING can only be called on an index that is modified using NONBLOCKING ADD_GROUP or ADD_COLUMN.

description: There are no pending rows to process.
cause: DBMS_XMLINDEX.PROCESS_PENDING was called on an index that does not have any pending rows to process.
action: Execute NONBLOCKING COMPLETE operation to complete the nonblocking alter index.

description: Cannot create XML Index for data stored in a CLOB column with object relational storage model.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML Index on a CLOB column stored with object relational storage model.
action: Change the column storage to binary XML.

description: XML Index cannot be created on an automatic list partitioned table.
cause: An attempt was made to create an XML Index on a table that had an automatic list partition.
action: Do not create an XML Index on an automatic list partitioned table.

description: XML Index with unstructured component cannot be created on an interval partitioned table.
cause: There was an attempt to create an XML Index with unstructured component on a table with interval partitioning.
action: Create an XML Index with structured component on a table with interval partitioning.

description: Internal event to control collection storage during create table.
cause: This event is used to create XMLType collections as LOBs during table creation.
action: None.

description: unregistered LOB value encountered
cause: The LOB value associated with the input locator did not exist in client-side reference tables.
action: This is an internal error. Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: remote temporary or abstract LOB locator is encountered
cause: Local database encountered a temporary or abstract LOB created on a remote database. Remote access to temporary or abstract LOB is not supported.
action: Avoid remote queries that return a temporary or abstract LOB.

description: Destination buffer is too small to hold CLOB data after character set conversion.
cause: An attempt to convert CLOB data to CHAR failed because the large object (LOB) size was bigger than the buffer limit for CHAR types or the CHAR buffer was not big enough to hold all of the data after the character set conversion.
action: Reduce the LOB size returned before performing the conversion. For example, use SUBSTR on CLOB or use DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR to convert from CLOB data to CHAR data.

description: encountered partial multibyte character
cause: The requested operation could not complete because a partial multibyte character was found at the end of the input.
action: Ensure that the input buffer ends with a complete multibyte character and retry the operation.

description: Cannot use other triggering events along with LOGICAL LOB UPDATE event
cause: An attempt was made to use other triggering events (such as INSERT, DELETE and UPDATE) with the LOGICAL LOB UPDATE event.
action: Create multiple triggers instead of sharing a trigger for multiple events.

description: Cannot create INSTEAD OF LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger
cause: INSTEAD OF LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger was not allowed.
action: None

description: Invalid LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger definition
cause: The LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger could not be created on a non-LOB column of a table. The column name has to be specified while creating the trigger. Only one column name can be specified while creating the trigger.
action: Specify LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger with a valid definition.

description: FOR EACH ROW clause is required for before or after LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers
cause: An attempt was made to create a before or after LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger without a FOR EACH ROW clause.
action: Specify a FOR EACH ROW clause for a before/after LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger.

description: WHEN clause is not allowed for LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers
cause: WHEN clause was specified for a LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger.
action: Remove the WHEN clause when creating a LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger.

description: Cannot reference a trigger of a different type
cause: The LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger did not follow other LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers. Non-LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers cannot follow LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers.
action: None

description: cannot access other columns in a LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger body
cause: An attempt was made to access an invalid column. A LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger can only access the ROWID column and the column for which it was specified. Access to other columns is not allowed.
action: Remove references to other columns within a LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger body.

description: cannot create a LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger on a view
cause: A LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger could not be created on view.
action: Do not include the LOGICAL LOB in the UPDATE trigger.

description: Cannot create a compound LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger with statement level actions
cause: A compound LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger could not contain statement level actions.
action: Create the compound LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger without statement level actions.

description: Cannot create a crossedition LOGICAL LOB UPDATE trigger
cause: Crossedition LOGICAL LOB UPDATE triggers were not supported.
action: None

description: PL/SQL subprogram '%s' for internal use only
cause: An attempt was made to use a subprogram that is for internal Oracle development use only.
action: Do not use this unsupported subprogram. Refer to Oracle documentation for available subprograms.

description: Internal event
cause: NA
action: Contact Oracle Support Services

description: internal event for testing
cause: This is an internal debugging event, and must be enabled with the supervision of Oracle Support Services or Oracle Development.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Unable to dynamically allocate additional memory
cause: An error occurred during dynamic memory allocation of segmented arrays for abstract LOBs because the LOB size exceeded the maximum size supported by the Segmented Array API.
action: Limit the size of the LOB to the one supported by the Segmented Array API.

description: invalid LOB locator encountered
cause: The LOB locator sent from client to server was invalid.
action: Pass a valid LOB locator that was either returned by the database or initialized as an empty locator.

description: LOB signature is not supported for clients on Oracle Database Release 19c or earlier.
cause: The buffer size allocated for the locator at the client side was not big enough to hold the locator with a signature. Large Object (LOB) signature is not supported for clients earlier than Oracle Database Release 19c.
action: Upgrade the client version to Oracle Database Release 19c or later. For more information or other solutions, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: cannot use BFILE locators selected from remote tables or shards
cause: A remote BFILE column cannot be referenced.
action: Remove references to BFILE in remote tables or shards.

description: New segment name must differ from available segment names
cause: Input segment name was already used by other objects within schema.
action: Query dba_lobs,dba_lob_partitions to check already used segment names.

description: Invalid or missing segment name information.
cause: Segment name information is missing or invalid format of alter table statment.
action: Query dba_lobs,dba_lob_partitions to get segment name. Provide old and newsegment name in alter table query.

description: invalid value for _LOB_session_parameters
cause: An invalid value was specified for the _LOB_session_parameters. The value expected for _LOB_session_parameters is a string that follows the format of a list of pairs key:value separated by (,). Supported keys: PGA_SMART_LOBS_LIMIT. For the key PGA_SMART_LOBS_LIMIT the expected values are: 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100. They represent the percentage allowed to store temporary LOBs in the PGA. If the usage in the PGA has overgone that percentage, the temporary LOBs are spilled to disk.
action: Update the value for _LOB_session_parameters with the supported keys and values.

description: Specified segment name does not exist or invalid.
cause: Segment name information provided does not match any object.
action: Query dba_lobs,dba_lob_partitions to get segment name. Provide old and new segment name in alter table query.

description: Invalid compression level specified.
cause: The archive compression level must be LOW or HIGH.
action: Use a valid archive compression level and retry.

description: COMPRESS must be specified with HYBRID COLUMNAR organization
cause: COMPRESS was not specified with HYBRID COLUMNAR organization.
action: Specify the COMPRESS clause for HYBRID COLUMNAR organization.

description: Incorrect organization clause
cause: HYBRID was specified in organization clause without COLUMNAR.
action: Specify COLUMNAR after HYBRID in organization clause.

description: Incorrect organization clause
cause: COMPRESS was not specified with organization HYBRID COLUMNAR.
action: Specify COMPRESS clause when specifying organization HYBRID COLUMNAR.

description: LOB update operations are not supported on HYBRID COLUMNAR organization tables of this type
cause: A LOB update using DBMS_LOB or a related interface was attempted on a HYBRID COLUMNAR compressed table that does not support this type of operation.
action: Alter the table to disable HYBRID COLUMNAR compression or do not perform LOB updates on this table.

description: LOB update operations are not supported on HYBRID COLUMNAR compressed tables with certain index types
cause: A LOB update using DBMS_LOB or a related interface was attempted on a HYBRID COLUMNAR compressed table with an unsupported index type. Virtual, functional, domain, and join indexes do not support these operations.
action: Drop the index or do not perform LOB updates on this table.

description: Exadata Hybrid Columnar Compression is not supported for tablespaces on this storage type
cause: An attempt was made to use Exadata Hybrid Columnar Compression on unsupported storage.
action: Create this table in a tablespace residing on Oracle Exadata, Oracle's Sun ZFS or Pillar Axiom storage or use a different compression type.

description: hybrid columnar compressed table cannot have column with LONG data type
cause: One of the following was attempted: - Create a hybrid columnar compressed table with a LONG data type. - Alter an existing table with a LONG data type to be hybrid columnar compressed. - Add a LONG data type column to a hybrid columnar compressed table.
action: LONG data types are not supported with hybrid columnar compressed tables. Create table without LONG column or change table to not be hybrid columnar compressed. If adding a column, do not use LONG data type. If modifying attributes of a column to change data type to LONG, the table cannot be hybrid columnar compressed.

description: Hybrid Columnar Compression with row-level locking is not supported for tablespaces on this storage type.
cause: An attempt was made to use Hybrid Columnar Compression with row-level locking on an unsupported storage type.
action: Create this table in a tablespace residing on Oracle Exadata storage or use a different compression type.

description: Could not get the compression analysis lock.
cause: The operation could not obtain the compression analysis lock in a reasonable amount of time.
action: Retry the operation.

description: Memory Speed Columnar compression is not allowed.
cause: Minimum requirements are not met.
action: The minimum database compatibility is 23.9.0.0.0, the minimum database block size is 8KB, and the tablespace must be bigfile and autoallocate.

description: IM FastStart checkpoint failed.
cause: In-Memory FastStart (IM FastStart) checkpointing could not complete within a reasonable amount of time in some Oracle RAC instances.
action: Retry checkpointing after some time.

description: IM FastStart Oracle RAC coordinator timeout.
cause: In-Memory FastStart (IM FastStart) checkpointing could not complete as Oracle RAC coordinator timed out.
action: Retry checkpointing after some time.

description: only one INMEMORY clause may be specified
cause: INMEMORY was specified more than once.
action: Specify each desired INMEMORY clause option only once.

description: in-memory area already exists
cause: An attempt was made to create an in-memory area when one was already in existence.
action: None.

description: in-memory area does not exist
cause: An attempt was made to drop an in-memory area when none were in existence.
action: None.

description: in-memory area size cannot be less than 100MB
cause: An attempt was made to create an in-memory area with less than 100MB of space.
action: None.

description: in-memory area size cannot exceed max(sga target, shared pool size)
cause: An attempt was made to create an in-memory area exceeding the size of the memory target.
action: Decrease the size of the in-memory area.

description: in-memory Xmem area size cannot be less than 100 MB
cause: An attempt was made to create an in-memory Xmem area with less than 100 MB of space.
action: None.

description: The in-memory area is out of space.
cause: The in-memory area did not have any free space.
action: Add free space either by removing the in-memory attribute on tables, partitions or sub-partitions which do not require it, or by increasing the size of the in-memory area.

description: In-Memory area is out of space for the current container.
cause: There was no free space in the In-Memory area for the current container.
action: Disable In-Memory from existing objects in the current container to make space or increase the maximum size limit by changing the INMEMORY_SIZE initialization parameter.

description: in-memory column store feature not supported for IOTs
cause: An attempt was made to enable the in-memory column store feature for an index-organized table.
action: None.

description: INMEMORY clause cannot be specified for virtual columns with disabled INMEMORY_VIRTUAL_COLUMNS parameter.
cause: An attempt was made to enable the in-memory selective columns feature for a virtual column with disabled INMEMORY_VIRTUAL_COLUMNS parameter.
action: To selectively enable a virtual column for the IM column store, the value of INMEMORY_VIRTUAL_COLUMNS initialization parameter must be ENABLED or MANUAL, and the SQL expression for the virtual column must refer only to columns that are enabled for the IM column store.

description: only one INMEMORY clause may be specified for each column
cause: INMEMORY clause was specified more than once for a column.
action: Specify each desired INMEMORY clause option only once per column.

description: column INMEMORY clause may only be specified for an inmemory table
cause: A column INMEMORY clause was specified for a table that is not specified to be in memory.
action: None.

description: INMEMORY clause may not be specified for LONG columns
cause: An attempt was made to enable the in-memory selective columns feature for a LONG column.
action: None.

description: invalid value "%s" for parameter inmemory_clause_default
cause: The value for the initialization parameter 'inmemory_clause_default' was invalid.
action: Choose a value allowed by the parameter syntax.

description: In-memory column store on Oracle RAC is only supported on Oracle-engineered systems.
cause: An attempt was made to use the in-memory column store feature with Oracle RAC on an unsupported system.
action: Disable Oracle RAC before attempting to use the in-memory column store in this environment or use an Oracle-engineered system.

description: In-memory column store FastStart debug event.
cause: An internal error for debugging was raised.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: In-memory column store FastStart internal error.
cause: FastStart uses this error code for internal error handling purposes.
action: No action necessary. Handled internally.

description: In-memory column store FastStart tablespace is offline.
cause: The FastStart feature was enabled but its tablespace was offline.
action: Disable FastStart or bring the FastStart tablespace online.

description: In-memory FastStart is only supported on Oracle-engineered systems.
cause: An attempt was made to use the in-memory column store FastStart feature on an unsupported system.
action: Use FastStart on an Oracle-engineered system.

description: In-memory FastStart Oracle Call Interface (OCI) error %s
cause: An OCI error occurred when enabling or disabling FastStart.
action: Manually correct the problem.

description: INMEMORY clause with DISTRIBUTE BY PARTITION specified for a table that is not partitioned.
cause: DISTRIBUTE BY PARTITION was specified for a table that is not partitioned.
action: None.

description: INMEMORY clause with DISTRIBUTE BY SUBPARTITION specified for a table that is not composite.
cause: DISTRIBUTE BY SUBPARTITION was specified for a table that is not composite.
action: None.

description: INMEMORY clause with DISTRIBUTE BY SUBPARTITION specified for a table that is not partitioned.
cause: DISTRIBUTE BY SUBPARTITION was specified for a table that is not partitioned.
action: None.

description: The FastStart administrative operation ran into a timeout.
cause: Multiple conflicting FastStart administrative operations are in progress.
action: Retry the operation after the conflicting Faststart administrative operations are completed.

description: This action cannot be performed when FastStart is not enabled.
cause: An attempt was made to perform a FastStart-related action when FastStart was not enabled.
action: Enable FastStart and retry.

description: FastStart is already enabled.
cause: Attempting to enable FastStart when it was already enabled.
action: FastStart is already enabled, and thus, there is no need to enable it // again.

description: FastStart is already enabled on this tablespace.
cause: Either this tablespace was already assigned to FastStart or some FastStart internal objects already existed on this tablespace.
action: Run DBMS_INMEMORY.DISABLE_FASTSTART, and then rerun DBMS_INMEMORY.ENABLE_FASTSTART.

description: Action cannot be performed when the database is in read-only mode.
cause: Attempted changes to FastStart objects on a read-only database.
action: Mount the database in writable mode and retry.

description: Action cannot be performed on the tablespace assigned to FastStart while FastStart is enabled.
cause: Attempted to take the FastStart tablespace offline while the feature was enabled.
action: Disable FastStart and retry.

description: While the tablespace (%s) is assigned to a FastStart area that is enabled, it cannot be dropped.
cause: Attempted to drop the specified FastStart tablespace with the FastStart feature enabled.
action: Disable the FastStart feature and retry.

description: IM FastStart cannot be enabled or migrated to a non-automatic segment space management tablespace (%s).
cause: An attempt was made to enable or migrate In-Memory FastStart (IM FastStart) to a non-automatic segment space management tablespace.
action: Enable or migrate IM FastStart to an automatic segment space management tablespace.

description: Unable to acquire a lock on the tablespace for the given FastStart operation.
cause: The given tablespace was locked by another operation while trying to run the FastStart operation.
action: Retry the FastStart operation after the completion of the operation which had taken a lock on the tablespace.

description: FastStart checkpoint has already started.
cause: An attempt to initiate a checkpoint was made when one was already started.
action: Wait for the previous checkpoint to finish.

description: FastStart %s was incomplete.
cause: The previous FastStart administrative procedure was incomplete.
action: Run the procedure again or disable the feature.

description: Invalid FastStart catalog version (%s) detected.
cause: The version number of the FastStart catalog was invalid or too old.
action: Rebuild the FastStart catalog.

description: invalid value "%s" for parameter cellmemory_clause_default
cause: The value for the initialization parameter 'cellmemory_clause_default' was invalid.
action: Choose a value allowed by the parameter syntax.

description: %s not supported for proxy PDB
cause: An attempt was made to use FastStart in the case of a proxy pluggable database (PDB).
action: None.

description: inmemory_size cannot be modified
cause: An attempt was made to modify inmemory_size parameter when database was not opened, was read-only, or was being migrated.
action: Issue the command after opening the database in read/write mode.

description: inmemory_size specified is less than a minimum of (%s) bytes
cause: inmemory_size was less than the minimum expected by the system.
action: Issue the command after changing the value for the inmemory_size parameter.

description: The tablespace %s where FastStart is being migrated has insufficient space.
cause: An attempt was made to migrate FastStart to a tablespace having insufficient space.
action: Add space to the tablespace where FastStart is migrated to, and try again.

description: FastStart not supported for %s
cause: An attempt was made to use FastStart along with the feature that is not supported.
action: None.

description: Error, obsolete redo seen on IM-enabled ADG, stopping recovery
cause: Obsolete (12.2OPC) redo was seen on standby database or logwriter (LGWR) encountered an error.
action: Recovery stopped. Set inmemory_adg_enabled to FALSE and restart recovery.

description: Population process is being tested
cause: The event was set to test that populate action is triggered after the process died.
action: None

description: In-Memory Expressions capture window is already OPEN
cause: An attempt was made to open an In-Memory Expressions capture window with another capture window already in the OPEN state.
action: Close the In-Memory Expressions capture window that is currently in the OPEN state.

description: In-Memory Expressions capture window is not OPEN
cause: An attempt was made to CLOSE an In-Memory Expressions capture window before opening it first.
action: Open an In-Memory Expressions capture window before attempting a CLOSE operation.

description: error encountered while changing the state of In-Memory Expressions capture window
cause: An internal error was encountered in the In-Memory Expressions procedure.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Resize of In-Memory Xmem area is not supported.
cause: Resize of In-Memory Xmem area was not supported on non multitenant container database (CDB) and root pluggable database (PDB).
action: None.

description: The new Xmem area size %0!s M is larger than configured Xmem area size %1!s M.
cause: The specified In-Memory area size was larger than the configured In-Memory XMem area size.
action: Check the new Xmem area size and reissue the command.

description: invalid INMEMORY_SIZE value for cloud configuration, it must be zero
cause: A nonzero value was specified for the INMEMORY_SIZE initialization parameter for a non-Oracle cloud.
action: Remove the INMEMORY_SIZE initialization parameter or set the value to zero.

description: In-Memory population or repopulation cannot be run for this segment.
cause: Either the segment requested for In-Memory did not exist, or a population or repopulation task was already in progress for this segment, or this segment was not In-Memory enabled.
action: Ensure that the segment exists, and it is In-Memory enabled, and no population or repopulation tasks are active for the segment.

description: This manageability package is only supported on Oracle RDBMS versions 10.2, 11.1, and 11.2.
cause: Package installation invoked on database version that was not 10.2, 11.1 or 11.2..
action: Use Oracle databaseversion 10.2, 11.1, or 11.2.

description: Invalid input. XMLSchema is null.
cause: XMLSchema was not provided to the procedure or function call..
action: Provide an XMLSchema.

description: input cannot be NULL
cause: An input parameter was NULL.
action: Provide an input parameter that is not NULL.

description: Input string exceeds the maximum size
cause: An input string was provided whose length exceeded the maximum size allowed. This size is 30 bytes for clients prior to Oracle Database 12c Release 2 (12.2) and 128 bytes otherwise.
action: Provide a shorter input string.

description: No matching elements found. Zero annotations were applied.
cause: The parameters provided to annotate the XMLSchema did not match any entities in the XMLSchema.
action: Correct the parameters.

description: No matching elements found. Zero annotations were removed.
cause: The parameters provided to annotate the XMLSchema did not match any entities in the XMLSchema.
action: Correct the parameters.

description: Annotation maps to multiple elements.
cause: The parameters provided to annotate the XMLSchema matched to multiple entities in the XMLSchema.

description: Name for collection table too long.
cause: The name for the collection table exceeded 25 characters.
action: Reduce the length of the name of the collection table.

description: XPath could not be mapped to exactly one table.
cause: XPath could not be mapped to existing table.
action: Check input parameters.

description: invalid XPath
cause: The XPath string provided to the procedure was not valid.
action: Check the XPath string.

description: invalid collection table specified by the XPath string
cause: An invalid collection table was specified by the XPath string.
action: Check the XPath string.

description: The procedure is called on an XMLType table in the BINARY storage model.
cause: The procedure renameCollectionTable did not work on XMLType in the BINARY storage model.
action: Out-of-line collection tables are only meant for the Object-Relational storage model, and do not apply to the BINARY storage model. There is no need to call the procedure on XMLType in the BINARY storage model.

description: cannot disable constraints or indexes for a table or column not conforming to an accessible XML schema
cause: The user attempted to disable constraints or indexes for an XMLType table or column which conform to no XML schema or a local one not accessible to the user.
action: Ensure the XMLType table or column conforms to an accessible XML schema.

description: Cannot enable constraints or indexes for a table/column not conforming to an accessible XML schema.
cause: Attempted to enable constraints or indexes for an XMLType table/column which does not to an XML schema or conforms to a local schema not accessible to the user.
action: Ensure the XMLType table/column conforms to an accessible XML schema.

description: invalid namespace declaration
cause: The namespace declaration was invalid.
action: Correct the namespace declaration.

description: Table does not exist.
cause: The tab_name parameter provided the name of a table that did not exist.
action: Correct the tab_name parameter.

description: Column does not exist in table.
cause: The col_name parameter provided the name of a column that did not exist in the given table.
action: Correct the col_name parameter.

description: column not of XMLType
cause: The col_name parameter contained the name of a column that was not an XMLType column.
action: Correct the col_name parameter.

description: Name for collection table already exists.
cause: The name for the collection table could not be used because it already existed.
action: Use another name for the collection table.

description: Table not of XMLType.
cause: The table_name parameter provided the name of a table that was not an XMLType table.
action: Correct the table_name parameter or provide the name of an XMLType column in the table.

description: XSLT rewrite transformation to XQuery not successful.
cause: The XSLT was not suitable for XQuery transformation optimization.
action: Use proper XSLT construct to faciliate XQuery transformation optimization.

description: NoInlining for XSLT to XQuery translation event is set
cause: This is an internal debugging event (19120, 0x200000) only.

description: Deletion of global %s is not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) declaration: The XML schema declaration, such as attribute and element.

description: deletion of %s from a complex type is not permitted (complex type '%s')
cause: An attempt was made to make an XMLSchema change that was not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.

description: Addition of non-optional %s to the complex type '%s' is not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) declaration: The XML schema declaration, such as attributegroup. 2) type: The declared XML schema complex type.

description: Deletion from an enumeration list is not permitted for simple type '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) type: The name of the XSD simple type.

description: Insertion at the end of an enumeration list is not permitted for simple type '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to change an XML schema that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) type: The declared XSD simple type.

description: Cannot evolve element or attribute '%s' to '%s' which is not a superset of '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) name: The name of the declared element or attribute. 2) new_type: The target type for the evolving element or attribute. 3) old_type: The declared type of the evolving element or attribute.

description: Cannot evolve element or attribute '%s' from '%s' to '%s' in a non-binary XML schema.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) name: The name of the declared element or attribute. 2) old_type: The declared type of the evolving element or attribute. 3) new_type: The target type for the evolving element or attribute.

description: Changing to mixed in complex type '%s' is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt to make XML schema changes was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.
params: 1) type: The XML schema complex type.

description: Changing to mixed in local complex type is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt to make XML schema changes was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.

description: Changing to mixed in complex type '%s' of non-binary XML schema is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt to make XML schema changes was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.
params: 1) complex_type: The name of the XML schema complex type.

description: Changing to mixed in local complex type of non-binary XML schema is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make XML schema changes that were not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.

description: Cannot change element or attribute '%s' from '%s' to '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) name: The name of the element or attribute. 2) old_property: The old property for the element or attribute, such as old QName or "Optional" for an attribute. 3) new_property: The new property for the element or attribute, such as new QName or "Required" for an attribute.

description: Cannot evolve element or attribute '%s' from a local type to global type '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) name: The name for the declared element or attribute. 2) global: The global type that the element or attribute is evolving into.

description: Cannot evolve reference-based element or attribute '%s' into type '%s'.
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.
params: 1) name: The name of the declared element or attribute. 2) type: The name of the declared XSD type.

description: Change to complex type '%s' is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make XML schema changes that were not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE are permitted.
params: 1) complex_type_name: The name of the XML schema complex type.

description: Change to xsd:any property is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make XMLSchema changes that were not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted.

description: cannot evolve element '%s' of complex type into a simple type '%s'
cause: An attempt was made to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve are permitted. Refer to the Oracle Database documentation to find permitted operations.
params: 1) element: The name of the declared element. 2) type: The name of the declared simple type.

description: Cannot modify MAXOCCURS for element '%s' since the XMLSchema is not registered for binary XML.
cause: An attempt was made to make XMLSchema changes that were not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.

description: Deletion of elements, attributes, and so on is not supported since the XMLSchema is not registered for binary XML.
cause: An attempt was made to make XMLSchema changes that were not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to the DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE procedure are permitted.

description: Change to %s '%s' is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make XMLSchema changes that were not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE are permitted.
params: 1) declaration_type: The type of the XMLSchema declaration, such as group and element. 2) declaration_name: The name of the XMLSchema declaration.

description: Change within restriction of complex type '%s' is unsupported or not permitted.
cause: An attempt was made to make XMLSchema changes that were not permitted through in-place XMLSchema evolution.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.INPLACEEVOLVE are permitted.

description: In-place XML schema evolution operation is not permitted.
cause: Attempted to make an XML schema change that was not permitted through in-place XML schema evolution.
action: Use permitted XML schema changes specified in the XMLDiff argument to DBMS_XMLSCHEMA.inPlaceEvolve.

description: Operation %s returned error code %s.
cause: A non-RDBMS operation such as orastream, LPX, or XML/XSL processing returned the operation-specific error code.
action: Look up the error number in Oracle Database documentation and then follow the recommended corrective actions.
params: 1) operation_name: The operation name. 2) error_code: The error number.

description: Invalid localObject value
cause: An invalid value for the parameter localObject was provided.
action: Correct value for the parameter localObject.

description: Failed to create a new stylesheet during %s
cause: Error is returned when trying to compile a new stylesheet.
action: Check the stylesheet document.

description: Invalid input value specified
cause: invalid input argument specified
action: Pass a valid input value

description: Table or XMLType column does not exist, is not user-visible or not of OR-xmltype
cause: Error is returned when trying to enable/disable indexes/constraints.
action: Check the table/column name and make sure its a OR-based xmltype table/column.

description: failed to escape special character 0x%s
cause: An attempt to escape special characters failed.
action: Remove the special characters that cannot be escaped.

description: Bind value was NULL.
cause: An attempt was made to use a bind value that was NULL.
action: Provide a bind value that is not NULL.

description: Function 'XPath2TabColMapping' can only be invoked on table with object-relational (structured) storage mode.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'XPath2TabColMapping' on a table with a non-object-relational storage model.
action: N/A

description: Function 'XPath2TabColMapping' can only be invoked on column with object-relational (structured) storage mode.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'XPath2TabColMapping' on a column with a non-object-relational storage model.
action: N/A

description: Function 'XPath2TabColMapping' does not accept XPath with a parent axis.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'XPath2TabColMapping' with an XPath expression that contained a parent axis.
action: Remove parent axis.

description: Function 'RenameCollectionTable' was not able to map XPath to table.
cause: The given XPath could not be mapped to a table..
action: Verify the XPath expression or try the DOT notation in function 'RenameCollectionTable'.

description: No owner name provided in renameCollectionTable
cause: An attempt was made to call the procedure renameCollectionTable without an owner name.
action: Provide an owner name.

description: No name provided for collection table
cause: An attempt was made to call the procedure renameCollectionTable without a name for the collection table.
action: Provide a name for the collection table.

description: No owner name provided in xpath2TabColMapping
cause: An attempt was made to call the procedure xpath2TabColMapping without an owner name.
action: Provide an owner name.

description: Function IndexXMLReferences can only be invoked on table with object-relational (structured) storage mode.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'IndexXMLReferences' on a table with a non-object-relational storage model.
action: N/A

description: Function IndexXMLReferences can only be invoked on column with object-relational (structured) storage mode.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'IndexXMLReferences' on a column with a non-object-relational storage model.
action: N/A

description: XPath cannot have predicates.
cause: An attempt was made to invoke the function 'XPath2TabColMapping' with an XPath expression containing predicates.
action: Remove predicates from XPath.

description: Parent table column could not be found.
cause: The collection defined by the XPath expression could not be renamed because parent table column could not be found.
action: Check user name input parameter.

description: XML event error
cause: An XML event error occurred.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: zero length XML data
cause: The XML data had zero length.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support.

description: hexadecimal to raw string conversion failed
cause: The conversion from hexadecimal to raw string failed.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support.

description: XML diff failed
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: XML patch failed
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: invalid namespace encountered
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Cannot allocate a new VM. All VMs are in use.
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: XSLT compiler creation failed
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: XSL VM creation failed
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: copy to LOB buffer failed
cause: The specified error occurred in Oracle XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support.

description: cannot set VM parameter
cause: The specified error occurred in XDB.
action: Correct the error or contact Oracle Support Services.

description: NULL webservice query.
cause: An XDB webservice query yielded a NULL value.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: invalid bindXML value
cause: An Oracle XML database operation encountered an invalid bindXML value.
action: Correct the bindXML value.

description: Multiple token tables are not supported.
cause: An attempt was made to create a new token table. If encountered during an import, a critical patch was possibly missing on the export database.
action: Use the default token table. If encountered during an import, apply the appropriate patch on the export database and try the export and import again.

description: fix invalid XDB schema types
cause: Internally used to fix invalid XDB schema types in a pluggable database.
action: NA

description: Element '%s' is missing type name annotation for type '%s'.
cause: A common user tried to register an XMLSchema with missing type name annotations. All type names from the schema and its dependencies should be annotated.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema being registered and its dependencies have all the element type names annotated.

description: Element '%s' is missing default table name annotation.
cause: A common user tried to register an XMLSchema with missing default table name annotations. All table names from the XMLSchema and its dependencies should be annotated.
action: Ensure that the XMLSchema being registered and its dependencies have all the default table names annotated.

description: invalid tablespace name
cause: The tablespace name did not have a closing double quotation mark.
action: Ensure that the last character is also a double quotation mark.

description: Moving XDB to %s is not allowed.
cause: An attempt was made to move XDB to a system tablespace.
action: Ensure that the target tablespace is not a system tablespace.

description: New tablespace %s is smaller than the current tablespace %s.
cause: The new tablespace was smaller than the current tablespace.
action: Ensure that the new tablespace is larger than the current tablespsace.

description: New tablespace %s is not automatic segment space management.
cause: The new tablespace was not automatic segment space management.
action: Ensure that the new tablespace is automatic segment space management.

description: Invalid resource handle or path name passed.
cause: An invalid resource handle or path name was passed.
action: Correct the resource handle or path name and retry.

description: The internal table is empty.
cause: The internal input table containing the schemas was empty.
action: Insert schemas to be moved into the internal table and invoke procedure.

description: XML schema %s exists for user %s
cause: The XML schema existed for the user.
action: Ensure that the XML schema is a new one.

description: cannot migrate inherited type %s
cause: The inherited type could not be migrated.
action: Ensure that it is not inherited by any other type.

description: cannot migrate XML schema %s
cause: The XML schema could not be migrated.
action: Ensure that the XML schema can be migrated.

description: cannot migrate owner from %s to %s for XML schema %s
cause: The owner could not be migrated for the XML schema.
action: Ensure that the XML schema can be migrated.

description: cannot grant XML schemas to public
cause: The XML schema could not be granted to public.
action: Ensure that the XML schema can be granted to public.

description: The level up the hierarchy must be greater than 0.
cause: The level up the hierarchy was less than 1.
action: Ensure that the level up the hierarchy is greater than 0.

description: The resource type is unknown.
cause: The resource type was not recognized.
action: Ensure that the resource is valid.

description: Substitution group is not supported when maintainDOM is not set.
cause: Annotation attribute maintainDOM was not set to TRUE.
action: Ensure that the maintainDOM attribute is set to TRUE.

description: XQuery data model must be allowed.
cause: XQuery data model was not allowed.
action: Ensure that the XQuery data model is allowed.

description: Position predicate on out-of-line table is not supported when maintainDOM is set to FALSE.
cause: An attempt was made to use a position predicate on an out-of-line table when maintainDOM was set to FALSE.
action: Ensure that maintainDOM is set to TRUE when using position predicate on an out-of-line table.

description: File access not over XDB repository is not allowed on server side.
cause: For security reasons, ftp and http access over XDB repository is not allowed on server side.
action: Have file access over XDB repository only or do not specify file access.

description: FTP and HTTP access over XDB repository is not allowed on server side
cause: For security reasons, ftp and http access over XDB repository is not allowed on server side.
action: Do not specify FTP or HTTP access over XDB repository.

description: ORADB operations not allowed on client-side.
cause: ORADB client access was a security issue.

description: invalid PL/SQL XML parser handle
cause: The PL/SQL XML parser handle was invalid.
action: Ensure that the PL/SQL XML parser handle is valid.

description: invalid PL/SQL XSL processor handle
cause: The PL/SQL XSL processor handle was invalid.
action: Ensure that the PL/SQL XSL processor handle is valid.

description: invalid PL/SQL XSL stylesheet handle
cause: The PL/SQL XSL stylesheet handle was invalid.
action: Ensure that the PL/SQL XSL stylesheet handle is valid.

description: invalid PL/SQL DOM handle
cause: The PL/SQL DOM handle was invalid.
action: Ensure that the PL/SQL DOM handle is valid.

description: invalid PL/SQL DOM %s handle
cause: The named PL/SQL DOM handle was invalid.
action: Ensure that the named PL/SQL DOM handle is valid.

description: NULL or invalid %s argument specified
cause: The named argument was either invalid or was specified as a NULL.
action: Specify a non-null, valid argument.

description: procedure or function not supported
cause: The PL/SQL procedure or function was not supported.
action: Modify the code to avoid usage of the PL/SQL procedure or function.

description: ACL path is not valid.
cause: ACL path was not valid.
action: Ensure the ACL path is valid.

description: XSLT parameter is not valid.
cause: XSLT parameter was not valid.
action: Ensure the XSLT parameter is valid.

description: Mismatch between complexType and SQLType "%s".
cause: The attributes referenced in schema definition differ from the attributes referenced by SQLType.
action: Ensure that the SQLName annotation references all the existing attributes in SQLType.

description: Attribute "%s" from type "%s" is not referenced in schema definition.
cause: At least one attribute, from an existing type, was not referenced in the schema definition.
action: Ensure that all attributes are referenced in the schema definition.
params: 1) attr: The declared XML attribute. 2) type: The declared XSD type.

description: Type "%s" is not defined in schema namespace "%s".
cause: The specified type was not defined for the given schema component.
action: Specify a valid type name.
params: 1) type_name: The type name written in the query. 2) schema_name: The name of the defined schema.

description: Storage type "%s" in schema is not supported for the packed XML memory object.
cause: The storage type was not supported for the packed XML memory object. The expected type is either RAW or VARCHAR2.
action: None.

description: Invalid use of VIRTUAL COLUMNS clause of XMLType table.
cause: There was an invalid use of VIRTUAL COLUMNS. The VIRTUAL COLUMNS clause is only valid when creating XMLType tables.
action: Remove the VIRTUAL COLUMNS clause or change the table to be of XMLType. Refer to Oracle documentation for the syntax to define virtual columns on relational tables.

description: registration of port failed
cause: The registration of the port failed.

description: duplicate or conflicting SCALE or EXTEND specifications
cause: The specifications were either a duplicate of each other or were conflicting.
action: Remove the duplicate or conflicting specification.

description: duplicate RESTART specified
cause: The specified RESTART was a duplicate.
action: Remove the duplicate specification.

description: CREATE SEQUENCE cannot have a RESTART clause
cause: The RESTART clause was specified in the CREATE SEQUENCE statement.
action: Remove the RESTART clause.

description: NEXTVAL cannot be instantiated for %s. Widen the sequence by %s digits or alter sequence with SCALE EXTEND.
cause: The NOEXTEND constraint was specified for the scalable sequence and the generated value was wider than the sequence maximum value.
action: Widen the sequence maximum value or remove the NOEXTEND constraint.

description: One or more Sharded Sequence objects exist that cannot be downgraded.
cause: There were Sharded Sequence objects in the database that were created in a release later than the selected release for downgrade.
action: Prior to downgrade, drop the Sharded Sequence objects that cannot be downgraded to the selected release. ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: bad depth indicator
cause: There was no subprogram, error, or backtrace at the specified stack depth.
action: Specify a depth for which there is a subprogram, error, or backtrace. //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: duplicate user tablespace specification
cause: An attempt was made to create more than one user tablespace during database creation.
action: Modify the command to contain only one user tablespace.

description: SQL statement length (%s) exceeds maximum allowed length (%s)
cause: An attempt was made to issue a SQL statement that exceeded the maximum allowed length of a statement.
action: Modify the SQL statement or the views to which it refers to fit within the maximum length or split the SQL statement. ///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

description: bind variables not allowed in the string returned from SQL macro
cause: The string returned from SQL macro contained bind variables.
action: Modify the SQL macro definition, so that it does not return a string containing bind variables. Instead, use bind variables as parameters to SQL macro.

description: invalid SQL text returned from SQL macro: %s
cause: The string returned from the SQL macro was invalid.
action: Modify the SQL macro definition.

description: cycle detected in SQL macro expansion
cause: A SQL macro expansion had a reference to an earlier SQL macro.
action: Modify the SQL macro definition.

description: scalar SQL macro cannot appear in FROM clause of a SQL statement
cause: The scalar SQL macro was called in the FROM clause of a SQL query.
action: Use scalar SQL macro in places where scalar expressions can appear in a a SQL statement.

description: table SQL macro can only appear in FROM clause of a SQL statement
cause: The table SQL macro was called from outside of a FROM clause of a SQL query.
action: Use the table SQL macro only in the FROM clause of a SQL query.

description: unsupported use of SQL macro: %s
cause: NA
action: NA

description: SQL macro is not supported with %s
cause: The SQL macro was not supported with this feature.
action: Do not use SQL macro with this feature.

description: SQL macro %s cannot be used remotely.
cause: A SQL macro was referenced remotely (for example, through a database link).
action: Reference a SQL macro locally in the database in which it is defined.
params: 1) macro_name: The name of the SQL macro.

description: SQL macro length(%s) was too big
cause: SQL Macro created was too big for current memory configuration. Note: Length comprise of user returned string and internally generated SQL fragment.

description: database character set conversion finished with errors.
cause: Conversion of blockchain tables failed while converting the database to Unicode.
action: Address the blockchain table conversion errors, then execute the command again.

description: database not ready for conversion to Unicode
cause: The repository of Database Migration Assistant for Unicode (DMU) indicated that the database was not ready for conversion to Unicode. Or, the repository of DMU was not found in the database.
action: Address all of the possible migration issues reported by DMU.

description: operation not allowed while converting database character set
cause: The requested operation was not allowed while converting the database character set.
action: No action required.

description: Only SYSDBA users can connect during database character set conversion.
cause: A user without the SYSDBA administrative privilege tried to connect to the database during character set conversion. The database is available only to users with the SYSDBA administrative privilege during a conversion operation on the database character set.

description: Failed to create persistent memory region backup file.
cause: Attempt to create a persistent memory region backup file failed.
action: Check the errors in the incident file that describe the operating system error which prevented the file creation. If possible, fix the problem. If this persists, contact Oracle Support.

description: Failed to delete persistent memory region backup file.
cause: The operating system call to delete a persistent memory region backup file failed.
action: Check the secondary errors in the incident file that describe the operating system error which prevented the file deletion. Fix the problem. If it persists, contact Oracle Support.

description: failure to attach to a persistent memory region
cause: The operating system call to attach a persistent memory region to the backup file failed in an Oracle process.
action: Check the incident file for the accompanying error messages on the operating system error that caused this failure and try to fix the problem. If you need assistance, contact Oracle Support.

description: failure to detach from a persistent memory region
cause: The operating system call to unmap a persistent memory region failed in an Oracle process.
action: Check the subsequent errors in the incident file that describe the operating system error which prevented the detach. If possible, fix the problem. Otherwise, contact Oracle Support.

description: failure to allocate persistent memory region
cause: System did not have %llu bytes of available persistent memory.
action: Allocate the required amount of persistent memory on the system.

description: failure to open a persistent memory region backup file
cause: An attempt to open a persistent memory region backup file failed.
action: Check the subsequent errors in the incident file that describe the operating system error which prevented the file from opening. If possible, fix the problem. Otherwise, contact Oracle Support.

description: internal error occurred
cause: An internal error occurred during an operation on persistent memory.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.\n

description: failure to query system state
cause: An attempt to query the system state failed.
action: Check the subsequent errors in the incident file that describe the operating system error that caused the failure to query system state. If possible, fix the problem. Otherwise, contact Oracle Support.

description: enables XGA tracing
cause: Tracing was enabled while doing an operation on XGA memory.
action: Set this event only under the supervision of Oracle Support Services.

description: failure to read from the persistent memory region backup file
cause: An attempt to read from the persistent memory region backup file failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: failure to write to the persistent memory region backup file
cause: An attempt to write to the persistent memory region backup file failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support.

description: persistent memory region header is corrupt
cause: Attempt to attach a persistent memory region failed because the region's header was corrupt.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Failed to identify the root object of the persistent memory region.
cause: Attaching to a persistent memory region failed because the root object could not be identified.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: No persistent memory region descriptor slots were available.
cause: Assigning a region descriptor to a persistent memory region failed.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: persistent memory region not found
cause: An attempt to query region information failed because the the persistent memory region descriptor specified was invalid.
action: Retry the operation with a valid region descriptor.

description: The persistent memory region detach failed due to active persistent memory transactions.
cause: Detaching from a persistent memory region failed due to active persistent memory transactions.
action: Retry the operation after completion of all the transactions.

description: Detected a corruption in the persistent memory region.
cause: Corruption detected in the persistent memory region.
action: Contact Oracle Support Services.

description: Persistent heap is in use by another transaction.
cause: An operation was attempted on a heap or a heap extent being created or deleted by another transaction.
action: Retry the operation after the other transaction operating on the heap completes.

description: persistent heap extent not found
cause: The specified persistent heap extent was not found in the heap.
action: Retry the operation with a correct persistent heap extent.

description: cannot drop a primary persistent heap extent
cause: An attempt to drop a primary persistent heap extent failed.
action: Retry the operation after dropping secondary extents or delete the entire heap.

description: out of persistent memory
cause: Memory in a persistent heap was exhausted.
action: Increase the persistent heap size.

description: Persistent heap extent drop operation failed.
cause: Attempt to drop a persistent heap extent failed because the extent was not free.
action: Free the extent and retry.

description: The database instance attempted to open too many files.
cause: The operating system limit on the number of open files has been reached.
action: Increase the operating system open file descriptors limit.

description: invalid file system for persistent memory region backup file
cause: An attempt to create or open a persistent memory region failed because an invalid file system was specified for the persistent memory region backup file.
action: Specify a valid supported file system for the persistent memory region backup file according to Oracle Database documentation for your operating system.

description: Recovery Appliance is shutting down
cause: The Recovery Appliance was in the process of shutting down. This message is recorded in the incident log for the Recovery Appliance. When the shutdown completes, the incident is marked as FIXED.
action: Wait for the Recovery Appliance to complete its shutdown.

description: storage location %s can no longer honor its reservations.
cause: The specified storage location did not contain enough space to fulfill the reservations of all of the databases assigned to it. This error will be seen if a storage location lost part of its disk space and was in the process of being repaired.
action: Either shrink the reservations for the databases contained within the storage location or add additional disk space to the storage location.

description: error repairing container files for storage location %s: %s
cause: An error was returned while trying to rebuild or repair the container files used to store data from protected databases.
action: The subsequent error will identify the error that needs to be addressed before the Recovery Appliance can be repaired.

description: resource error detected
cause: A task needed to be interrupted because it detected a resource limitation such as insufficient temporary table space or a snapshot being too old. It will be retried once the contention for the resource decreases. The secondary messages will identify the resource that has been exhausted.
action: If this error occurs rarely, no user action is required. If the condition becomes persistent, the Recovery Appliance administrator should increase the resource that is exhausted.

description: unbalanced parenthesis in "%s" at column %s
cause: The list of storage destinations contained an entry with an unbalanced parenthesis or parentheses inverted. For example )(.
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: no destination in "%s" at column %s
cause: The storage destination contained a syntax error.
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: bad storage size in "%s" at column %s
cause: The list of storage destinations contained an entry that specified an invalid storage size. While a storage size specification is not required, if specified, it must be enclosed in balanced parentheses, begin with a string of numbers that evaluate to a size greater than zero and be optionally terminated by a single character specifying the units of the number string: K for kilobytes, M for megabytes, G for gigabytes, T for terabytes, P for petabytes, E for exabytes, Z for zetabytes, and Y for yottabytes. For example, (32T).
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: no storage size in "%s" at column %s
cause: The list of storage destinations contained an entry that specified a non-ASM-based storage destination but did not provide a storage size. Non-ASM-based storage destinations must specify both a storage destination name and a storage size.
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: more than one polling_location in "%s" at column %s
cause: More than one polling_location was specified. Only one polling_location is allowed.
action: Specify only one polling destination directory and retry the operation.

description: ASM polling_location is not supported in "%s" at column %s
cause: The polling_location specified an ASM-based location. Only non-ASM-based polling_locations are supported.
action: Specify one non-ASM polling destination and retry the operation.

description: polling_location must not have storage size in "%s" at column %s
cause: The polling_location contained a size specification. A polling_location must contain only a file specification.
action: Remove the size specification and retry the operation.

description: storage destination do not reference an ASM diskgroup
cause: The storage destination referenced a non-ASM storage location. Only ASM-based storage destinations are allowed. The operation has been rolled back.
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: non-ASM storage destination
cause: The storage destinations (considering both existing and new) contained more than one non-ASM storage destination. Only ASM-based storage destinations are allowed. The operation has been rolled back.
action: Correct the syntax error and retry the operation.

description: requested size %s for %s was too small; already using %s
cause: The size requested for the storage destination was smaller than its current size.
action: Increase the requested size and retry the operation.

description: requested size %s for %s was larger than total available space %s
cause: The size requested for the storage destination was larger than its current used space plus its currect free space.
action: Decrease the requested size and retry the operation.

description: instance %s is not available to Recovery Appliance
cause: The Recovery Appliance could not utilize the specified instance due to its absence from Oracle RAC.
action: Restart the specified instance or repair any connectivity issues with the specified instance.

description: storage location %s allocation size %s does not equal diskgroup %s allocation size %s
cause: The minimum allocation size of the specified storage location was not the same as the specified diskgroup allocation unit size.
action: Specify a different diskgroup or a different storage location and retry the operation.

description: network chunk size %s is not a multiple of diskgroup %s allocation size %s
cause: The configured network chunk size was not a multiple of the specified diskgroup allocation unit size.
action: Specify a different diskgroup or reconfigure the network chunk size and retry the operation.

description: diskgroup %s allocation size %s is not a power of two
cause: The diskgroup allocation unit size was not a power of two.
action: Specify a different diskgroup and retry the operation.

description: diskgroup %s allocation size %s is less than two megabytes %s
cause: The diskgroup allocation unit size was less than two megabytes.
action: Specify a different diskgroup and retry the operation.

description: no containers were created for storage location %s
cause: No storage was allocated and initialized for the specified storage location.
action: Specify a different diskgroup for the storage location, increase the size of the diskgroup, or reduce the size of the storage location and retry the operation.

description: reserved space %s is less than the minimum reservation %s
cause: No storage was allocated and initialized for the specified storage location.
action: Specify a different diskgroup for the storage location, increase the size of the diskgroup, or reduce the size of the storage location and retry the operation.

description: number of drives must be greater than zero
cause: The specified number of tape drives was NULL or was less than or equal to zero.
action: Specify a number of tape drives greater than 0 and retry the operation.

description: number of drives reserved for restore operations must be greater than or equal to zero
cause: The number of tape drives reserved for restore operations was NULL or was less than zero.
action: Specify a number of tape drives reserved for restore operations greater than or equal to zero and retry the operation.

description: number of restore drives %s too large; must be less than %s
cause: The number of tape drives reserved for restore operations was at least as large as the total number of drives available. The number of tape drives reserved for restore operations must be at least one less than the total number of drives available.
action: Specify a number of tape drives reserved for restore operations less than the total number of drives available and retry the operation.

description: number of streams must be greater than zero
cause: The number of streams was less than or equal to zero.
action: Specify a number of streams greater than zero and retry the operation.

description: number of streams %s too large; must be no larger than %s
cause: The number of streams was larger than the total number of drives available. The number of streams must be no larger than the total number of drives available.
action: Reduce the number of available streams and retry the operation.

description: number of copies %s not in the range 1 through 4
cause: The number of copies was either NULL or not in the range 1 through 4 inclusive.
action: Specify a number of copies in the range 1 through 4 and retry the operation.

description: replication server name length %s is too long
cause: The replication server name was longer than 128 characters.
action: Specify a replication server name shorter than 128 characters and retry the operation.

description: replication server proxy port %s must be greater than zero
cause: The replication server proxy port number was less than or equal to zero.
action: Specify a replication server proxy port number greater than zero and retry the operation.

description: replication server proxy URL provided but proxy port is NULL
cause: A replication server proxy URL was provided but a proxy port number was not. If either a proxy URL or a proxy port are specified, both must be specified.
action: Specify both a replication server URL and a replication server proxy port number and retry the operation.

description: replication server proxy port provided but proxy URL is NULL
cause: A replication server proxy port number was provided but a proxy URL was not. If either a proxy URL or a proxy port are specified, both must be specified.
action: Specify both a replication server URL and a replication server proxy port number and retry the operation.

description: HTTP server not configured at replication host
cause: The HTTP server at the replication host site has not been configured.
action: Configure the HTTP server at the replication host site and retry the operation.

description: unable to move individual backup piece with BP_KEY %s; not a KEEP backup
cause: An attempt was made to move an individual backup piece, but the backup set of which this backup piece was a member was not a KEEP backup.
action: Specify a backup piece key that is a member of a KEEP backup set and retry the operation.

description: storage size is less than minimum %s in "%s" at column %s
cause: The specified storage size was less than the minimum required.
action: Specify a larger storage size and retry the operation.

description: unknown incarnation detected at Recovery Appliance, need catalog resync
cause: A new archived log or backup set belonging to the new incarnation was received at Recovery Appliance.
action: Using RMAN, connect to the Recovery Appliance as a recovery catalog, primary database as target database and perform the resynchronization operation using the RESYNC CATALOG RMAN command. If this error occurred at downstream of the Recovery Appliance (in a replicated Recovery Appliance setup), the reconcile operation fixes this error automatically when the same error is fixed at the upstream Recovery Appliance.

description: Task ID %s of type %s has been interrupted %s times.
cause: The specified task was restarted an unexpected number of times. Tasks get interrupted when there is competition for resources. This is only a warning. It does not necessarily indicate a problem with the Recovery Appliance.
action: If these problems persist for long periods, contact Oracle Support Services.

description: unable to copy a full backup of database %s to tape or replicated Recovery Appliance
cause: While creating a full database backup to tape or to a replicated recovery appliance, level 0 backups of one or more data files were missing.
action: Query the RA_SBT_TEMPLATE_MDF view to determine the data files for which backups are missing. If using the "incremental forever" backup strategy, perform a level-0 incremental backup for the given database and retry the operation.

description: guaranteed copy suspended for database %s
